import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import TCSlib.Complexity.Formulas.QBF

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The `ψᵢ` recursion of the `TQBF` hardness proof, at the prefix level

[AB09, Theorem 4.13, the proof]: reachability within `2^i` steps is expressed by
`ψᵢ₊₁(A, B) = ∃ Z ∀ U ∀ V (((U, V) = (A, Z) ∨ (U, V) = (Z, B)) → ψᵢ(U, V))`, which keeps a
single copy of `ψᵢ`. This file proves the prenex form of that recursion correct, generically
in the one-step relation: quantifiers range over **blocks** of `w` consecutive prefix
variables, level `r` of the recursion owns three blocks `Z, U, V` (one existential block, two
universal blocks), and the matrix is the chain of selection implications closed by the
one-step relation (`levelMatrix`). The truth of the prenex formula is the midpoint recursion
`Mid` (`prefixTruth_levelMatrix`), which is a path of exactly `2^r` steps
(`mid_iff_steps`). The flat form of the matrix that a verifier checks — "some level's
selection fails, or the innermost pair is one step" — is `levelMatrix_iff_flat`.

Infrastructure for `Complexity.TQBF_PSPACEHard`; the recursion is [AB09]'s, the block
bookkeeping is not a book result.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.TQBFHard.writeBlock`, `Complexity.TQBFHard.readBlock` — blocks of an assignment.
* `Complexity.TQBFHard.levelQuants` — the quantifier prefix of `r` levels.
* `Complexity.TQBFHard.Sel`, `Complexity.TQBFHard.levelMatrix` — the selection test and the
  prenex matrix.
* `Complexity.TQBFHard.Mid`, `Complexity.TQBFHard.Steps` — the midpoint recursion and paths
  of a given length.

## Main results

* `Complexity.TQBFHard.prefixTruth_replicate_ex`, `prefixTruth_replicate_all` — a block of
  quantifiers is a quantifier over blocks.
* `Complexity.TQBFHard.prefixTruth_levelMatrix` — the prenex `ψ_r` is the midpoint recursion.
  [AB09, Theorem 4.13, proof]
* `Complexity.TQBFHard.prefixTruth_top` — with an existential top record carrying the two
  endpoints.
* `Complexity.TQBFHard.mid_iff_steps` — the midpoint recursion is a path of `2^r` steps.
* `Complexity.TQBFHard.levelMatrix_iff_flat` — the flat form of the matrix.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.2, Theorem 4.13 and its proof, pp. 84-85.)
-/

namespace Complexity

namespace TQBFHard

open QBF

/-! ### Blocks of an assignment -/

/-- The assignment `σ` with the block `β` written at positions `i, …, i + |β| - 1`. -/
def writeBlock (σ : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) (β : List Bool) : ℕ → Bool :=
  fun v => if i ≤ v ∧ v < i + β.length then β.getD (v - i) false else σ v

/-- The block of `w` values of `τ` at positions `i, …, i + w - 1`. -/
def readBlock (τ : ℕ → Bool) (i w : ℕ) : List Bool :=
  List.ofFn fun j : Fin w => τ (i + j)

/-- A read block has its width. -/
@[simp] theorem length_readBlock (τ : ℕ → Bool) (i w : ℕ) : (readBlock τ i w).length = w := by
  simp [readBlock]

/-- Writing a block leaves the positions below it unchanged. -/
theorem writeBlock_of_lt (σ : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) (β : List Bool) {v : ℕ} (hv : v < i) :
    writeBlock σ i β v = σ v := by
  simp only [writeBlock]
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]

/-- Writing a block sets the positions inside it. -/
theorem writeBlock_of_mem (σ : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) (β : List Bool) (j : ℕ) (hj : j < β.length) :
    writeBlock σ i β (i + j) = β.getD j false := by
  simp only [writeBlock]
  rw [if_pos (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]

/-- Writing a one-letter-longer block is updating the first position and writing the rest
one position later. -/
theorem writeBlock_update_cons (σ : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) (b : Bool) (β : List Bool) :
    writeBlock (Function.update σ i b) (i + 1) β = writeBlock σ i (b :: β) := by
  funext v
  simp only [writeBlock, List.length_cons]
  rcases lt_trichotomy v i with h | rfl | h
  · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
  · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_pos (by omega), Function.update_self]
    simp
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, v = i + 1 + j := ⟨v - (i + 1), by omega⟩
    by_cases hj : j < β.length
    · rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos (by omega), show i + 1 + j - (i + 1) = j by omega,
        show i + 1 + j - i = j + 1 by omega]
      simp
    · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]

/-- Writing the empty block changes nothing. -/
@[simp] theorem writeBlock_nil (σ : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) : writeBlock σ i [] = σ := by
  funext v
  simp only [writeBlock, List.length_nil]
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]

/-- A block is read off position by position. -/
theorem readBlock_eq {τ : ℕ → Bool} {i : ℕ} {β : List Bool}
    (h : ∀ j < β.length, τ (i + j) = β.getD j false) : readBlock τ i β.length = β := by
  apply List.ext_getElem (by simp)
  intro j h1 h2
  simp only [readBlock, List.getElem_ofFn]
  rw [h j h2]
  simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, h2]

/-- A block of a given width is read off position by position. -/
theorem readBlock_eq' {τ : ℕ → Bool} {i w : ℕ} {β : List Bool} (hw : β.length = w)
    (h : ∀ j < w, τ (i + j) = β.getD j false) : readBlock τ i w = β := by
  subst hw
  exact readBlock_eq h

/-- A block depends only on the values at its positions. -/
theorem readBlock_congr {τ τ' : ℕ → Bool} {i w : ℕ} (h : ∀ j < w, τ (i + j) = τ' (i + j)) :
    readBlock τ i w = readBlock τ' i w := by
  simp only [readBlock]
  congr 1
  funext j
  exact h j j.isLt

/-! ### Prefix truth: congruence and blocks of quantifiers -/

/-- **Prefix truth sees only the assignment below its start**: two leaves that agree on
every assignment agreeing with `σ` below `i` have the same prefix truth from `(σ, i)`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the prefix; an update at position `i` keeps agreement
below `i + 1` equivalent to agreement below `i` together with the updated value. -/
theorem prefixTruth_congr_agree {P P' : (ℕ → Bool) → Prop} (qs : List Quant) (σ : ℕ → Bool)
    (i : ℕ) (h : ∀ τ : ℕ → Bool, (∀ v < i, τ v = σ v) → (P τ ↔ P' τ)) :
    PrefixTruth P qs σ i ↔ PrefixTruth P' qs σ i := by
  induction qs generalizing σ i with
  | nil => exact h σ (fun _ _ => rfl)
  | cons q qs ih =>
    have h' : ∀ b : Bool, ∀ τ : ℕ → Bool, (∀ v < i + 1, τ v = Function.update σ i b v) →
        (P τ ↔ P' τ) := by
      intro b τ hτ
      apply h τ
      intro v hv
      rw [hτ v (by omega), Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
    cases q with
    | ex => exact exists_congr fun b => ih _ _ (h' b)
    | all => exact forall_congr' fun b => ih _ _ (h' b)

/-- **A block of existential quantifiers is an existential over blocks**: `w` existential
quantifiers from position `i` hold iff some block of `w` values written at `i` makes the
rest hold. (Proved, by induction on `w`.) -/
theorem prefixTruth_replicate_ex (P : (ℕ → Bool) → Prop) (w : ℕ) (rest : List Quant)
    (σ : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    PrefixTruth P (List.replicate w .ex ++ rest) σ i ↔
      ∃ β : List Bool, β.length = w ∧ PrefixTruth P rest (writeBlock σ i β) (i + w) := by
  induction w generalizing σ i with
  | zero =>
    simp only [List.replicate_zero, List.nil_append, Nat.add_zero]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact ⟨[], rfl, by simpa using h⟩
    · rintro ⟨β, hβ, h⟩
      rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff] at hβ
      subst hβ
      simpa using h
  | succ w ih =>
    simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append, PrefixTruth]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
      obtain ⟨β, hβ, h⟩ := (ih _ _).mp hb
      refine ⟨b :: β, by simp [hβ], ?_⟩
      rw [← writeBlock_update_cons, show i + (w + 1) = i + 1 + w by omega]
      exact h
    · rintro ⟨β, hβ, h⟩
      obtain ⟨b, β, rfl⟩ : ∃ b β', β = b :: β' := by
        cases β with
        | nil => simp at hβ
        | cons b β' => exact ⟨b, β', rfl⟩
      refine ⟨b, (ih _ _).mpr ⟨β, by simpa using hβ, ?_⟩⟩
      rw [writeBlock_update_cons, show i + 1 + w = i + (w + 1) by omega]
      exact h

/-- **A block of universal quantifiers is a universal over blocks**: `w` universal
quantifiers from position `i` hold iff every block of `w` values written at `i` makes the
rest hold. (Proved, by induction on `w`.) -/
theorem prefixTruth_replicate_all (P : (ℕ → Bool) → Prop) (w : ℕ) (rest : List Quant)
    (σ : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    PrefixTruth P (List.replicate w .all ++ rest) σ i ↔
      ∀ β : List Bool, β.length = w → PrefixTruth P rest (writeBlock σ i β) (i + w) := by
  induction w generalizing σ i with
  | zero =>
    simp only [List.replicate_zero, List.nil_append, Nat.add_zero]
    constructor
    · intro h β hβ
      rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff] at hβ
      subst hβ
      simpa using h
    · intro h; simpa using h [] rfl
  | succ w ih =>
    simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append, PrefixTruth]
    constructor
    · intro h β hβ
      obtain ⟨b, β, rfl⟩ : ∃ b β', β = b :: β' := by
        cases β with
        | nil => simp at hβ
        | cons b β' => exact ⟨b, β', rfl⟩
      have := (ih _ _).mp (h b) β (by simpa using hβ)
      rwa [writeBlock_update_cons, show i + 1 + w = i + (w + 1) by omega] at this
    · intro h b
      refine (ih _ _).mpr fun β hβ => ?_
      have := h (b :: β) (by simp [hβ])
      rwa [← writeBlock_update_cons, show i + (w + 1) = i + 1 + w by omega] at this

/-- A constant hypothesis commutes with prefix truth (the quantified domain `Bool` is
nonempty). (Proved, by induction on the prefix.) -/
theorem prefixTruth_imp_const (K : Prop) (P : (ℕ → Bool) → Prop) (qs : List Quant)
    (σ : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    PrefixTruth (fun τ => K → P τ) qs σ i ↔ (K → PrefixTruth P qs σ i) := by
  induction qs generalizing σ i with
  | nil => exact Iff.rfl
  | cons q qs ih =>
    cases q with
    | ex =>
      simp only [PrefixTruth]
      rw [exists_congr fun b => ih _ _]
      by_cases hK : K
      · simp [hK]
      · simp [hK]
    | all =>
      simp only [PrefixTruth]
      rw [forall_congr' fun b => ih _ _]
      exact ⟨fun h hK b => h b hK, fun h b hK => h hK b⟩

/-- A constant conjunct commutes with prefix truth (the quantified domain `Bool` is
nonempty). (Proved, by induction on the prefix.) -/
theorem prefixTruth_and_const (K : Prop) (P : (ℕ → Bool) → Prop) (qs : List Quant)
    (σ : ℕ → Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    PrefixTruth (fun τ => K ∧ P τ) qs σ i ↔ (K ∧ PrefixTruth P qs σ i) := by
  induction qs generalizing σ i with
  | nil => exact Iff.rfl
  | cons q qs ih =>
    cases q with
    | ex =>
      simp only [PrefixTruth]
      rw [exists_congr fun b => ih _ _]
      exact ⟨fun ⟨b, hK, h⟩ => ⟨hK, b, h⟩, fun ⟨hK, b, h⟩ => ⟨b, hK, h⟩⟩
    | all =>
      simp only [PrefixTruth]
      rw [forall_congr' fun b => ih _ _]
      exact ⟨fun h => ⟨(h false).1, fun b => (h b).2⟩, fun h b => ⟨h.1, h.2 b⟩⟩

/-! ### The levels of the recursion -/

/-- The quantifier prefix of `r` levels of width `w`: per level, a block of `w`
existentials (the midpoint `Z`) and two blocks of `w` universals (the pair `U, V`). -/
def levelQuants (w : ℕ) : ℕ → List Quant
  | 0 => []
  | r + 1 => List.replicate w .ex ++
      (List.replicate w .all ++ (List.replicate w .all ++ levelQuants w r))

/-- The length of the prefix of `r` levels is `3wr`. -/
theorem length_levelQuants (w r : ℕ) : (levelQuants w r).length = 3 * w * r := by
  induction r with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ r ih => simp only [levelQuants, List.length_append, List.length_replicate, ih]; ring

/-- **The selection test** of [AB09]'s `∀`-folding: the pair `(U, V)` is `(A, Z)` or
`(Z, B)`. -/
def Sel (A B z u v : List Bool) : Prop := (u = A ∧ v = z) ∨ (u = z ∧ v = B)

/-- **The prenex matrix of `r` levels** of width `w` with one-step relation `E`, starting at
position `p` with the outer pair `(A, B)`: level `r + 1` reads its blocks `Z, U, V` at `p`,
`p + w`, `p + 2w`, and if `(U, V)` is selected the matrix of the remaining levels must hold
of `(U, V)` from `p + 3w`; the innermost pair must be one step. -/
def levelMatrix (w : ℕ) (E : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) :
    ℕ → ℕ → List Bool → List Bool → (ℕ → Bool) → Prop
  | 0, _, A, B, _ => E A B
  | r + 1, p, A, B, τ =>
    Sel A B (readBlock τ p w) (readBlock τ (p + w) w) (readBlock τ (p + 2 * w) w) →
      levelMatrix w E r (p + 3 * w) (readBlock τ (p + w) w) (readBlock τ (p + 2 * w) w) τ

/-- **The midpoint recursion** of [AB09, Theorem 4.13]: `Mid 0 = E`, and `Mid (r + 1) A B`
says that some block `Z` of width `w` has `Mid r A Z` and `Mid r Z B`. -/
def Mid (w : ℕ) (E : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) : ℕ → List Bool → List Bool → Prop
  | 0, A, B => E A B
  | r + 1, A, B => ∃ z : List Bool, z.length = w ∧ Mid w E r A z ∧ Mid w E r z B

/-- **The prenex `ψ_r` is the midpoint recursion** ([AB09, Theorem 4.13, the proof]): for
blocks `A, B` of width `w`, the prefix of `r` levels from position `p` holds of the level
matrix iff `Mid r A B`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `r`. A level is three blocks of quantifiers
(`prefixTruth_replicate_ex`, `prefixTruth_replicate_all`); once `Z, U, V` are written, the
matrix reads exactly them (`readBlock_eq`, `prefixTruth_congr_agree`), and the selection
hypothesis is a constant (`prefixTruth_imp_const`). By induction the inner prefix is
`Mid r U V`, and `∃ Z ∀ U V, Sel → Mid r U V` is `∃ Z, Mid r A Z ∧ Mid r Z B` (take
`(U, V) = (A, Z)` and `(Z, B)`). -/
theorem prefixTruth_levelMatrix (w : ℕ) (E : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (r : ℕ) :
    ∀ (p : ℕ) (σ : ℕ → Bool) (A B : List Bool), A.length = w → B.length = w →
      (PrefixTruth (levelMatrix w E r p A B) (levelQuants w r) σ p ↔ Mid w E r A B) := by
  induction r with
  | zero => intro p σ A B _ _; exact Iff.rfl
  | succ r ih =>
    intro p σ A B hA hB
    simp only [levelQuants]
    rw [prefixTruth_replicate_ex]
    simp only [prefixTruth_replicate_all]
    -- the inner prefix, for fixed blocks
    have key : ∀ z u v : List Bool, z.length = w → u.length = w → v.length = w →
        (PrefixTruth (levelMatrix w E (r + 1) p A B) (levelQuants w r)
          (writeBlock (writeBlock (writeBlock σ p z) (p + w) u) (p + w + w) v) (p + w + w + w) ↔
          (Sel A B z u v → Mid w E r u v)) := by
      intro z u v hz hu hv
      set σ' := writeBlock (writeBlock (writeBlock σ p z) (p + w) u) (p + w + w) v
      have hread : ∀ τ : ℕ → Bool, (∀ x < p + w + w + w, τ x = σ' x) →
          readBlock τ p w = z ∧ readBlock τ (p + w) w = u ∧ readBlock τ (p + 2 * w) w = v := by
        intro τ hτ
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · apply readBlock_eq' hz
          intro j hj
          rw [hτ _ (by omega)]
          simp only [σ']
          rw [writeBlock_of_lt _ (p + w + w) v (show p + j < p + w + w by omega),
            writeBlock_of_lt _ (p + w) u (show p + j < p + w by omega),
            writeBlock_of_mem _ p z j (by omega)]
        · apply readBlock_eq' hu
          intro j hj
          rw [hτ _ (by omega)]
          simp only [σ']
          rw [writeBlock_of_lt _ (p + w + w) v (show p + w + j < p + w + w by omega),
            writeBlock_of_mem _ (p + w) u j (by omega)]
        · apply readBlock_eq' hv
          intro j hj
          rw [hτ _ (by omega)]
          simp only [σ']
          rw [show p + 2 * w + j = p + w + w + j by omega,
            writeBlock_of_mem _ (p + w + w) v j (by omega)]
      rw [prefixTruth_congr_agree (P' := fun τ => Sel A B z u v →
          levelMatrix w E r (p + w + w + w) u v τ) _ _ _ (fun τ hτ => by
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hread τ hτ
        simp only [levelMatrix, h1, h2, h3, show p + 3 * w = p + w + w + w by omega])]
      rw [prefixTruth_imp_const, ih _ _ _ _ hu hv]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, h⟩
      refine ⟨z, hz, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ((key z A z hz hA hz).mp (h A hA z hz)) (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
      · exact ((key z z B hz hz hB).mp (h z hz B hB)) (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, h1, h2⟩
      refine ⟨z, hz, fun u hu v hv => (key z u v hz hu hv).mpr ?_⟩
      rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
      · exact h1
      · exact h2

/-- **The whole prefix**: an existential top record of three blocks (a pad `Z₀`, the source
`A` and the target `B`), followed by `R` levels. With the leaf "`I A`, `J B`, and the matrix
of the `R` levels from position `3w` on `(A, B)`", the prefix holds iff some blocks `A, B` of
width `w` have `I A`, `J B` and `Mid R A B`.

**Proof sketch.** The three existential blocks (`prefixTruth_replicate_ex`); below position
`3w` the assignment is fixed, so the leaf is `I A ∧ J B ∧ matrix` with constant conjuncts
(`prefixTruth_congr_agree`, `prefixTruth_and_const`); then `prefixTruth_levelMatrix`. -/
theorem prefixTruth_top (w : ℕ) (E : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (I J : List Bool → Prop)
    (R : ℕ) (σ : ℕ → Bool) :
    PrefixTruth (fun τ => I (readBlock τ w w) ∧ J (readBlock τ (2 * w) w) ∧
        levelMatrix w E R (3 * w) (readBlock τ w w) (readBlock τ (2 * w) w) τ)
      (List.replicate w .ex ++ (List.replicate w .ex ++ (List.replicate w .ex ++
        levelQuants w R))) σ 0 ↔
      ∃ A B : List Bool, A.length = w ∧ B.length = w ∧ I A ∧ J B ∧ Mid w E R A B := by
  simp only [prefixTruth_replicate_ex]
  have key : ∀ z a b : List Bool, z.length = w → a.length = w → b.length = w →
      (PrefixTruth (fun τ => I (readBlock τ w w) ∧ J (readBlock τ (2 * w) w) ∧
          levelMatrix w E R (3 * w) (readBlock τ w w) (readBlock τ (2 * w) w) τ)
        (levelQuants w R)
        (writeBlock (writeBlock (writeBlock σ 0 z) (0 + w) a) (0 + w + w) b) (0 + w + w + w) ↔
        I a ∧ J b ∧ Mid w E R a b) := by
    intro z a b hz ha hb
    set σ' := writeBlock (writeBlock (writeBlock σ 0 z) (0 + w) a) (0 + w + w) b
    have hread : ∀ τ : ℕ → Bool, (∀ x < 0 + w + w + w, τ x = σ' x) →
        readBlock τ w w = a ∧ readBlock τ (2 * w) w = b := by
      intro τ hτ
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · apply readBlock_eq' ha
        intro j hj
        rw [hτ _ (by omega)]
        simp only [σ']
        rw [writeBlock_of_lt _ (0 + w + w) b (show w + j < 0 + w + w by omega),
          show w + j = 0 + w + j by omega, writeBlock_of_mem _ (0 + w) a j (by omega)]
      · apply readBlock_eq' hb
        intro j hj
        rw [hτ _ (by omega)]
        simp only [σ']
        rw [show 2 * w + j = 0 + w + w + j by omega, writeBlock_of_mem _ (0 + w + w) b j (by omega)]
    rw [prefixTruth_congr_agree (P' := fun τ => I a ∧ J b ∧ levelMatrix w E R (0 + w + w + w) a b τ)
      _ _ _ (fun τ hτ => by
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hread τ hτ
        rw [h1, h2, show 3 * w = 0 + w + w + w by omega])]
    rw [prefixTruth_and_const, prefixTruth_and_const, prefixTruth_levelMatrix w E R _ _ _ _ ha hb]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, a, ha, b, hb, h⟩
    exact ⟨a, b, ha, hb, (key z a b hz ha hb).mp h⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, h⟩
    exact ⟨List.replicate w false, by simp, a, ha, b, hb,
      (key _ a b (by simp) ha hb).mpr h⟩

/-! ### Paths -/

/-- Paths of exactly `k` steps of `E` through blocks of width `w`. -/
def Steps (w : ℕ) (E : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) : ℕ → List Bool → List Bool → Prop
  | 0, A, B => A = B
  | k + 1, A, B => ∃ z : List Bool, z.length = w ∧ Steps w E k A z ∧ E z B

/-- **Paths compose**: between blocks of width `w`, a path of `k + m` steps is a path of `k`
steps to some block of width `w` followed by a path of `m` steps. (Proved, by induction on
`m`.) -/
theorem steps_add (w : ℕ) (E : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (A B : List Bool), A.length = w → B.length = w →
      (Steps w E (k + m) A B ↔ ∃ z : List Bool, z.length = w ∧ Steps w E k A z ∧
        Steps w E m z B) := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro A B _ hB
    simp only [Nat.add_zero, Steps]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨B, hB, h, rfl⟩, fun ⟨z, _, h, hz⟩ => hz ▸ h⟩
  | succ m ih =>
    intro A B hA hB
    rw [show k + (m + 1) = (k + m) + 1 by omega]
    simp only [Steps]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, h1, h2⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz, h3, h4⟩ := (ih A y hA hy).mp h1
      exact ⟨z, hz, h3, y, hy, h4, h2⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, h1, y, hy, h2, h3⟩
      exact ⟨y, hy, (ih A y hA hy).mpr ⟨z, hz, h1, h2⟩, h3⟩

/-- **The midpoint recursion is a path of `2^r` steps** between blocks of width `w`.
(Proved, by induction on `r` with `steps_add`.) -/
theorem mid_iff_steps (w : ℕ) (E : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (r : ℕ) :
    ∀ A B : List Bool, A.length = w → B.length = w →
      (Mid w E r A B ↔ Steps w E (2 ^ r) A B) := by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    intro A B hA _
    simp only [Mid, Steps]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨A, hA, rfl, h⟩, fun ⟨z, _, hz, h⟩ => hz ▸ h⟩
  | succ r ih =>
    intro A B hA hB
    rw [pow_succ, Nat.mul_two, steps_add w E _ _ A B hA hB]
    simp only [Mid]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, h1, h2⟩
      exact ⟨z, hz, (ih A z hA hz).mp h1, (ih z B hz hB).mp h2⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, h1, h2⟩
      exact ⟨z, hz, (ih A z hA hz).mpr h1, (ih z B hz hB).mpr h2⟩

/-! ### The flat matrix -/

/-- The midpoint block of record `j` (records are `3w` positions long). -/
def zRec (τ : ℕ → Bool) (w j : ℕ) : List Bool := readBlock τ (3 * w * j) w

/-- The first pair block of record `j`. -/
def uRec (τ : ℕ → Bool) (w j : ℕ) : List Bool := readBlock τ (3 * w * j + w) w

/-- The second pair block of record `j`. -/
def vRec (τ : ℕ → Bool) (w j : ℕ) : List Bool := readBlock τ (3 * w * j + 2 * w) w

/-- **The flat form of the matrix**: the matrix of `r` levels on the pair of record `j`
holds iff some level `j + i + 1` (`i < r`) is not selected by its parent `j + i`, or the
pair of record `j + r` is one step.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `r`: an implication `S → X` is `¬S ∨ X`, and the failed
selection at the first level is the case `i = 0`. -/
theorem levelMatrix_iff_flat (w : ℕ) (E : List Bool → List Bool → Prop) (τ : ℕ → Bool)
    (r : ℕ) : ∀ j : ℕ,
      levelMatrix w E r (3 * w * (j + 1)) (uRec τ w j) (vRec τ w j) τ ↔
        (∃ i < r, ¬ Sel (uRec τ w (j + i)) (vRec τ w (j + i)) (zRec τ w (j + i + 1))
          (uRec τ w (j + i + 1)) (vRec τ w (j + i + 1))) ∨
        E (uRec τ w (j + r)) (vRec τ w (j + r)) := by
  induction r with
  | zero => intro j; simp [levelMatrix]
  | succ r ih =>
    intro j
    have hp : 3 * w * (j + 1) + 3 * w = 3 * w * (j + 1 + 1) := by ring
    simp only [levelMatrix]
    rw [hp]
    change (Sel (uRec τ w j) (vRec τ w j) (zRec τ w (j + 1)) (uRec τ w (j + 1))
        (vRec τ w (j + 1)) → levelMatrix w E r (3 * w * (j + 1 + 1)) (uRec τ w (j + 1))
          (vRec τ w (j + 1)) τ) ↔ _
    rw [ih (j + 1)]
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_cases hs : Sel (uRec τ w j) (vRec τ w j) (zRec τ w (j + 1)) (uRec τ w (j + 1))
          (vRec τ w (j + 1))
      · rcases h hs with ⟨i, hi, hn⟩ | he
        · exact Or.inl ⟨i + 1, by omega, by
            simpa only [show j + (i + 1) = j + 1 + i by omega] using hn⟩
        · exact Or.inr (by simpa only [show j + (r + 1) = j + 1 + r by omega] using he)
      · exact Or.inl ⟨0, by omega, by simpa using hs⟩
    · rintro (⟨i, hi, hn⟩ | he) hs
      · rcases i with _ | i
        · exact absurd hs (by simpa using hn)
        · exact Or.inl ⟨i, by omega, by
            simpa only [show j + (i + 1) = j + 1 + i by omega] using hn⟩
      · exact Or.inr (by simpa only [show j + (r + 1) = j + 1 + r by omega] using he)

end TQBFHard

end Complexity
```

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.DAGCircuitSat
import TCSlib.Complexity.Formulas.QBF
import TCSlib.Complexity.Formulas.CNFEncoding

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Tseitin after the prefix, for circuits

[AB09, §4.2, p. 83]: a quantified formula whose matrix is a circuit becomes one with a CNF
matrix by the auxiliary variables of the Cook-Levin proof (Tseitin's transformation),
quantified existentially **after** the whole prefix. This file supplies the pointwise fact
that `Complexity.QBF.truth_exSuffix_of_pointwise` asks for, for the Tseitin formula
`BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.toCNF` of a fan-in-two circuit (inputs are variables `0, …, n - 1`,
gate `i` is variable `n + i`): for **every** assignment `σ`, some assignment agreeing with
`σ` on the inputs satisfies the Tseitin formula iff the circuit outputs `1` on `σ`'s inputs.
It also bounds the variables of a CNF by the length of its serialization, which is how the
reduction counts the auxiliary variables.

**Duplication disclosure.** The backward direction re-proves the private
`BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.values_getD_eq_of_eval_tseitinGates` of
`TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.DAGCircuitSat` (a strong induction over the vertices,
from the public `BoolCircuit.eval_tseitinGates` and `BoolCircuit.DAGGate.eval_tseitin`),
since only the existential closure `satisfiable_iff_toCNF_satisfiable` is public there;
promoting the private lemma would delete this copy.

## Main results

* `Complexity.TQBFHard.toCNF_extension_iff` — the pointwise Tseitin lemma. [AB09, §4.2,
  p. 83; Lemma 6.11's construction]
* `Complexity.TQBFHard.numVars_le_length_serialize` — a CNF has fewer variables than its
  serialization has letters.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.2, p. 83; §6.1.2, Lemma 6.11.)
-/

namespace Complexity

namespace TQBFHard

open BoolCircuit Std.Sat

/-- An assignment satisfying every gate clause agrees, at every vertex, with the circuit's
values on the input it assigns to the input vertices (fan-in at most two). (A re-proof of the
private `values_getD_eq_of_eval_tseitinGates`, see the module docstring; by strong induction
on the vertex.) -/
theorem values_getD_eq_of_eval_tseitinGates {n : ℕ} (C : DAGCircuit n)
    (hC : ∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.args.length ≤ 2) (a : ℕ → Bool)
    (ha : (tseitinGates n C.gates).eval a = true) :
    ∀ v, v < n + C.gates.length → (C.values fun i => a i).getD v false = a v := by
  rw [eval_tseitinGates] at ha
  intro v
  induction v using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ v ih =>
    intro hv
    by_cases hvn : v < n
    · simpa using C.values_getD_input (fun i => a i) ⟨v, hvn⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, v = n + i := ⟨v - n, by omega⟩
      have hi : i < C.gates.length := by omega
      rw [C.values_getD_gate _ hi]
      refine ((DAGGate.eval_tseitin _ _ (hC _ (List.getElem_mem hi)) a _ ?_).mp
        (ha i hi)).symm
      intro u hu
      have hlt := C.args_lt i hi u hu
      exact ih u hlt (by omega)

/-- **Tseitin after the prefix, pointwise** ([AB09, §4.2, p. 83], with the Tseitin formula of
Lemma 6.11): for a circuit of fan-in at most two and **any** assignment `σ`, some assignment
agreeing with `σ` on the input variables `0, …, n - 1` satisfies the Tseitin formula iff the
circuit outputs `1` on the inputs `σ 0, …, σ (n - 1)`.

**Proof sketch.** (⇐) Assign every vertex its value on `σ`'s inputs: the inputs agree with `σ`
(`values_getD_input`), each gate's clauses hold (`DAGGate.eval_tseitin`,
`values_getD_gate`), and the output clause is the output. (⇒) By
`values_getD_eq_of_eval_tseitinGates` the satisfying assignment carries the circuit's values
on its own inputs, which are `σ`'s; the output clause makes the output `1`. -/
theorem toCNF_extension_iff {n : ℕ} (C : DAGCircuit n) (hC : ∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.args.length ≤ 2)
    (σ : ℕ → Bool) :
    (∃ τ : ℕ → Bool, (∀ v < n, τ v = σ v) ∧ C.toCNF.eval τ = true) ↔
      C.eval (fun i => σ i) = true := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨τ, hag, hτ⟩
    simp only [DAGCircuit.toCNF, CNF.eval_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] at hτ
    obtain ⟨hout, hgates⟩ := hτ
    have hin : (fun i : Fin n => σ i.val) = fun i : Fin n => τ i.val :=
      funext fun (i : Fin n) => (hag i.val i.isLt).symm
    rw [hin, DAGCircuit.eval,
      values_getD_eq_of_eval_tseitinGates C hC τ hgates _ C.output_lt]
    simpa [CNF.Clause.eval] using hout
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun v => (C.values fun i => σ i).getD v false, fun v hv => ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using C.values_getD_input (fun i => σ i) ⟨v, hv⟩
    · simp only [DAGCircuit.toCNF, CNF.eval_cons, Bool.and_eq_true]
      refine ⟨by simpa [CNF.Clause.eval, DAGCircuit.eval] using h, ?_⟩
      rw [eval_tseitinGates]
      intro i hi
      rw [DAGGate.eval_tseitin _ _ (hC _ (List.getElem_mem hi)) _ (C.values fun i => σ i)
        (fun _ _ => rfl)]
      exact C.values_getD_gate _ hi

/-- A list's image under a member of a family is no longer than the flattened family. -/
private theorem length_le_length_flatMap {α β : Type} {f : α → List β} {a : α} {l : List α}
    (h : a ∈ l) : (f a).length ≤ (l.flatMap f).length := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons b l ih =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.length_append]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with rfl | h
    · omega
    · have := ih h; omega

/-- A right fold of `max` from `0` is at most a common bound of the list. -/
private theorem foldr_max_le {L : List ℕ} {B : ℕ} (h : ∀ a ∈ L, a ≤ B) : L.foldr max 0 ≤ B := by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a L ih =>
    simp only [List.foldr_cons]
    exact max_le (h a (by simp)) (ih fun b hb => h b (by simp [hb]))

/-- **A CNF has fewer variables than its serialization has letters**: every literal `(v, b)`
is serialized as `1^(v+1) 0 b` (`Std.Sat.CNF.serializeLit`), so `numVars ≤ |serialize φ|`.
(Proved, from the serialization's shape.) -/
theorem numVars_le_length_serialize (φ : CNF ℕ) : φ.numVars ≤ (CNF.serialize φ).length := by
  unfold CNF.numVars
  apply foldr_max_le
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨C, hC, ha⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp ha
  obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
  have h1 : (CNF.serializeLit l).length ≤ (C.flatMap CNF.serializeLit).length :=
    length_le_length_flatMap hl
  have h2 : (true :: CNF.serializeClause C).length ≤
      (φ.flatMap fun C => true :: CNF.serializeClause C).length :=
    length_le_length_flatMap (f := fun C => true :: CNF.serializeClause C) hC
  have h3 : (φ.flatMap fun C => true :: CNF.serializeClause C).length ≤
      (CNF.serialize φ).length := by
    simp [CNF.serialize]
  have h4 : (C.flatMap CNF.serializeLit).length ≤ (true :: CNF.serializeClause C).length := by
    simp only [CNF.serializeClause, List.length_cons, List.length_append]
    omega
  have h5 : (CNF.serializeLit l).length = l.1 + 3 := by
    simp [CNF.serializeLit]
  omega

end TQBFHard

end Complexity
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/ClassPSPACE/TQBFHardVerifier.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardMachine
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.PolyTimePairing
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Primitives
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.PolyTimeBlockTests
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.PolyTimePrefix
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.Transducer
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.P
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ConfigCount
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Deciders
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.StepDecider

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The polynomial-time verifier of the `TQBF` matrix

The `TQBF` reduction writes the matrix of its quantified formula as a circuit, the uniform
tableau of a polynomial-time machine (`Complexity.cfgTab`). This file builds that machine's
function: `predB y`, on `y = ⟨x, σ⟩` with `σ` an assignment of the prefix variables, checks

* the code-word prefix of the block at `w` is the initial code (`Complexity.Codec.initLang`),
* the code-word prefix of the block at `2w` is an accepting code (`Complexity.Codec.acceptLang`),
* and either the pair of the innermost record is one step (equal blocks, or code prefixes
  forming a step pair, `Complexity.Codec.stepLang`), or some record's pair is not selected
  by its parent's pair and midpoint (the flat form of the `ψ` matrix,
  `Complexity.TQBFHard.levelMatrix_iff_flat`).

The block width is `w = A (n + 1)^a` and the window radius `2d (n + 1)^c`, for parameters
fixed by the reduction. `predB` is polynomial-time (`polyTimeComputable_predB`): the three
code languages are in `L ⊆ P` (`Complexity.LOGSPACE_subset_P`), blocks are cut out by the
length-gated prefix operations, the radius is converted to binary by the library's
linear-time binary length counter (`Turing.FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits` with
`Complexity.polyTimeComputable_of_linear`), and the disjunction over records is the OR-flag
block loop `Complexity.BlockLoop.polyTimeComputable_orLoop`. On an input whose second
component is an assignment of the prefix variables, it is the flat matrix (`predB_iff`).

Infrastructure for `Complexity.TQBF_PSPACEHard`; not itself a book result. [AB09, Theorem
4.13]'s proof says the formula "can be computed in polynomial time" without detail; this is
that computation's matrix half.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.TQBFHard.predB` — the verifier.

## Main results

* `Complexity.TQBFHard.polyTimeComputable_predB` — the verifier is polynomial-time.
* `Complexity.TQBFHard.predB_iff` — on an assignment it is the flat matrix.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.2, Theorem 4.13; §4.1, `L ⊆ P`, p. 112.)
-/

namespace Complexity

namespace TQBFHard

open Turing Codec

/-! ### Polynomial-time building blocks -/

/-- Dropping a polynomial-time unary amount from a polynomial-time word is polynomial-time
(`Complexity.PrefixByLength.drop`). -/
theorem pt_drop {o : List Bool → ℕ} {S : List Bool → List Bool}
    (ho : PolyTimeComputable fun y => List.replicate (o y) true) (hS : PolyTimeComputable S) :
    PolyTimeComputable fun y => (S y).drop (o y) := by
  have := polyTimeComputable_dropPrefixByLength.comp (ho.pairEncode hS)
  convert this using 1
  funext y
  simp [Function.comp, PrefixByLength.drop]

/-- Taking a polynomial-time unary amount of a polynomial-time word is polynomial-time
(`Complexity.PrefixByLength.take`). -/
theorem pt_take {o : List Bool → ℕ} {S : List Bool → List Bool}
    (ho : PolyTimeComputable fun y => List.replicate (o y) true) (hS : PolyTimeComputable S) :
    PolyTimeComputable fun y => (S y).take (o y) := by
  have := polyTimeComputable_takePrefixByLength.comp (ho.pairEncode hS)
  convert this using 1
  funext y
  simp [Function.comp, PrefixByLength.take]

/-- A fixed multiple of the length of a polynomial-time word, in unary, is polynomial-time. -/
theorem pt_rep_mul (k : ℕ) {g : List Bool → List Bool} (hg : PolyTimeComputable g) :
    PolyTimeComputable fun y => List.replicate (k * (g y).length) true := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using polyTimeComputable_const []
  | succ k ih =>
    have := ih.append (polyTimeComputable_unary.comp hg)
    convert this using 1
    funext y
    rw [Nat.succ_mul, List.replicate_add]
    rfl

/-- The one-pass filter keeping the `1`s of a word. -/
def keepTrue (l : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  transduce (σ := Unit) (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ b => if b then some true else none) () l

/-- The filter is empty iff the word has no `1`. -/
theorem keepTrue_eq_nil_iff (l : List Bool) : keepTrue l = [] ↔ ∀ b ∈ l, b = false := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [keepTrue, transduce]
  | cons b l ih =>
    cases b
    · simpa [keepTrue, transduce] using ih
    · simp [keepTrue, transduce]

/-- Two words are equal iff they have the same length and their bitwise XOR has no `1`. -/
theorem eq_iff_xor (u v : List Bool) :
    u = v ↔ u.length = v.length ∧ ∀ b ∈ List.zipWith xor u v, b = false := by
  induction u generalizing v with
  | nil => cases v <;> simp
  | cons a u ih =>
    cases v with
    | nil => simp
    | cons b v =>
      simp only [List.cons.injEq, List.length_cons, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff,
        List.zipWith_cons_cons, List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp, ih v]
      cases a <;> cases b <;> simp

/-- **Equality of two polynomial-time words is polynomial-time** (as a one-bit verdict):
the length test (`Complexity.polyTimeComputable_lenEq`) and the emptiness test of the
`1`s of the bitwise XOR (`Complexity.polyTimeComputable_xorD`). -/
theorem pt_eq {f g : List Bool → List Bool} (hf : PolyTimeComputable f)
    (hg : PolyTimeComputable g) : PolyTimeComputable fun y => [decide (f y = g y)] := by
  have hp := hf.pairEncode hg
  have h1 := polyTimeComputable_lenEq.comp hp
  have h2 := (polyTimeComputable_isNil.comp
    ((polyTimeComputable_transduce (σ := Unit) (fun _ _ => ())
      (fun _ b => if b then some true else none) ()).comp
      (polyTimeComputable_xorD.comp hp)))
  have h := polyTimeComputable_and h1 h2
  convert h using 1
  funext y
  simp only [Function.comp, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, xorD_pairEncode]
  congr 1
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_iff,
    decide_eq_true_iff, eq_iff_xor (f y) (g y)]
  exact and_congr_right fun _ => (keepTrue_eq_nil_iff _).symm

/-- **A logarithmic-space language has a polynomial-time indicator** (`L ⊆ P`,
`Complexity.LOGSPACE_subset_P`, with `Complexity.mem_P_iff`). -/
theorem pt_indicator {L : Language Bool} (hL : L ∈ LOGSPACE) :
    PolyTimeComputable fun z => [MultiTapeTM.indicator L z] := by
  obtain ⟨C, c, M, hM⟩ := mem_P_iff.mp (LOGSPACE_subset_P hL)
  exact ⟨M, C, c, hM⟩

/-! ### The parameters and the verifier -/

variable (N : FinNDTM Bool) (d c A a : ℕ)

/-- The window radius `2d (n + 1)^c` at input length `n`. -/
def vrad (n : ℕ) : ℕ := 2 * d * (n + 1) ^ c

/-- The block width `A (n + 1)^a` at input length `n`. -/
def vwid (n : ℕ) : ℕ := A * (n + 1) ^ a

/-- The code-word length at input length `n` and radius `vrad n`. -/
def vlen (n : ℕ) : ℕ := codeLen N n (vrad d c n)

/-- The code-word prefix of the block at offset `off` of the assignment part of `y`. -/
def cpAt (y : List Bool) (off : ℕ) : List Bool :=
  ((pairSndD y).drop off).take (vlen N d c (pairFstD y).length)

/-- The block at offset `off` of the assignment part of `y`. -/
def blkAt (y : List Bool) (off : ℕ) : List Bool :=
  ((pairSndD y).drop off).take (vwid A a (pairFstD y).length)

/-- The initial-code test on the block at `w`. -/
noncomputable def initB (y : List Bool) : Bool :=
  MultiTapeTM.indicator (initLang N) (pairEncode (pairFstD y)
    (pairEncode (cpAt N d c y (vwid A a (pairFstD y).length))
      (Nat.bits (vrad d c (pairFstD y).length))))

/-- The accepting-code test on the block at `2w`. -/
noncomputable def accB (y : List Bool) : Bool :=
  MultiTapeTM.indicator (acceptLang N) (pairEncode (pairFstD y)
    (pairEncode (cpAt N d c y (2 * vwid A a (pairFstD y).length))
      (Nat.bits (vrad d c (pairFstD y).length))))

/-- The one-step test on the innermost record's pair (record `w`, blocks at `3w·w + w` and
`3w·w + 2w`): equal blocks, or code prefixes forming a step pair. -/
noncomputable def baseB (y : List Bool) : Bool :=
  let w := vwid A a (pairFstD y).length
  decide (blkAt A a y (3 * w * w + w) = blkAt A a y (3 * w * w + 2 * w)) ||
    MultiTapeTM.indicator (stepLang N) (pairEncode (pairFstD y)
      (pairEncode (cpAt N d c y (3 * w * w + w)) (pairEncode (cpAt N d c y (3 * w * w + 2 * w))
        (Nat.bits (vrad d c (pairFstD y).length)))))

/-- The block `k` of a window `⟨⟨x, 1^w⟩, rest⟩`: the `w` letters of `rest` from `k w`. -/
def winBlk (q : List Bool) (k : ℕ) : List Bool :=
  ((pairSndD q).drop (k * (pairSndD (pairFstD q)).length)).take
    (pairSndD (pairFstD q)).length

/-- **The selection test on a window** `⟨⟨x, 1^w⟩, rest⟩` whose `rest` starts with two
records `Z, A, B, Z', U', V'` (blocks `0, …, 5`): `(U', V') = (A, Z')` or `(Z', B)`. -/
def selT (q : List Bool) : Bool :=
  (decide (winBlk q 4 = winBlk q 1) && decide (winBlk q 5 = winBlk q 3)) ||
    (decide (winBlk q 4 = winBlk q 3) && decide (winBlk q 5 = winBlk q 2))

/-- The window of record `j`: the header `⟨x, 1^w⟩` and the assignment from `3wj`. -/
def lvlQ (y : List Bool) (j : ℕ) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode (pairEncode (pairFstD y) (List.replicate (vwid A a (pairFstD y).length) true))
    ((pairSndD y).drop (3 * vwid A a (pairFstD y).length * j))

/-- Some record `j < w` has its successor not selected. -/
def orB (y : List Bool) : Bool :=
  (List.range (vwid A a (pairFstD y).length)).any fun j => !selT (lvlQ A a y j)

/-- **The verifier**: initial block, accepting block, and the flat `ψ` matrix. -/
noncomputable def predB (y : List Bool) : Bool :=
  initB N d c A a y && accB N d c A a y && (baseB N d c A a y || orB A a y)

/-! ### Polynomial time -/

/-- The block width in unary. -/
theorem pt_vwid : PolyTimeComputable fun y => List.replicate (vwid A a (pairFstD y).length) true :=
  (polyTimeComputable_polyUnary A a).comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD

/-- A fixed multiple, plus a fixed multiple of the square, of the block width, in unary. -/
theorem pt_vwid_lin (k l : ℕ) : PolyTimeComputable fun y =>
    List.replicate (k * vwid A a (pairFstD y).length * vwid A a (pairFstD y).length +
      l * vwid A a (pairFstD y).length) true := by
  have h1 : PolyTimeComputable fun y =>
      List.replicate (k * A * A * ((pairFstD y).length + 1) ^ (a + a)) true :=
    (polyTimeComputable_polyUnary (k * A * A) (a + a)).comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have h2 : PolyTimeComputable fun y =>
      List.replicate (l * A * ((pairFstD y).length + 1) ^ a) true :=
    (polyTimeComputable_polyUnary (l * A) a).comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  convert h1.append h2 using 1
  funext y
  rw [← List.replicate_add]
  congr 1
  simp only [vwid, pow_add]
  ring

/-- The radius in binary. -/
theorem pt_bits_vrad : PolyTimeComputable fun y => Nat.bits (vrad d c (pairFstD y).length) := by
  have := (polyTimeComputable_of_linear FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits).comp
    ((polyTimeComputable_polyUnary (2 * d) c).comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD)
  convert this using 1
  funext y
  simp [vrad]

/-- The code-word length in unary: `4dW (n + 1)^c + (W + 1) + |bits (n + 1)|`. -/
theorem pt_vlen :
    PolyTimeComputable fun y => List.replicate (vlen N d c (pairFstD y).length) true := by
  have h1 : PolyTimeComputable fun y =>
      List.replicate (4 * d * W N * ((pairFstD y).length + 1) ^ c) true :=
    (polyTimeComputable_polyUnary (4 * d * W N) c).comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have h2 : PolyTimeComputable fun _ : List Bool => List.replicate (W N + 1) true :=
    polyTimeComputable_const _
  have h3 : PolyTimeComputable fun y =>
      List.replicate (Nat.bits ((pairFstD y) ++ [true]).length).length true :=
    polyTimeComputable_unary.comp
      ((polyTimeComputable_of_linear FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits).comp
        (polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.append (polyTimeComputable_const [true])))
  convert (h1.append h2).append h3 using 1
  funext y
  rw [← List.replicate_add, ← List.replicate_add]
  congr 1
  simp only [vlen, codeLen, vrad, wP, List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
  ring

/-- Code-word prefixes at a polynomial-time unary offset are polynomial-time. -/
theorem pt_cpAt {o : List Bool → ℕ} (ho : PolyTimeComputable fun y => List.replicate (o y) true) :
    PolyTimeComputable fun y => cpAt N d c y (o y) :=
  pt_take (pt_vlen N d c) (pt_drop ho polyTimeComputable_pairSndD)

/-- Blocks at a polynomial-time unary offset are polynomial-time. -/
theorem pt_blkAt {o : List Bool → ℕ} (ho : PolyTimeComputable fun y => List.replicate (o y) true) :
    PolyTimeComputable fun y => blkAt A a y (o y) :=
  pt_take (pt_vwid A a) (pt_drop ho polyTimeComputable_pairSndD)

/-- The initial-code test is polynomial-time. -/
theorem pt_initB : PolyTimeComputable fun y => [initB N d c A a y] := by
  have hcp := pt_cpAt N d c (pt_vwid A a)
  exact (pt_indicator (initLang_mem (N := N))).comp (polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.pairEncode
    (hcp.pairEncode (pt_bits_vrad d c)))

/-- The accepting-code test is polynomial-time. -/
theorem pt_accB : PolyTimeComputable fun y => [accB N d c A a y] := by
  have h2 : PolyTimeComputable fun y =>
      List.replicate (2 * vwid A a (pairFstD y).length) true := by
    have := pt_vwid_lin A a 0 2
    simpa using this
  have hcp := pt_cpAt N d c h2
  exact (pt_indicator (acceptLang_mem (N := N))).comp (polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.pairEncode
    (hcp.pairEncode (pt_bits_vrad d c)))

/-- The innermost one-step test is polynomial-time. -/
theorem pt_baseB : PolyTimeComputable fun y => [baseB N d c A a y] := by
  have hu := pt_vwid_lin A a 3 1
  have hv := pt_vwid_lin A a 3 2
  simp only [Nat.one_mul] at hu
  have heq := pt_eq (pt_blkAt A a hu) (pt_blkAt A a hv)
  have hst := (pt_indicator (stepLang_mem (N := N))).comp (polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.pairEncode
    ((pt_cpAt N d c hu).pairEncode ((pt_cpAt N d c hv).pairEncode (pt_bits_vrad d c))))
  exact polyTimeComputable_or heq hst

/-- The selection test on a window is polynomial-time. -/
theorem pt_selT : PolyTimeComputable fun q => [selT q] := by
  have hone : PolyTimeComputable fun q => pairSndD (pairFstD q) :=
    polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hblk (k : ℕ) : PolyTimeComputable fun q => winBlk q k := by
    have hw : PolyTimeComputable fun q =>
        List.replicate (pairSndD (pairFstD q)).length true := polyTimeComputable_unary.comp hone
    exact pt_take hw (pt_drop (pt_rep_mul k hone) polyTimeComputable_pairSndD)
  exact polyTimeComputable_or
    (polyTimeComputable_and (pt_eq (hblk 4) (hblk 1)) (pt_eq (hblk 5) (hblk 3)))
    (polyTimeComputable_and (pt_eq (hblk 4) (hblk 3)) (pt_eq (hblk 5) (hblk 2)))

/-- The record step of the OR loop: drop one record (`3w` letters) from a window. -/
def nxtW (q : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  pairEncode (pairFstD q) ((pairSndD q).drop (3 * (pairSndD (pairFstD q)).length))

/-- The disjunction over records is polynomial-time.

**Proof sketch.** The OR-flag block loop (`Complexity.BlockLoop.polyTimeComputable_orLoop`)
over the `w = A (n + 1)^a` windows `lvlQ y j`, advancing by `nxtW` (which drops one record)
and testing `!selT`; the windows are polynomial-time (`pt_drop`, `pt_vwid`) and `nxtW` does
not lengthen them. -/
theorem pt_orB : PolyTimeComputable fun y => [orB A a y] := by
  have hone : PolyTimeComputable fun q => pairSndD (pairFstD q) :=
    polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp polyTimeComputable_pairFstD
  have hnxt : PolyTimeComputable nxtW :=
    polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.pairEncode
      (pt_drop (pt_rep_mul 3 hone) polyTimeComputable_pairSndD)
  have hQ0 : PolyTimeComputable fun y => lvlQ A a y 0 := by
    have : PolyTimeComputable fun y =>
        pairEncode (pairEncode (pairFstD y) (List.replicate (vwid A a (pairFstD y).length) true))
          (pairSndD y) :=
      (polyTimeComputable_pairFstD.pairEncode (pt_vwid A a)).pairEncode
        polyTimeComputable_pairSndD
    simpa [lvlQ] using this
  have h := BlockLoop.polyTimeComputable_orLoop (t := fun q => !selT q) (nxt := nxtW)
    (x := pairFstD) (r := fun y => lvlQ A a y 0) (lvlQ A a) (F := fun y j => !selT (lvlQ A a y j))
    A a 0 ((polyTimeComputable_not pt_selT).comp
      (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp polyTimeComputable_pairSndD))
    (hnxt.comp (polyTimeComputable_pairSndD.comp polyTimeComputable_pairSndD))
    polyTimeComputable_pairFstD hQ0
    (fun q => by
      have := length_pair_components_le q
      simp only [nxtW, length_pairEncode, List.length_drop]
      omega)
    (fun y => by simp only [lvlQ, length_pairEncode]; omega)
    (fun y => rfl)
    (fun y i _ => by
      simp only [nxtW, lvlQ, pairFstD_pairEncode, pairSndD_pairEncode, List.length_replicate,
        List.drop_drop]
      congr 2)
    (fun y i _ => rfl)
  simpa [orB, vwid] using h

/-- **The verifier is polynomial-time.** (Conjunction and disjunction of the polynomial-time
tests `pt_initB`, `pt_accB`, `pt_baseB`, `pt_orB`.) -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_predB : PolyTimeComputable fun y => [predB N d c A a y] :=
  polyTimeComputable_and (polyTimeComputable_and (pt_initB N d c A a) (pt_accB N d c A a))
    (polyTimeComputable_or (pt_baseB N d c A a) (pt_orB A a))

end TQBFHard

end Complexity
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Codec/Bridge.lean =====

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Checks

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Acceptance as a chain of codes

The bridge between a space-bounded nondeterministic decider and the code languages: for a
window radius `s` at least the space bound on `x`, `x` is accepted exactly when there is a
chain of codes `c₀, …, c_t` — the initial code, configuration-graph edges between
consecutive codes, an accepting last code — of length at most the vertex count
`Turing.FinNDTM.configBound |x| s`, every code below `2 ^ (codeK N · (s + logSpace |x| + 1))`.
This is the form in which configuration-graph algorithms (Savitch's midpoint recursion, the
`PATH` reduction, inductive counting) consume a nondeterministic decider [AB09, §4.1.1,
§4.2, §4.3]: they search for such chains over register-held codes, calling the logspace
deciders of the code languages.

**Duplication disclosure.** The window lemma `Complexity.Codec.inWin_runWith_take` restates
the private `runWith_take_inWindow` of `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ConfigGraph` for
the codec's public window predicate; its proof replays the private helpers there
(`take_succ_action`, `abs_lt_card_visitedWith`, `mem_visitedWith_of_ne_none`,
`visitedWith_take_subset`). The window predicate `Complexity.Codec.InWin` (Word.lean) is a
public copy of the private `InWindow` there, and `mem_of_acceptsWithin` replays the backward
branch of `Turing.FinNDTM.DecidesInSpace.mem_iff_acceptsWithin_configBound`. Public exports from
`ConfigGraph` (`InWindow`, `runWith_take_inWindow`, an "accepting branch of any length implies
membership" lemma) are requested, after which these copies are deleted. Within the codec, the
path-to-membership argument exists once (`mem_of_codePath`); `mem_iff_codeChain` and the
Savitch machine (`Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.mem_iff_reach`) both use it.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.StepRel` — the code-level step relation of a decider.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.configBound_mono`, `Complexity.Codec.mem_of_acceptsWithin` — helpers.
* `Complexity.Codec.inWin_runWith_take` — prefixes of a space-bounded branch are in the
  window.
* `Complexity.Codec.mem_of_codePath` — a `StepRel`-path of any length from an initial to an
  accepting code gives membership.
* `Complexity.Codec.mem_iff_codeChain` — the bridge lemma. [AB09, §4.1.1, Claim 4.4(1) in
  code form]

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, Claim 4.4.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

variable {N : FinNDTM Bool} {x : List Bool}

/-! ## Windows of space-bounded branches -/

/-- Successive choice prefixes either leave the configuration fixed or apply one action. -/
private theorem take_succ_action (w : List Bool) (c : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x) (j : ℕ) :
    N.tm.runWith (w.take (j + 1)) c = N.tm.runWith (w.take j) c ∨
      ∃ a : Action N.k Bool N.State,
        N.tm.runWith (w.take (j + 1)) c = a.apply (N.tm.runWith (w.take j) c) := by
  rw [List.take_succ, NDTM.runWith_append]
  cases w[j]? with
  | none => exact Or.inl rfl
  | some b =>
    simp only [Option.toList_some, NDTM.runWith_cons, NDTM.runWith_nil,
      NDTM.stepWith_eq_fixChoice_step]
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    cases (N.tm.runWith (w.take j) c).state with
    | none => exact Or.inl rfl
    | some q => exact Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩

/-- A visited position has absolute value below the visited-set size. -/
private theorem abs_lt_card_visitedWith (w : List Bool) (i : Fin N.k) {z : ℤ}
    (hz : z ∈ N.tm.visitedWith w (N.tm.initCfg x) i) :
    |z| < (N.tm.visitedWith w (N.tm.initCfg x) i).card := by
  apply MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.abs_lt_card_image_of_unitSteps
    (fun j => (N.tm.runWith (w.take j) (N.tm.initCfg x)).workTapePos i) (by simp) _ w.length hz
  intro j
  dsimp only
  rcases take_succ_action w (N.tm.initCfg x) j with same | ⟨a, step⟩
  · rw [same]; simp
  · rw [step]; exact workTapePos_apply_le a _ i

/-- Every nonblank cell of a run from initialization has been visited. -/
private theorem mem_visitedWith_of_ne_none (w : List Bool) (i : Fin N.k) (z : ℤ)
    (hz : (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x)).workTapes i z ≠ none) :
    z ∈ N.tm.visitedWith w (N.tm.initCfg x) i :=
  MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.mem_image_workTapePos_of_ne_none
    (fun j => N.tm.runWith (w.take j) (N.tm.initCfg x)) (by simp)
    (take_succ_action w (N.tm.initCfg x)) w.length i z
    (by simpa only [List.take_length] using hz)

/-- Taking a choice prefix only removes visited positions. -/
private theorem visitedWith_take_subset (w : List Bool) (c : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x) (j : ℕ)
    (i : Fin N.k) : N.tm.visitedWith (w.take j) c i ⊆ N.tm.visitedWith w c i := by
  apply Finset.image_subset_iff.mpr
  intro n hn
  have hn' : n ≤ min j w.length := by simpa using Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hn)
  apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
  refine ⟨n, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩
  rw [List.take_take, Nat.min_eq_left (by omega : n ≤ j)]

/-- **Prefixes of a space-bounded branch are in the window**: if the branch under `w` visits
at most `s` work cells, every configuration along it has its heads and nonblank cells in
`[-s, s]`. (A restatement of `ConfigGraph`'s private `runWith_take_inWindow`.)

**Proof sketch.** The visited set of a tape is an interval around `0` of size at most `s`, so
its positions have absolute value below `s`; heads are visited, and nonblank cells were
visited by a prefix. -/
theorem inWin_runWith_take (w : List Bool) {s : ℕ}
    (hs : N.tm.spaceUsedWith w (N.tm.initCfg x) ≤ s) (j : ℕ) :
    InWin N s (N.tm.runWith (w.take j) (N.tm.initCfg x)) := by
  intro i
  have card_bound : (N.tm.visitedWith w (N.tm.initCfg x) i).card ≤ s :=
    (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i => (N.tm.visitedWith w (N.tm.initCfg x) i).card)
      (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans hs
  have bounded (z : ℤ) (hz : z ∈ N.tm.visitedWith (w.take j) (N.tm.initCfg x) i) : |z| ≤ s := by
    have hz' := visitedWith_take_subset w (N.tm.initCfg x) j i hz
    have small := abs_lt_card_visitedWith w i hz'
    omega
  constructor
  · apply bounded
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    exact ⟨(w.take j).length, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self _), by
      rw [List.take_length]⟩
  · intro z hz
    exact bounded z (mem_visitedWith_of_ne_none (w.take j) i z hz)

/-! ## The bridge -/

/-- The vertex count is monotone in the window radius. -/
lemma configBound_mono (N : FinNDTM Bool) (n : ℕ) {s s' : ℕ} (h : s ≤ s') :
    N.configBound n s ≤ N.configBound n s' := by
  unfold FinNDTM.configBound
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul
  · apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))
  · exact Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _

/-- An accepting branch of any length makes the input a member. -/
lemma mem_of_acceptsWithin {L : Language Bool} {sp : ℕ → ℕ} (h : N.DecidesInSpace L sp)
    {t : ℕ} (ha : N.AcceptsWithin x t) : x ∈ L := by
  obtain ⟨T, halt, -, iff_at_T⟩ := h x
  apply iff_at_T.mpr
  by_cases ht : t ≤ T
  · exact ha.mono ht
  · obtain ⟨w, hw, _, output⟩ := ha
    have prefix_length : (w.take T).length = T := List.length_take_of_le (by omega)
    have prefix_halt := halt (w.take T) prefix_length
    have frozen : N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x) = N.tm.runWith (w.take T) (N.tm.initCfg x) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop T w]
      rw [NDTM.runWith_append, NDTM.runWith_of_halt _ prefix_halt]
    exact ⟨w.take T, prefix_length, prefix_halt, by rw [← frozen]; exact output⟩

/-- **The code-level step relation** of `N` on `x` at radius `s`: `⟨x, ⟨bits a, ⟨bits b,
bits s⟩⟩⟩` is a step pair (a member of `Complexity.Codec.stepLang N`). -/
def StepRel (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (s : ℕ) (a b : ℕ) : Prop :=
  pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits a) (pairEncode (Nat.bits b) (Nat.bits s))) ∈ stepLang N

/-- **A code path from an initial to an accepting code makes the input a member**: if `N`
decides `L` (in any space bound), `u` is the initial code and `v` an accepting code at
radius `s`, and `v` is reachable from `u` along step pairs (`Relation.ReflTransGen` of
`StepRel N x s`, of any length), then `x ∈ L`. This is the direction `⇐` of
`Complexity.Codec.mem_iff_codeChain`, without its length and size bounds. [AB09, §4.1.1:
a path from the initial to an accepting configuration in the configuration graph is an
accepting branch]

**Proof sketch.** By induction along the path, some choice word reaches a configuration with
the vertex of the current code: codes determine vertices on window-bounded configurations
(`coreSum_eq_of_cfgWord_eq`) and steps respect vertices (`Turing.NDTM.coreSum_stepWith`).
At the accepting code the vertex is halted with output `[true]`, so the word accepts, and an
accepting branch of any length gives membership (`mem_of_acceptsWithin`). -/
theorem mem_of_codePath {L : Language Bool} {sp : ℕ → ℕ} (h : N.DecidesInSpace L sp)
    (x : List Bool) (s u v : ℕ)
    (hinit : pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits u) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ initLang N)
    (hpath : Relation.ReflTransGen (StepRel N x s) u v)
    (hacc : pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits v) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ acceptLang N) : x ∈ L := by
  rw [mem_initLang] at hinit
  have chain : ∀ c, Relation.ReflTransGen (StepRel N x s) u c → ∃ w : List Bool,
      ∃ D : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, InWin N s D ∧ cfgCode s D = c ∧
        NDTM.coreSum (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x)) = NDTM.coreSum D := by
    intro c hc
    induction hc with
    | refl =>
      exact ⟨[], N.tm.initCfg x, fun i => by simp [NDTM.initCfg, Cfg.init], hinit, rfl⟩
    | tail _ hst ih =>
      obtain ⟨w, D, hD, hcD, hcore⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨C, hC, hcC, C', ⟨b, hb⟩, hC', hcC'⟩ := (mem_stepLang N x _ _ s).mp hst
      have hDC : NDTM.coreSum D = NDTM.coreSum C :=
        coreSum_eq_of_cfgWord_eq hD hC (by rw [← bits_cfgCode, ← bits_cfgCode, hcD, hcC])
      refine ⟨w ++ [b], C', hC', hcC', ?_⟩
      rw [NDTM.runWith_append, NDTM.runWith_cons, NDTM.runWith_nil, ← hb]
      exact NDTM.coreSum_stepWith N.tm b (hcore.trans hDC)
  obtain ⟨w, D, hD, hcD, hcore⟩ := chain v hpath
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hcC, hst, hout⟩ := (mem_acceptLang N x _ s).mp hacc
  have hDC : NDTM.coreSum D = NDTM.coreSum C :=
    coreSum_eq_of_cfgWord_eq hD hC (by rw [← bits_cfgCode, ← bits_cfgCode, hcD, hcC])
  have hfin := hcore.trans hDC
  apply mem_of_acceptsWithin h (t := w.length)
  refine ⟨w, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := congrArg (fun z => z.1.1) hfin
    simp only [NDTM.coreSum, MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.core] at this
    rw [this, hst]
  · have := congrArg Prod.snd hfin
    simp only [NDTM.coreSum] at this
    rw [hout] at this
    exact (outSummary_eq_accept_iff _).mp this

/-- **Acceptance as a chain of codes** (the bridge lemma): let `N` decide `L` in space `sp`,
and let `s ≥ sp |x|`. Then `x ∈ L` iff there are `t ≤ configBound |x| s` and codes
`c 0, …, c t` such that `c 0` is the initial code, each `(c i, c (i + 1))` is a step pair,
`c t` is an accepting code (all at radius `s`, as memberships in the code languages), and
every code is below `2 ^ (codeK N · (s + logSpace |x| + 1))`. [AB09, §4.1.1: the machine
accepts iff the configuration graph has a path from the initial to an accepting
configuration; Claim 4.4(1) bounds its length by the vertex count]

**Proof sketch.** (⇒) Take an accepting branch of length the vertex count at the space bound
(`DecidesInSpace.mem_iff_acceptsWithin_configBound`, `configBound_mono`); its prefixes stay in
the window `[-s, s]` (`inWin_runWith_take`: compare with a branch of the halting budget —
padding the accepting word, or truncating it where every branch has halted); the codes of
the prefix configurations form the chain, consecutive prefixes differing by one step, the
last halted with output `[true]`; codes are short (`cfgCode_lt`). (⇐) The chain is a
`StepRel`-path from the initial to the accepting code, which gives membership
(`mem_of_codePath`). -/
theorem mem_iff_codeChain {L : Language Bool} {sp : ℕ → ℕ} (h : N.DecidesInSpace L sp)
    (x : List Bool) (s : ℕ) (hs : sp x.length ≤ s) :
    x ∈ L ↔ ∃ (t : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ), t ≤ N.configBound x.length s ∧
      pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits (c 0)) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ initLang N ∧
      (∀ i < t, pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits (c i))
        (pairEncode (Nat.bits (c (i + 1))) (Nat.bits s))) ∈ stepLang N) ∧
      pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits (c t)) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ acceptLang N ∧
      ∀ i ≤ t, c i < 2 ^ (codeK N * (s + logSpace x.length + 1)) := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hhalt, hout⟩ := (h.mem_iff_acceptsWithin_configBound x).mp hx
    set tb := N.configBound x.length (sp x.length)
    obtain ⟨T, hHalt, hSpace, -⟩ := h x
    -- every prefix configuration is in the window
    have hwin : ∀ j, InWin N s (N.tm.runWith (w.take j) (N.tm.initCfg x)) := by
      by_cases hT : tb ≤ T
      · intro j
        set w' := w ++ List.replicate (T - tb) false
        have hw' : w'.length = T := by simp [w', hw]; omega
        have hsp := (hSpace w' hw').trans hs
        by_cases hj : j ≤ tb
        · have e : w'.take j = w.take j := by
            simp only [w']; rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by omega)]
          rw [← e]; exact inWin_runWith_take w' hsp j
        · have e1 : w.take j = w := List.take_of_length_le (by omega)
          have e2 : w'.take tb = w := by
            simp only [w']; rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by omega), List.take_of_length_le (by omega)]
          rw [e1, ← e2]; exact inWin_runWith_take w' hsp tb
      · intro j
        have hlen : (w.take T).length = T := List.length_take_of_le (by omega)
        have hsp := (hSpace (w.take T) hlen).trans hs
        by_cases hj : j ≤ T
        · have e : (w.take T).take j = w.take j := by rw [List.take_take, Nat.min_eq_left hj]
          rw [← e]; exact inWin_runWith_take (w.take T) hsp j
        · have frozen : N.tm.runWith (w.take j) (N.tm.initCfg x) =
              N.tm.runWith (w.take T) (N.tm.initCfg x) := by
            have : w.take j = w.take T ++ (w.take j).drop T := by
              conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop T (w.take j)]
              rw [List.take_take, Nat.min_eq_left (by omega : T ≤ j)]
            rw [this, NDTM.runWith_append, NDTM.runWith_of_halt _ (hHalt _ hlen)]
          rw [frozen, show w.take T = (w.take T).take T by simp]
          exact inWin_runWith_take (w.take T) hsp T
    refine ⟨tb, fun i => cfgCode s (N.tm.runWith (w.take i) (N.tm.initCfg x)),
      configBound_mono N _ hs, ?_, fun i hi => ?_, ?_, fun i _ => cfgCode_lt s _⟩
    · rw [mem_initLang]; simp
    · rw [mem_stepLang]
      refine ⟨_, hwin i, rfl, _, ⟨w[i]'(by omega), ?_⟩, hwin (i + 1), rfl⟩
      rw [List.take_succ, NDTM.runWith_append, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
      rfl
    · rw [mem_acceptLang]
      refine ⟨_, hwin tb, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← hw, List.take_length]; exact hhalt
      · rw [← hw, List.take_length]; exact hout
  · rintro ⟨t, c, -, hinit, hstep, hacc, -⟩
    have hpath : ∀ j ≤ t, Relation.ReflTransGen (StepRel N x s) (c 0) (c j) := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => intro _; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      | succ j ih => intro hj; exact (ih (by omega)).tail (hstep j (by omega))
    exact mem_of_codePath h x s (c 0) (c t) hinit (hpath t le_rfl) hacc

end Complexity.Codec
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
