Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMLoops

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Abstract-register-machine fragments for the codec checkers

Bounded loops of abstract register machines (`Complexity.LogProg.ARM`) used by the logspace
checkers of the configuration codec, stated like the shared fragments of
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.InputAccess` (`registerCopy_loop`,
`registerScale_loop`, …): over any machine whose instructions at the given labels have the
given shape, as runs `Complexity.LogProg.AReach` through configurations meeting the syntactic
preconditions with all registers bounded by `B`.

* `Complexity.Codec.incChain`, `Complexity.Codec.decChain` — straight chains of increments
  and decrements of one register.
* `Complexity.Codec.scan_loop` — **the scan engine**: walk two pointers through the input in
  lockstep (any stride), read the input bit under each through a bit oracle, and feed the
  pair of bits to a finite-state step; the run ends in the label of the fold of the step
  over the zipped words read.
* `Complexity.Codec.decodeStride_loop` — decode a binary field laid out at any stride
  (most significant letter last), the strided form of `boundedDecode_loop`.
* `Complexity.Codec.halvCount_loop` — count the binary digits of a register by halving.
* `Complexity.Codec.le_loop` — compare two registers by counting.

Logspace machine infrastructure ([AB09, §4.1: logspace algorithms keep a constant number of
`O(log n)`-bit counters]); not a result of [AB09].

**Duplication disclosure.** `decodeStride_loop` is `boundedDecode_loop` of
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.InputAccess` with its single decrement replaced
by a chain of `stride` decrements (the codec's fields are doubled in the virtual input); the
proof is adapted from that one. `incChain` is the public form of the private
`arm_increments` there. A shared generalization of both is requested.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.incChain`, `Complexity.Codec.decChain`.
* `Complexity.Codec.scan_loop`, `Complexity.Codec.decodeStride_loop`,
  `Complexity.Codec.halvCount_loop`, `Complexity.Codec.le_loop`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

variable {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type}

/-- **A chain of increments** of register `r` along the labels `labels 0, …, labels k`. -/
theorem incChain (A : ARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (y : List Bool)
    (r : Fin m) (labels : ℕ → Λ) (k B : ℕ)
    (hcode : ∀ i < k, A (labels i) = .inc r (labels (i + 1)))
    (v : Fin m → ℕ) (hv : ∀ s, v s ≤ B) (hk : v r + k ≤ B) :
    AReach A oracle y (GuardLe A y B) (some (labels 0), v, none)
      (some (labels k), Function.update v r (v r + k), none) := by
  induction k generalizing labels v with
  | zero => simpa only [Nat.add_zero, Function.update_eq_self] using
      (AReach.refl (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := y) (G := GuardLe A y B) (some (labels 0), v, none))
  | succ k ih =>
    have hc := hcode 0 (by omega)
    apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hc], hv⟩
    simp only [astep, hc]
    have hv' : ∀ s, Function.update v r (v r + 1) s ≤ B :=
      register_update_le v r B _ hv (by omega)
    have hp := ih (fun i => labels (i + 1)) (fun i hi => hcode (i + 1) (by omega))
      (Function.update v r (v r + 1)) hv' (by simp; omega)
    simpa only [Function.update_self, Function.update_idem, Nat.add_assoc,
      Nat.add_comm 1 k] using hp

/-- **A chain of decrements** of register `r` along the labels `labels 0, …, labels k`
(with `k ≤ v r`, so no decrement truncates). -/
theorem decChain (A : ARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (y : List Bool)
    (r : Fin m) (labels : ℕ → Λ) (k B : ℕ)
    (hcode : ∀ i < k, A (labels i) = .dec r (labels (i + 1)))
    (v : Fin m → ℕ) (hv : ∀ s, v s ≤ B) (hk : k ≤ v r) :
    AReach A oracle y (GuardLe A y B) (some (labels 0), v, none)
      (some (labels k), Function.update v r (v r - k), none) := by
  induction k generalizing labels v with
  | zero => simpa only [Nat.sub_zero, Function.update_eq_self] using
      (AReach.refl (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := y) (G := GuardLe A y B) (some (labels 0), v, none))
  | succ k ih =>
    have hc := hcode 0 (by omega)
    apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hc], hv⟩
    simp only [astep, hc]
    have hv' : ∀ s, Function.update v r (v r - 1) s ≤ B :=
      register_update_le v r B _ hv (by have := hv r; omega)
    have hp := ih (fun i => labels (i + 1)) (fun i hi => hcode (i + 1) (by omega))
      (Function.update v r (v r - 1)) hv' (by simp; omega)
    simpa only [Function.update_self, Function.update_idem,
      show v r - 1 - k = v r - (k + 1) by omega] using hp

/-- **The scan engine.** Two pointer registers `p`, `q` walk in lockstep with stride
`stride` until `p` reaches `lim`; at each position the bits `u_i`, `u'_i` under the pointers
are read through the oracle `j` and the finite-state step `δ` consumes the pair. The run from
`test st₀` ends in `done` of the fold of `δ` over the zipped words, with both pointers
advanced by `stride · |u|`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `u` (with `u'` of the same length). If `p = lim` the run
exits; otherwise the two reads take the bits `u_0`, `u'_0`, the step applies `δ`, and two
increment chains (`incChain`) advance the pointers to the rest of the words. Pointer values
stay below `lim` (for `p`) and the supplied bound (for `q`). -/
theorem scan_loop {σ : Type} (A : ARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (y : List Bool) (p q lim : Fin m) (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpl : p ≠ lim) (hql : q ≠ lim) (j : Fin d)
    (δ : σ → Bool × Bool → σ) (test rd1 : σ → Λ) (rd2 : σ → Bool → Λ) (adv1 adv2 : σ → ℕ → Λ)
    (done : σ → Λ) (stride : ℕ) (hs : 0 < stride)
    (htest : ∀ st, A (test st) = .jeq p lim (done st) (rd1 st))
    (hrd1 : ∀ st, A (rd1 st) = .call j .whole [p] (rd2 st true) (rd2 st false))
    (hrd2 : ∀ st b, A (rd2 st b) =
      .call j .whole [q] (adv1 (δ st (b, true)) 0) (adv1 (δ st (b, false)) 0))
    (hadv1 : ∀ st i, i < stride → A (adv1 st i) = .inc p (adv1 st (i + 1)))
    (hend1 : ∀ st, adv1 st stride = adv2 st 0)
    (hadv2 : ∀ st i, i < stride → A (adv2 st i) = .inc q (adv2 st (i + 1)))
    (hend2 : ∀ st, adv2 st stride = test st)
    (B : ℕ) (u u' : List Bool) (hlen : u'.length = u.length) (st₀ : σ) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) (hlim : v lim = v p + stride * u.length)
    (hq : v q + stride * u.length ≤ B)
    (ho1 : ∀ i < u.length, oracle j (pairEncode y (Nat.bits (v p + stride * i))) = u.getD i false)
    (ho2 : ∀ i < u.length, oracle j (pairEncode y (Nat.bits (v q + stride * i))) = u'.getD i false) :
    AReach A oracle y (GuardLe A y B) (some (test st₀), v, none)
      (some (done ((List.zip u u').foldl δ st₀)),
        Function.update (Function.update v p (v p + stride * u.length)) q
          (v q + stride * u.length), none) := by
  induction u generalizing u' st₀ v with
  | nil =>
    have e : v p = v lim := by simpa using hlim.symm
    have hu' : u' = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by simpa using hlen)
    subst hu'
    simp only [List.zip_nil_left, List.foldl_nil, List.length_nil, Nat.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero,
      Function.update_eq_self]
    simpa [astep, htest, e] using
      (AReach.single (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := y) (G := GuardLe A y B)
        (a := (some (test st₀), v, none)) ⟨by simp [PreS, htest, hpl], hv⟩)
  | cons b u ih =>
    obtain ⟨b', u'', rfl⟩ : ∃ b' u'', u' = b' :: u'' := by
      cases u' with
      | nil => simp at hlen
      | cons b' u'' => exact ⟨b', u'', rfl⟩
    simp only [List.length_cons] at hlen hlim hq
    have hstep : stride ≤ stride * (u.length + 1) :=
      Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right stride (by omega)
    have hne : v p ≠ v lim := by omega
    have hb := ho1 0 (by simp)
    have hb' := ho2 0 (by simp)
    simp only [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.add_zero, List.getD_cons_zero] at hb hb'
    set st₁ := δ st₀ (b, b') with hst₁
    -- the test and the two reads
    have reads : AReach A oracle y (GuardLe A y B) (some (test st₀), v, none)
        (some (adv1 st₁ 0), v, none) := by
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, htest, hpl], hv⟩
      simp only [astep, htest, if_neg hne]
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hrd1], hv⟩
      simp only [astep, hrd1, vword_whole₁, hb]
      have e1 : (if b = true then rd2 st₀ true else rd2 st₀ false) = rd2 st₀ b := by
        cases b <;> rfl
      rw [e1]
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hrd2], hv⟩
      simp only [astep, hrd2, vword_whole₁, hb']
      have e2 : (if b' = true then adv1 (δ st₀ (b, true)) 0 else adv1 (δ st₀ (b, false)) 0) =
          adv1 st₁ 0 := by cases b' <;> rfl
      rw [e2]
      exact AReach.refl _
    -- the two increment chains
    set v₁ := Function.update v p (v p + stride) with hv₁
    set v₂ := Function.update v₁ q (v q + stride) with hv₂
    have bd₁ : ∀ r, v₁ r ≤ B := register_update_le v p B _ hv (by have := hv lim; omega)
    have bd₂ : ∀ r, v₂ r ≤ B := register_update_le v₁ q B _ bd₁ (by omega)
    have c1 := incChain A oracle y p (adv1 st₁) stride B (hadv1 st₁) v hv
      (by have := hv lim; omega)
    rw [hend1] at c1
    have c2 := incChain A oracle y q (adv2 st₁) stride B (hadv2 st₁) v₁ bd₁
      (by rw [hv₁, Function.update_of_ne hpq.symm]; omega)
    rw [hend2, hv₁, Function.update_of_ne hpq.symm] at c2
    -- the rest of the words
    have v₂p : v₂ p = v p + stride := by
      rw [hv₂, Function.update_of_ne hpq, hv₁, Function.update_self]
    have v₂q : v₂ q = v q + stride := by rw [hv₂, Function.update_self]
    have v₂l : v₂ lim = v lim := by
      rw [hv₂, Function.update_of_ne hql.symm, hv₁, Function.update_of_ne hpl.symm]
    have rest := ih u'' (by simpa using hlen) st₁ v₂ bd₂
      (by rw [v₂l, v₂p, hlim]; ring)
      (by rw [v₂q]; rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one] at hq; omega)
      (fun i hi => by
        have := ho1 (i + 1) (by simp; omega)
        rw [v₂p, show v p + stride + stride * i = v p + stride * (i + 1) by ring, this]
        rfl)
      (fun i hi => by
        have := ho2 (i + 1) (by simp; omega)
        rw [v₂q, show v q + stride + stride * i = v q + stride * (i + 1) by ring, this]
        rfl)
    have fin : Function.update (Function.update v₂ p (v₂ p + stride * u.length)) q
        (v₂ q + stride * u.length) =
        Function.update (Function.update v p (v p + stride * (u.length + 1))) q
          (v q + stride * (u.length + 1)) := by
      rw [v₂p, v₂q]
      funext r
      by_cases hrq : r = q
      · subst hrq; simp only [Function.update_self]; ring
      · by_cases hrp : r = p
        · subst hrp
          simp only [Function.update_of_ne hrq, Function.update_self]; ring
        · simp [Function.update_of_ne hrq, Function.update_of_ne hrp, hv₂, hv₁]
    rw [fin] at rest
    simp only [List.zip_cons_cons, List.foldl_cons, List.length_cons]
    exact reads.trans (c1.trans (c2.trans rest))

/-- **A strided reverse scan decodes a bounded binary field** laid out at positions
`base + stride · i` (least significant letter first): from the pointer at
`base + stride · k`, with the suffix value from letter `k` in the accumulator, the run
reaches `done` with the value of the whole field. This is `boundedDecode_loop` of
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.InputAccess` with the pointer stepped by
`stride` decrements (duplication disclosed in the module docstring).

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `k`. At `k = 0` the pointer is at the base and the run
exits. Otherwise step the pointer down by `stride` (`decChain`), read letter `k - 1`, copy
the accumulator into the temporary (`registerCopy_loop`), clear the accumulator, transfer
twice the temporary back (`registerScale_loop`), and add the letter: the accumulator holds
the suffix value from `k - 1`. -/
theorem decodeStride_loop (A : ARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (y : List Bool) (ptr base acc tmp : Fin m)
    (hpb : ptr ≠ base) (hpa : ptr ≠ acc) (hpt : ptr ≠ tmp)
    (hba : base ≠ acc) (hbt : base ≠ tmp) (hat : acc ≠ tmp)
    (j : Fin d) (test read done : Λ) (downs : ℕ → Λ)
    (copy bump clear scale take add : Bool → Λ) (incs : Bool → ℕ → Λ) (stride : ℕ)
    (htest : A test = .jeq ptr base done (downs 0))
    (hdowns : ∀ i < stride, A (downs i) = .dec ptr (downs (i + 1)))
    (hdend : downs stride = read)
    (hread : A read = .call j .whole [ptr] (copy true) (copy false))
    (hcopy : ∀ b, A (copy b) = .jeq tmp acc (clear b) (bump b))
    (hbump : ∀ b, A (bump b) = .inc tmp (copy b))
    (hclear : ∀ b, A (clear b) = .clr acc (scale b))
    (hscale : ∀ b, A (scale b) = .jz tmp (add b) (take b))
    (htake : ∀ b, A (take b) = .dec tmp (incs b 0))
    (hincs : ∀ b i, i < 2 → A (incs b i) = .inc acc (incs b (i + 1)))
    (hend : ∀ b, incs b 2 = scale b)
    (hadd : ∀ b, A (add b) = if b then .inc acc test else .jz tmp test test)
    (w : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (values : ∀ i ≤ w.length, bitsVal (w.drop i) ≤ B)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ w.length) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) (hs : 0 < stride)
    (hp : v ptr = v base + stride * k) (ha : v acc = bitsVal (w.drop k)) (ht : v tmp = 0)
    (ho : ∀ i < w.length,
      oracle j (pairEncode y (Nat.bits (v base + stride * i))) = w.getD i false) :
    ∃ v', (∀ r, v' r ≤ B) ∧ v' ptr = v base ∧ v' acc = bitsVal w ∧ v' tmp = 0 ∧
      (∀ r, r ≠ ptr → r ≠ acc → r ≠ tmp → v' r = v r) ∧
      AReach A oracle y (GuardLe A y B) (some test, v, none) (some done, v', none) := by
  induction k generalizing v with
  | zero =>
    have eq : v ptr = v base := by simpa using hp
    refine ⟨v, hv, eq, by simpa using ha, ht, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl, ?_⟩
    simpa [astep, htest, eq] using
      (AReach.single (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := y) (G := GuardLe A y B)
        (a := (some test, v, none)) ⟨by simp [PreS, htest, hpb], hv⟩)
  | succ k ih =>
    have kin : k < w.length := by omega
    let b := w.getD k false
    have val : bitsVal (w.drop k) = b.toNat + 2 * bitsVal (w.drop (k + 1)) := by
      rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons kin]
      simp only [bitsVal]
      congr 1
      simp [b, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, kin]
    have bound : 2 * v acc + b.toNat ≤ B := by
      have vb := values k (by omega)
      rw [val, ← ha] at vb
      omega
    let vd := Function.update v ptr (v base + stride * k)
    let vc := Function.update vd tmp (v acc)
    let vz := Function.update vc acc 0
    let vs := Function.update (Function.update vz tmp 0) acc (2 * v acc)
    let vn := Function.update vs acc (bitsVal (w.drop k))
    have bd : ∀ r, vd r ≤ B := register_update_le v ptr B _ hv (by
      have := hv ptr; rw [hp, Nat.mul_succ] at this; omega)
    have bc : ∀ r, vc r ≤ B := register_update_le vd tmp B _ bd (hv acc)
    have bz : ∀ r, vz r ≤ B := register_update_le vc acc B 0 bc (Nat.zero_le _)
    have bs : ∀ r, vs r ≤ B := register_update_le _ acc B _
      (register_update_le vz tmp B 0 bz (Nat.zero_le _)) (by omega)
    have bn : ∀ r, vn r ≤ B := register_update_le vs acc B _ bs (values k (by omega))
    have vb : vn base = v base := by simp [vn, vs, vz, vc, vd, hba, hbt, hpb.symm]
    have vp : vn ptr = v base + stride * k := by simp [vn, vs, vz, vc, vd, hpa, hpt]
    have va : vn acc = bitsVal (w.drop k) := by simp [vn]
    have vt : vn tmp = 0 := by simp [vn, vs, hat.symm]
    have vf : ∀ r, r ≠ ptr → r ≠ acc → r ≠ tmp → vn r = v r := by
      intro r hr hp ht
      simp [vn, vs, vz, vc, vd, Function.update_of_ne, hr, hp, ht]
    obtain ⟨v', bv, ep, ea, et, frame, rest⟩ := ih (by omega) vn bn
      (by rw [vp, vb]) va vt (by simpa only [vb] using ho)
    refine ⟨v', bv, by simpa only [vb] using ep, ea, et, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro r hr hp ht
      exact (frame r hr hp ht).trans (vf r hr hp ht)
    · have ne : v ptr ≠ v base := by rw [hp, Nat.mul_succ]; omega
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, htest, hpb], hv⟩
      simp only [astep, htest, if_neg ne]
      have dc := decChain A oracle y ptr downs stride B hdowns v hv
        (by rw [hp, Nat.mul_succ]; omega)
      have pred : v ptr - stride = v base + stride * k := by rw [hp, Nat.mul_succ]; omega
      rw [pred, hdend] at dc
      apply dc.trans
      change AReach A oracle y _ (some read, vd, none) _
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hread], bd⟩
      have bit : oracle j (pairEncode y (Nat.bits (vd ptr))) = b := by
        simpa only [vd, Function.update_self] using ho k kin
      simp only [astep, hread, vword_whole₁, bit]
      have cb : (if b = true then copy true else copy false) = copy b := by cases b <;> rfl
      rw [cb]
      have cr := registerCopy_loop A oracle y tmp acc hat.symm (copy b) (bump b) (clear b)
        (hcopy b) (hbump b) B vd bd (by simp [vd, hpt.symm, hpa.symm, ht])
      have ca : vd acc = v acc := by simp [vd, hpa.symm]
      simp only [ca] at cr
      apply cr.trans
      change AReach A oracle y _ (some (clear b), vc, none) _
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hclear], bc⟩
      simp only [astep, hclear]
      change AReach A oracle y _ (some (scale b), vz, none) _
      have za : vz acc = 0 := by simp [vz]
      have zt : vz tmp = v acc := by simp [vz, vc, hat.symm]
      have sr := registerScale_loop A oracle y tmp acc hat.symm (scale b) (take b) (add b)
        (incs b) 2 (hscale b) (htake b) (hincs b) (hend b) B vz bz
        (by rw [za, zt]; omega)
      simp only [za, zt, Nat.zero_add] at sr
      apply sr.trans
      change AReach A oracle y _ (some (add b), vs, none) _
      apply AReach.step ⟨by cases b <;> simp [PreS, hadd], bs⟩
      have nb : astep A oracle y (some (add b), vs, none) = (some test, vn, none) := by
        have sv : vs acc = 2 * v acc := by simp [vs]
        have kv : bitsVal (w.drop k) = b.toNat + 2 * v acc := by rw [val, ← ha]
        cases hb : b
        · have same : vn = vs := by
            simp only [vn, kv, hb, Bool.toNat_false, Nat.zero_add, ← sv, Function.update_eq_self]
          simp [astep, hadd, same]
        · simp only [astep, hadd, ↓reduceIte]
          simp only [vn, kv, hb, Bool.toNat_true, sv, Nat.add_comm]
      rw [nb]
      exact rest

/-- **Counting binary digits by halving**: halving `t` until it is zero while incrementing
`c` adds `|bits t|` to `c` and clears `t`.

**Proof sketch.** Strong induction on the value of `t`: a nonzero value loses exactly one
binary digit when halved (`bits_half`). -/
theorem halvCount_loop (A : ARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (y : List Bool)
    (t c : Fin m) (htc : t ≠ c) (test halve bump done : Λ)
    (htest : A test = .jz t done halve) (hhalve : A halve = .half t bump)
    (hbump : A bump = .inc c test) (B : ℕ) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B)
    (hc : v c + (Nat.bits (v t)).length ≤ B) :
    AReach A oracle y (GuardLe A y B) (some test, v, none)
      (some done, Function.update (Function.update v t 0) c (v c + (Nat.bits (v t)).length),
        none) := by
  generalize hn : v t = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing v with
  | _ n ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hpos
    · have e : Function.update (Function.update v t 0) c (v c + (Nat.bits 0).length) = v := by
        funext r
        by_cases hrc : r = c
        · subst hrc; simp
        · by_cases hrt : r = t
          · subst hrt; simp [hrc, hn]
          · simp [hrc, hrt]
      rw [e]
      simpa [astep, htest, hn] using
        (AReach.single (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := y) (G := GuardLe A y B)
          (a := (some test, v, none)) ⟨by simp [PreS, htest], hv⟩)
    · rw [hn] at hc
      have hlen : (Nat.bits (n / 2)).length + 1 = (Nat.bits n).length := by
        rw [bits_half, List.length_tail]
        have : 0 < (Nat.bits n).length := by
          rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]; exact Nat.size_pos.mpr hpos
        omega
      set v₁ := Function.update v t (n / 2)
      set v₂ := Function.update v₁ c (v c + 1)
      have b₁ : ∀ r, v₁ r ≤ B := register_update_le v t B _ hv (by have := hv t; omega)
      have b₂ : ∀ r, v₂ r ≤ B := register_update_le v₁ c B _ b₁ (by omega)
      have v₂t : v₂ t = n / 2 := by simp [v₂, v₁, htc]
      have v₂c : v₂ c = v c + 1 := by simp [v₂]
      have rest := ih (n / 2) (by omega) v₂ b₂ (by rw [v₂c, v₂t]; omega) v₂t
      have e : Function.update (Function.update v₂ t 0) c (v₂ c + (Nat.bits (n / 2)).length) =
          Function.update (Function.update v t 0) c (v c + (Nat.bits n).length) := by
        rw [v₂c]
        funext r
        by_cases hrc : r = c
        · subst hrc; simp; omega
        · by_cases hrt : r = t
          · subst hrt; simp [hrc]
          · simp [hrc, hrt, v₂, v₁]
      rw [e] at rest
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, htest], hv⟩
      simp only [astep, htest, hn, show n ≠ 0 by omega, ↓reduceIte]
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hhalve], hv⟩
      simp only [astep, hhalve, hn]
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hbump], b₁⟩
      simp only [astep, hbump]
      have : Function.update v₁ c (v₁ c + 1) = v₂ := by simp [v₂, v₁, htc.symm]
      rw [this]
      exact rest

/-- **Comparing two registers by counting**: stepping `t` up from below both `a` and `b`
reaches `a` first (or simultaneously) iff `a ≤ b`; the run ends in `yes` or `no`
accordingly, with `t = min a b`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `min a b - t`: at `t = a` answer yes, else at `t = b`
answer no, else increment `t`. -/
theorem le_loop (A : ARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (y : List Bool)
    (t a b : Fin m) (hta : t ≠ a) (htb : t ≠ b) (test₁ test₂ bump yes no : Λ)
    (htest₁ : A test₁ = .jeq t a yes test₂) (htest₂ : A test₂ = .jeq t b no bump)
    (hbump : A bump = .inc t test₁) (B : ℕ) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B)
    (ha : v t ≤ v a) (hb : v t ≤ v b) :
    AReach A oracle y (GuardLe A y B) (some test₁, v, none)
      (some (if v a ≤ v b then yes else no), Function.update v t (min (v a) (v b)), none) := by
  generalize hn : min (v a) (v b) - v t = n
  induction n generalizing v with
  | zero =>
    have hm : v t = min (v a) (v b) := by omega
    by_cases hab : v a ≤ v b
    · have eq : v t = v a := by omega
      rw [if_pos hab, ← hm, Function.update_eq_self]
      simpa [astep, htest₁, eq] using
        (AReach.single (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := y) (G := GuardLe A y B)
          (a := (some test₁, v, none)) ⟨by simp [PreS, htest₁, hta], hv⟩)
    · have ne : v t ≠ v a := by omega
      have eq : v t = v b := by omega
      rw [if_neg hab, ← hm, Function.update_eq_self]
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, htest₁, hta], hv⟩
      simp only [astep, htest₁, if_neg ne]
      simpa [astep, htest₂, eq] using
        (AReach.single (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := y) (G := GuardLe A y B)
          (a := (some test₂, v, none)) ⟨by simp [PreS, htest₂, htb], hv⟩)
  | succ n ih =>
    have ne₁ : v t ≠ v a := by omega
    have ne₂ : v t ≠ v b := by omega
    set v₁ := Function.update v t (v t + 1)
    have b₁ : ∀ r, v₁ r ≤ B := register_update_le v t B _ hv (by have := hv a; omega)
    have va : v₁ a = v a := by simp [v₁, hta.symm]
    have vb : v₁ b = v b := by simp [v₁, htb.symm]
    have vt : v₁ t = v t + 1 := by simp [v₁]
    have rest := ih v₁ b₁ (by omega) (by omega) (by rw [va, vb, vt]; omega)
    rw [va, vb, show Function.update v₁ t (min (v a) (v b)) = Function.update v t (min (v a) (v b))
      by simp [v₁]] at rest
    apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, htest₁, hta], hv⟩
    simp only [astep, htest₁, if_neg ne₁]
    apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, htest₂, htb], hv⟩
    simp only [astep, htest₂, if_neg ne₂]
    apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hbump], hv⟩
    simp only [astep, hbump]
    exact rest

end Complexity.Codec
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Codec/Langs.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Step

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The four code languages

The languages a configuration-graph algorithm calls on codes of configurations of a fixed
machine `N` on its real input `x`, at window radius `s` [AB09, §4.1.1]. Each takes the input
`x`, one or two codes and the radius, laid out as the virtual input of a `whole`-mode call
of an abstract register machine whose registers hold the codes and the radius
(`Complexity.LogProg.vword`): `⟨x, ⟨bits c, bits s⟩⟩` or `⟨x, ⟨bits c, ⟨bits c', bits s⟩⟩⟩`.

* `Complexity.Codec.validLang N` — `c` is the code of a window-bounded configuration;
* `Complexity.Codec.initLang N` — `c` is the code of the initial configuration;
* `Complexity.Codec.acceptLang N` — `c` is the code of a halted window-bounded
  configuration with output `[true]` (acceptance as in `Turing.FinNDTM.AcceptsWithin`);
* `Complexity.Codec.stepLang N` — `c`, `c'` are codes of window-bounded configurations
  with an edge `Turing.NDTM.CfgStep` between them.

Besides the membership characterizations, this file reduces membership to the finite
checks on code words that the logspace deciders perform (`ValidChk`, `InitChk`,
`AcceptChk`, `StepChk`).

Configuration-graph infrastructure; not a result of [AB09].

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.validLang`, `initLang`, `acceptLang`, `stepLang`.
* `Complexity.Codec.InitChk`, `AcceptChk`, `StepChk` — the word-level checks.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.mem_validLang`, `mem_initLang`, `mem_acceptLang`, `mem_stepLang` —
  membership through the codec.
* `Complexity.Codec.initChk_iff`, `acceptChk_iff`, `stepChk_iff` — the checks recognize
  the code words of the respective configurations.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

variable (N : FinNDTM Bool)

/-! ## The languages -/

/-- **Valid codes**: `⟨x, ⟨bits c, bits s⟩⟩` such that `c` is the code at radius `s` of a
window-bounded configuration of `N` on `x`. -/
def validLang : Language Bool :=
  {y | ∃ (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ), y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∧
    ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, InWin N s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c}

/-- **Initial codes**: `⟨x, ⟨bits c, bits s⟩⟩` such that `c` is the code at radius `s` of the
initial configuration of `N` on `x`. -/
def initLang : Language Bool :=
  {y | ∃ (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ), y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∧
    cfgCode s (N.tm.initCfg x) = c}

/-- **Accepting codes**: `⟨x, ⟨bits c, bits s⟩⟩` such that `c` is the code at radius `s` of a
window-bounded configuration of `N` on `x` that is halted with output exactly `[true]`. -/
def acceptLang : Language Bool :=
  {y | ∃ (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ), y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∧
    ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, InWin N s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧ C.state = none ∧
      C.output = [true]}

/-- **Step pairs**: `⟨x, ⟨bits c, ⟨bits c', bits s⟩⟩⟩` such that `c` and `c'` are the codes at
radius `s` of window-bounded configurations of `N` on `x` joined by a configuration-graph
edge (one step under some choice bit). -/
def stepLang : Language Bool :=
  {y | ∃ (x : List Bool) (c c' s : ℕ),
    y = pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (pairEncode (Nat.bits c') (Nat.bits s))) ∧
    ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, InWin N s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧
      ∃ C' : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, N.tm.CfgStep C C' ∧ InWin N s C' ∧ cfgCode s C' = c'}

/-- The pairing is injective in both components. -/
lemma pairEncode_inj {a b a' b' : List Bool} (h : pairEncode a b = pairEncode a' b') :
    a = a' ∧ b = b' := by
  have := pairEncode_injective (show (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => pairEncode p.1 p.2) (a, b) =
    (fun p : List Bool × List Bool => pairEncode p.1 p.2) (a', b') from h)
  simpa using this

/-- **Membership in the valid-code language.** -/
theorem mem_validLang (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ) :
    pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ validLang N ↔
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, InWin N s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x', c', s', h, hC⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, h2⟩ := pairEncode_inj h
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := pairEncode_inj h2
    rw [bits_injective h3, bits_injective h4]
    exact hC
  · intro h; exact ⟨x, c, s, rfl, h⟩

/-- **Membership in the initial-code language.** -/
theorem mem_initLang (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ) :
    pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ initLang N ↔
      cfgCode s (N.tm.initCfg x) = c := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x', c', s', h, hC⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, h2⟩ := pairEncode_inj h
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := pairEncode_inj h2
    rw [bits_injective h3, bits_injective h4]
    exact hC
  · intro h; exact ⟨x, c, s, rfl, h⟩

/-- **Membership in the accepting-code language.** -/
theorem mem_acceptLang (x : List Bool) (c s : ℕ) :
    pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ acceptLang N ↔
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, InWin N s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧ C.state = none ∧
        C.output = [true] := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x', c', s', h, hC⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, h2⟩ := pairEncode_inj h
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := pairEncode_inj h2
    rw [bits_injective h3, bits_injective h4]
    exact hC
  · intro h; exact ⟨x, c, s, rfl, h⟩

/-- **Membership in the step language.** -/
theorem mem_stepLang (x : List Bool) (c c' s : ℕ) :
    pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits c) (pairEncode (Nat.bits c') (Nat.bits s))) ∈
        stepLang N ↔
      ∃ C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, InWin N s C ∧ cfgCode s C = c ∧
        ∃ C' : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x, N.tm.CfgStep C C' ∧ InWin N s C' ∧ cfgCode s C' = c' := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x', c₁, c₂, s', h, hC⟩
    obtain ⟨rfl, h2⟩ := pairEncode_inj h
    obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := pairEncode_inj h2
    obtain ⟨h5, h6⟩ := pairEncode_inj h4
    rw [bits_injective h3, bits_injective h5, bits_injective h6]
    exact hC
  · intro h; exact ⟨x, c, c', s, rfl, h⟩

end Complexity.Codec
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Codec/Layout.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Parse

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The codec machine lays out a code word and scans it

The second phase of the codec machine `Complexity.Codec.CA`: from the field positions of
the parse and the radius `s`, compute `|x| + 1`, the position-field width `wP |x|`, the end
`E` of the chunk region and the end `F` of the position field of the code word `w`; check the
length of `w` and its final letter; decode the input position. The machine rejects exactly
when the length or the final letter is wrong.

Logspace machine infrastructure for the codec; not a result of [AB09].

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.layR` — the register file after the layout phase.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.two_pow_bits_le`, `Complexity.Codec.wP_le` — width arithmetic.
* `Complexity.Codec.layout_run` — the layout phase of the first code word.
* `Complexity.Codec.le_phase` — the position comparison.
* `Complexity.Codec.vscan_run` — the validity scan.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

variable {N : FinNDTM Bool} {mode : CMode}

/-- `2 ^ |bits L| ≤ 2L` for `L ≥ 1`. -/
lemma two_pow_bits_le (L : ℕ) (hL : 1 ≤ L) : 2 ^ (Nat.bits L).length ≤ 2 * L := by
  rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
  have hpos : 1 ≤ Nat.size L := Nat.size_pos.mpr (by omega)
  have hlt : ¬ L < 2 ^ (Nat.size L - 1) := by
    rw [← Nat.size_le]; omega
  have e : 2 ^ Nat.size L = 2 * 2 ^ (Nat.size L - 1) := by
    rw [← pow_succ']; congr 1; omega
  omega

/-- The position-field width is at most `n + 1`. -/
lemma wP_le (n : ℕ) : wP n ≤ n + 1 := by
  have h1 := length_bits_le_log (n + 1)
  have h2 := Nat.log_lt_self 2 (show n + 1 ≠ 0 by omega)
  simp only [wP]
  omega

/-- Letters of the first code word inside the input. -/
lemma getD_w (x w rest : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < w.length) :
    (pairEncode x (pairEncode w rest)).getD (2 * x.length + 2 + 2 * i) false = w.getD i false := by
  rw [pe_getD_snd, pe_getD_fst _ _ _ hi]

/-- The register bound dominates the layout arithmetic. -/
lemma bnd_ge (y : List Bool) (s : ℕ) (hs : s ≤ 2 * y.length) :
    y.length + 2 * W N * (2 * s + 1) + 2 * (y.length + 1) + 4 ≤ bnd N y := by
  unfold bnd
  have h1 : 2 * W N * (2 * s + 1) ≤ 2 * W N * (4 * y.length + 1) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
  have e1 : 2 * W N * (4 * y.length + 1) = 8 * (W N * y.length) + 2 * W N := by ring
  have e2 : (8 * W N + 8) * (y.length + 1) = 8 * (W N * y.length) + 8 * W N + 8 * y.length + 8 := by
    ring
  omega

/-- A register file's valuation at an `if` between two registers. -/
lemma Regs.val_ite (R : Regs) (c : Prop) [Decidable c] (r r' : Fin 21) :
    R.val (if c then r else r') = if c then R.val r else R.val r' := by
  split <;> rfl

variable (N) in
/-- The register file after the layout phase. -/
def layR (R : Regs) (n s pos : ℕ) : Regs :=
  { R with
    N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := 2 * n + 2 + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N,
    F := 2 * n + 2 + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N + 2 * wP n,
    U := 2 * n + 2 + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N + 2 * wP n + 4,
    Q1 := 2 * n + 2 + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N, Pos := pos }

/-- **The layout phase**: on an input `⟨x, ⟨w, …⟩⟩` with the radius `s` in `rS`, the machine
computes `|x| + 1`, the field width `wP |x|`, the chunk-region end `E`, the position-field
end `F`; it rejects unless `w` has the code length (compared through `F + 4` with the start
of the next field) and ends with `1`; otherwise it decodes the input position and reaches
the position comparison.

**Proof sketch.** A straight sequence of the loop families: copy and halve (`cp_run`, one
`half`), count the width (`hc_run`), scale and add (`sc_run`, `ic_run`) to get
`E = a + 2W(2s + 1)` and `F = E + 2 wP`, compare `F + 4` with the next field's start (the
code length), read the final letter, and decode the position field at stride two
(`dc_run`). Letters of `w` sit at `a + 2i` (`getD_w`). -/
theorem layout_run (y x w rest : List Bool) (hy : y = pairEncode x (pairEncode w rest))
    (R : Regs) (s : ℕ) (hBd : R.Bd (bnd N y)) (hL : R.L = y.length) (hA : R.A = 2 * x.length + 2)
    (hS : R.S = s) (hs : s ≤ 2 * y.length) (hN1 : R.N1 = 0) (hWp : R.Wp = 0) (hE : R.E = 0)
    (hF : R.F = 0) (hT : R.T = 0) (hU : R.U = 0) (hPos : R.Pos = 0)
    (hcmp : (if mode = .step then R.B else R.P) = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4) :
    (w.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length + 1 ∧
      w.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length) false = true ∧
      Reach N mode y (bnd N y) (.cp .N1) R.val .leT1
        (layR N R x.length s (bitsVal ((w.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length)))).val) ∨
    (¬ (w.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length + 1 ∧
      w.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length) false = true) ∧
      AHalt (CA N mode) orc y (GuardLe (CA N mode) y (bnd N y)) (some (.cp .N1), R.val, none) false) := by
  set B := bnd N y
  set n := x.length
  set a := 2 * n + 2
  set e := a + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N
  set f := e + 2 * wP n
  have hyl : y.length = a + 2 * w.length + 2 + rest.length := by
    rw [hy, length_pairEncode, length_pairEncode]; ring
  have hbig := bnd_ge (N := N) y s hs
  have hwP := wP_le n
  have he2 : e = a + 2 * W N * (2 * s + 1) := by simp only [e]; ring
  have hB0 := hBd
  simp only [Regs.Bd] at hB0
  -- the arithmetic
  have r1 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .N1) R.val .halveN ({R with N1 := a} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .N1 R.val hBd.val_le (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc]; omega))
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hA, a])
  have r2 : Reach N mode y B .halveN ({R with N1 := a} : Regs).val (.cp .Tn)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega) (by simp [PreS, CA]))
      (by simp [astep, CA, a])
  have r3 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .Tn) ({R with N1 := n + 1} : Regs).val .hcTest
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, T := n + 1} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Tn _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hT])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  have r4 : Reach N mode y B .hcTest ({R with N1 := n + 1, T := n + 1} : Regs).val (.cp .E)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (hc_run y B _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [hWp]; simp only [wP] at hwP; omega)) (by simp [hWp, hT, wP])
  have r5 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .E) ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n} : Regs).val (.cp .Ts)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := a} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .E _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hE])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hA, a])
  have r6 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .Ts) ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := a} : Regs).val
      (.sc .E) ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := a, T := s} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Ts _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hT])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hS])
  have r7 : Reach N mode y B (.sc .E) ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := a, T := s} : Regs).val
      (icL N .E 0) ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := a + 4 * W N * s, T := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (sc_run y B .E _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor]; omega)) (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor])
  have r8 : Reach N mode y B (icL N .E 0)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := a + 4 * W N * s, T := 0} : Regs).val (.cp .F)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (ic_run y B .E _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [icReg, icCount]; omega)) (by simp [icReg, icCount, e])
  have r9 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .F)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0} : Regs).val (.cp .Tw)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0, F := e} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .F _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hF])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  have r10 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .Tw)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0, F := e} : Regs).val (.sc .F)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := wP n, F := e} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Tw _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  have r11 : Reach N mode y B (.sc .F)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := wP n, F := e} : Regs).val .clrU
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0, F := f} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (sc_run y B .F _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor]; omega)) (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor, f])
  have r12 : Reach N mode y B .clrU
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0, F := f} : Regs).val (.cp .U)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0, F := f, U := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA])
  have r13 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .U)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0, F := f, U := 0} : Regs).val (icL N .U 0)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0, F := f, U := f} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .U _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  have r14 : Reach N mode y B (icL N .U 0)
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0, F := f, U := f} : Regs).val .lenChk
      ({R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0, F := f, U := f + 4} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (ic_run y B .U _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [icReg, icCount]; omega)) (by simp [icReg, icCount])
  have r1_14 := r1.trans (r2.trans (r3.trans (r4.trans (r5.trans (r6.trans (r7.trans (r8.trans
    (r9.trans (r10.trans (r11.trans (r12.trans (r13.trans r14))))))))))))
  set R14 : Regs := {R with N1 := n + 1, Wp := wP n, E := e, T := 0, F := f, U := f + 4}
  have hR14 : R14.Bd B := by simp only [R14, Regs.Bd]; omega
  have hcmp' : R14.val (if mode = .step then rB else rP) = 2 * n + 2 * w.length + 4 := by
    rw [Regs.val_ite]; simpa [R14] using hcmp
  have hneq : (if mode = .step then rB else rP) ≠ rU := by split <;> decide
  by_cases hlen : w.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n + 1
  · have heq : f + 4 = 2 * n + 2 * w.length + 4 := by
      rw [hlen]; simp only [f, e, a]; ring
    have r15 : Reach N mode y B .lenChk R14.val .term R14.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; exact fun h => hneq h.symm))
        (by simp only [astep, CA]; rw [hcmp']; simp [R14, heq])
    have hterm : y.getD f false = w.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n) false := by
      rw [show f = 2 * x.length + 2 + 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n) by
          simp only [f, e, a, n]; ring, hy, getD_w _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at hterm
    by_cases htm : w.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n) false = true
    · have htm' := htm
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at htm'
      left
      refine ⟨hlen, htm, ?_⟩
      have r16 : Reach N mode y B .term R14.val .clrQ1 R14.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
          (by simp [astep, CA, vword_whole₁, orc_bit, R14, hterm, htm'])
      have r17 : Reach N mode y B .clrQ1 R14.val (.cp .Q1f) ({R14 with Q1 := 0} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA])
      have r18 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .Q1f) ({R14 with Q1 := 0} : Regs).val (.dcTest .Pos)
          ({R14 with Q1 := f} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Q1f _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [R14, Regs.Bd]; omega)
          (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, R14])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, R14])
      set pf := (w.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP n)
      have hpf : pf.length = wP n := by simp only [pf, List.length_take, List.length_drop]; omega
      have hpow : 2 ^ wP n ≤ 2 * (n + 1) := two_pow_bits_le (n + 1) (by omega)
      have r19 : Reach N mode y B (.dcTest .Pos) ({R14 with Q1 := f} : Regs).val .leT1
          ({R14 with Q1 := e, Pos := bitsVal pf} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.cast (dc_run y B .Pos pf
          (fun i _ => by
            have h1 := bitsVal_lt_two_pow (pf.drop i)
            have h2 : 2 ^ (pf.drop i).length ≤ 2 ^ wP n :=
              Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by simp; omega)
            omega)
          _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [R14, Regs.Bd]; omega)
          (by simp [dcPtr, dcBase, dcStride, R14, hpf, f])
          (by simp [dcAcc, R14, hPos]) (by simp [R14])
          (fun i hi => by
            rw [hpf] at hi
            simp only [dcBase, dcStride, R14, Regs.val_E]
            rw [hy, show e + 2 * i = 2 * x.length + 2 + 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1) + i) by
                rw [he2]; simp only [a, n]; ring,
              getD_w _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
            simp only [pf, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take, if_pos hi,
              List.getElem?_drop]))
          (by simp [dcPtr, dcBase, dcAcc, R14])
      refine (r1_14.trans (r15.trans (r16.trans (r17.trans (r18.trans r19))))).cast ?_
      simp only [layR, R14, e, f, a, pf, n, hT]
    · have htm' : (w[W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n]?).getD false = false := by
        rw [← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]; simpa using htm
      right
      refine ⟨fun h => htm h.2, ?_⟩
      have r16 : Reach N mode y B .term R14.val .rej R14.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
          (by simp [astep, CA, vword_whole₁, orc_bit, R14, hterm, htm'])
      exact halt_rej (r1_14.trans (r15.trans r16)) hR14.val_le
  · right
    refine ⟨fun h => hlen h.1, ?_⟩
    have hne : f + 4 ≠ 2 * n + 2 * w.length + 4 := by
      intro h; apply hlen; simp only [f, e, a] at h
      have : 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N = 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1)) := by ring
      omega
    have r15 : Reach N mode y B .lenChk R14.val .rej R14.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; exact fun h => hneq h.symm))
        (by
          have hne' : ¬ f = 2 * n + 2 * w.length := by omega
          simp only [astep, CA]; rw [hcmp']; simp [R14, hne'])
    exact halt_rej (r1_14.trans r15) hR14.val_le

/-! ## The position comparison and the validity scan -/


/-- **The position comparison**: with `rT = 0`, a position at most `rN1` continues (to the
second code word for steps, to the scan otherwise) with `rT` cleared again; a larger
position is rejected.

**Proof sketch.** `le_run`, then one `clr`. -/
theorem le_phase (y : List Bool) (R : Regs) (hBd : R.Bd (bnd N y)) (hT : R.T = 0) :
    (R.Pos ≤ R.N1 → Reach N mode y (bnd N y) .leT1 R.val
      (if mode = .step then .cp .E2 else .clrQ1v) R.val) ∧
    (¬ R.Pos ≤ R.N1 →
      AHalt (CA N mode) orc y (GuardLe (CA N mode) y (bnd N y)) (some .leT1, R.val, none) false) := by
  have hB0 := hBd
  simp only [Regs.Bd] at hB0
  have h := le_run (N := N) (mode := mode) y (bnd N y) R.val hBd.val_le (by simpa using hT)
  simp only [Regs.val_Pos, Regs.val_N1, Regs.upd_T] at h
  constructor
  · intro hle
    rw [if_pos hle] at h
    refine h.trans ?_
    refine Reach.single' (gd_of ?_ (by simp [PreS, CA])) ?_
    · apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega
    · simp [astep, CA]
      have : ({R with T := 0} : Regs) = R := by cases R; simp_all
      rw [this]
  · intro hle
    rw [if_neg hle] at h
    exact halt_rej h (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)

/-- **The validity scan**: from `.clrQ1v`, with `rA` at the start of the code word `w` and
`rE` at the end of its chunk region (`W (2s + 1)` letters, inside `w`), the machine clears
and sets both scan pointers to `rA` and runs the validity scan over the region, ending in
`vDone` of the scan state whose first component is `vScan` of the region.

**Proof sketch.** Two clears and two copies set the pointers; the scan engine (`v_run`) reads
the region at stride two (`getD_w`), and its final state is by definition the adaptor fold
whose first component is `vScan`. -/
theorem vscan_run (y x w rest : List Bool) (hy : y = pairEncode x (pairEncode w rest))
    (R : Regs) (s : ℕ) (hBd : R.Bd (bnd N y)) (hA : R.A = 2 * x.length + 2)
    (hE : R.E = 2 * x.length + 2 + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N)
    (hw : W N * (2 * s + 1) ≤ w.length) :
    ∃ st : VAd N, st.1 = vScan N (w.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))) ∧
      Reach N mode y (bnd N y) .clrQ1v R.val (.vDone st) ({R with Q1 := R.E, Q2 := R.E} : Regs).val := by
  set B := bnd N y
  have hB0 := hBd
  simp only [Regs.Bd] at hB0
  have hE' : R.E = R.A + 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1)) := by rw [hE, hA]; ring
  have r1 : Reach N mode y B .clrQ1v R.val .clrQ2v ({R with Q1 := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of hBd.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA])
  have r2 : Reach N mode y B .clrQ2v ({R with Q1 := 0} : Regs).val (.cp .Q1a)
      ({R with Q1 := 0, Q2 := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA])
  have r3 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .Q1a) ({R with Q1 := 0, Q2 := 0} : Regs).val (.cp .Q2a)
      ({R with Q1 := R.A, Q2 := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Q1a _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  have r4 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .Q2a) ({R with Q1 := R.A, Q2 := 0} : Regs).val (.vTest (vAd0 N))
      ({R with Q1 := R.A, Q2 := R.A} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Q2a _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  set u := w.take (W N * (2 * s + 1))
  have hu : u.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) := by simp only [u, List.length_take]; omega
  have ho : ∀ i < u.length, y.getD (R.A + 2 * i) false = u.getD i false := by
    intro i hi
    rw [hu] at hi
    rw [hA, hy, getD_w _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
    simp only [u, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take, if_pos hi]
  have r5 := v_run (N := N) (mode := mode) y B u u rfl (vAd0 N)
    ({R with Q1 := R.A, Q2 := R.A} : Regs).val
    (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega) (by simp [hu, hE'])
    (by simp [hu]; omega) (by simpa using ho) (by simpa using ho)
  refine ⟨_, rfl, (r1.trans (r2.trans (r3.trans r4))).trans (Reach.cast r5 ?_)⟩
  simp [hu, hE']

end Complexity.Codec
```

/-

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Layout

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The step machine lays out the second code word and reads the input symbol

Two phases of the codec machine `Complexity.Codec.CA` in mode `step`: the layout of the second
code word `w'` (its chunk-region end `E₂`, its position-field end `F₂`, the length and
final-letter checks, the decoded input position), and the read of the input symbol under the
first word's input head into the register `rZ` (`0` for a blank, `1` for `0`, `2` for `1`),
followed by the pointer copies of the double sliding scan.

Logspace machine infrastructure for the codec; not a result of [AB09].

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.lay2R` — the register file after the second layout.
* `Complexity.Codec.zcode` — the register code of an input symbol.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.layout2_run` — the layout of the second code word.
* `Complexity.Codec.insym_run` — the input-symbol read and the scan pointers.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

variable {N : FinNDTM Bool}

/-- Letters of the second code word inside a step input. -/
lemma getD_w2 (x w w' rest : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < w'.length) :
    (pairEncode x (pairEncode w (pairEncode w' rest))).getD
      (2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 + 2 * i) false = w'.getD i false := by
  rw [show 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 + 2 * i = 2 * x.length + 2 + (2 * w.length + 2 + 2 * i)
    by ring, pe_getD_snd, pe_getD_snd, pe_getD_fst _ _ _ hi]

variable (N) in
/-- The register file after the layout of the second code word. -/
def lay2R (R : Regs) (b s wp pos : ℕ) : Regs :=
  { R with
    E2 := b + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N, F2 := b + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N + 2 * wp,
    U := b + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N + 2 * wp + 4, Q1 := b + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N,
    Pos2 := pos, T := 0 }

/-- **The layout of the second code word**: as `layout_run`, for `w'` starting at `rB`,
reusing `wP |x|` from `rWp`; the length check compares `F₂ + 4` with the start `rP` of the
radius field. The machine rejects exactly when `w'` has the wrong length or final letter, and
otherwise reaches the input-symbol read with the decoded position of `w'` in `rPos2`.

**Proof sketch.** The loop sequence of `layout_run` from the scale of the radius on, with
letters of `w'` at `b + 2i` (`getD_w2`). -/
theorem layout2_run (y x w w' rest : List Bool)
    (hy : y = pairEncode x (pairEncode w (pairEncode w' rest)))
    (R : Regs) (s : ℕ) (hBd : R.Bd (bnd N y)) (hB : R.B = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4)
    (hP : R.P = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6) (hS : R.S = s)
    (hs : s ≤ 2 * y.length) (hWp : R.Wp = wP x.length) (hE2 : R.E2 = 0) (hF2 : R.F2 = 0)
    (hT : R.T = 0) (hPos2 : R.Pos2 = 0) :
    (w'.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length + 1 ∧
      w'.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length) false = true ∧
      Reach N .step y (bnd N y) (.cp .E2) R.val .inZ
        (lay2R N R (2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4) s (wP x.length)
          (bitsVal ((w'.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP x.length)))).val) ∨
    (¬ (w'.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length + 1 ∧
      w'.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP x.length) false = true) ∧
      AHalt (CA N .step) orc y (GuardLe (CA N .step) y (bnd N y)) (some (.cp .E2), R.val, none)
        false) := by
  set B := bnd N y
  set n := x.length
  set b := 2 * n + 2 * w.length + 4
  set e := b + 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N
  set f := e + 2 * wP n
  have hyl : y.length = b + 2 * w'.length + 2 + rest.length := by
    rw [hy, length_pairEncode, length_pairEncode, length_pairEncode]; simp only [b, n]; ring
  have hbig := bnd_ge (N := N) y s hs
  have hwP := wP_le n
  have he2 : e = b + 2 * W N * (2 * s + 1) := by simp only [e]; ring
  have hB0 := hBd
  simp only [Regs.Bd] at hB0
  have r5 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .E2) R.val (.cp .Ts2) ({R with E2 := b} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .E2 _ hBd.val_le (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hE2]))
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hB, b])
  have r6 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Ts2) ({R with E2 := b} : Regs).val (.sc .E2)
      ({R with E2 := b, T := s} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Ts2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hT])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hS])
  have r7 : Reach N .step y B (.sc .E2) ({R with E2 := b, T := s} : Regs).val (icL N .E2 0)
      ({R with E2 := b + 4 * W N * s, T := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (sc_run y B .E2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor]; omega)) (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor])
  have r8 : Reach N .step y B (icL N .E2 0) ({R with E2 := b + 4 * W N * s, T := 0} : Regs).val
      (.cp .F2) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (ic_run y B .E2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [icReg, icCount]; omega)) (by simp [icReg, icCount, e])
  have r9 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .F2) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0} : Regs).val (.cp .Tw2)
      ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := e} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .F2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hF2])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  have r10 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Tw2) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := e} : Regs).val (.sc .F2)
      ({R with E2 := e, T := wP n, F2 := e} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Tw2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hWp])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hWp])
  have r11 : Reach N .step y B (.sc .F2) ({R with E2 := e, T := wP n, F2 := e} : Regs).val .clrU2
      ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (sc_run y B .F2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor]; omega)) (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor, f])
  have r12 : Reach N .step y B .clrU2 ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f} : Regs).val (.cp .U2)
      ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA])
  have r13 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .U2) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := 0} : Regs).val
      (icL N .U2 0) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := f} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .U2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  have r14 : Reach N .step y B (icL N .U2 0) ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := f} : Regs).val
      .lenChk2 ({R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := f + 4} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (ic_run y B .U2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [icReg, icCount]; omega)) (by simp [icReg, icCount])
  have r5_14 := r5.trans (r6.trans (r7.trans (r8.trans (r9.trans (r10.trans (r11.trans
    (r12.trans (r13.trans r14))))))))
  set R14 : Regs := {R with E2 := e, T := 0, F2 := f, U := f + 4}
  have hR14 : R14.Bd B := by simp only [R14, Regs.Bd]; omega
  by_cases hlen : w'.length = W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n + 1
  · have heq : f + 4 = 2 * n + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6 := by
      rw [hlen]; simp only [f, e, b]; ring
    have r15 : Reach N .step y B .lenChk2 R14.val .term2 R14.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide)) (by simp [astep, CA, R14, heq, hP])
    have hterm : y.getD f false = w'.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n) false := by
      rw [show f = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 + 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n) by
          simp only [f, e, b, n]; ring, hy, getD_w2 _ _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at hterm
    by_cases htm : w'.getD (W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n) false = true
    · have htm' := htm
      rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at htm'
      left
      refine ⟨hlen, htm, ?_⟩
      have r16 : Reach N .step y B .term2 R14.val .clrQ1b R14.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
          (by simp [astep, CA, vword_whole₁, orc_bit, R14, hterm, htm'])
      have r17 : Reach N .step y B .clrQ1b R14.val (.cp .Q1f2) ({R14 with Q1 := 0} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA])
      have r18 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Q1f2) ({R14 with Q1 := 0} : Regs).val (.dcTest .Pos2)
          ({R14 with Q1 := f} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Q1f2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [R14, Regs.Bd]; omega)
          (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, R14])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, R14])
      set pf := (w'.drop (W N * (2 * s + 1))).take (wP n)
      have hpf : pf.length = wP n := by simp only [pf, List.length_take, List.length_drop]; omega
      have hpow : 2 ^ wP n ≤ 2 * (n + 1) := two_pow_bits_le (n + 1) (by omega)
      have r19 : Reach N .step y B (.dcTest .Pos2) ({R14 with Q1 := f} : Regs).val .inZ
          ({R14 with Q1 := e, Pos2 := bitsVal pf} : Regs).val :=
        Reach.cast (dc_run y B .Pos2 pf
          (fun i _ => by
            have h1 := bitsVal_lt_two_pow (pf.drop i)
            have h2 : 2 ^ (pf.drop i).length ≤ 2 ^ wP n :=
              Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by simp; omega)
            omega)
          _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [R14, Regs.Bd]; omega)
          (by simp [dcPtr, dcBase, dcStride, R14, hpf, f])
          (by simp [dcAcc, R14, hPos2]) (by simp [R14])
          (fun i hi => by
            rw [hpf] at hi
            simp only [dcBase, dcStride, R14, Regs.val_E2]
            rw [hy, show e + 2 * i = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 + 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1) + i) by
                rw [he2]; simp only [b, n]; ring,
              getD_w2 _ _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
            simp only [pf, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take, if_pos hi,
              List.getElem?_drop]))
          (by simp [dcPtr, dcBase, dcAcc, R14])
      refine (r5_14.trans (r15.trans (r16.trans (r17.trans (r18.trans r19))))).cast ?_
      simp only [lay2R, R14, e, f, b, pf, n]
    · have htm' : (w'[W N * (2 * s + 1) + wP n]?).getD false = false := by
        rw [← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]; simpa using htm
      right
      refine ⟨fun h => htm h.2, ?_⟩
      have r16 : Reach N .step y B .term2 R14.val .rej R14.val :=
        Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
          (by simp [astep, CA, vword_whole₁, orc_bit, R14, hterm, htm'])
      exact halt_rej (r5_14.trans (r15.trans r16)) hR14.val_le
  · right
    refine ⟨fun h => hlen h.1, ?_⟩
    have hne : ¬ f = 2 * n + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 2 := by
      intro h; apply hlen; simp only [f, e, b] at h
      have : 4 * W N * s + 2 * W N = 2 * (W N * (2 * s + 1)) := by ring
      omega
    have r15 : Reach N .step y B .lenChk2 R14.val .rej R14.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR14.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide)) (by simp [astep, CA, R14, hP, hne])
    exact halt_rej (r5_14.trans r15) hR14.val_le

/-- The register code of an optional input symbol: `0` blank, `1` for `0`, `2` for `1`. -/
def zcode : Option Bool → ℕ
  | none => 0
  | some false => 1
  | some true => 2

/-- **The input-symbol read**: the machine stores the code of the input symbol under the
first word's input head (`inpOf`) in `rZ`, then copies the scan pointers `rQ3 := rA`,
`rQ4 := rB`.

**Proof sketch.** Zero and end tests on the position; otherwise copy the position, decrement,
double into `rU` (`sc_run`) — the address of input letter `pos - 1` in the doubled first
field — read it (`pe_getD_fst`) and count it into `rZ`; then two copies. -/
theorem insym_run (y x rest : List Bool) (hy : y = pairEncode x rest) (R : Regs)
    (hBd : R.Bd (bnd N y)) (hPos : R.Pos ≤ x.length + 1) (hN1 : R.N1 = x.length + 1)
    (hT : R.T = 0) (hZ : R.Z = 0) (hQ3 : R.Q3 = 0) (hQ4 : R.Q4 = 0) :
    ∃ u, u ≤ bnd N y ∧ Reach N .step y (bnd N y) .inZ R.val .clrQ1v
      ({R with Z := zcode (inpOf x R.Pos), U := u, Q3 := R.A, Q4 := R.B} : Regs).val := by
  set B := bnd N y
  have hB0 := hBd
  simp only [Regs.Bd] at hB0
  have hyl : y.length = 2 * x.length + 2 + rest.length := by rw [hy, length_pairEncode]
  have hLB : y.length ≤ B := length_le_bnd y
  -- the pointer copies
  have copies : ∀ R' : Regs, R'.Bd B → R'.Q3 = 0 → R'.Q4 = 0 →
      Reach N .step y B (.cp .Q3) R'.val .clrQ1v ({R' with Q3 := R'.A, Q4 := R'.B} : Regs).val := by
    intro R' hR' h3 h4
    have hR'0 := hR'
    simp only [Regs.Bd] at hR'0
    have c1 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Q3) R'.val (.cp .Q4) ({R' with Q3 := R'.A} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Q3 _ hR'.val_le (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, h3])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
    have c2 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Q4) ({R' with Q3 := R'.A} : Regs).val .clrQ1v
        ({R' with Q3 := R'.A, Q4 := R'.B} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Q4 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
        (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, h4])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
    exact c1.trans c2
  by_cases h0 : R.Pos = 0
  · refine ⟨R.U, hB0.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
    have r1 : Reach N .step y B .inZ R.val (.cp .Q3) R.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hBd.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA, h0])
    have := copies R hBd hQ3 hQ4
    exact (r1.trans this).cast (by simp [inpOf, h0, zcode, hZ])
  have r1 : Reach N .step y B .inZ R.val .inN R.val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of hBd.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA, h0])
  by_cases h1 : R.Pos = x.length + 1
  · refine ⟨R.U, hB0.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, ?_⟩
    have r2 : Reach N .step y B .inN R.val (.cp .Q3) R.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hBd.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide)) (by simp [astep, CA, h1, hN1])
    have := copies R hBd hQ3 hQ4
    exact (r1.trans (r2.trans this)).cast (by simp [inpOf, h1, zcode, hZ])
  have r2 : Reach N .step y B .inN R.val (.cp .Tpos) R.val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of hBd.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]; decide))
      (by simp [astep, CA, hN1]; omega)
  have r3 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .Tpos) R.val .inDec ({R with T := R.Pos} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Tpos _ hBd.val_le (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hT])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
  have r4 : Reach N .step y B .inDec ({R with T := R.Pos} : Regs).val .clrU3
      ({R with T := R.Pos - 1} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA])
  have r5 : Reach N .step y B .clrU3 ({R with T := R.Pos - 1} : Regs).val (.sc .In)
      ({R with T := R.Pos - 1, U := 0} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.single' (gd_of (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA])
  have r6 : Reach N .step y B (.sc .In) ({R with T := R.Pos - 1, U := 0} : Regs).val .inRead
      ({R with T := 0, U := 2 * (R.Pos - 1)} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (sc_run y B .In _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor]; omega)) (by simp [scDst, scSrc, scFactor])
  set R6 : Regs := {R with T := 0, U := 2 * (R.Pos - 1)}
  have hR6 : R6.Bd B := by simp only [R6, Regs.Bd]; omega
  have hbit : y.getD (2 * (R.Pos - 1)) false = x.getD (R.Pos - 1) false := by
    rw [hy, pe_getD_fst _ _ _ (by omega)]
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD] at hbit
  have hin : inpOf x R.Pos = some (x.getD (R.Pos - 1) false) := by
    simp [inpOf, h0, h1]
  refine ⟨2 * (R.Pos - 1), by omega, ?_⟩
  rw [hin, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  cases hb : (x[R.Pos - 1]?).getD false
  · have r7 : Reach N .step y B .inRead R6.val .inF R6.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR6.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
        (by simp [astep, CA, vword_whole₁, orc_bit, R6, hbit, hb])
    have r8 : Reach N .step y B .inF R6.val (.cp .Q3) ({R6 with Z := 1} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR6.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA, R6, hZ])
    have := copies ({R6 with Z := 1} : Regs) (by simp only [R6, Regs.Bd]; omega) (by simp [R6, hQ3])
      (by simp [R6, hQ4])
    exact (r1.trans (r2.trans (r3.trans (r4.trans (r5.trans (r6.trans (r7.trans (r8.trans
      this)))))))).cast (by simp [R6, hT, zcode])
  · have r7 : Reach N .step y B .inRead R6.val .inT1 R6.val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR6.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA]))
        (by simp [astep, CA, vword_whole₁, orc_bit, R6, hbit, hb])
    have r8 : Reach N .step y B .inT1 R6.val .inF ({R6 with Z := 1} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of hR6.val_le (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA, R6, hZ])
    have r9 : Reach N .step y B .inF ({R6 with Z := 1} : Regs).val (.cp .Q3)
        ({R6 with Z := 2} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.single' (gd_of (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [R6, Regs.Bd]; omega)
        (by simp [PreS, CA])) (by simp [astep, CA])
    have := copies ({R6 with Z := 2} : Regs) (by simp only [R6, Regs.Bd]; omega) (by simp [R6, hQ3])
      (by simp [R6, hQ4])
    exact (r1.trans (r2.trans (r3.trans (r4.trans (r5.trans (r6.trans (r7.trans (r8.trans
      (r9.trans this))))))))).cast (by simp [R6, hT, zcode])

end Complexity.Codec

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
