```
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Checks
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Engine
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Regs

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The abstract register machine deciding the code languages

One abstract register machine (`Complexity.LogProg.ARM`) over 21 registers, calling the
logspace length and bit oracles of its input (`Complexity.inputLenLang`,
`Complexity.inputBitLang`), decides each of the four code languages; the `mode` selects the
language. On an input `⟨x, ⟨w, s⟩⟩` (or `⟨x, ⟨w, ⟨w', s⟩⟩⟩` for steps) it

1. measures the input and parses its fields with aligned pair scans, rejecting malformed
   inputs, and decodes the radius `s` from the last field after a width check;
2. computes, with copy, scale and increment loops, the layout of the code word `w` — its
   chunk region, its position field, its length — and checks the length and the final
   letter, decodes the input position and compares it with `|x| + 1`;
3. (steps) does the same for `w'`, reads the input symbol under the input head into a
   register, and prepares the pointers of the second scan;
4. runs the validity scan over the chunk region of `w` — the finite-state device of
   `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Valid`, letter by letter through the scan engine;
5. finishes per mode: valid and accepting codes answer from the scan state; the initial code
   also tests the position field and the middle cell; a step moves the input position by the
   action of each choice bit and compares it with that of `w'`, then runs the double sliding
   scan of the two chunk regions.

All registers hold pointers into the input, lengths, or values bounded by a constant times
the input length, so `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_poly` makes the languages logspace
(`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Deciders`).

Logspace machine infrastructure for the codec; not a result of [AB09].

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.Lab` — the labels.
* `Complexity.Codec.CA` — the machine, by `Complexity.Codec.CMode`.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.dcStride_le`, `Complexity.Codec.scFactor_le`,
  `Complexity.Codec.icCount_le` — the label families are finite.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

/-! ## Oracles and modes -/

/-- The length oracle: `Complexity.inputLenLang`. -/
abbrev jLen : Fin 2 := 0

/-- The bit oracle: `Complexity.inputBitLang`. -/
abbrev jBit : Fin 2 := 1

/-- Which code language the machine decides. -/
inductive CMode where
  /-- valid codes -/
  | valid
  /-- the initial code -/
  | init
  /-- accepting codes -/
  | accept
  /-- step pairs -/
  | step
  deriving DecidableEq

/-! ## Labels -/

/-- The copy loops of the machine (destination `cpDst`, source `cpSrc`). -/
inductive CpId where
  | A | B | Q1s | Cap | Q2 | N1 | Tn | E | Ts | F | Tw | U | Q1f
  | E2 | Ts2 | F2 | Tw2 | U2 | Q1f2 | Tpos | Q3 | Q4 | Q1a | Q2a | Uc | Tsc
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- The scale loops of the machine (`scDst += scFactor · scSrc`). -/
inductive ScId where
  | E | F | E2 | F2 | In | C
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- The increment chains of the machine (`icReg += icCount`). -/
inductive IcId where
  | E | U | E2 | U2 | C
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- The decoding loops of the machine: the radius, and the two input positions. -/
inductive DcId where
  | S | Pos | Pos2
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- The phases of moving the input position by one choice bit's action and comparing. -/
inductive PmPh where
  | start | eq | inc | eq2 | decR (r : Bool) | decN | eq3 | incR (r : Bool)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

variable (N : FinNDTM Bool)

/-- The validity-scan state through the chunk adaptor. -/
abbrev VAd := AdSt (VSt N) (Bool × Bool) (hH N + 3 * N.k)

/-- The double-sliding-scan state through the chunk adaptor. -/
abbrev SAd := AdSt (SSt N) (Bool × Bool) (hH N + 3 * N.k)

set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
set_option synthInstance.maxSize 2000 in
/-- The labels of the codec machine. -/
inductive Lab where
  | rej | acc
  | lenScan | lenInc
  | prScan (p : Fin 3) | prFirst (p : Fin 3) | prTest (p : Fin 3) (b : Bool)
  | prRead (p : Fin 3) (b : Bool) | prAdv (p : Fin 3) (k : Fin 4)
  | cp (c : CpId) | cpI (c : CpId)
  | ctTest (b : Bool) | ctCheck | ctRead | ctHalve (b : Bool) | ctAdv (b : Bool)
  | dcTest (c : DcId) | dcDown (c : DcId) (i : Fin 2) | dcRead (c : DcId)
  | dcCopy (c : DcId) (b : Bool) | dcBump (c : DcId) (b : Bool) | dcClear (c : DcId) (b : Bool)
  | dcScale (c : DcId) (b : Bool) | dcTake (c : DcId) (b : Bool)
  | dcInc (c : DcId) (b : Bool) (i : Fin 2) | dcAdd (c : DcId) (b : Bool)
  | halveN
  | hcTest | hcHalve | hcBump
  | sc (c : ScId) | scDown (c : ScId) | scInc (c : ScId) (i : Fin (4 * W N))
  | ic (c : IcId) (i : Fin (4 * W N))
  | clrU | lenChk | term | clrQ1
  | leT1 | leT2 | leBump | leClr
  | clrU2 | lenChk2 | term2 | clrQ1b
  | inZ | inN | inDec | clrU3 | inRead | inT1 | inF
  | clrQ1v | clrQ2v
  | vTest (st : VAd N) | vRd1 (st : VAd N) | vRd2 (st : VAd N) (b : Bool)
  | vAdv1 (st : VAd N) (i : Fin 2) | vAdv2 (st : VAd N) (i : Fin 2) | vDone (st : VAd N)
  | iz1 | iz2 | iz3 | icen | clrUc | cenRead
  | zA (σ : VSt N) | zB (σ : VSt N) | zC (σ : VSt N)
  | pm (I : SInfo N) (b f : Bool) (ph : PmPh)
  | sTest (I : SInfo N) (f₀ f₁ : Bool) (st : SAd N) | sRd1 (I : SInfo N) (f₀ f₁ : Bool) (st : SAd N)
  | sRd2 (I : SInfo N) (f₀ f₁ : Bool) (st : SAd N) (b : Bool)
  | sAdv1 (I : SInfo N) (f₀ f₁ : Bool) (st : SAd N) (i : Fin 2)
  | sAdv2 (I : SInfo N) (f₀ f₁ : Bool) (st : SAd N) (i : Fin 2)
  | sFin (I : SInfo N) (f₀ f₁ : Bool) (st : SAd N)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

end Complexity.Codec

/-! ## The machine -/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

variable (N : FinNDTM Bool)

/-- An unconditional jump (a zero test with equal branches). -/
def goto (l : Lab N) : Ins 21 2 (Lab N) := .jz rZ l l

/-- Destination register of a copy loop. -/
def cpDst : CpId → Fin 21
  | .A => rA | .B => rB | .Q1s => rQ1 | .Cap => rCap | .Q2 => rQ2 | .N1 => rN1 | .Tn => rT
  | .E => rE | .Ts => rT | .F => rF | .Tw => rT | .U => rU | .Q1f => rQ1 | .E2 => rE2
  | .Ts2 => rT | .F2 => rF2 | .Tw2 => rT | .U2 => rU | .Q1f2 => rQ1 | .Tpos => rT
  | .Q3 => rQ3 | .Q4 => rQ4 | .Q1a => rQ1 | .Q2a => rQ2 | .Uc => rU | .Tsc => rT

/-- Source register of a copy loop. -/
def cpSrc : CpId → Fin 21
  | .A => rP | .B => rP | .Q1s => rP | .Cap => rL | .Q2 => rL | .N1 => rA | .Tn => rN1
  | .E => rA | .Ts => rS | .F => rE | .Tw => rWp | .U => rF | .Q1f => rF | .E2 => rB
  | .Ts2 => rS | .F2 => rE2 | .Tw2 => rWp | .U2 => rF2 | .Q1f2 => rF2 | .Tpos => rPos
  | .Q3 => rA | .Q4 => rB | .Q1a => rA | .Q2a => rA | .Uc => rA | .Tsc => rS

/-- The initial validity-scan state. -/
def vAd0 : VAd N := (vInit N, 0, fun _ => (false, false))

/-- The initial double-sliding-scan state. -/
def sAd0 : SAd N := ((sInit N, sInit N), 0, fun _ => (false, false))

/-- Successor of a copy loop. -/
def cpNext : CpId → Lab N
  | .A => .prScan 1 | .B => .prScan 2 | .Q1s => .cp .Cap | .Cap => .ctTest true
  | .Q2 => .dcTest .S | .N1 => .halveN | .Tn => .hcTest | .E => .cp .Ts | .Ts => .sc .E
  | .F => .cp .Tw | .Tw => .sc .F | .U => .ic .U ⟨0, by simp [W]⟩ | .Q1f => .dcTest .Pos
  | .E2 => .cp .Ts2 | .Ts2 => .sc .E2 | .F2 => .cp .Tw2 | .Tw2 => .sc .F2
  | .U2 => .ic .U2 ⟨0, by simp [W]⟩ | .Q1f2 => .dcTest .Pos2 | .Tpos => .inDec
  | .Q3 => .cp .Q4 | .Q4 => .clrQ1v | .Q1a => .cp .Q2a | .Q2a => .vTest (vAd0 N)
  | .Uc => .cp .Tsc | .Tsc => .sc .C

/-- Pointer, base, accumulator, temporary of a decoding loop. -/
def dcPtr : DcId → Fin 21 | .S => rQ2 | .Pos => rQ1 | .Pos2 => rQ1
/-- Base register of a decoding loop. -/
def dcBase : DcId → Fin 21 | .S => rP | .Pos => rE | .Pos2 => rE2
/-- Accumulator of a decoding loop. -/
def dcAcc : DcId → Fin 21 | .S => rS | .Pos => rPos | .Pos2 => rPos2
/-- The stride of a decoding loop: the radius field is plain, code fields are doubled. -/
def dcStride : DcId → ℕ | .S => 1 | .Pos => 2 | .Pos2 => 2

/-- The stride of a decoding loop is at most two. -/
lemma dcStride_le (c : DcId) : dcStride c ≤ 2 := by cases c <;> simp [dcStride]

/-- The decrement labels of a decoding loop. -/
def dcDowns (c : DcId) (i : ℕ) : Lab N :=
  if h : i < dcStride c then .dcDown c ⟨i, by have := dcStride_le c; omega⟩ else .dcRead c

/-- The increment labels of a decoding loop. -/
def dcIncs (c : DcId) (b : Bool) (i : ℕ) : Lab N :=
  if h : i < 2 then .dcInc c b ⟨i, h⟩ else .dcScale c b

/-- Successor of a decoding loop. -/
def dcNext : DcId → Lab N | .S => .cp .N1 | .Pos => .leT1 | .Pos2 => .inZ

/-- Source of a scale loop. -/
def scSrc : ScId → Fin 21 | _ => rT
/-- Destination of a scale loop. -/
def scDst : ScId → Fin 21
  | .E => rE | .F => rF | .E2 => rE2 | .F2 => rF2 | .In => rU | .C => rU
/-- Factor of a scale loop. -/
def scFactor : ScId → ℕ
  | .E => 4 * W N | .F => 2 | .E2 => 4 * W N | .F2 => 2 | .In => 2 | .C => 2 * W N

/-- Factors are at most `4 W`. -/
lemma scFactor_le (c : ScId) : scFactor N c ≤ 4 * W N := by
  have : 1 ≤ W N := by simp [W]
  cases c <;> simp [scFactor] <;> omega

/-- The increment labels of a scale loop. -/
def scIncs (c : ScId) (i : ℕ) : Lab N :=
  if h : i < scFactor N c then .scInc c ⟨i, by have := scFactor_le N c; omega⟩ else .sc c

/-- Successor of a scale loop. -/
def scNext : ScId → Lab N
  | .E => .ic .E ⟨0, by simp [W]⟩ | .F => .clrU
  | .E2 => .ic .E2 ⟨0, by simp [W]⟩ | .F2 => .clrU2 | .In => .inRead
  | .C => .ic .C ⟨0, by simp [W]⟩

/-- Register of an increment chain. -/
def icReg : IcId → Fin 21 | .E => rE | .U => rU | .E2 => rE2 | .U2 => rU | .C => rU
/-- Length of an increment chain. -/
def icCount : IcId → ℕ
  | .E => 2 * W N | .U => 4 | .E2 => 2 * W N | .U2 => 4 | .C => 2 * (hH N + 2)

/-- Chain lengths are at most `4 W`. -/
lemma icCount_le (c : IcId) : icCount N c ≤ 4 * W N := by
  simp only [W]
  cases c <;> simp only [icCount, W] <;> omega

/-- Successor of an increment chain. -/
def icNext : IcId → Lab N
  | .E => .cp .F | .U => .lenChk | .E2 => .cp .F2 | .U2 => .lenChk2 | .C => .cenRead

/-- The labels of an increment chain. -/
def icL (c : IcId) (i : ℕ) : Lab N :=
  if h : i < icCount N c then .ic c ⟨i, by have := icCount_le N c; omega⟩ else icNext N c

/-- The continuation of a parse loop after an advance (`k`: the case). -/
def prCont (mode : CMode) (p : Fin 3) (k : Fin 4) : Lab N :=
  match k with
  | 0 => .prTest p false
  | 1 => .prTest p true
  | 2 => .prScan p
  | 3 => match p with
    | 0 => .cp .A
    | 1 => if mode = .step then .cp .B else .cp .Q1s
    | 2 => .cp .Q1s

/-- The advance labels of a parse loop. -/
def prAdvL (mode : CMode) (p : Fin 3) (k : Fin 4) (i : ℕ) : Lab N :=
  if i = 0 then .prAdv p k else prCont N mode p k

/-- The pointer-advance labels of the validity scan. -/
def vA2 (st : VAd N) (i : ℕ) : Lab N := if h : i < 2 then .vAdv2 st ⟨i, h⟩ else .vTest st

/-- The pointer-advance labels of the validity scan (first pointer). -/
def vA1 (st : VAd N) (i : ℕ) : Lab N := if h : i < 2 then .vAdv1 st ⟨i, h⟩ else vA2 N st 0

/-- The letter step of the validity scan. -/
noncomputable def δV : VAd N → Bool × Bool → VAd N := adStep (vChunk N)

/-- The letter step of the double sliding scan under step data `I`. -/
noncomputable def δS (I : SInfo N) : SAd N → Bool × Bool → SAd N :=
  adStep (sChunk N (Gs N I false) (Gs N I true))

/-- The pointer-advance labels of the double sliding scan. -/
def sA2 (I : SInfo N) (f₀ f₁ : Bool) (st : SAd N) (i : ℕ) : Lab N :=
  if h : i < 2 then .sAdv2 I f₀ f₁ st ⟨i, h⟩ else .sTest I f₀ f₁ st

/-- The pointer-advance labels of the double sliding scan (first pointer). -/
def sA1 (I : SInfo N) (f₀ f₁ : Bool) (st : SAd N) (i : ℕ) : Lab N :=
  if h : i < 2 then .sAdv1 I f₀ f₁ st ⟨i, h⟩ else sA2 N I f₀ f₁ st 0

/-- After the position comparison for choice bit `b` with verdict `r`: the next bit, or the
double sliding scan with both verdicts. -/
def pmNext (I : SInfo N) (b f r : Bool) : Lab N :=
  if b then .sTest I f r (sAd0 N) else .pm I true r .start

/-- **The codec machine** in mode `mode` (see the module docstring). -/
noncomputable def CA (mode : CMode) : ARM 21 2 (Lab N)
  | .rej => .ret false
  | .acc => .ret true
  | .lenScan => .call jLen .whole [rL] .lenInc (.prScan 0)
  | .lenInc => .inc rL .lenScan
  | .prScan p => .jeq rP rL .rej (.prFirst p)
  | .prFirst p => .call jBit .whole [rP] (prAdvL N mode p 1 0) (prAdvL N mode p 0 0)
  | .prTest p b => .jeq rP rL .rej (.prRead p b)
  | .prRead p b => .call jBit .whole [rP]
      (if b then prAdvL N mode p 2 0 else prAdvL N mode p 3 0)
      (if b then .rej else prAdvL N mode p 2 0)
  | .prAdv p k => .inc rP (prAdvL N mode p k 1)
  | .cp c => .jeq (cpDst c) (cpSrc c) (cpNext N c) (.cpI c)
  | .cpI c => .inc (cpDst c) (.cp c)
  | .ctTest b => .jeq rQ1 rL (if b then .cp .Q2 else .rej) .ctCheck
  | .ctCheck => .jz rCap .rej .ctRead
  | .ctRead => .call jBit .whole [rQ1] (.ctHalve true) (.ctHalve false)
  | .ctHalve b => .half rCap (.ctAdv b)
  | .ctAdv b => .inc rQ1 (.ctTest b)
  | .dcTest c => .jeq (dcPtr c) (dcBase c) (dcNext N c) (dcDowns N c 0)
  | .dcDown c i => .dec (dcPtr c) (dcDowns N c (i + 1))
  | .dcRead c => .call jBit .whole [dcPtr c] (.dcCopy c true) (.dcCopy c false)
  | .dcCopy c b => .jeq rT (dcAcc c) (.dcClear c b) (.dcBump c b)
  | .dcBump c b => .inc rT (.dcCopy c b)
  | .dcClear c b => .clr (dcAcc c) (.dcScale c b)
  | .dcScale c b => .jz rT (.dcAdd c b) (.dcTake c b)
  | .dcTake c b => .dec rT (dcIncs N c b 0)
  | .dcInc c b i => .inc (dcAcc c) (dcIncs N c b (i + 1))
  | .dcAdd c b => if b then .inc (dcAcc c) (.dcTest c) else .jz rT (.dcTest c) (.dcTest c)
  | .halveN => .half rN1 (.cp .Tn)
  | .hcTest => .jz rT (.cp .E) .hcHalve
  | .hcHalve => .half rT .hcBump
  | .hcBump => .inc rWp .hcTest
  | .sc c => .jz (scSrc c) (scNext N c) (.scDown c)
  | .scDown c => .dec (scSrc c) (scIncs N c 0)
  | .scInc c i => .inc (scDst c) (scIncs N c (i + 1))
  | .ic c i => .inc (icReg c) (icL N c (i + 1))
  | .clrU => .clr rU (.cp .U)
  | .lenChk => .jeq rU (if mode = .step then rB else rP) .term .rej
  | .term => .call jBit .whole [rF] .clrQ1 .rej
  | .clrQ1 => .clr rQ1 (.cp .Q1f)
  | .leT1 => .jeq rT rPos .leClr .leT2
  | .leT2 => .jeq rT rN1 .rej .leBump
  | .leBump => .inc rT .leT1
  | .leClr => .clr rT (if mode = .step then .cp .E2 else .clrQ1v)
  | .clrU2 => .clr rU (.cp .U2)
  | .lenChk2 => .jeq rU rP .term2 .rej
  | .term2 => .call jBit .whole [rF2] .clrQ1b .rej
  | .clrQ1b => .clr rQ1 (.cp .Q1f2)
  | .inZ => .jz rPos (.cp .Q3) .inN
  | .inN => .jeq rPos rN1 (.cp .Q3) (.cp .Tpos)
  | .inDec => .dec rT .clrU3
  | .clrU3 => .clr rU (.sc .In)
  | .inRead => .call jBit .whole [rU] .inT1 .inF
  | .inT1 => .inc rZ .inF
  | .inF => .inc rZ (.cp .Q3)
  | .clrQ1v => .clr rQ1 .clrQ2v
  | .clrQ2v => .clr rQ2 (.cp .Q1a)
  | .vTest st => .jeq rQ1 rE (.vDone st) (.vRd1 st)
  | .vRd1 st => .call jBit .whole [rQ1] (.vRd2 st true) (.vRd2 st false)
  | .vRd2 st b => .call jBit .whole [rQ2] (vA1 N (δV N st (b, true)) 0)
      (vA1 N (δV N st (b, false)) 0)
  | .vAdv1 st i => .inc rQ1 (vA1 N st (i + 1))
  | .vAdv2 st i => .inc rQ2 (vA2 N st (i + 1))
  | .vDone st =>
    match mode with
    | .valid => .ret (decide (VAcc N st.1))
    | .accept => .ret (decide (VAcc N st.1 ∧ st.1.2.1 = some (none, 1)))
    | .init => goto N (if VAcc N st.1 ∧ st.1.2.1 = some (some N.tm.q₀, 0) ∧
        st.1.2.2.2.2.2 = true then .iz1 else .rej)
    | .step => goto N (if VAcc N st.1 then .zA st.1 else .rej)
  | .iz1 => .jz rPos .rej .iz2
  | .iz2 => .dec rPos .iz3
  | .iz3 => .jz rPos .icen .rej
  | .icen => if N.k = 0 then .ret true else goto N .clrUc
  | .clrUc => .clr rU (.cp .Uc)
  | .cenRead => .call jBit .whole [rU] .acc .rej
  | .zA σ => .jz rZ (.pm (σ, none) false false .start) (.zB σ)
  | .zB σ => .dec rZ (.zC σ)
  | .zC σ => .jz rZ (.pm (σ, some false) false false .start) (.pm (σ, some true) false false .start)
  | .pm I b f ph =>
    match ph with
    | .start =>
      match (aI N I b).inputTape with
      | .zero => .jeq rPos rPos2 (pmNext N I b f true) (pmNext N I b f false)
      | .pos => .jeq rPos rN1 (.pm I b f .eq) (.pm I b f .inc)
      | .neg => .jz rPos (.pm I b f .eq) (.pm I b f .decN)
    | .eq => .jeq rPos rPos2 (pmNext N I b f true) (pmNext N I b f false)
    | .inc => .inc rPos (.pm I b f .eq2)
    | .eq2 => .jeq rPos rPos2 (.pm I b f (.decR true)) (.pm I b f (.decR false))
    | .decR r => .dec rPos (pmNext N I b f r)
    | .decN => .dec rPos (.pm I b f .eq3)
    | .eq3 => .jeq rPos rPos2 (.pm I b f (.incR true)) (.pm I b f (.incR false))
    | .incR r => .inc rPos (pmNext N I b f r)
  | .sTest I f₀ f₁ st => .jeq rQ3 rE (.sFin I f₀ f₁ st) (.sRd1 I f₀ f₁ st)
  | .sRd1 I f₀ f₁ st => .call jBit .whole [rQ3] (.sRd2 I f₀ f₁ st true) (.sRd2 I f₀ f₁ st false)
  | .sRd2 I f₀ f₁ st b => .call jBit .whole [rQ4] (sA1 N I f₀ f₁ (δS N I st (b, true)) 0)
      (sA1 N I f₀ f₁ (δS N I st (b, false)) 0)
  | .sAdv1 I f₀ f₁ st i => .inc rQ3 (sA1 N I f₀ f₁ st (i + 1))
  | .sAdv2 I f₀ f₁ st i => .inc rQ4 (sA2 N I f₀ f₁ st (i + 1))
  | .sFin I f₀ f₁ st =>
    .ret ((f₀ && sDone N (Gs N I false) st.1.1) || (f₁ && sDone N (Gs N I true) st.1.2))

end Complexity.Codec
```

```
/-

Authors: Hydroxyi

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Run

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The codec machine parses its input

The first phase of the codec machine `Complexity.Codec.CA`: measure the input, parse the
pairs `⟨x, ⟨w, s⟩⟩` (or `⟨x, ⟨w, ⟨w', s⟩⟩⟩` for steps), check that the last field is a
canonical binary word of at most `|bits |y||` letters, and decode it. Either the input has
this shape and the machine reaches the layout phase with the field positions in its
registers, or it does not and the machine rejects.

Logspace machine infrastructure for the codec; not a result of [AB09].

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.bnd` — the register bound `(8 W + 8)(|y| + 1)`.
* `Complexity.Codec.Shape1`, `Complexity.Codec.Shape2` — the well-shaped inputs.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.parse_run` — the parse phase, for one-code inputs.
* `Complexity.Codec.parse_run₂` — the parse phase, for step inputs.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

variable {N : FinNDTM Bool} {mode : CMode}

variable (N) in
/-- The register bound of the codec machine on input `y`. -/
def bnd (y : List Bool) : ℕ := (8 * W N + 8) * (y.length + 1)

/-- The input length is below the register bound. -/
lemma length_le_bnd (y : List Bool) : y.length ≤ bnd N y := by
  unfold bnd
  calc y.length ≤ 1 * (y.length + 1) := by omega
    _ ≤ (8 * W N + 8) * (y.length + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)

/-! ## Positions in pairs -/

/-- Letter `i` of the first component of a pair sits at position `2i`. -/
lemma pe_getD_fst (u v : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < u.length) :
    (pairEncode u v).getD (2 * i) false = u.getD i false := by
  rw [pairEncode_getD, if_pos (by omega)]
  congr 1; omega

/-- Letter `j` of the second component of a pair sits at position `2|u| + 2 + j`. -/
lemma pe_getD_snd (u v : List Bool) (j : ℕ) :
    (pairEncode u v).getD (2 * u.length + 2 + j) false = v.getD j false := by
  rw [pairEncode_getD, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega)]
  congr 1; omega

/-- The second component of a pair is its suffix after `2|u| + 2` letters. -/
lemma pe_drop (u v : List Bool) : (pairEncode u v).drop (2 * u.length + 2) = v := by
  rw [pairEncode_eq_dbl, List.append_assoc, show 2 * u.length + 2 = (dbl u).length + 2 by simp,
    List.drop_append]
  simp

/-- A word whose last letter (default `true`) is `true` is canonical. -/
lemma canon_of_getLastD {w : List Bool} (h : w.getLastD true = true) : Canon w := by
  intro hw
  rwa [List.getLastD_eq_getLast?, List.getLast?_eq_getLast hw, Option.getD_some] at h

/-- The last letter (default `true`) of a binary word is `true`. -/
lemma getLastD_bits (s : ℕ) : (Nat.bits s).getLastD true = true := by
  by_cases h : Nat.bits s = []
  · rw [h]; rfl
  · rw [List.getLastD_eq_getLast?, List.getLast?_eq_getLast h, Option.getD_some]
    exact canon_bits s h

/-- A word of at most `|bits L|` letters has value below `2L` (for `L ≥ 1`). -/
lemma bitsVal_le_of_width (w : List Bool) (L : ℕ) (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hw : w.length ≤ (Nat.bits L).length) (i : ℕ) : bitsVal (w.drop i) ≤ 2 * L := by
  have h1 : bitsVal (w.drop i) < 2 ^ (w.drop i).length := bitsVal_lt_two_pow _
  have h2 : (w.drop i).length ≤ (Nat.bits L).length := by simp; omega
  have h3 : 2 ^ (Nat.bits L).length ≤ 2 * L := by
    rw [Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
    have hpos : 1 ≤ Nat.size L := Nat.size_pos.mpr (by omega)
    have hlt : ¬ L < 2 ^ (Nat.size L - 1) := by
      rw [← Nat.size_le]; omega
    have e : 2 ^ Nat.size L = 2 * 2 ^ (Nat.size L - 1) := by
      rw [← pow_succ']; congr 1; omega
    omega
  have := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 0 < 2 by norm_num) h2
  omega

/-- A canonical word has last letter (default `true`) `true`. -/
lemma getLastD_of_canon {w : List Bool} (h : Canon w) : w.getLastD true = true := by
  by_cases hw : w = []
  · rw [hw]; rfl
  · rw [List.getLastD_eq_getLast?, List.getLast?_eq_getLast hw, Option.getD_some]
    exact h hw

/-! ## Rejection -/

/-- A run into `rej` is a rejecting halt. -/
lemma halt_rej {y : List Bool} {B : ℕ} {l : Lab N} {v v' : Fin 21 → ℕ}
    (h : Reach N mode y B l v .rej v') (hv' : ∀ r, v' r ≤ B) :
    AHalt (CA N mode) orc y (GuardLe (CA N mode) y B) (some l, v, none) false :=
  AReach.halt h (AHalt.ret rfl ⟨by simp [PreS, CA], hv'⟩)

/-! ## The radius field -/

/-- **The radius phase**: from `.cp .Q1s` with the pointer at the last field `w`, the machine
reaches the layout phase with the value of `w` decoded into `rS` when `w` is canonical and
at most `|bits |y||` letters long, and rejects otherwise.

**Proof sketch.** Copy the pointer and the cap (`cp_run`), check the width
(`ct_run`: its verdict is exactly canonicity and the width bound), copy the end pointer, and
decode (`dc_run`, values bounded by `bitsVal_le_of_width`). -/
theorem sw_run (y : List Bool) (R : Regs) (p : ℕ) (hBd : R.Bd (bnd N y))
    (hL : R.L = y.length) (hP : R.P = p) (hp : p ≤ y.length) (hQ1 : R.Q1 = 0) (hCap : R.Cap = 0)
    (hQ2 : R.Q2 = 0) (hS : R.S = 0) (hT : R.T = 0) (hy : 1 ≤ y.length) :
    (Canon (y.drop p) ∧ (y.drop p).length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length ∧
      ∃ q1 cap, q1 ≤ bnd N y ∧ cap ≤ bnd N y ∧
        Reach N mode y (bnd N y) (.cp .Q1s) R.val (.cp .N1)
          ({R with Q1 := q1, Cap := cap, Q2 := p, S := bitsVal (y.drop p)} : Regs).val) ∨
    (¬ (Canon (y.drop p) ∧ (y.drop p).length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length) ∧
      AHalt (CA N mode) orc y (GuardLe (CA N mode) y (bnd N y)) (some (.cp .Q1s), R.val, none)
        false) := by
  set B := bnd N y
  have hLB : y.length ≤ B := length_le_bnd y
  have h2L : 2 * y.length ≤ B := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (y.length + 1) (show 2 ≤ 8 * W N + 8 by omega)
    simp only [B, bnd]; omega
  have hB0 := hBd
  simp only [Regs.Bd] at hB0
  -- copy the pointer and the cap
  have r1 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .Q1s) R.val (.cp .Cap) ({R with Q1 := p} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Q1s R.val hBd.val_le (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc]; omega))
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hP])
  have r2 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .Cap) ({R with Q1 := p} : Regs).val (.ctTest true)
      ({R with Q1 := p, Cap := y.length} : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Cap _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc]; omega)) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hL])
  have hlen : y.length = p + (y.drop p).length := by simp; omega
  obtain ⟨v', hv', hq1, hframe, r3⟩ := ct_run (N := N) (mode := mode) y B (y.drop p)
    ({R with Q1 := p, Cap := y.length} : Regs).val
    (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega) (by simp [hL]; omega)
    (fun i _ => by simp)
  have hv'R : v' = ({R with Q1 := v' rQ1, Cap := v' rCap} : Regs).val := by
    funext r
    by_cases h1 : r = rQ1
    · subst h1; rfl
    · by_cases h2 : r = rCap
      · subst h2; rfl
      · rw [hframe r h1 h2]
        fin_cases r <;> first | rfl | exact absurd rfl h1 | exact absurd rfl h2
  have hcap : ({R with Q1 := p, Cap := y.length} : Regs).val rCap = y.length := rfl
  rw [hcap] at r3
  have hc : (y.drop p).length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length ∧ (y.drop p).getLastD true = true ↔
      Canon (y.drop p) ∧ (y.drop p).length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length :=
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨canon_of_getLastD b, a⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨b, getLastD_of_canon a⟩⟩
  by_cases hok : (y.drop p).length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length ∧
      (y.drop p).getLastD true = true
  · left
    obtain ⟨hcan, hw⟩ := hc.mp hok
    rw [if_pos hok.1, if_pos hok.2] at r3
    refine ⟨hcan, hw, v' rQ1, v' rCap, hv' _, hv' _, ?_⟩
    have b1 := hv' rQ1
    have b2 := hv' rCap
    -- copy the end pointer and decode
    have r4 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .Q2) ({R with Q1 := v' rQ1, Cap := v' rCap} : Regs).val
        (.dcTest .S) ({R with Q1 := v' rQ1, Cap := v' rCap, Q2 := y.length} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.cast (cp_run y B .Q2 _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
        (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc]; omega)) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc, hL])
    have r5 : Reach N mode y B (.dcTest .S)
        ({R with Q1 := v' rQ1, Cap := v' rCap, Q2 := y.length} : Regs).val (.cp .N1)
        ({R with Q1 := v' rQ1, Cap := v' rCap, Q2 := p, S := bitsVal (y.drop p)} : Regs).val :=
      Reach.cast (dc_run y B .S (y.drop p)
        (fun i _ => (bitsVal_le_of_width _ _ hy hw i).trans h2L)
        _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
        (by simp [dcPtr, dcBase, dcStride]; omega) (by simp [dcAcc, hS])
        (by simp [hT]) (fun i _ => by simp [dcBase, dcStride, hP]))
        (by simp [dcPtr, dcBase, dcAcc, hP])
    exact (r1.trans r2).trans ((Reach.cast r3 hv'R).trans (r4.trans r5))
  · right
    refine ⟨fun h => hok (hc.mpr h), ?_⟩
    rw [show (if (y.drop p).length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length then
        if (y.drop p).getLastD true then Lab.cp CpId.Q2 else Lab.rej else Lab.rej) = (Lab.rej : Lab N)
      by split_ifs with h1 h2 <;> first | rfl | exact absurd ⟨h1, h2⟩ hok] at r3
    exact halt_rej ((r1.trans r2).trans r3) hv'

/-! ## The whole parse -/

/-- The well-shaped one-code inputs `⟨x, ⟨w, bits s⟩⟩` whose radius field fits the width
check. -/
def Shape1 (y x w : List Bool) (s : ℕ) : Prop :=
  y = pairEncode x (pairEncode w (Nat.bits s)) ∧ (Nat.bits s).length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length

/-- The well-shaped step inputs `⟨x, ⟨w, ⟨w', bits s⟩⟩⟩` whose radius field fits the width
check. -/
def Shape2 (y x w w' : List Bool) (s : ℕ) : Prop :=
  y = pairEncode x (pairEncode w (pairEncode w' (Nat.bits s))) ∧
    (Nat.bits s).length ≤ (Nat.bits y.length).length

/-- The first parse step: measure the input and parse its first component.

**Proof sketch.** The length loop (`len_run`) sets `rL = |y|`; the aligned pair scan from
`0` (`pr_run`) rejects when `y` is not a pair and otherwise stops past `x` and the
separator; the pointer is copied into `rA` (`cp_run`). -/
theorem parse_x (y : List Bool) :
    (∃ x r, y = pairEncode x r ∧
      Reach N mode y (bnd N y) .lenScan ({} : Regs).val (.prScan 1)
        ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2, A := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs).val) ∨
    ((∀ x r, y ≠ pairEncode x r) ∧
      AHalt (CA N mode) orc y (GuardLe (CA N mode) y (bnd N y)) (some .lenScan, ({} : Regs).val, none)
        false) := by
  set B := bnd N y
  have hLB : y.length ≤ B := length_le_bnd y
  have r0 : Reach N mode y B .lenScan ({} : Regs).val (.prScan 0)
      ({ L := y.length } : Regs).val :=
    Reach.cast (len_run y B hLB _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
      (by simp)) (by simp)
  have h1 := pr_run (N := N) (mode := mode) y B 0 ({ L := y.length } : Regs).val
    (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega) rfl (by simp)
  simp only [Regs.val_P, List.drop_zero] at h1
  cases hd : pairDecode y with
  | none =>
    rw [hd] at h1
    obtain ⟨t, ht, run⟩ := h1
    right
    refine ⟨fun x r h => (by rw [h, pairDecode_pairEncode] at hd; cases hd), ?_⟩
    refine halt_rej (r0.trans run) ?_
    rw [Regs.upd_P]
    apply Regs.Bd.val_le
    simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega
  | some xr =>
    obtain ⟨x, r⟩ := xr
    rw [hd] at h1
    have hy := eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode y x r hd
    left
    refine ⟨x, r, hy, ?_⟩
    have hxl : 2 * x.length + 2 ≤ y.length := by rw [hy, length_pairEncode]; omega
    have r1 : Reach N mode y B (.prScan 0) ({ L := y.length } : Regs).val (.cp .A)
        ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs).val :=
      Reach.cast h1 (by simp)
    have r2 : Reach N mode y B (.cp .A) ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs).val
        (.prScan 1) ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2, A := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs).val :=
      Reach.cast (cp_run y B .A _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
        (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
    exact r0.trans (r1.trans r2)

/-- **The parse phase on one-code inputs**: a well-shaped input `⟨x, ⟨w, bits s⟩⟩` brings the
machine to the layout phase with `rL = |y|`, `rP = rQ2` at the radius field, `rA` at `w`,
`rS = s`; any other input is rejected.

**Proof sketch.** Measure and parse `x` (`parse_x`), parse `w` (`pr_run`), and treat the
radius field (`sw_run`). Each failure (no pair, no inner pair, a non-canonical or too long
radius field) rules out the shape, by injectivity of the pairing. -/
theorem parse_run (hm : mode ≠ .step) (y : List Bool) :
    (∃ (x w : List Bool) (s q1 cap : ℕ), Shape1 y x w s ∧ q1 ≤ bnd N y ∧ cap ≤ bnd N y ∧
      Reach N mode y (bnd N y) .lenScan ({} : Regs).val (.cp .N1)
        ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4, A := 2 * x.length + 2,
           Q1 := q1, Cap := cap, Q2 := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4, S := s } : Regs).val) ∨
    ((¬ ∃ x w s, Shape1 y x w s) ∧
      AHalt (CA N mode) orc y (GuardLe (CA N mode) y (bnd N y)) (some .lenScan, ({} : Regs).val, none)
        false) := by
  set B := bnd N y
  have hLB : y.length ≤ B := length_le_bnd y
  rcases parse_x (N := N) (mode := mode) y with ⟨x, r, hy, r01⟩ | ⟨hno, hhalt⟩
  · have hdrop : y.drop (2 * x.length + 2) = r := by rw [hy, pe_drop]
    have hxl : 2 * x.length + 2 ≤ y.length := by rw [hy, length_pairEncode]; omega
    have h2 := pr_run (N := N) (mode := mode) y B 1
      ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2, A := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs).val
      (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega) rfl (by simpa using hxl)
    simp only [Regs.val_P, hdrop] at h2
    cases hd : pairDecode r with
    | none =>
      rw [hd] at h2
      obtain ⟨t, ht, run⟩ := h2
      right
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rintro ⟨x', w', s', hs, -⟩
        rw [hy] at hs
        obtain ⟨-, hr⟩ := pairEncode_inj hs
        rw [hr, pairDecode_pairEncode] at hd; cases hd
      · refine halt_rej (r01.trans run) ?_
        rw [Regs.upd_P]
        apply Regs.Bd.val_le
        have hyl : y.length = 2 * x.length + 2 + r.length := by rw [hy, length_pairEncode]
        simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega
    | some ws =>
      obtain ⟨w, sw⟩ := ws
      rw [hd] at h2
      have hr := eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode r w sw hd
      have hcont : prCont N mode 1 3 = .cp .Q1s := by simp [prCont, hm]
      rw [hcont] at h2
      have hlen : y.length = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 + sw.length := by
        rw [hy, hr, length_pairEncode, length_pairEncode]; ring
      have hdrop2 : y.drop (2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4) = sw := by
        rw [show 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 = (2 * x.length + 2) + (2 * w.length + 2) by ring,
          ← List.drop_drop, hdrop, hr, pe_drop]
      have r2 : Reach N mode y B (.prScan 1)
          ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2, A := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs).val (.cp .Q1s)
          ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4,
             A := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs).val :=
        Reach.cast h2 (by simp; ring_nf)
      rcases sw_run (N := N) (mode := mode) y
        ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4, A := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs)
        (2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4) (by simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega) rfl rfl (by omega)
        rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl (by omega) with ⟨hcan, hw, q1, cap, hq1, hcap, run⟩ | ⟨hbad, hhalt⟩
      · left
        rw [hdrop2] at hcan hw run
        refine ⟨x, w, bitsVal sw, q1, cap, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hq1, hcap, r01.trans (r2.trans run)⟩
        · rw [hy, hr, ← canon_eq_bits sw hcan]
        · rwa [← canon_eq_bits sw hcan]
      · right
        refine ⟨?_, AReach.halt (r01.trans r2) hhalt⟩
        rintro ⟨x', w', s', hs, hwid⟩
        rw [hdrop2] at hbad
        rw [hy] at hs
        obtain ⟨-, h1⟩ := pairEncode_inj hs
        rw [hr] at h1
        obtain ⟨-, h2⟩ := pairEncode_inj h1
        rw [h2] at hbad
        exact hbad ⟨canon_bits s', hwid⟩
  · right
    refine ⟨?_, hhalt⟩
    rintro ⟨x', w', s', hs, -⟩
    exact hno x' _ hs

/-- **The parse phase on step inputs**: a well-shaped input `⟨x, ⟨w, ⟨w', bits s⟩⟩⟩` brings
the step machine to the layout phase with `rA` at `w`, `rB` at `w'`, `rP = rQ2` at the
radius field and `rS = s`; any other input is rejected.

**Proof sketch.** As `parse_run`, with one more pair parse (`pr_run`) for `w'`. -/
theorem parse_run₂ (y : List Bool) :
    (∃ (x w w' : List Bool) (s q1 cap : ℕ), Shape2 y x w w' s ∧ q1 ≤ bnd N y ∧ cap ≤ bnd N y ∧
      Reach N .step y (bnd N y) .lenScan ({} : Regs).val (.cp .N1)
        ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6,
           A := 2 * x.length + 2, B := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4, Q1 := q1, Cap := cap,
           Q2 := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6, S := s } : Regs).val) ∨
    ((¬ ∃ x w w' s, Shape2 y x w w' s) ∧
      AHalt (CA N .step) orc y (GuardLe (CA N .step) y (bnd N y))
        (some .lenScan, ({} : Regs).val, none) false) := by
  set B := bnd N y
  have hLB : y.length ≤ B := length_le_bnd y
  rcases parse_x (N := N) (mode := .step) y with ⟨x, r, hy, r01⟩ | ⟨hno, hhalt⟩
  · have hdrop : y.drop (2 * x.length + 2) = r := by rw [hy, pe_drop]
    have hyl : y.length = 2 * x.length + 2 + r.length := by rw [hy, length_pairEncode]
    have h2 := pr_run (N := N) (mode := .step) y B 1
      ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2, A := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs).val
      (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega) rfl (by simp; omega)
    simp only [Regs.val_P, hdrop] at h2
    cases hd : pairDecode r with
    | none =>
      rw [hd] at h2
      obtain ⟨t, ht, run⟩ := h2
      right
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rintro ⟨x', w', w'', s', hs, -⟩
        rw [hy] at hs
        obtain ⟨-, hr⟩ := pairEncode_inj hs
        rw [hr, pairDecode_pairEncode] at hd; cases hd
      · refine halt_rej (r01.trans run) ?_
        rw [Regs.upd_P]
        apply Regs.Bd.val_le
        simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega
    | some wr =>
      obtain ⟨w, r2⟩ := wr
      rw [hd] at h2
      have hr := eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode r w r2 hd
      have hcont : prCont N .step 1 3 = .cp .B := by simp [prCont]
      rw [hcont] at h2
      have hyl2 : y.length = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 + r2.length := by
        rw [hyl, hr, length_pairEncode]; ring
      have hdrop2 : y.drop (2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4) = r2 := by
        rw [show 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 = (2 * x.length + 2) + (2 * w.length + 2) by ring,
          ← List.drop_drop, hdrop, hr, pe_drop]
      have r2' : Reach N .step y B (.prScan 1)
          ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2, A := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs).val (.cp .B)
          ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4,
             A := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs).val :=
        Reach.cast h2 (by simp; ring_nf)
      have r3 : Reach N .step y B (.cp .B)
          ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4,
             A := 2 * x.length + 2 } : Regs).val (.prScan 2)
          ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4, A := 2 * x.length + 2,
             B := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 } : Regs).val :=
        Reach.cast (cp_run y B .B _ (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega)
          (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])) (by simp [cpDst, cpSrc])
      have h3 := pr_run (N := N) (mode := .step) y B 2
        ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4, A := 2 * x.length + 2,
           B := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 } : Regs).val
        (by apply Regs.Bd.val_le; simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega) rfl (by simp; omega)
      simp only [Regs.val_P, hdrop2] at h3
      cases hd2 : pairDecode r2 with
      | none =>
        rw [hd2] at h3
        obtain ⟨t, ht, run⟩ := h3
        right
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rintro ⟨x', w', w'', s', hs, -⟩
          rw [hy] at hs
          obtain ⟨-, h1⟩ := pairEncode_inj hs
          rw [hr] at h1
          obtain ⟨-, h2⟩ := pairEncode_inj h1
          rw [h2, pairDecode_pairEncode] at hd2; cases hd2
        · refine halt_rej (r01.trans (r2'.trans (r3.trans run))) ?_
          rw [Regs.upd_P]
          apply Regs.Bd.val_le
          simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega
      | some ws =>
        obtain ⟨w', sw⟩ := ws
        rw [hd2] at h3
        have hr2 := eq_pairEncode_of_pairDecode r2 w' sw hd2
        have hcont2 : prCont N .step 2 3 = .cp .Q1s := rfl
        rw [hcont2] at h3
        have hyl3 : y.length = 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6 + sw.length := by
          rw [hyl2, hr2, length_pairEncode]; ring
        have hdrop3 : y.drop (2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6) = sw := by
          rw [show 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6 =
              (2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4) + (2 * w'.length + 2) by ring,
            ← List.drop_drop, hdrop2, hr2, pe_drop]
        have r4 : Reach N .step y B (.prScan 2)
            ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4, A := 2 * x.length + 2,
               B := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 } : Regs).val (.cp .Q1s)
            ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6,
               A := 2 * x.length + 2, B := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 } : Regs).val :=
          Reach.cast h3 (by simp; ring_nf)
        rcases sw_run (N := N) (mode := .step) y
          ({ L := y.length, P := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6,
             A := 2 * x.length + 2, B := 2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 4 } : Regs)
          (2 * x.length + 2 * w.length + 2 * w'.length + 6) (by simp only [Regs.Bd]; omega) rfl rfl
          (by omega) rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl (by omega)
          with ⟨hcan, hw, q1, cap, hq1, hcap, run⟩ | ⟨hbad, hhalt⟩
        · left
          rw [hdrop3] at hcan hw run
          refine ⟨x, w, w', bitsVal sw, q1, cap, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hq1, hcap,
            r01.trans (r2'.trans (r3.trans (r4.trans run)))⟩
          · rw [hy, hr, hr2, ← canon_eq_bits sw hcan]
          · rwa [← canon_eq_bits sw hcan]
        · right
          refine ⟨?_, AReach.halt (r01.trans (r2'.trans (r3.trans r4))) hhalt⟩
          rintro ⟨x', w₁, w₂, s', hs, hwid⟩
          rw [hdrop3] at hbad
          rw [hy] at hs
          obtain ⟨-, h1⟩ := pairEncode_inj hs
          rw [hr] at h1
          obtain ⟨-, h2⟩ := pairEncode_inj h1
          rw [hr2] at h2
          obtain ⟨-, h3⟩ := pairEncode_inj h2
          rw [h3] at hbad
          exact hbad ⟨canon_bits s', hwid⟩
  · right
    refine ⟨?_, hhalt⟩
    rintro ⟨x', w', w'', s', hs, -⟩
    exact hno x' _ hs

end Complexity.Codec
```

```
/-

import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Fin
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The register file of the codec machine

The codec machine `Complexity.Codec.CA` works over 21 registers. This file names them
(`Complexity.Codec.rL`, …), packages register valuations as a structure with named fields
(`Complexity.Codec.Regs`, all fields `0` by default), and proves that writing a register of a
register file's valuation is the valuation of the updated structure — so that runs of the
machine can be tracked as structure updates.

Logspace machine infrastructure for the codec; not a result of [AB09].

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.Regs`, `Complexity.Codec.Regs.val` — register files and their valuations.
* `Complexity.Codec.Regs.Bd` — all registers bounded.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.Regs.upd_L` and siblings — register writes on register files.
* `Complexity.Codec.Regs.Bd.val_le` — bounded register files have bounded valuations.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

/-! ## Registers -/
/-- Register `L`. -/
abbrev rL : Fin 21 := 0
/-- Register `P`. -/
abbrev rP : Fin 21 := 1
/-- Register `A`. -/
abbrev rA : Fin 21 := 2
/-- Register `B`. -/
abbrev rB : Fin 21 := 3
/-- Register `S`. -/
abbrev rS : Fin 21 := 4
/-- Register `N1`. -/
abbrev rN1 : Fin 21 := 5
/-- Register `Wp`. -/
abbrev rWp : Fin 21 := 6
/-- Register `E`. -/
abbrev rE : Fin 21 := 7
/-- Register `F`. -/
abbrev rF : Fin 21 := 8
/-- Register `E2`. -/
abbrev rE2 : Fin 21 := 9
/-- Register `F2`. -/
abbrev rF2 : Fin 21 := 10
/-- Register `Pos`. -/
abbrev rPos : Fin 21 := 11
/-- Register `Pos2`. -/
abbrev rPos2 : Fin 21 := 12
/-- Register `T`. -/
abbrev rT : Fin 21 := 13
/-- Register `U`. -/
abbrev rU : Fin 21 := 14
/-- Register `Q1`. -/
abbrev rQ1 : Fin 21 := 15
/-- Register `Q2`. -/
abbrev rQ2 : Fin 21 := 16
/-- Register `Q3`. -/
abbrev rQ3 : Fin 21 := 17
/-- Register `Q4`. -/
abbrev rQ4 : Fin 21 := 18
/-- Register `Cap`. -/
abbrev rCap : Fin 21 := 19
/-- Register `Z`. -/
abbrev rZ : Fin 21 := 20
/-- The register file of the codec deciders, by name (all `0` by default). -/
structure Regs where
  /-- register `L` -/
  L : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `P` -/
  P : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `A` -/
  A : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `B` -/
  B : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `S` -/
  S : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `N1` -/
  N1 : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `Wp` -/
  Wp : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `E` -/
  E : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `F` -/
  F : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `E2` -/
  E2 : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `F2` -/
  F2 : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `Pos` -/
  Pos : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `Pos2` -/
  Pos2 : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `T` -/
  T : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `U` -/
  U : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `Q1` -/
  Q1 : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `Q2` -/
  Q2 : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `Q3` -/
  Q3 : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `Q4` -/
  Q4 : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `Cap` -/
  Cap : ℕ := 0
  /-- register `Z` -/
  Z : ℕ := 0

/-- The register valuation of a register file. -/
def Regs.val (R : Regs) : Fin 21 → ℕ
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => R.L
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => R.P
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => R.A
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => R.B
  | ⟨4, _⟩ => R.S
  | ⟨5, _⟩ => R.N1
  | ⟨6, _⟩ => R.Wp
  | ⟨7, _⟩ => R.E
  | ⟨8, _⟩ => R.F
  | ⟨9, _⟩ => R.E2
  | ⟨10, _⟩ => R.F2
  | ⟨11, _⟩ => R.Pos
  | ⟨12, _⟩ => R.Pos2
  | ⟨13, _⟩ => R.T
  | ⟨14, _⟩ => R.U
  | ⟨15, _⟩ => R.Q1
  | ⟨16, _⟩ => R.Q2
  | ⟨17, _⟩ => R.Q3
  | ⟨18, _⟩ => R.Q4
  | ⟨19, _⟩ => R.Cap
  | _ => R.Z

/-- Reading register `L`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_L (R : Regs) : R.val rL = R.L := rfl

/-- Reading register `P`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_P (R : Regs) : R.val rP = R.P := rfl

/-- Reading register `A`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_A (R : Regs) : R.val rA = R.A := rfl

/-- Reading register `B`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_B (R : Regs) : R.val rB = R.B := rfl

/-- Reading register `S`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_S (R : Regs) : R.val rS = R.S := rfl

/-- Reading register `N1`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_N1 (R : Regs) : R.val rN1 = R.N1 := rfl

/-- Reading register `Wp`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_Wp (R : Regs) : R.val rWp = R.Wp := rfl

/-- Reading register `E`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_E (R : Regs) : R.val rE = R.E := rfl

/-- Reading register `F`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_F (R : Regs) : R.val rF = R.F := rfl

/-- Reading register `E2`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_E2 (R : Regs) : R.val rE2 = R.E2 := rfl

/-- Reading register `F2`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_F2 (R : Regs) : R.val rF2 = R.F2 := rfl

/-- Reading register `Pos`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_Pos (R : Regs) : R.val rPos = R.Pos := rfl

/-- Reading register `Pos2`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_Pos2 (R : Regs) : R.val rPos2 = R.Pos2 := rfl

/-- Reading register `T`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_T (R : Regs) : R.val rT = R.T := rfl

/-- Reading register `U`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_U (R : Regs) : R.val rU = R.U := rfl

/-- Reading register `Q1`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_Q1 (R : Regs) : R.val rQ1 = R.Q1 := rfl

/-- Reading register `Q2`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_Q2 (R : Regs) : R.val rQ2 = R.Q2 := rfl

/-- Reading register `Q3`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_Q3 (R : Regs) : R.val rQ3 = R.Q3 := rfl

/-- Reading register `Q4`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_Q4 (R : Regs) : R.val rQ4 = R.Q4 := rfl

/-- Reading register `Cap`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_Cap (R : Regs) : R.val rCap = R.Cap := rfl

/-- Reading register `Z`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.val_Z (R : Regs) : R.val rZ = R.Z := rfl

/-- Writing register `L`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.upd_L (R : Regs) (v : ℕ) :
    Function.update R.val rL v = ({ R with L := v } : Regs).val := by
  funext r; fin_cases r <;> rfl

/-- Writing register `P`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.upd_P (R : Regs) (v : ℕ) :
    Function.update R.val rP v = ({ R with P := v } : Regs).val := by

/-- Writing register `A`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.upd_A (R : Regs) (v : ℕ) :
    Function.update R.val rA v = ({ R with A := v } : Regs).val := by

/-- Writing register `B`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.upd_B (R : Regs) (v : ℕ) :

@[simp] lemma Regs.upd_N1 (R : Regs) (v : ℕ) :

  funext r; fin_cases r <;> rfl

/-- Writing register `Q2`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.upd_Q2 (R : Regs) (v : ℕ) :
    Function.update R.val rQ2 v = ({ R with Q2 := v } : Regs).val := by
  funext r; fin_cases r <;> rfl

/-- Writing register `Q3`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.upd_Q3 (R : Regs) (v : ℕ) :
    Function.update R.val rQ3 v = ({ R with Q3 := v } : Regs).val := by
  funext r; fin_cases r <;> rfl

/-- Writing register `Q4`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.upd_Q4 (R : Regs) (v : ℕ) :
    Function.update R.val rQ4 v = ({ R with Q4 := v } : Regs).val := by
  funext r; fin_cases r <;> rfl

/-- Writing register `Cap`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.upd_Cap (R : Regs) (v : ℕ) :
    Function.update R.val rCap v = ({ R with Cap := v } : Regs).val := by
  funext r; fin_cases r <;> rfl

/-- Writing register `Z`. -/
@[simp] lemma Regs.upd_Z (R : Regs) (v : ℕ) :
    Function.update R.val rZ v = ({ R with Z := v } : Regs).val := by
  funext r; fin_cases r <;> rfl

/-- All registers of a register file are at most `B`. -/
def Regs.Bd (R : Regs) (B : ℕ) : Prop :=
  R.L ≤ B ∧ R.P ≤ B ∧ R.A ≤ B ∧ R.B ≤ B ∧ R.S ≤ B ∧ R.N1 ≤ B ∧ R.Wp ≤ B ∧ R.E ≤ B ∧ R.F ≤ B ∧ R.E2 ≤ B ∧ R.F2 ≤ B ∧ R.Pos ≤ B ∧ R.Pos2 ≤ B ∧ R.T ≤ B ∧ R.U ≤ B ∧ R.Q1 ≤ B ∧ R.Q2 ≤ B ∧ R.Q3 ≤ B ∧ R.Q4 ≤ B ∧ R.Cap ≤ B ∧ R.Z ≤ B

/-- A bounded register file has a bounded valuation. -/
lemma Regs.Bd.val_le {R : Regs} {B : ℕ} (h : R.Bd B) : ∀ r, R.val r ≤ B := by
  obtain ⟨hL, hP, hA, hB, hS, hN1, hWp, hE, hF, hE2, hF2, hPos, hPos2, hT, hU, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hQ4, hCap, hZ⟩ := h
  intro r; fin_cases r <;> assumption

end Complexity.Codec
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Codec/Run.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Machine
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.VWord

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Runs of the codec machine's loops

Each loop family of the codec machine `Complexity.Codec.CA` (copies, scales, increment chains,
decodings, the parse scans, the width check, the two scans) runs as the corresponding shared
fragment says (`Complexity.LogProg.registerCopy_loop`, `registerScale_loop`,
`alignedPair_loop`, `canonicalTail_loop`, `inputLength_loop`, and the fragments of
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Engine`). The lemmas here instantiate them once per
family, for every instance and every mode, against the input oracles.

Logspace machine infrastructure for the codec; not a result of [AB09].

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.codecAs`, `Complexity.Codec.orc` — the two oracle languages and the
  oracle they answer.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.orc_bit`, `Complexity.Codec.orc_len` — the oracle reads the input.
* `Complexity.Codec.cp_run`, `sc_run`, `ic_run`, `dc_run`, `pr_run`, `ct_run`, `len_run`,
  `hc_run`, `le_run`, `v_run`, `s_run` — the loop families.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

open Turing LogProg

/-- The oracle languages: the length and the bit language of the input. -/
def codecAs : Fin 2 → Language Bool := fun j => if j = 0 then inputLenLang else inputBitLang

/-- The oracle languages are logspace. -/
lemma codecAs_mem (j : Fin 2) : codecAs j ∈ LOGSPACE := by
  fin_cases j
  · exact inputLenLang_mem
  · exact inputBitLang_mem

/-- The oracle answering the codec machine's calls. -/
noncomputable def orc : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool :=
  fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (codecAs j : Set (List Bool)) V

/-- The bit oracle reads the input. -/
lemma orc_bit (y : List Bool) (a : ℕ) : orc jBit (pairEncode y (Nat.bits a)) = y.getD a false := by
  show MultiTapeTM.indicator (inputBitLang : Set (List Bool)) _ = _
  rw [inputBitLang, indicator_indexLang_pairEncode]
  cases y.getD a false <;> simp

/-- The length oracle compares with the input length. -/
lemma orc_len (y : List Bool) (a : ℕ) :
    orc jLen (pairEncode y (Nat.bits a)) = decide (a < y.length) := by
  show MultiTapeTM.indicator (inputLenLang : Set (List Bool)) _ = _
  rw [inputLenLang, indicator_indexLang_pairEncode]
  exact decide_eq_decide.mpr Iff.rfl

variable {N : FinNDTM Bool} {mode : CMode}

/-- Runs of the codec machine through bounded configurations. -/
abbrev Reach (N : FinNDTM Bool) (mode : CMode) (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ)
    (l : Lab N) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (l' : Lab N) (v' : Fin 21 → ℕ) : Prop :=
  AReach (CA N mode) orc y (GuardLe (CA N mode) y B) (some l, v, none) (some l', v', none)

/-- Runs compose. -/
lemma Reach.trans {y : List Bool} {B : ℕ} {l₁ l₂ l₃ : Lab N} {v₁ v₂ v₃ : Fin 21 → ℕ}
    (h₁ : Reach N mode y B l₁ v₁ l₂ v₂) (h₂ : Reach N mode y B l₂ v₂ l₃ v₃) :
    Reach N mode y B l₁ v₁ l₃ v₃ := AReach.trans h₁ h₂

/-- A run to an equal valuation. -/
lemma Reach.cast {y : List Bool} {B : ℕ} {l₁ l₂ : Lab N} {v₁ v₂ v₂' : Fin 21 → ℕ}
    (h : Reach N mode y B l₁ v₁ l₂ v₂) (e : v₂ = v₂') : Reach N mode y B l₁ v₁ l₂ v₂' := e ▸ h

/-- One step of the machine as a run. -/
lemma Reach.single' {y : List Bool} {B : ℕ} {l l' : Lab N} {v v' : Fin 21 → ℕ}
    (hG : GuardLe (CA N mode) y B (some l, v, none))
    (e : astep (CA N mode) orc y (some l, v, none) = (some l', v', none)) :
    Reach N mode y B l v l' v' := by
  have := AReach.single (A := CA N mode) (oracle := orc) (x := y) hG
  rwa [e] at this

/-- The guard at a label that is not a register comparison or a call. -/
lemma gd_of {y : List Bool} {B : ℕ} {l : Lab N} {v : Fin 21 → ℕ} (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B)
    (h : PreS (CA N mode) y (some l, v, none)) : GuardLe (CA N mode) y B (some l, v, none) := ⟨h, hv⟩

/-! ## Copies, scales, increment chains -/

/-- Copy loops copy between distinct registers. -/
lemma cpDst_ne (c : CpId) : cpDst c ≠ cpSrc c := by cases c <;> decide

/-- **Copy loops**: the destination counts up to the source. -/
theorem cp_run (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (c : CpId) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B)
    (hle : v (cpDst c) ≤ v (cpSrc c)) :
    Reach N mode y B (.cp c) v (cpNext N c) (Function.update v (cpDst c) (v (cpSrc c))) :=
  registerCopy_loop (CA N mode) orc y (cpDst c) (cpSrc c) (cpDst_ne c) (.cp c) (.cpI c)
    (cpNext N c) rfl rfl B v hv hle

/-- Scale loops scale between distinct registers. -/
lemma scSrc_ne (c : ScId) : scSrc c ≠ scDst c := by cases c <;> decide

/-- **Scale loops**: `dst += factor · src`, clearing `src`. -/
theorem sc_run (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (c : ScId) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B)
    (htot : v (scDst c) + scFactor N c * v (scSrc c) ≤ B) :
    Reach N mode y B (.sc c) v (scNext N c)
      (Function.update (Function.update v (scSrc c) 0) (scDst c)
        (v (scDst c) + scFactor N c * v (scSrc c))) := by
  refine registerScale_loop (CA N mode) orc y (scSrc c) (scDst c) (scSrc_ne c) (.sc c)
    (.scDown c) (scNext N c) (scIncs N c) (scFactor N c) rfl rfl (fun i hi => ?_) ?_ B v hv htot
  · simp only [scIncs, dif_pos hi]; rfl
  · simp [scIncs]

/-- **Increment chains**. -/
theorem ic_run (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (c : IcId) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B)
    (hk : v (icReg c) + icCount N c ≤ B) :
    Reach N mode y B (icL N c 0) v (icNext N c)
      (Function.update v (icReg c) (v (icReg c) + icCount N c)) := by
  have h := incChain (CA N mode) orc y (icReg c) (icL N c) (icCount N c) B (fun i hi => by
    simp only [icL, dif_pos hi]; rfl) v hv hk
  simpa [icL] using h

/-- The first label of an increment chain. -/
lemma icL_zero (c : IcId) : icL N c 0 = .ic c ⟨0, by have := icCount_le N c; simp [W]⟩ := by
  have : 0 < icCount N c := by cases c <;> simp [icCount, W]
  simp [icL, this]

/-! ## Decodings -/

/-- Pointer, base, accumulator, temporary of a decoding are distinct. -/
lemma dc_distinct (c : DcId) : dcPtr c ≠ dcBase c ∧ dcPtr c ≠ dcAcc c ∧ dcPtr c ≠ rT ∧
    dcBase c ≠ dcAcc c ∧ dcBase c ≠ rT ∧ dcAcc c ≠ rT := by
  cases c <;> decide

/-- **Decoding loops**: from the pointer `stride · |w|` above the base, with the accumulator
and the temporary cleared, the run ends with the accumulator holding the value of the field
`w` read at the stride, the pointer at the base, the temporary cleared.

**Proof sketch.** `decodeStride_loop` at the instance's registers and labels, from the top of
the field; its frame conditions identify the final valuation. -/
theorem dc_run (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (c : DcId) (w : List Bool)
    (values : ∀ i ≤ w.length, bitsVal (w.drop i) ≤ B) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B)
    (hp : v (dcPtr c) = v (dcBase c) + dcStride c * w.length) (ha : v (dcAcc c) = 0)
    (ht : v rT = 0)
    (ho : ∀ i < w.length,
      y.getD (v (dcBase c) + dcStride c * i) false = w.getD i false) :
    Reach N mode y B (.dcTest c) v (dcNext N c)
      (Function.update (Function.update v (dcPtr c) (v (dcBase c))) (dcAcc c) (bitsVal w)) := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := dc_distinct c
  have hs : 0 < dcStride c := by cases c <;> simp [dcStride]
  obtain ⟨v', bv, ep, ea, et, frame, run⟩ := decodeStride_loop (CA N mode) orc y (dcPtr c)
    (dcBase c) (dcAcc c) rT h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 jBit (.dcTest c) (.dcRead c) (dcNext N c)
    (dcDowns N c) (.dcCopy c) (.dcBump c) (.dcClear c) (.dcScale c) (.dcTake c) (.dcAdd c)
    (dcIncs N c) (dcStride c) rfl (fun i hi => by simp only [dcDowns, dif_pos hi]; rfl)
    (by simp [dcDowns]) rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
    (fun _ => rfl) (fun b i hi => by simp only [dcIncs, dif_pos hi]; rfl)
    (fun b => by simp [dcIncs]) (fun b => by cases b <;> rfl) w B values w.length le_rfl v hv hs
    hp (by rw [ha, List.drop_length]; rfl) ht (fun i hi => by rw [orc_bit]; exact ho i hi)
  refine Reach.cast run (funext fun r => ?_)
  by_cases hrp : r = dcPtr c
  · subst hrp; simp [ep, h2]
  · by_cases hra : r = dcAcc c
    · subst hra; simp [ea]
    · by_cases hrt : r = rT
      · subst hrt; simp [et, hrp, hra, ht]
      · simp [frame r hrp hra hrt, hrp, hra]

/-! ## Measuring, parsing, checking widths -/

/-- **Measuring the input**: the length loop counts `rL` up to `|y|`. -/
theorem len_run (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (hB : y.length ≤ B) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) (hr : v rL ≤ y.length) :
    Reach N mode y B .lenScan v (.prScan 0) (Function.update v rL y.length) :=
  inputLength_loop (CA N mode) orc y rL jLen .lenScan .lenInc (.prScan 0) rfl rfl
    (fun n _ => orc_len y n) B hB v hv hr

/-- **Parse loops**: from `rP = a`, the aligned pair scan of the suffix `y.drop a` rejects a
suffix that is not a pair, and otherwise ends past the first component and the separator. -/
theorem pr_run (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (p : Fin 3) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B)
    (hL : v rL = y.length) (ha : v rP ≤ y.length) :
    match pairDecode (y.drop (v rP)) with
    | none => ∃ t ≤ (y.drop (v rP)).length,
        Reach N mode y B (.prScan p) v .rej (Function.update v rP (v rP + 1 * t))
    | some (u, _) => Reach N mode y B (.prScan p) v (prCont N mode p 3)
        (Function.update v rP (v rP + 1 * (2 * u.length + 2))) :=
  alignedPair_loop (CA N mode) orc y rP rL jBit (.prScan p) (.prFirst p) (.prTest p)
    (.prRead p) .rej (prCont N mode p 3) (prAdvL N mode p) 1 B (by omega) (by decide)
    rfl rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
    (fun k i hi => by obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
                      rfl)
    (by simp only [prAdvL, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, trivial⟩)
    (y.drop (v rP)) v hv (by simp [hL]; omega)
    (fun i hi => by rw [orc_bit, getD_drop]; ring_nf)

/-- **The width check** of the radius field: from `rQ1` at the start of the last field `w`
of the input, with the cap `rCap`, the run reaches the radius decoding exactly when `w` is
canonical and has at most `|bits (rCap)|` letters; otherwise it rejects. -/
theorem ct_run (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (w : List Bool) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B)
    (hl : v rL = v rQ1 + 1 * w.length)
    (ho : ∀ i < w.length, y.getD (v rQ1 + 1 * i) false = w.getD i false) :
    ∃ v', (∀ r, v' r ≤ B) ∧ v' rQ1 ≤ v rL ∧ (∀ r, r ≠ rQ1 → r ≠ rCap → v' r = v r) ∧
      Reach N mode y B (.ctTest true) v
        (if w.length ≤ (Nat.bits (v rCap)).length then
          if w.getLastD true then .cp .Q2 else .rej else .rej) v' := by
  obtain ⟨v', h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := canonicalTail_loop (CA N mode) orc y rQ1 rL rCap (by decide)
    (by decide) (by decide) jBit .ctTest .ctCheck .ctRead .rej (.cp .Q2) .ctHalve
    (fun b i => if i = 0 then .ctAdv b else .ctTest b) 1 B (by omega) (fun _ => rfl) rfl rfl
    (fun _ => rfl) (fun b i hi => by obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
                                     rfl)
    (fun b => by simp) w true v hv hl (fun i hi => by rw [orc_bit]; exact ho i hi)
  exact ⟨v', h1, h2, h3, h4⟩

/-- **Counting the position width**: halving a copy of `n + 1` in `rT` while counting in
`rWp`. -/
theorem hc_run (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B)
    (hc : v rWp + (Nat.bits (v rT)).length ≤ B) :
    Reach N mode y B .hcTest v (.cp .E)
      (Function.update (Function.update v rT 0) rWp (v rWp + (Nat.bits (v rT)).length)) :=
  halvCount_loop (CA N mode) orc y rT rWp (by decide) .hcTest .hcHalve .hcBump (.cp .E) rfl rfl
    rfl B v hv hc

/-- **The position comparison**: counting `rT` up from `0` reaches the position before
`n + 1` iff the position is at most `n + 1`. -/
theorem le_run (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) (ht : v rT = 0) :
    Reach N mode y B .leT1 v (if v rPos ≤ v rN1 then .leClr else .rej)
      (Function.update v rT (min (v rPos) (v rN1))) :=
  le_loop (CA N mode) orc y rT rPos rN1 (by decide) (by decide) .leT1 .leT2 .leBump .leClr .rej
    rfl rfl rfl B v hv (by omega) (by omega)

/-! ## The two scans -/

/-- **The validity scan run**: from `rQ1`, `rQ2` at the starts of the words `u`, `u'` read at
stride two and `rE` at the end of `u`, the scan ends in `vDone` of the fold of the letter
step over the zipped words. -/
theorem v_run (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (u u' : List Bool) (hlen : u'.length = u.length)
    (st : VAd N) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B) (hlim : v rE = v rQ1 + 2 * u.length)
    (hq : v rQ2 + 2 * u.length ≤ B)
    (ho1 : ∀ i < u.length, y.getD (v rQ1 + 2 * i) false = u.getD i false)
    (ho2 : ∀ i < u.length, y.getD (v rQ2 + 2 * i) false = u'.getD i false) :
    Reach N mode y B (.vTest st) v (.vDone ((List.zip u u').foldl (δV N) st))
      (Function.update (Function.update v rQ1 (v rQ1 + 2 * u.length)) rQ2
        (v rQ2 + 2 * u.length)) :=
  scan_loop (CA N mode) orc y rQ1 rQ2 rE (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) jBit (δV N)
    .vTest .vRd1 .vRd2 (vA1 N) (vA2 N) .vDone 2 (by omega) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun st i hi => by simp only [vA1, dif_pos hi]; rfl)
    (fun st => by simp [vA1]) (fun st i hi => by simp only [vA2, dif_pos hi]; rfl)
    (fun st => by simp [vA2]) B u u' hlen st v hv hlim hq
    (fun i hi => by rw [orc_bit]; exact ho1 i hi) (fun i hi => by rw [orc_bit]; exact ho2 i hi)

/-- **The double sliding scan run**, through `rQ3`, `rQ4` up to `rE`. -/
theorem s_run (y : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (I : SInfo N) (f₀ f₁ : Bool) (u u' : List Bool)
    (hlen : u'.length = u.length) (st : SAd N) (v : Fin 21 → ℕ) (hv : ∀ r, v r ≤ B)
    (hlim : v rE = v rQ3 + 2 * u.length) (hq : v rQ4 + 2 * u.length ≤ B)
    (ho1 : ∀ i < u.length, y.getD (v rQ3 + 2 * i) false = u.getD i false)
    (ho2 : ∀ i < u.length, y.getD (v rQ4 + 2 * i) false = u'.getD i false) :
    Reach N mode y B (.sTest I f₀ f₁ st) v (.sFin I f₀ f₁ ((List.zip u u').foldl (δS N I) st))
      (Function.update (Function.update v rQ3 (v rQ3 + 2 * u.length)) rQ4
        (v rQ4 + 2 * u.length)) :=
  scan_loop (CA N mode) orc y rQ3 rQ4 rE (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) jBit (δS N I)
    (.sTest I f₀ f₁) (.sRd1 I f₀ f₁) (.sRd2 I f₀ f₁) (sA1 N I f₀ f₁) (sA2 N I f₀ f₁)
    (.sFin I f₀ f₁) 2 (by omega) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun st i hi => by simp only [sA1, dif_pos hi]; rfl)
    (fun st => by simp [sA1]) (fun st i hi => by simp only [sA2, dif_pos hi]; rfl)
    (fun st => by simp [sA2]) B u u' hlen st v hv hlim hq
    (fun i hi => by rw [orc_bit]; exact ho1 i hi) (fun i hi => by rw [orc_bit]; exact ho2 i hi)

end Complexity.Codec
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import Mathlib.Data.List.Zip
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Pi
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Prod

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Finite-state scans over chunked words

The logspace checkers of the configuration codec read their code words letter by letter and
keep only finitely much information in the control. This file supplies the two pure
finite-state devices they are built from, as folds over lists:

* the **chunk adaptor** `Complexity.Codec.adStep`: a letter-level automaton that buffers
  `w + 1` letters and then applies a chunk-level step — so a fold over a word made of
  fixed-width chunks is a fold over its chunks (`Complexity.Codec.foldl_adStep_flatten`);
* the **sliding check** `Complexity.Codec.slStep`: reading two streams `u` and `v` in
  lockstep, verify `vⱼ = G (uⱼ₋₁) (uⱼ) (uⱼ₊₁)` for every `j`, with a padding value `e`
  outside both streams — the shape of "one machine step is a local relation between
  neighbouring cells" (`Complexity.Codec.slide_ok_iff`).

Infrastructure for the codec checkers (finite automata in the sense of [Sip13, §1.1]); not a
result of [AB09].

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.Codec.adStep` — the chunk adaptor.
* `Complexity.Codec.slStep` — the sliding check.

## Main results

* `Complexity.Codec.foldl_adStep_flatten` — the adaptor folds chunk by chunk.
* `Complexity.Codec.slide_ok_iff` — the sliding verdict is the local relation.
* `Complexity.Codec.zip_flatten` — zipping block words blockwise.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.)
* [Sip13] M. Sipser, *Introduction to the Theory of Computation*, 3rd ed., Cengage, 2013.
  (§1.1: finite automata.)
-/

namespace Complexity.Codec

/-! ## The chunk adaptor -/

section Adaptor

variable {σ α : Type} {w : ℕ}

/-- The state of the chunk adaptor for chunks of `w + 1` letters: the chunk-level state, the
number of letters of the current chunk read so far, and the buffer. -/
abbrev AdSt (σ α : Type) (w : ℕ) := σ × Fin (w + 1) × (Fin (w + 1) → α)

/-- **The chunk adaptor**: store the letter; on the last letter of a chunk, apply the
chunk-level step `δ` to the buffered chunk and start a new chunk. -/
def adStep (δ : σ → List α → σ) (st : AdSt σ α w) (a : α) : AdSt σ α w :=
  if st.2.1.val = w then (δ st.1 (List.ofFn (Function.update st.2.2 st.2.1 a)), 0,
    Function.update st.2.2 st.2.1 a)
  else (st.1, ⟨(st.2.1.val + 1) % (w + 1), Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩,
    Function.update st.2.2 st.2.1 a)

/-- Reading a partial chunk only fills the buffer.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the letters read; each one is stored at the current count,
which then increases, and earlier entries are untouched. -/
lemma foldl_adStep_partial (δ : σ → List α → σ) (s : σ) (l : List α) (j : ℕ)
    (buf : Fin (w + 1) → α) (hj : j + l.length ≤ w) :
    ∃ buf' : Fin (w + 1) → α,
      l.foldl (adStep δ) (s, ⟨j, by omega⟩, buf) = (s, ⟨j + l.length, by omega⟩, buf') ∧
      ∀ t : Fin (w + 1), (hjt : j ≤ t.val) → (htl : t.val < j + l.length) →
        buf' t = l[t.val - j]'(by omega) := by
  induction l generalizing j buf with
  | nil => exact ⟨buf, by simp, fun t h1 h2 => by simp at h2; omega⟩
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.length_cons] at hj
    have hne : j ≠ w := by omega
    have step : adStep δ (s, ⟨j, by omega⟩, buf) a =
        (s, ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩, Function.update buf ⟨j, by omega⟩ a) := by
      simp only [adStep, hne, ↓reduceIte, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, and_true]
      exact Fin.ext (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega))
    obtain ⟨buf', e, hb⟩ := ih (j + 1) (Function.update buf ⟨j, by omega⟩ a) (by omega)
    refine ⟨buf', ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [List.foldl_cons, step, e]
      simp only [List.length_cons, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, and_true]
      exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)
    · intro t h1 h2
      simp only [List.length_cons] at h2
      by_cases ht : t.val = j
      · -- `t` was written by the first letter and is not touched afterwards
        have hfix : ∀ (l' : List α) (j' : ℕ) (b : Fin (w + 1) → α) (hj' : j' + l'.length ≤ w),
            j < j' → (l'.foldl (adStep δ) (s, ⟨j', by omega⟩, b)).2.2 ⟨j, by omega⟩ =
              b ⟨j, by omega⟩ := by
          intro l'
          induction l' with
          | nil => intros; rfl
          | cons a' l' ih' =>
            intro j' b hj' hjj
            simp only [List.length_cons] at hj'
            have hne' : j' ≠ w := by omega
            rw [List.foldl_cons]
            have st' : adStep δ (s, ⟨j', by omega⟩, b) a' =
                (s, ⟨j' + 1, by omega⟩, Function.update b ⟨j', by omega⟩ a') := by
              simp only [adStep, hne', ↓reduceIte, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and, and_true]
              exact Fin.ext (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega))
            rw [st', ih' (j' + 1) _ (by omega) (by omega)]
            rw [Function.update_of_ne (by simp [Fin.ext_iff]; omega)]
        have := hfix l (j + 1) (Function.update buf ⟨j, by omega⟩ a) (by omega) (by omega)
        rw [e] at this
        simp only at this
        have hbt : buf' t = a := by
          have tj : t = ⟨j, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext ht
          rw [tj]; simpa using this
        rw [hbt]
        simp only [ht, Nat.sub_self, List.getElem_cons_zero]
      · rw [hb t (by omega) (by omega)]
        have : t.val - j = (t.val - (j + 1)) + 1 := by omega
        simp only [this, List.getElem_cons_succ]

/-- One chunk of `w + 1` letters through the adaptor is one chunk-level step.

**Proof sketch.** Split the chunk into its first `w` letters and its last letter. The
partial lemma fills the buffer with the first `w`; the last letter completes the buffer,
which then lists exactly the chunk, and `δ` is applied. -/
lemma foldl_adStep_chunk (δ : σ → List α → σ) (s : σ) (ch : List α)
    (hch : ch.length = w + 1) (buf : Fin (w + 1) → α) :
    ∃ buf' : Fin (w + 1) → α, ch.foldl (adStep δ) (s, 0, buf) = (δ s ch, 0, buf') := by
  obtain ⟨l, a, rfl⟩ : ∃ l a, ch = l ++ [a] := by
    rcases List.eq_nil_or_concat ch with h | ⟨l, a, h⟩
    · subst h; simp at hch
    · exact ⟨l, a, by rw [h, List.concat_eq_append]⟩
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at hch
  obtain ⟨b, e, hb⟩ := foldl_adStep_partial δ s l 0 buf (by omega)
  refine ⟨Function.update b ⟨w, by omega⟩ a, ?_⟩
  rw [List.foldl_append, show ((0 : Fin (w + 1))) = ⟨0, by omega⟩ from rfl, e]
  simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, adStep, Nat.zero_add, hch, ↓reduceIte]
  have hof : List.ofFn (Function.update b ⟨w, by omega⟩ a) = l ++ [a] := by
    apply List.ext_getElem (by simp; omega)
    intro t h1 h2
    simp only [List.length_ofFn] at h1
    simp only [List.getElem_ofFn]
    by_cases ht : t = w
    · have hw : (⟨t, h1⟩ : Fin (w + 1)) = ⟨w, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext ht
      rw [hw, Function.update_self, List.getElem_append_right (by omega)]
      simp [ht, hch]
    · have hne : (⟨t, h1⟩ : Fin (w + 1)) ≠ ⟨w, by omega⟩ := fun h => ht (congrArg Fin.val h)
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hne, hb ⟨t, h1⟩ (Nat.zero_le _) (by simp; omega),
        List.getElem_append_left (by omega)]
      simp
  rw [hof]
  rfl

/-- **The adaptor folds chunk by chunk**: on a word that is a concatenation of chunks of
`w + 1` letters, the adaptor started at a chunk boundary ends at a chunk boundary with the
chunk-level fold.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the chunks, one `foldl_adStep_chunk` per chunk. -/
theorem foldl_adStep_flatten (δ : σ → List α → σ) (s : σ) (L : List (List α))
    (hL : ∀ ch ∈ L, ch.length = w + 1) (buf : Fin (w + 1) → α) :
    ∃ buf' : Fin (w + 1) → α, L.flatten.foldl (adStep δ) (s, 0, buf) = (L.foldl δ s, 0, buf') := by
  induction L generalizing s buf with
  | nil => exact ⟨buf, rfl⟩
  | cons ch L ih =>
    obtain ⟨b, e⟩ := foldl_adStep_chunk δ s ch (hL ch (by simp)) buf
    obtain ⟨b', e'⟩ := ih (δ s ch) (fun c hc => hL c (by simp [hc])) b
    exact ⟨b', by rw [List.flatten_cons, List.foldl_append, e, e', List.foldl_cons]⟩

end Adaptor

/-! ## Zipping block words -/

/-- Zipping two concatenations of blocks of matching lengths is concatenating the blockwise
zips. -/
theorem zip_flatten {α β : Type} (L₁ : List (List α)) (L₂ : List (List β))
    (h : L₁.length = L₂.length)
    (hl : ∀ (i : ℕ) (h₁ : i < L₁.length) (h₂ : i < L₂.length), L₁[i].length = L₂[i].length) :
    List.zip L₁.flatten L₂.flatten = (List.zipWith List.zip L₁ L₂).flatten := by
  induction L₁ generalizing L₂ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a L₁ ih =>
    cases L₂ with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b L₂ =>
      simp only [List.flatten_cons, List.zipWith_cons_cons]
      have h0 := hl 0 (by simp) (by simp)
      simp only [List.getElem_cons_zero] at h0
      rw [List.zip_append h0,
        ih L₂ (by simpa using h) (fun i h₁ h₂ => hl (i + 1) (by simpa using h₁)
          (by simpa using h₂))]

/-! ## The sliding check -/

section Slide

variable {X : Type} [DecidableEq X]

/-- The state of the sliding check: the two previous letters of the first stream, the
previous letter of the second stream, and the verdict so far. -/
abbrev SlSt (X : Type) := X × X × X × Bool

/-- **The sliding check**: on reading `(uⱼ, vⱼ)`, verify `vⱼ₋₁ = G uⱼ₋₂ uⱼ₋₁ uⱼ` and shift. -/
def slStep (G : X → X → X → X) (st : SlSt X) (uv : X × X) : SlSt X :=
  (st.2.1, uv.1, uv.2, st.2.2.2 && decide (st.2.2.1 = G st.1 st.2.1 uv.1))

/-- The sliding check on index sequences, in closed form: after `J` pairs the state holds the
last two first-stream letters and the last second-stream letter (padded by `e` before the
start), and the verdict is the local relation at every earlier position.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `J` (`List.range_succ`, `List.foldl_append`). -/
lemma foldl_slStep_range (G : X → X → X → X) (e : X) (f g : ℕ → X) (J : ℕ) :
    ((List.range J).map (fun i => (f i, g i))).foldl (slStep G) (e, e, e, true) =
      ((e :: e :: (List.range J).map f).getD J e,
        (e :: e :: (List.range J).map f).getD (J + 1) e,
        (e :: (List.range J).map g).getD J e,
        decide (∀ i < J, (e :: (List.range J).map g).getD i e =
          G ((e :: e :: (List.range J).map f).getD i e)
            ((e :: e :: (List.range J).map f).getD (i + 1) e)
            ((e :: e :: (List.range J).map f).getD (i + 2) e))) := by
  induction J with
  | zero => simp
  | succ J ih =>
    rw [List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.foldl_append, ih]
    simp only [List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil,
      slStep]
    have get1 : ∀ i, i < J + 2 → (e :: e :: ((List.range J).map f ++ [f J])).getD i e =
        (e :: e :: (List.range J).map f).getD i e := by
      intro i hi
      simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
      rcases i with _ | _ | i
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ]
        rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by simp; omega)]
    have get2 : ∀ i, i < J + 1 → (e :: ((List.range J).map g ++ [g J])).getD i e =
        (e :: (List.range J).map g).getD i e := by
      intro i hi
      simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
      rcases i with _ | i
      · rfl
      · simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ]
        rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by simp; omega)]
    have lastf : (e :: e :: ((List.range J).map f ++ [f J])).getD (J + 2) e = f J := by
      simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    have lastg : (e :: ((List.range J).map g ++ [g J])).getD (J + 1) e = g J := by
      simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    have beyondf : (e :: e :: (List.range J).map f).getD (J + 2) e = e := by
      simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    refine ⟨(get1 (J + 1) (by omega)).symm, lastf.symm, lastg.symm, ?_⟩
    rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff]
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hall, hlast⟩ i hi
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hi with hi | rfl
      · rw [get2 i (by omega), get1 i (by omega), get1 (i + 1) (by omega),
          get1 (i + 2) (by omega)]
        exact hall i hi
      · rw [get2 i (by omega), get1 i (by omega), get1 (i + 1) (by omega), lastf]
        exact hlast
    · intro hall
      refine ⟨fun i hi => ?_, ?_⟩
      · have := hall i (by omega)
        rwa [get2 i (by omega), get1 i (by omega), get1 (i + 1) (by omega),
          get1 (i + 2) (by omega)] at this
      · have := hall J (by omega)
        rwa [get2 J (by omega), get1 J (by omega), get1 (J + 1) (by omega), lastf] at this

/-- **The sliding verdict is the local relation**: on two streams `u`, `v` of equal length
`m`, followed by two padding pairs `(e, e)`, the sliding check accepts iff for every
`j < m + 2`, `vⱼ₋₁ = G uⱼ₋₂ uⱼ₋₁ uⱼ` (all letters outside the streams read as `e`) — i.e.
`v` is the image of `u` under the local rule `G`, and `G` maps the padding next to either
end of `u` to `e`.

**Proof sketch.** Rewrite the input as the indexed sequence `j ↦ (uⱼ, vⱼ)` for `j < m + 2`
(padded by `e`) and apply the closed form `foldl_slStep_range`; for `j ≤ m + 1` the padded
prefixes agree with the padded streams. -/
theorem slide_ok_iff (G : X → X → X → X) (e : X) (u v : List X) (h : u.length = v.length) :
    ((List.zip u v ++ [(e, e), (e, e)]).foldl (slStep G) (e, e, e, true)).2.2.2 = true ↔
      ∀ i < u.length + 2, (e :: v).getD i e =
        G ((e :: e :: u).getD i e) ((e :: e :: u).getD (i + 1) e)
          ((e :: e :: u).getD (i + 2) e) := by
  have hin : List.zip u v ++ [(e, e), (e, e)] =
      (List.range (u.length + 2)).map (fun i => (u.getD i e, v.getD i e)) := by
    apply List.ext_getElem (by simp [h])
    intro i h1 h2
    simp only [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_range, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    by_cases hi : i < u.length
    · rw [List.getElem_append_left (by simp [h]; omega)]
      simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (h ▸ hi : i < v.length)]
    · rw [List.getElem_append_right (by simp [h]; omega)]
      simp only [List.length_zip, h, min_self, List.length_append, List.length_cons,
        List.length_nil] at h1 ⊢
      have hu : u[i]? = none := List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)
      have hv : v[i]? = none := List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)
      rw [hu, hv]
      rcases (show i - v.length = 0 ∨ i - v.length = 1 by omega) with e1 | e1 <;> simp [e1]
  rw [hin, foldl_slStep_range]
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
  have fu : ∀ i, i ≤ u.length + 3 → (e :: e :: (List.range (u.length + 2)).map
      (fun i => u.getD i e)).getD i e = (e :: e :: u).getD i e := by
    intro i _
    simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    rcases i with _ | _ | i
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · by_cases hi : i < u.length + 2
      · simp [hi]
      · simp [hi, List.getElem?_eq_none (show u.length ≤ i by omega)]
  have fv : ∀ i, (e :: (List.range (u.length + 2)).map (fun i => v.getD i e)).getD i e =
      (e :: v).getD i e := by
    intro i
    simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
    rcases i with _ | i
    · rfl
    · by_cases hi : i < u.length + 2
      · simp [hi]
      · simp [hi, List.getElem?_eq_none (show v.length ≤ i by omega)]
  constructor
  · intro hall i hi
    have := hall i hi
    rwa [fv, fu i (by omega), fu (i + 1) (by omega), fu (i + 2) (by omega)] at this
  · intro hall i hi
    rw [fv, fu i (by omega), fu (i + 1) (by omega), fu (i + 2) (by omega)]
    exact hall i hi

end Slide

end Complexity.Codec
```

```
/-

Authors: Hydroxyi
```
