Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Codec.Bridge
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Reachable codes at growing radii

The exponential-time simulation of a space-bounded nondeterministic decider `N` does not know
the space bound: it searches the configuration graph at the radii `s = 0, 1, 2, …` and stops at
the first radius at which growing the window to `s + 1` does not add a reachable vertex. This
file proves that this works.

At radius `s`, the *reachable codes* (`Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode`) are the codes reachable from
the initial code along step pairs (`Complexity.Codec.StepRel`); they are exactly the codes of
the configurations reached by choice words all of whose prefixes stay in the window `[-s, s]`
(`Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_iff`). Re-coding a configuration at radius `s + 1` maps the
reachable codes at `s` injectively into those at `s + 1`
(`Complexity.ExpBFS.card_rset_le_succ`). If the two sets have the same size, every one-step
successor of a window-`s` run is again in the window (it is in the window `s + 1`, hence the
re-coding of a window-`s` run, hence of the same vertex), so every run stays in the window and
acceptance is decided by the reachable codes at `s`
(`Complexity.ExpBFS.mem_iff_of_card_eq`). Once `s` is at least the space bound, every run is
in the window and the sizes agree (`Complexity.ExpBFS.card_rset_succ_of_le`).

Configuration-graph infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1.1, Theorem 4.2]; not itself a result of
the book (the book assumes `S` space-constructible and computes the radius instead).

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun` — a choice word whose prefixes stay in the window.
* `Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode`, `Complexity.ExpBFS.rset` — reachable codes at a radius.

## Main results

* `Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_iff` — reachable codes are the codes of window runs.
* `Complexity.ExpBFS.card_rset_le_succ` — the count does not drop when the radius grows.
* `Complexity.ExpBFS.mem_iff_of_card_eq` — equal counts decide membership.
* `Complexity.ExpBFS.card_rset_succ_of_le` — above the space bound the counts agree.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, Claim 4.4, Theorem 4.2.)
-/

namespace Complexity.ExpBFS

open Turing Codec LogProg

variable {N : FinNDTM Bool} {x : List Bool}

/-! ## Windows -/

/-- The window predicate depends only on the configuration-graph vertex. -/
lemma inWin_of_coreSum_eq {s : ℕ} {C D : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x}
    (h : NDTM.coreSum C = NDTM.coreSum D) (hC : InWin N s C) : InWin N s D := by
  simp only [NDTM.coreSum, MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.core, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, hw, hp⟩, -⟩ := h
  intro i
  rw [← hw, ← hp]
  exact hC i

/-- The window grows with the radius. -/
lemma inWin_mono {s s' : ℕ} {C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x} (h : InWin N s C) (hs : s ≤ s') :
    InWin N s' C := fun i =>
  ⟨(h i).1.trans (by exact_mod_cast hs), fun z hz => ((h i).2 z hz).trans (by exact_mod_cast hs)⟩

/-- One step from the window `[-s, s]` stays in the window `[-(s + 1), s + 1]`: heads move by
one cell and write under themselves. -/
lemma inWin_stepWith {s : ℕ} {C : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x} (h : InWin N s C) (b : Bool) :
    InWin N (s + 1) (N.tm.stepWith b C) := by
  unfold NDTM.stepWith
  cases hs : C.state with
  | none => exact inWin_mono h (by omega)
  | some q =>
    intro i
    obtain ⟨hp, hz⟩ := h i
    have hmove := workTapePos_apply_le (N.tm.tr b q C.inputSymbol C.workTapeSymbols) C i
    refine ⟨by push_cast; rw [abs_le] at hp hmove ⊢; constructor <;> linarith [hp.1, hp.2,
      hmove.1, hmove.2], fun z hz' => ?_⟩
    rcases hwr : ((N.tm.tr b q C.inputSymbol C.workTapeSymbols).workTapes i).1 with _ | sym
    · simp only [Action.apply, hwr] at hz'
      exact (hz z hz').trans (by push_cast; linarith)
    · simp only [Action.apply, hwr] at hz'
      by_cases hzp : z = C.workTapePos i
      · subst hzp; exact hp.trans (by push_cast; linarith)
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hzp] at hz'
        exact (hz z hz').trans (by push_cast; linarith)

/-- A choice word all of whose prefix configurations lie in the window `[-s, s]`. -/
def WinRun (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (s : ℕ) (w : List Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ≤ w.length, InWin N s (N.tm.runWith (w.take j) (N.tm.initCfg x))

/-- The initial configuration is in every window. -/
lemma inWin_init (s : ℕ) : InWin N s (N.tm.initCfg x) := fun i => by
  simp [NDTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]

/-- Extending a window run by a step that stays in the window. -/
lemma WinRun.snoc {s : ℕ} {w : List Bool} (h : WinRun N x s w) (b : Bool)
    (hb : InWin N s (N.tm.runWith (w ++ [b]) (N.tm.initCfg x))) : WinRun N x s (w ++ [b]) := by
  intro j hj
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hj
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (w.length + 1) with h' | h'
  · rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by omega)]; exact h j (by omega)
  · obtain rfl : j = w.length + 1 := by omega
    rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp)]; exact hb

/-- A window run is a window run at every larger radius. -/
lemma WinRun.mono {s s' : ℕ} {w : List Bool} (h : WinRun N x s w) (hs : s ≤ s') :
    WinRun N x s' w := fun j hj => inWin_mono (h j hj) hs

/-- The whole run of a window run is in the window. -/
lemma WinRun.last {s : ℕ} {w : List Bool} (h : WinRun N x s w) :
    InWin N s (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x)) := by
  simpa using h w.length le_rfl

/-! ## Reachable codes -/

/-- **The reachable codes at radius `s`**: codes reachable from the initial code along step
pairs at radius `s`. -/
def RCode (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (s u : ℕ) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (StepRel N x s) (cfgCode s (N.tm.initCfg x)) u

/-- Equal codes of window configurations are equal vertices. -/
lemma coreSum_eq_of_code_eq {s : ℕ} {C D : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x} (hC : InWin N s C)
    (hD : InWin N s D) (h : cfgCode s C = cfgCode s D) : NDTM.coreSum C = NDTM.coreSum D :=
  coreSum_eq_of_cfgWord_eq hC hD (by rw [← bits_cfgCode, ← bits_cfgCode, h])

/-- Equal vertices have equal codes. -/
lemma code_eq_of_coreSum_eq {s : ℕ} {C D : Cfg N.k Bool N.State x}
    (h : NDTM.coreSum C = NDTM.coreSum D) : cfgCode s C = cfgCode s D := by
  simp only [cfgCode, cfgWord_congr (s := s) h]

/-- **Reachable codes are the codes of window runs.**

**Proof sketch.** (⇐) The codes of consecutive prefixes of a window run are step pairs.
(⇒) Induction along the path: a step pair from the code of a window run's end leads, by
the vertex's determination of its successors (`Turing.NDTM.coreSum_stepWith`), to the code of
the run extended by the pair's choice bit, still in the window (`inWin_of_coreSum_eq`). -/
theorem rcode_iff (s u : ℕ) :
    RCode N x s u ↔ ∃ w, WinRun N x s w ∧ cfgCode s (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x)) = u := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact ⟨[], fun j _ => by simpa using inWin_init s, rfl⟩
    | tail _ hst ih =>
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hcode⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨C, hC, hcC, C', ⟨b, hb⟩, hC', hcC'⟩ := (mem_stepLang N x _ _ s).mp hst
      have hv : NDTM.coreSum (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x)) = NDTM.coreSum C :=
        coreSum_eq_of_code_eq hw.last hC (hcode.trans hcC.symm)
      have hv' : NDTM.coreSum (N.tm.runWith (w ++ [b]) (N.tm.initCfg x)) = NDTM.coreSum C' := by
        rw [NDTM.runWith_append, NDTM.runWith_cons, NDTM.runWith_nil, ← hb]
        exact NDTM.coreSum_stepWith N.tm b hv
      refine ⟨w ++ [b], hw.snoc b (inWin_of_coreSum_eq hv'.symm hC'), ?_⟩
      rw [code_eq_of_coreSum_eq hv', hcC']
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    have key : ∀ j ≤ w.length,
        RCode N x s (cfgCode s (N.tm.runWith (w.take j) (N.tm.initCfg x))) := by
      intro j
      induction j with
      | zero => intro _; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      | succ j ih =>
        intro hj
        refine (ih (by omega)).tail ?_
        rw [StepRel, mem_stepLang]
        refine ⟨_, hw j (by omega), rfl, _, ⟨w[j]'(by omega), ?_⟩, hw (j + 1) hj, rfl⟩
        rw [List.take_succ, NDTM.runWith_append, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)]
        rfl
    simpa using key w.length le_rfl

/-- Reachable codes lie below the code bound. -/
lemma rcode_lt {s u : ℕ} (h : RCode N x s u) :
    u < 2 ^ (codeK N * (s + logSpace x.length + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨w, -, rfl⟩ := (rcode_iff s u).mp h
  exact cfgCode_lt s _

/-- **The reachable codes at radius `s`**, as a finite set. -/
noncomputable def rset (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (s : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.range (2 ^ (codeK N * (s + logSpace x.length + 1)))).filter (RCode N x s)

/-- Membership in the reachable codes. -/
lemma mem_rset {s u : ℕ} : u ∈ rset N x s ↔ RCode N x s u := by
  classical
  simp only [rset, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨rcode_lt h, h⟩⟩

open Classical in
/-- Counting the reachable codes below any bound above the code bound gives their number. -/
lemma card_filter_rcode {s K : ℕ} (hK : 2 ^ (codeK N * (s + logSpace x.length + 1)) ≤ K) :
    ((Finset.range K).filter (RCode N x s)).card = (rset N x s).card := by
  have e : (Finset.range K).filter (RCode N x s) = rset N x s := by
    apply Finset.ext
    intro u
    rw [mem_rset]
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨(rcode_lt h).trans_le hK, h⟩⟩
  rw [e]

/-! ## Growing the radius -/

open Classical in
/-- Re-coding at radius `s + 1`: a reachable code at radius `s` is the code of a window run,
re-coded at radius `s + 1` (well defined up to the vertex). -/
noncomputable def recode (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x : List Bool) (s u : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if h : RCode N x s u then
    cfgCode (s + 1) (N.tm.runWith (Classical.choose ((rcode_iff s u).mp h)) (N.tm.initCfg x))
  else 0

/-- The re-coding of the code of a window run is the code at radius `s + 1` of its end. -/
lemma recode_spec {s : ℕ} {w : List Bool} (hw : WinRun N x s w) :
    recode N x s (cfgCode s (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x))) =
      cfgCode (s + 1) (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x)) := by
  have h : RCode N x s (cfgCode s (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x))) :=
    (rcode_iff s _).mpr ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  rw [recode, dif_pos h]
  obtain ⟨hw', hcode⟩ := Classical.choose_spec ((rcode_iff s _).mp h)
  exact code_eq_of_coreSum_eq (coreSum_eq_of_code_eq hw'.last hw.last hcode)

/-- Re-coding is injective on the reachable codes. -/
lemma recode_injOn (s : ℕ) : Set.InjOn (recode N x s) (rset N x s : Set ℕ) := by
  intro u hu v hv huv
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := (rcode_iff s u).mp (mem_rset.mp hu)
  obtain ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩ := (rcode_iff s v).mp (mem_rset.mp hv)
  rw [recode_spec hw, recode_spec hw'] at huv
  exact code_eq_of_coreSum_eq
    (coreSum_eq_of_code_eq ((hw.mono (by omega)).last) ((hw'.mono (by omega)).last) huv)

/-- Re-coding maps reachable codes to reachable codes. -/
lemma recode_mem {s u : ℕ} (hu : u ∈ rset N x s) : recode N x s u ∈ rset N x (s + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := (rcode_iff s u).mp (mem_rset.mp hu)
  rw [recode_spec hw, mem_rset, rcode_iff]
  exact ⟨w, hw.mono (by omega), rfl⟩

/-- **The count of reachable codes does not drop when the radius grows.** -/
theorem card_rset_le_succ (s : ℕ) : (rset N x s).card ≤ (rset N x (s + 1)).card :=
  Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ (fun _ hu => recode_mem hu) (recode_injOn s)

/-- With equal counts, every reachable code at radius `s + 1` is a re-coding. -/
lemma image_recode_of_card_eq {s : ℕ} (h : (rset N x s).card = (rset N x (s + 1)).card) :
    (rset N x s).image (recode N x s) = rset N x (s + 1) := by
  classical
  apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hv
    exact recode_mem hu
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn (recode_injOn s), h]

/-- **Equal counts close the window**: if the counts at `s` and `s + 1` agree, every choice word
is a window run at radius `s`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the word. One more step from a window run is in the window
`s + 1` (`inWin_stepWith`), so its code at `s + 1` is reachable, hence (equal counts) the
re-coding of a window run at `s`; equal codes at `s + 1` are equal vertices, and the window
depends only on the vertex. -/
theorem winRun_of_card_eq {s : ℕ} (h : (rset N x s).card = (rset N x (s + 1)).card) :
    ∀ w : List Bool, WinRun N x s w := by
  intro w
  induction w using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => exact fun j _ => by simpa using inWin_init s
  | append_singleton w b ih =>
    refine ih.snoc b ?_
    have hstep : InWin N (s + 1) (N.tm.runWith (w ++ [b]) (N.tm.initCfg x)) := by
      rw [NDTM.runWith_append, NDTM.runWith_cons, NDTM.runWith_nil]
      exact inWin_stepWith ih.last b
    have hrun : WinRun N x (s + 1) (w ++ [b]) := (ih.mono (by omega)).snoc b hstep
    have hmem : cfgCode (s + 1) (N.tm.runWith (w ++ [b]) (N.tm.initCfg x)) ∈ rset N x (s + 1) :=
      mem_rset.mpr ((rcode_iff _ _).mpr ⟨_, hrun, rfl⟩)
    rw [← image_recode_of_card_eq h] at hmem
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hre⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
    obtain ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩ := (rcode_iff s u).mp (mem_rset.mp hu)
    rw [recode_spec hw'] at hre
    exact inWin_of_coreSum_eq (coreSum_eq_of_code_eq ((hw'.mono (by omega)).last) hstep hre)
      hw'.last

/-- **Equal counts decide membership**: if `N` decides `L` (in any space) and the counts of
reachable codes at radii `s` and `s + 1` agree, then `x ∈ L` iff some reachable code at
radius `s` is an accepting code.

**Proof sketch.** (⇐) `Complexity.Codec.mem_of_codePath`. (⇒) An accepting branch is a
window run (`winRun_of_card_eq`), so the code of its halted end is reachable and accepting. -/
theorem mem_iff_of_card_eq {L : Language Bool} {sp : ℕ → ℕ} (hN : N.DecidesInSpace L sp)
    {s : ℕ} (h : (rset N x s).card = (rset N x (s + 1)).card) :
    x ∈ L ↔ ∃ u, RCode N x s u ∧
      pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits u) (Nat.bits s)) ∈ acceptLang N := by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨T, -, -, hiff⟩ := hN x
    obtain ⟨w, -, hhalt, hout⟩ := hiff.mp hx
    have hw := winRun_of_card_eq h w
    refine ⟨_, (rcode_iff s _).mpr ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_acceptLang]
    exact ⟨_, hw.last, rfl, hhalt, hout⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, hacc⟩
    exact mem_of_codePath hN x s _ u (by rw [mem_initLang]) hu hacc

/-- Every configuration reached from initialization by a decider in space `sp` lies in the
window of radius `sp |x|`.

**Proof sketch.** Words of the halting budget's length use at most `sp |x|` cells, so their
prefixes are in the window (`Complexity.Codec.inWin_runWith_take`); a shorter word is a prefix
of a padded one, a longer one has halted at the budget. -/
lemma inWin_runWith_of_decides {L : Language Bool} {sp : ℕ → ℕ} (hN : N.DecidesInSpace L sp)
    (w : List Bool) : InWin N (sp x.length) (N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x)) := by
  obtain ⟨T, hHalt, hSpace, -⟩ := hN x
  by_cases hw : w.length ≤ T
  · set w' := w ++ List.replicate (T - w.length) false
    have hw' : w'.length = T := by simp [w']; omega
    have := inWin_runWith_take w' (hSpace w' hw') w.length
    rwa [show w'.take w.length = w by simp [w']] at this
  · have hlen : (w.take T).length = T := List.length_take_of_le (by omega)
    have frozen : N.tm.runWith w (N.tm.initCfg x) = N.tm.runWith (w.take T) (N.tm.initCfg x) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop T w]
      rw [NDTM.runWith_append, NDTM.runWith_of_halt _ (hHalt _ hlen)]
    rw [frozen]
    have := inWin_runWith_take (w.take T) (hSpace _ hlen) T
    rwa [show (w.take T).take T = w.take T by simp] at this

/-- **Above the space bound the counts agree.** If `N` decides `L` in space `sp` and
`sp |x| ≤ s`, the counts of reachable codes at radii `s` and `s + 1` agree.

**Proof sketch.** Every run is in the window `sp |x| ≤ s` (`inWin_runWith_of_decides`), so
every window run at `s + 1` is one at `s`, and its code at `s + 1` is the re-coding of its
code at `s`; with `card_rset_le_succ` the counts agree. -/
theorem card_rset_succ_of_le {L : Language Bool} {sp : ℕ → ℕ} (hN : N.DecidesInSpace L sp)
    {s : ℕ} (hs : sp x.length ≤ s) : (rset N x s).card = (rset N x (s + 1)).card := by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm (card_rset_le_succ s) ?_
  calc (rset N x (s + 1)).card ≤ ((rset N x s).image (recode N x s)).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card
        intro v hv
        obtain ⟨w, -, rfl⟩ := (rcode_iff _ v).mp (mem_rset.mp hv)
        have hw : WinRun N x s w := fun j _ =>
          inWin_mono (inWin_runWith_of_decides hN (w.take j)) hs
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_, mem_rset.mpr ((rcode_iff s _).mpr ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩),
          recode_spec hw⟩
    _ ≤ (rset N x s).card := Finset.card_image_le

end Complexity.ExpBFS
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ExpBFS.Run

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The relaxation round of the search machine

Run lemmas for the first parts of one search of `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.A` over the codes
`u < K`, its marks kept at the memory cells `Bs + u`: the specifications (the decider answers
`ini`, `stp`, the growth predicates `Mono`, `Out`, the reachable codes `Cl`), the initial
marking (`ini_run`) and one relaxation round (`inner_run` for a fixed source `U`, `outer_run`
over all sources). The rounds, the count and the whole search are in
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ExpBFS.Search`.

Infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1.1, proof of Theorem 4.2]; not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.ini`, `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.stp` — the decider answers.
* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.Mono`, `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.Out` — the memory grows, and
  only in the region.
* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.Cl` — the codes reachable below `K`.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.ini_run` — the initial marking.
* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.inner_run`, `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.outer_run` — one
  relaxation round.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, Theorem 4.2.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

namespace ExpBFS

open Turing

variable {K₀ : ℕ} {orc : Fin 4 → List Bool → Bool} {x : List Bool} {B P : ℕ}

/-! ## Specifications -/

/-- The radius of a search: `s` for the first, `s1` for the second. -/
def rr (S : St) (φ : Bool) : ℕ := if φ then S.s1 else S.s

/-- The radius register of a search holds its radius. -/
lemma toV_rad (S : St) (φ : Bool) : S.toV (rad (toPh φ)) = rr S φ := by cases φ <;> rfl

/-- The initial-code decider's answer at `u` (radius `r`). -/
def ini (orc : Fin 4 → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool) (r u : ℕ) : Bool :=
  orc 1 (pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits u) (Nat.bits r)))

/-- The step-pair decider's answer at `(u, v)` (radius `r`). -/
def stp (orc : Fin 4 → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool) (r u v : ℕ) : Bool :=
  orc 2 (pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits u) (pairEncode (Nat.bits v) (Nat.bits r))))

/-- The memory cell of code `v` in the region at base `b`. -/
abbrev cell (b v : ℕ) : ℤ := ((b + v : ℕ) : ℤ)

/-- The memory only grows. -/
def Mono (M M' : ℤ → Bool) : Prop := ∀ z, M z = true → M' z = true

/-- The memory changes only in the region `[b, b + K)`. -/
def Out (b K : ℕ) (M M' : ℤ → Bool) : Prop := ∀ z, (∀ v, v < K → z ≠ cell b v) → M' z = M z

/-- The memory grows from itself. -/
lemma Mono.refl (M : ℤ → Bool) : Mono M M := fun _ h => h

/-- Growth of the memory composes. -/
lemma Mono.trans {M M' M'' : ℤ → Bool} (h : Mono M M') (h' : Mono M' M'') : Mono M M'' :=
  fun z hz => h' z (h z hz)

/-- An unchanged memory changes only in the region. -/
lemma Out.refl (b K : ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) : Out b K M M := fun _ _ => rfl

/-- Changes only in the region compose. -/
lemma Out.trans {b K : ℕ} {M M' M'' : ℤ → Bool} (h : Out b K M M') (h' : Out b K M' M'') :
    Out b K M M'' := fun z hz => (h' z hz).trans (h z hz)

/-- Setting a bit grows the memory. -/
lemma mono_update (M : ℤ → Bool) (z : ℤ) : Mono M (Function.update M z true) := by
  intro z' hz
  by_cases h : z' = z
  · subst h; simp
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne h]; exact hz

/-- Setting a bit of the region changes the memory only in the region. -/
lemma out_update (M : ℤ → Bool) {b K v : ℕ} (hv : v < K) :
    Out b K M (Function.update M (cell b v) true) := fun _ hz =>
  Function.update_of_ne (hz v hv) _ _

/-- Distinct codes have distinct cells. -/
lemma cell_inj {b v v' : ℕ} (h : cell b v = cell b v') : v = v' := by
  simp only [cell] at h; omega

/-- Prefixing a run to a run statement with one witness. -/
lemma ex1_pre {α : Type} {a b : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)} {f : α → MConf 17 (Lb K₀)} {Q : α → Prop}
    (h1 : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) a b)
    (h2 : ∃ y, MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) b (f y) ∧ Q y) :
    ∃ y, MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) a (f y) ∧ Q y := by
  obtain ⟨y, hr, hq⟩ := h2; exact ⟨y, h1.trans hr, hq⟩

/-- Prefixing a run to a run statement with two witnesses. -/
lemma ex2_pre {α β : Type} {a b : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)} {f : α → β → MConf 17 (Lb K₀)}
    {Q : α → β → Prop} (h1 : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) a b)
    (h2 : ∃ y z, MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) b (f y z) ∧ Q y z) :
    ∃ y z, MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) a (f y z) ∧ Q y z := by
  obtain ⟨y, z, hr, hq⟩ := h2; exact ⟨y, z, h1.trans hr, hq⟩

/-- **The codes reachable below `K`**: reachable from an initial code `u < K` through step
pairs with targets below `K`. -/
def Cl (orc : Fin 4 → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool) (r K v : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ u, u < K ∧ ini orc x r u = true ∧
    Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => stp orc x r a b = true ∧ b < K) u v

/-- Reachable codes lie below `K`. -/
lemma Cl.lt {r K v : ℕ} (h : Cl orc x r K v) : v < K := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, -, hpath⟩ := h
  cases hpath.cases_tail with
  | inl e => exact e ▸ hu
  | inr h => obtain ⟨_, -, -, hb⟩ := h; exact hb

/-- Reachable codes are closed under step pairs below `K`. -/
lemma Cl.step {r K u v : ℕ} (h : Cl orc x r K u) (hs : stp orc x r u v = true) (hv : v < K) :
    Cl orc x r K v := by
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀, hi, hpath⟩ := h
  exact ⟨u₀, hu₀, hi, hpath.tail ⟨hs, hv⟩⟩

/-! ## The initial marking -/

/-- The bounds of a search: registers at most `B`, the region and the counters fit. -/
def SBd (B P : ℕ) (S : St) : Prop :=
  S.Bd B ∧ S.Bs + S.K ≤ B ∧ S.Bs + S.K ≤ P ∧ S.K + 1 ≤ B

/-- **The initial marking**: from `iU` with `U = u₀`, the machine marks the initial codes
`u₀ ≤ v < K` and reaches `rl0` with `U = K`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `K - U`: test `U = K`, ask the initial-code decider, mark by an
access (`ac_run`), increment `U`. -/
theorem ini_run (φ : Bool) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool), S.K - S.U = j → S.U ≤ S.K →
    S.T = 0 → S.T2 = 0 → S.Z = 0 → SBd B P S →
    ∃ M', MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.iU φ) S M 0) (cf (.rl0 φ) { S with U := S.K } M' 0) ∧
      Mono M M' ∧ Out S.Bs S.K M M' ∧
      (∀ v, S.U ≤ v → v < S.K → ini orc x (rr S φ) v = true → M' (cell S.Bs v) = true) ∧
      (∀ v, v < S.K → M' (cell S.Bs v) = true → M (cell S.Bs v) = true ∨
        ini orc x (rr S φ) v = true) := by
  intro j
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ j ih =>
  intro S M hj hUK hT hT2 hZ hS
  obtain ⟨hbd, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩ := hS
  by_cases hU : S.U = S.K
  · refine ⟨M, ?_, Mono.refl M, Out.refl _ _ M, fun v h1 h2 => by omega, fun v _ h => Or.inl h⟩
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep]; regs [hU, ↓reduceIte]
    refine reach_cf (MReach.refl _) ?_ rfl
    ext <;> simp [hU]
  · have hlt : S.U < S.K := by omega
    -- the next round, from `U + 1`, with memory `M1`
    have next : ∀ M1 : ℤ → Bool, Mono M M1 → Out S.Bs S.K M M1 →
        (ini orc x (rr S φ) S.U = true → M1 (cell S.Bs S.U) = true) →
        (∀ v, v < S.K → M1 (cell S.Bs v) = true → M (cell S.Bs v) = true ∨
          ini orc x (rr S φ) v = true) →
        ∃ M', MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.iN φ) S M1 0)
          (cf (.rl0 φ) { S with U := S.K } M' 0) ∧ Mono M M' ∧ Out S.Bs S.K M M' ∧
          (∀ v, S.U ≤ v → v < S.K → ini orc x (rr S φ) v = true → M' (cell S.Bs v) = true) ∧
          (∀ v, v < S.K → M' (cell S.Bs v) = true → M (cell S.Bs v) = true ∨
            ini orc x (rr S φ) v = true) := by
      intro M1 hm1 ho1 hu1 hc1
      have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with U := S.U + 1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
      obtain ⟨M', hr, hm, ho, hmark, hclean⟩ := ih (S.K - (S.U + 1)) (by omega)
        { S with U := S.U + 1 } M1 rfl (by simp only; omega) hT hT2 hZ
        ⟨hbd1, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩
      refine ⟨M', ?_, hm1.trans hm, ho1.trans ho, fun v h1 h2 h3 => ?_, fun v h1 h2 => ?_⟩
      · refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
        simp only [astep]; regs
        exact reach_cf hr (by ext <;> simp) rfl
      · rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with e | e
        · subst e; exact hm _ (hu1 h3)
        · exact hmark v (by simp only; omega) h2 h3
      · rcases hclean v h1 h2 with h | h
        · exact hc1 v h1 h
        · exact Or.inr h
    refine ex1_pre (b := ?b1) ?p1 ?q1
    case p1 =>
      refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
      simp only [astep]; regs; rw [if_neg hU]
      refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
      simp only [astep, vword_whole₂]; regs
      rw [toV_rad]
      exact MReach.refl _
    by_cases hi : orc 1 (pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits S.U) (Nat.bits (rr S φ)))) = true
    · simp only [hi, ↓reduceIte]
      have hac := ac_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.ini φ) S M hbd hT
        hT2 hZ (by simp [Site.idx]; omega) (by simp [Site.idx]; omega)
      simp only [Site.set, Site.idx, St.toV_U, acExit] at hac
      obtain ⟨M', hr, rest⟩ := next (Function.update M (cell S.Bs S.U) true)
        (mono_update M _) (out_update M hlt) (fun _ => by simp)
        (fun v hv h => by
          by_cases e : v = S.U
          · subst e; exact Or.inr hi
          · left; rwa [Function.update_of_ne (fun h' => e (cell_inj h'))] at h)
      exact ⟨M', hac.trans hr, rest⟩
    · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hi
      simp only [hi, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      have hni : ini orc x (rr S φ) S.U = false := hi
      obtain ⟨M', hr, rest⟩ := next M (Mono.refl M) (Out.refl _ _ M)
        (by simp [hni]) (fun v _ h => Or.inl h)
      exact ⟨M', hr, rest⟩

/-! ## A relaxation round -/

/-- **The inner loop of a round**: for the marked source `U = u`, from `rlV` with `V = v₀`, the
machine marks the unmarked targets `v₀ ≤ v < K` of step pairs `(u, v)`, raising the change
flag if it marks one, and reaches `rlNU` with `V` cleared.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `K - V`: test `V = K`; read the mark of `V` (`ac_run`); if
unmarked ask the step decider, and on a step pair mark `V` and raise the flag. -/
theorem inner_run (φ : Bool) (u : ℕ) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool), S.K - S.V = j →
    S.V ≤ S.K → S.U = u → u < S.K → S.T = 0 → S.T2 = 0 → S.Z = 0 → S.ch ≤ 1 → SBd B P S →
    ∃ M' ch', MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.rlV φ) S M 0)
        (cf (.rlNU φ) { S with V := 0, ch := ch' } M' 0) ∧
      Mono M M' ∧ Out S.Bs S.K M M' ∧ ch' ≤ 1 ∧
      (∀ v, v < S.K → M' (cell S.Bs v) = true → M (cell S.Bs v) = true ∨
        stp orc x (rr S φ) u v = true) ∧
      (∀ v, S.V ≤ v → v < S.K → stp orc x (rr S φ) u v = true → M' (cell S.Bs v) = true) ∧
      (M' = M → ch' = S.ch) ∧ (M' ≠ M → ch' = 1) := by
  intro j
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ j ih =>
  intro S M hj hVK hUu hu hT hT2 hZ hch hS
  obtain ⟨hbd, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩ := hS
  by_cases hV : S.V = S.K
  · refine ⟨M, S.ch, ?_, Mono.refl M, Out.refl _ _ M, hch, fun v _ h => Or.inl h,
      fun v h1 h2 => by omega, fun _ => rfl, fun h => absurd rfl h⟩
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep]; regs [hV, ↓reduceIte]
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep]; regs
    refine reach_cf (MReach.refl _) ?_ rfl
    ext <;> simp
  · have hlt : S.V < S.K := by omega
    -- continuing from `V + 1` with memory `M1` and flag `c1`
    have next : ∀ (M1 : ℤ → Bool) (c1 : ℕ), c1 ≤ 1 → Mono M M1 → Out S.Bs S.K M M1 →
        (∀ v, v < S.K → M1 (cell S.Bs v) = true → M (cell S.Bs v) = true ∨
          stp orc x (rr S φ) u v = true) →
        (stp orc x (rr S φ) u S.V = true → M1 (cell S.Bs S.V) = true) →
        (M1 = M → c1 = S.ch) → (M1 ≠ M → c1 = 1) →
        ∃ M' ch', MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.rlNV φ) { S with ch := c1 } M1 0)
            (cf (.rlNU φ) { S with V := 0, ch := ch' } M' 0) ∧
          Mono M M' ∧ Out S.Bs S.K M M' ∧ ch' ≤ 1 ∧
          (∀ v, v < S.K → M' (cell S.Bs v) = true → M (cell S.Bs v) = true ∨
            stp orc x (rr S φ) u v = true) ∧
          (∀ v, S.V ≤ v → v < S.K → stp orc x (rr S φ) u v = true →
            M' (cell S.Bs v) = true) ∧
          (M' = M → ch' = S.ch) ∧ (M' ≠ M → ch' = 1) := by
      intro M1 c1 hc1 hm1 ho1 hcl1 hmk1 he1 hn1
      have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with V := S.V + 1, ch := c1 } := by
        simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
      obtain ⟨M', ch', hr, hm, ho, hch', hcl, hmk, he, hn⟩ := ih (S.K - (S.V + 1)) (by omega)
        { S with V := S.V + 1, ch := c1 } M1 rfl (by simp only; omega) hUu hu hT hT2 hZ hc1
        ⟨hbd1, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩
      have hrr : rr { S with V := S.V + 1, ch := c1 } φ = rr S φ := by cases φ <;> rfl
      rw [hrr] at hcl hmk
      refine ⟨M', ch', ?_, hm1.trans hm, ho1.trans ho, hch', fun v hv h => ?_, fun v h1 h2 h3 => ?_,
        fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_⟩
      · have hbd2 : St.Bd B { S with ch := c1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
        refine step_of rfl hbd2 ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
        simp only [astep]; regs
        exact reach_cf hr (by ext <;> simp) rfl
      · rcases hcl v hv h with h' | h'
        · exact hcl1 v hv h'
        · exact Or.inr h'
      · rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with e | e
        · subst e; exact hm _ (hmk1 h3)
        · exact hmk v (by simp only; omega) h2 h3
      · have e1 : M1 = M := by
          funext z
          have a1 := hm1 z
          have a2 := hm z
          rw [e] at a2
          cases h1 : M z <;> cases h2 : M1 z <;> simp_all
        rw [he (e.trans e1.symm), he1 e1]
      · by_cases e1 : M' = M1
        · rw [he e1]; exact hn1 (fun h => e (e1.trans h))
        · exact hn e1
    refine ex2_pre (b := ?b2) ?p2 ?q2
    case p2 =>
      refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
      simp only [astep]; regs; rw [if_neg hV]
      exact MReach.refl _
    have hac := ac_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.rV φ) S M hbd hT
      hT2 hZ (by simp [Site.idx]; omega) (by simp [Site.idx]; omega)
    simp only [Site.set, Site.idx, St.toV_V, Bool.false_or, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
      acExit] at hac
    refine ex2_pre hac ?_
    by_cases hb : M (cell S.Bs S.V) = true
    · simp only [hb, ↓reduceIte]
      obtain ⟨M', ch', hr, rest⟩ := next M S.ch hch (Mono.refl M) (Out.refl _ _ M)
        (fun v _ h => Or.inl h) (fun _ => hb) (fun _ => rfl) (fun h => absurd rfl h)
      exact ⟨M', ch', cont (by ext <;> rfl) hr, rest⟩
    · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hb
      simp only [hb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      refine ex2_pre (b := ?b3) ?p3 ?q3
      case p3 =>
        refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
        simp only [astep, vword_whole₃]; regs
        simp only [toV_rad, hUu]
        exact MReach.refl _
      by_cases hs : orc 2 (pairEncode x (pairEncode (Nat.bits u) (pairEncode (Nat.bits S.V)
          (Nat.bits (rr S φ))))) = true
      · simp only [hs, ↓reduceIte]
        have hac2 := ac_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.sV φ) S M hbd
          hT hT2 hZ (by simp [Site.idx]; omega) (by simp [Site.idx]; omega)
        simp only [Site.set, Site.idx, St.toV_V, acExit] at hac2
        refine ex2_pre hac2 ?_
        have hbd0 : St.Bd B { S with ch := 0 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
        refine ex2_pre (b := ?b4) ?p4 ?q4
        case p4 =>
          refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
          simp only [astep]; regs
          refine step_of rfl hbd0 ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
          simp only [astep]; regs
          exact MReach.refl _
        have hne : Function.update M (cell S.Bs S.V) true ≠ M := by
          intro e
          have := congrFun e (cell S.Bs S.V)
          rw [Function.update_self, hb] at this
          cases this
        obtain ⟨M', ch', hr, rest⟩ := next (Function.update M (cell S.Bs S.V) true) 1 le_rfl
          (mono_update M _) (out_update M hlt)
          (fun v hv h => by
            by_cases e : v = S.V
            · subst e; exact Or.inr hs
            · left; rwa [Function.update_of_ne (fun h' => e (cell_inj h'))] at h)
          (fun _ => by simp) (fun e => absurd e hne) (fun _ => rfl)
        exact ⟨M', ch', cont (by ext <;> simp) hr, rest⟩
      · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hs
        simp only [hs, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
        have hns : stp orc x (rr S φ) u S.V = false := hs
        obtain ⟨M', ch', hr, rest⟩ := next M S.ch hch (Mono.refl M) (Out.refl _ _ M)
          (fun v _ h => Or.inl h) (fun h => by rw [hns] at h; cases h) (fun _ => rfl)
          (fun h => absurd rfl h)
        exact ⟨M', ch', cont (by ext <;> rfl) hr, rest⟩

/-- Memory that grows from `M` to `M'` and back is unchanged. -/
lemma mono_antisymm {M M' : ℤ → Bool} (h : Mono M M') (h' : Mono M' M) : M' = M := by
  funext z
  have a := h z
  have b := h' z
  cases h1 : M z <;> cases h2 : M' z <;> simp_all

/-- **The outer loop of a round**: from `rlU` with `U = u₀` and `V` clear, the machine runs
the inner loop for every marked source `u₀ ≤ U < K` and reaches `rlE` with `U = K`. Every new
mark is a step target of an earlier mark (so a set closed under step pairs and containing the
old marks contains the new ones); if nothing was marked, the marks were closed under step
pairs from the sources `u₀ ≤ u < K`; the change flag is raised iff something was marked.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `K - U`: read the mark of `U` (`ac_run`); if marked run
`inner_run`; increment `U`. -/
theorem outer_run (φ : Bool) : ∀ (j : ℕ) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool), S.K - S.U = j → S.U ≤ S.K →
    S.V = 0 → S.T = 0 → S.T2 = 0 → S.Z = 0 → S.ch ≤ 1 → SBd B P S →
    ∃ M' ch', MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.rlU φ) S M 0)
        (cf (.rlE φ) { S with U := S.K, ch := ch' } M' 0) ∧
      Mono M M' ∧ Out S.Bs S.K M M' ∧ ch' ≤ 1 ∧
      (∀ Q : ℕ → Prop, (∀ a b, Q a → a < S.K → b < S.K →
          stp orc x (rr S φ) a b = true → Q b) →
        (∀ v, v < S.K → M (cell S.Bs v) = true → Q v) →
        ∀ v, v < S.K → M' (cell S.Bs v) = true → Q v) ∧
      (M' = M → ∀ a b, S.U ≤ a → a < S.K → b < S.K → M (cell S.Bs a) = true →
        stp orc x (rr S φ) a b = true → M (cell S.Bs b) = true) ∧
      (M' = M → ch' = S.ch) ∧ (M' ≠ M → ch' = 1) := by
  intro j
  induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ j ih =>
  intro S M hj hUK hV hT hT2 hZ hch hS
  obtain ⟨hbd, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩ := hS
  by_cases hU : S.U = S.K
  · refine ⟨M, S.ch, ?_, Mono.refl M, Out.refl _ _ M, hch, fun Q _ h => h,
      fun _ a b h1 h2 => by omega, fun _ => rfl, fun h => absurd rfl h⟩
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep]; regs [hU, ↓reduceIte]
    refine reach_cf (MReach.refl _) ?_ rfl
    ext <;> simp [hU]
  · have hlt : S.U < S.K := by omega
    -- continuing from `U + 1` with memory `M1` and flag `c1`
    have next : ∀ (M1 : ℤ → Bool) (c1 : ℕ), c1 ≤ 1 → Mono M M1 → Out S.Bs S.K M M1 →
        (∀ Q : ℕ → Prop, (∀ a b, Q a → a < S.K → b < S.K →
            stp orc x (rr S φ) a b = true → Q b) →
          (∀ v, v < S.K → M (cell S.Bs v) = true → Q v) →
          ∀ v, v < S.K → M1 (cell S.Bs v) = true → Q v) →
        (M1 = M → ∀ b, b < S.K → M (cell S.Bs S.U) = true →
          stp orc x (rr S φ) S.U b = true → M (cell S.Bs b) = true) →
        (M1 = M → c1 = S.ch) → (M1 ≠ M → c1 = 1) →
        ∃ M' ch', MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.rlNU φ) { S with ch := c1 } M1 0)
            (cf (.rlE φ) { S with U := S.K, ch := ch' } M' 0) ∧
          Mono M M' ∧ Out S.Bs S.K M M' ∧ ch' ≤ 1 ∧
          (∀ Q : ℕ → Prop, (∀ a b, Q a → a < S.K → b < S.K →
              stp orc x (rr S φ) a b = true → Q b) →
            (∀ v, v < S.K → M (cell S.Bs v) = true → Q v) →
            ∀ v, v < S.K → M' (cell S.Bs v) = true → Q v) ∧
          (M' = M → ∀ a b, S.U ≤ a → a < S.K → b < S.K → M (cell S.Bs a) = true →
            stp orc x (rr S φ) a b = true → M (cell S.Bs b) = true) ∧
          (M' = M → ch' = S.ch) ∧ (M' ≠ M → ch' = 1) := by
      intro M1 c1 hc1 hm1 ho1 hq1 hcl1 he1 hn1
      have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with U := S.U + 1, ch := c1 } := by
        simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
      obtain ⟨M', ch', hr, hm, ho, hch', hq, hcl, he, hn⟩ := ih (S.K - (S.U + 1)) (by omega)
        { S with U := S.U + 1, ch := c1 } M1 rfl (by simp only; omega) hV hT hT2 hZ hc1
        ⟨hbd1, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩
      have hrr : rr { S with U := S.U + 1, ch := c1 } φ = rr S φ := by cases φ <;> rfl
      rw [hrr] at hq hcl
      have hbd2 : St.Bd B { S with ch := c1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
      refine ⟨M', ch', ?_, hm1.trans hm, ho1.trans ho, hch', fun Q hQ hM => hq Q hQ (hq1 Q hQ hM),
        fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_, fun e => ?_⟩
      · refine step_of rfl hbd2 ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
        simp only [astep]; regs
        exact reach_cf hr (by ext <;> simp) rfl
      · have e1 : M1 = M := mono_antisymm hm1 (e ▸ hm)
        intro a b ha hab hb hMa hs
        rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le ha with e2 | e2
        · subst e2; exact hcl1 e1 b hb hMa hs
        · have := hcl (e ▸ e1.symm ▸ rfl) a b (by simp only; omega) hab hb (e1 ▸ hMa) hs
          rwa [e1] at this
      · have e1 : M1 = M := mono_antisymm hm1 (e ▸ hm)
        rw [he (e.trans e1.symm), he1 e1]
      · by_cases e1 : M' = M1
        · rw [he e1]; exact hn1 (fun h => e (e1.trans h))
        · exact hn e1
    refine ex2_pre (b := ?b5) ?p5 ?q5
    case p5 =>
      refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ ?_
      simp only [astep]; regs; rw [if_neg hU]
      exact MReach.refl _
    have hac := ac_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.rU φ) S M hbd hT
      hT2 hZ (by simp [Site.idx]; omega) (by simp [Site.idx]; omega)
    simp only [Site.set, Site.idx, St.toV_U, Bool.false_or, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte,
      acExit] at hac
    refine ex2_pre hac ?_
    by_cases hb : M (cell S.Bs S.U) = true
    · simp only [hb, ↓reduceIte]
      obtain ⟨M1, c1, hr1, hm1, ho1, hc1, hcl1, hmk1, he1, hn1⟩ :=
        inner_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) φ S.U (S.K - S.V) S M rfl
          (by omega) rfl hlt hT hT2 hZ hch ⟨hbd, hB1, hP1, hK1⟩
      obtain ⟨M', ch', hr, rest⟩ := next M1 c1 hc1 hm1 ho1
        (fun Q hQ hM v hv h => by
          rcases hcl1 v hv h with h' | h'
          · exact hM v hv h'
          · exact hQ _ _ (hM _ hlt hb) hlt hv h')
        (fun e b hbK _ hs => by
          have := hmk1 b (by omega) hbK hs
          rwa [e] at this)
        (fun e => he1 e) (fun e => hn1 e)
      refine ⟨M', ch', hr1.trans ?_, rest⟩
      exact cont (by ext <;> simp [hV]) hr
    · rw [Bool.not_eq_true] at hb
      simp only [hb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      obtain ⟨M', ch', hr, rest⟩ := next M S.ch hch (Mono.refl M) (Out.refl _ _ M)
        (fun Q _ h => h) (fun _ b _ h => by rw [hb] at h; cases h) (fun _ => rfl)
        (fun h => absurd rfl h)
      exact ⟨M', ch', cont (by ext <;> rfl) hr, rest⟩

end ExpBFS

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ExpBFS.Machine

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Routines of the search machine

Run lemmas for the straight-line parts of the breadth-first search memory machine
`Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.A`: single steps (`step_of`, `mright_of`, …), the loop sites
(instances of the generic loops of `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMLoops`,
transferred to the memory machine by `Complexity.LogProg.MReach.of_areach`), a memory access
(`ac_run`: walk the head out to `Bs + idx`, read or set the bit, walk back), the setup
(`setup_run`) and the width computation (`wk_run`).

Infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1.1, proof of Theorem 4.2]; not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.G` — the guard: registers at most `B`, the memory head in
  `[0, P]`.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.preS_A` — the machine meets the syntactic preconditions.
* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.ac_run` — a memory access.
* `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.setup_run`, `Complexity.LogProg.ExpBFS.wk_run`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, Theorem 4.2.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

namespace ExpBFS

open Turing

variable {K₀ : ℕ}

/-- The deterministic part of the search machine. -/
abbrev Ad (K₀ : ℕ) : ARM 17 4 (Lb K₀) := (A K₀).detPart false

/-- A configuration of the search machine with a named register file. -/
abbrev cf (l : Lb K₀) (st : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) : MConf 17 (Lb K₀) :=
  ((some l, st.toV, none), (M, p))

/-- The radius registers are not `U`. -/
lemma rad_ne_U (p : Ph3) : rU ≠ rad p := by cases p <;> decide

/-- The radius registers are neither `U` nor `V`. -/
lemma rad_ne_V (p : Ph3) : rV ≠ rad p := by cases p <;> decide

/-- **The search machine meets the syntactic preconditions** everywhere: its equality tests
compare distinct registers and its calls have distinct arguments. -/
lemma preS_A (x : List Bool) (a : AConf 17 (Lb K₀)) : PreS (Ad K₀) x a := by
  rcases a with ⟨_ | l, v, res⟩
  · trivial
  · cases l with
    | iC φ => simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, rad_ne_U]
    | rlS φ => cases φ <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, rad, toPh] <;> decide
    | d1 i => simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A]
    | fz i => simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A]
    | nz i => by_cases h : i.val = 0 <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, h]
    | cp k j => fin_cases j <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, cpI]
    | mv j => fin_cases j <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, mvI]
    | sh p j => fin_cases j <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, shI]
    | ac st ph =>
      rcases ph with j | _ | ⟨b, j⟩
      · fin_cases j <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, acI]
      · by_cases h : st.set <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, acI, h]
      · fin_cases j <;> simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A, acI]
    | _ => simp [PreS, MARM.detPart, A] <;> decide

variable {orc : Fin 4 → List Bool → Bool} {x : List Bool} {B P : ℕ}

/-- **The guard** of the search machine's runs: the syntactic preconditions, every register
at most `B`, the memory head in `[0, P]`. -/
def G (x : List Bool) (B P : ℕ) (c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)) : Prop :=
  GuardLe (Ad K₀) x B c.1 ∧ 0 ≤ c.2.2 ∧ c.2.2 ≤ P

/-- A bounded register file with the memory head in range meets the guard. -/
lemma g_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (l : Lb K₀) : G x B P (cf l st M p) := ⟨⟨preS_A x _, hbd.toV⟩, hp⟩

/-- One register step from a bounded register file. -/
lemma step_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l : Lb K₀} {i : Ins 17 4 (Lb K₀)}
    {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)} (hA : A K₀ l = .det i) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (astep (fun _ => i) orc x (some l, st.toV, none), (M, p))
      c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := by
  refine MReach.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) =
      (astep (fun _ => i) orc x (some l, st.toV, none), (M, p)) := by
    simp only [mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- One halting register step from a bounded register file. -/
lemma stepH_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l : Lb K₀} {i : Ins 17 4 (Lb K₀)} {r : Bool}
    (hA : A K₀ l = .det i) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MHalt (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (astep (fun _ => i) orc x (some l, st.toV, none), (M, p))
      r) :
    MHalt (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) r := by
  refine MHalt.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) =
      (astep (fun _ => i) orc x (some l, st.toV, none), (M, p)) := by
    simp only [mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- A memory head move to the right. -/
lemma mright_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l' : Lb K₀} {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)}
    (hA : A K₀ l = .mright l') (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l' st M (p + 1)) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := by
  refine MReach.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) = cf l' st M (p + 1) := by simp only [cf, mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- A memory head move to the left. -/
lemma mleft_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l' : Lb K₀} {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)}
    (hA : A K₀ l = .mleft l') (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l' st M (p - 1)) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := by
  refine MReach.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) = cf l' st M (p - 1) := by simp only [cf, mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- Setting the memory bit under the head. -/
lemma mset_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l' : Lb K₀} {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)}
    (hA : A K₀ l = .mset l') (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l' st (Function.update M p true) p) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := by
  refine MReach.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) = cf l' st (Function.update M p true) p := by
    simp only [cf, mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- Branching on the memory bit under the head. -/
lemma mread_of {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l₁ l₀ : Lb K₀} {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)}
    (hA : A K₀ l = .mread l₁ l₀) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (if M p then l₁ else l₀) st M p) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := by
  refine MReach.step (g_of hbd hp l) ?_
  have e : mstep (A K₀) orc x (cf l st M p) = cf (if M p then l₁ else l₀) st M p := by
    simp only [cf, mstep, hA]
  rw [e]; exact h

/-- Continue a run from an equal register file. -/
lemma cont {st st' : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l : Lb K₀} {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)}
    (e : st = st') (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st' M p) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c := e ▸ h

/-- Transfer a run of the deterministic part through `GuardLe` to the search machine. -/
lemma of_areach {a a' : AConf 17 (Lb K₀)} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : AReach (Ad K₀) orc x (GuardLe (Ad K₀) x B) a a') (hlive : a'.1 ≠ none) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (a, (M, p)) (a', (M, p)) :=
  (MReach.of_areach (M, p) h hlive).mono fun c ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, by rw [h2]; exact hp⟩

/-- A clear step. -/
lemma clr_step {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l' : Lb K₀} {r : Fin 17}
    {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)} (hA : A K₀ l = .det (.clr r l')) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) ((some l', Function.update st.toV r 0, none), (M, p)) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c :=
  step_of hA hbd hp h

/-- An increment step. -/
lemma inc_step {st : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p : ℤ} {l l' : Lb K₀} {r : Fin 17}
    {c : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)} (hA : A K₀ l = .det (.inc r l')) (hbd : st.Bd B) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P)
      ((some l', Function.update st.toV r (st.toV r + 1), none), (M, p)) c) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf l st M p) c :=
  step_of hA hbd hp h

/-! ## Loop sites -/

/-- Copy sites have distinct registers, all different from `Z`. -/
lemma cp_ne (k : CpS K₀) : cpSrc k ≠ cpDst k ∧ cpSrc k ≠ rZ ∧ cpDst k ≠ rZ := by
  rcases k with p | p | ⟨p, i⟩ | p | p | p | st | st | _
  · cases p <;> simp only [cpSrc, cpDst, rad] <;> decide
  all_goals first
    | (simp only [cpSrc, cpDst]; decide)
    | (cases st <;> simp only [cpSrc, cpDst, Site.idx] <;> decide)

/-- **A copy site** adds the source to the target. -/
theorem cp_run (k : CpS K₀) (st : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (hbd : st.Bd B) (hZ : st.Z = 0) (hb : st.toV (cpDst k) + st.toV (cpSrc k) ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.cp k 0) st M p)
      ((some (cpExit k), Function.update st.toV (cpDst k)
        (st.toV (cpDst k) + st.toV (cpSrc k)), none), (M, p)) :=
  of_areach hp (copy_run (A := Ad K₀) (oracle := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (l := .cp k 0)
    (l1 := .cp k 1) (l2 := .cp k 2) (l3 := .cp k 3) (l4 := .cp k 4) (l5 := .cp k 5)
    (l6 := .cp k 6) (lx := cpExit k) (cp_ne k).1 (cp_ne k).2.1 (cp_ne k).2.2 rfl rfl rfl rfl
    rfl rfl rfl _ hZ hbd.toV hb) (by simp)

/-- **The shift site** of phase `p` multiplies `K` by `2 ^ C` and clears `C`. -/
theorem sh_run (q : Ph3) (st : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P)
    (hbd : st.Bd B) (hZ : st.Z = 0) (hb : st.K * 2 ^ st.C ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.sh q 0) st M p)
      (cf (.cp (.KB1 q) 0) { st with C := 0, K := st.K * 2 ^ st.C } M p) := by
  have h := shl_run (A := Ad K₀) (oracle := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (c := rC) (r := rK) (z := rZ)
    (l := .sh q 0) (l1 := .sh q 1) (l2 := .sh q 2) (l3 := .sh q 3) (l4 := .sh q 4)
    (l5 := .sh q 5) (l6 := .sh q 6) (l7 := .sh q 7) (l8 := .sh q 8) (lx := .cp (.KB1 q) 0)
    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl _ st.toV rfl hZ
    hbd.toV hb
  regs at h
  exact of_areach hp h (by simp)

/-- **The move site** `c1 := c1 + c`, `c := 0`. -/
theorem mv_run (st : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (hp : 0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ P) (hbd : st.Bd B)
    (hb : st.c1 + st.c ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.mv 0) st M p)
      (cf (.cp .s1 0) { st with c := 0, c1 := st.c1 + st.c } M p) := by
  have h := move_run (A := Ad K₀) (oracle := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (r := rc) (t := rc1)
    (l := .mv 0) (l1 := .mv 1) (l2 := .mv 2) (lx := .cp .s1 0) (by decide) rfl rfl rfl _
    st.toV rfl hbd.toV hb
  regs at h
  exact of_areach hp h (by simp)

/-- Rewriting the end configuration of a run along equal register files and head positions. -/
lemma reach_cf {a : MConf 17 (Lb K₀)} {l : Lb K₀} {st st' : St} {M : ℤ → Bool} {p p' : ℤ}
    (h : MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) a (cf l st M p)) (e1 : st = st') (e2 : p = p') :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) a (cf l st' M p') := e1 ▸ e2 ▸ h

/-! ## Memory accesses -/

/-- The index register of an access site is `U` or `V`. -/
lemma idx_cases (st : Site) : st.idx = rU ∨ st.idx = rV := by
  cases st <;> simp [Site.idx]

/-- **The outward walk**: from `wo 0` with `T = k`, the head moves `k` cells right while `T`
counts down to `0` and `T2` counts up by `k`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `k`; one round is `jz`, `dec T`, `inc T2`, `mright`. -/
theorem wo_run (st : Site) : ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ), S.T = k → S.Bd B →
    S.T2 + k ≤ B → 0 ≤ p → p + k ≤ P →
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.ac st (.wo 0)) S M p)
      (cf (.ac st .op) { S with T := 0, T2 := S.T2 + k } M (p + k)) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro S M p hT hbd hb hp0 hpP
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨hp0, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep, St.toV_T, hT, ↓reduceIte]
    exact reach_cf (MReach.refl _) (by ext <;> simp [hT]) (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro S M p hT hbd hb hp0 hpP
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨hp0, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep, St.toV_T, hT, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨hp0, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep]; regs [hT, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with T := k } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    refine step_of rfl hbd1 ⟨hp0, by omega⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep]; regs
    have hbd2 : St.Bd B { S with T := k, T2 := S.T2 + 1 } := by
      simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    refine mright_of rfl hbd2 ⟨hp0, by omega⟩ ?_
    refine reach_cf (ih _ M (p + 1) rfl hbd2 (by simp only; omega) (by omega)
      (by push_cast at hpP ⊢; omega)) (by ext <;> simp; omega) (by push_cast; ring)

/-- **The return walk**: from `wb b 0` with `T2 = k`, the head moves `k` cells left while `T2`
counts down to `0`, and the access exits with the bit `b`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `k`; one round is `jz`, `dec T2`, `mleft`. -/
theorem wb_run (st : Site) (b : Bool) : ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ), S.T2 = k →
    S.Bd B → 0 ≤ p - k → p ≤ P →
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.ac st (.wb b 0)) S M p)
      (cf (acExit st b) { S with T2 := 0 } M (p - k)) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro S M p hT hbd hp0 hpP
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨by omega, hpP⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep, St.toV_T2, hT, ↓reduceIte]
    exact reach_cf (MReach.refl _) (by ext <;> simp [hT]) (by simp)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro S M p hT hbd hp0 hpP
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨by omega, hpP⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep, St.toV_T2, hT, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨by omega, hpP⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep]; regs [hT, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with T2 := k } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    refine mleft_of rfl hbd1 ⟨by omega, hpP⟩ ?_
    refine reach_cf (ih _ M (p - 1) rfl hbd1 (by push_cast at hp0 ⊢; omega) (by omega))
      (by ext <;> simp) (by push_cast; ring)

/-- **A memory access** at site `st`, from the start of its two copies with `T`, `T2`, `Z`
clear and the memory head at `0`: the access ends at the site's exit for the bit read at
`Bs + idx` (or `true` after setting it), with the same register file and the head back at `0`;
a setting site sets the bit at `Bs + idx`.

**Proof sketch.** Copy `Bs` and the index into `T` (`cp_run`), walk out (`wo_run`), read or
set (`mread_of`, `mset_of`), walk back (`wb_run`). -/
theorem ac_run (st : Site) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (hbd : S.Bd B) (hT : S.T = 0)
    (hT2 : S.T2 = 0) (hZ : S.Z = 0) (hB : S.Bs + S.toV st.idx ≤ B)
    (hP : S.Bs + S.toV st.idx ≤ P) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.cp (.aB st) 0) S M 0)
      (cf (acExit st (st.set || M ((S.Bs + S.toV st.idx : ℕ) : ℤ))) S
        (if st.set then Function.update M ((S.Bs + S.toV st.idx : ℕ) : ℤ) true else M) 0) := by
  set u := S.toV st.idx with hu
  have h1 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.aB st) S M 0
    ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩
    hbd hZ (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h1
  regs at h1
  simp only [hT, zero_add] at h1
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with T := S.Bs } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have hidx1 : ({ S with T := S.Bs } : St).toV st.idx = u := by
    rcases idx_cases st with h | h <;> simp [hu, h]
  have h2 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.aI st)
    { S with T := S.Bs } M 0
    ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩ hbd1 (by simpa using hZ) (by
      simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; rw [hidx1]; simp only [St.toV_T]; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h2
  rw [hidx1] at h2
  regs at h2
  have hbd2 : St.Bd B { S with T := S.Bs + u } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h3 := wo_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) st (S.Bs + u)
    { S with T := S.Bs + u } M 0 rfl hbd2 (by simp only; omega) le_rfl (by push_cast; omega)
  simp only [zero_add] at h3
  set S3 : St := { S with T := 0, T2 := S.Bs + u } with hS3
  have hS3' : ({ ({ S with T := S.Bs + u } : St) with T := 0, T2 := S.T2 + (S.Bs + u) } : St)
      = S3 := by ext <;> simp [hS3, hT2]
  rw [hS3'] at h3
  have hbd3 : S3.Bd B := by simp only [hS3, St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have hend : ({ S3 with T2 := 0 } : St) = S := by ext <;> simp [hS3, hT, hT2]
  refine ((h1.trans h2).trans h3).trans ?_
  by_cases hs : st.set
  · refine mset_of (l' := .ac st (.wb true 0)) (by simp [A, acI, hs]) hbd3
      ⟨by omega, by push_cast; omega⟩ ?_
    have h4 := wb_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) st true (S.Bs + u) S3
      (Function.update M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ) true) ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ) rfl hbd3 (by simp)
      (by push_cast; omega)
    simp only [hs, Bool.true_or, ↓reduceIte]
    exact reach_cf h4 hend (by simp)
  · refine mread_of (l₁ := .ac st (.wb true 0)) (l₀ := .ac st (.wb false 0))
      (by simp [A, acI, hs]) hbd3 ⟨by omega, by push_cast; omega⟩ ?_
    have h4 := wb_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) st
      (M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ)) (S.Bs + u) S3 M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ) rfl hbd3 (by simp)
      (by push_cast; omega)
    simp only [hs, Bool.false_or, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    have e : (if M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ) = true then Lb.ac st (.wb true 0)
        else Lb.ac st (.wb false 0)) = Lb.ac (K₀ := K₀) st (.wb (M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ)) 0) := by
      cases M ((S.Bs + u : ℕ) : ℤ) <;> rfl
    rw [e]
    exact reach_cf h4 hend (by simp)

/-! ## The setup -/

/-- The number of halvings that take `k` to `0`. -/
def hv (k : ℕ) : ℕ := if k = 0 then 0 else Nat.log 2 k + 1

/-- One halving less. -/
lemma hv_div (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) : hv k = hv (k / 2) + 1 := by
  unfold hv
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 2 with h | h
  · obtain rfl : k = 1 := by omega
    simp
  · have h2 : k / 2 ≠ 0 := by omega
    rw [if_neg hk, if_neg h2, Nat.log_of_one_lt_of_le (by decide) h]

/-- The value of `Lg` after the setup: `1 +` the number of halvings of `|x|`. -/
def lgv (n : ℕ) : ℕ := 1 + hv n

/-- `Lg` bounds the logarithm of the input length. -/
lemma logSpace_le_lgv (n : ℕ) : logSpace n ≤ lgv n := by
  unfold lgv hv logSpace
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h; simp
  · omega

/-- `Lg` exceeds the logarithm of the input length by at most one. -/
lemma lgv_le (n : ℕ) : lgv n ≤ logSpace n + 1 := by
  unfold lgv hv logSpace
  split_ifs <;> omega

/-- `Lg` is at most `|x| + 1`. -/
lemma lgv_le_succ (n : ℕ) : lgv n ≤ n + 1 := by
  unfold lgv hv
  split_ifs with h
  · omega
  · have := Nat.log_lt_self 2 h
    omega

/-- **The logarithm loop**: from `lg0` with `N = k`, the machine halves `N` to `0`, adding the
number of halvings to `Lg`, and reaches the first width computation.

**Proof sketch.** Strong induction on `k` (`hv_div`). -/
theorem lg_run : ∀ (k : ℕ) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool), S.N = k → S.Bd B → S.Lg + hv k ≤ B →
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf .lg0 S M 0)
      (cf (.cp (.radX .fst) 0) { S with N := 0, Lg := S.Lg + hv k } M 0) := by
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ k ih =>
  intro S M hN hbd hb
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst hk
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep]; regs [hN, ↓reduceIte]
    exact reach_cf (MReach.refl _) (by ext <;> simp [hN, hv]) rfl
  · refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep]; regs [hN, hk, ↓reduceIte]
    refine step_of rfl hbd ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep]; regs [hN]
    have hdiv := hv_div k hk
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with N := k / 2 } := by
      simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩; omega
    refine step_of rfl hbd1 ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ ?_
    simp only [astep]; regs
    have hbd2 : St.Bd B { S with N := k / 2, Lg := S.Lg + 1 } := by
      simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    exact reach_cf (ih (k / 2) (by omega) _ M rfl hbd2 (by simp only; omega))
      (by ext <;> simp; omega) rfl

/-- **The setup**: from `scan` with all registers clear, the machine counts the input length
into `N`, sets `Lg := 1` and runs the logarithm loop, reaching the first width computation with
`Lg = lgv |x|` and every other register clear.

**Proof sketch.** `inputLength_loop` (asking decider `0`) on the deterministic part,
transferred by `of_areach`; one increment; `lg_run`. -/
theorem setup_run (hq : ∀ k ≤ x.length, orc 0 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits k)) = decide (k < x.length))
    (M : ℤ → Bool) (hB : x.length + 2 ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf .scan St.zero M 0)
      (cf (.cp (.radX .fst) 0) { St.zero with Lg := lgv x.length } M 0) := by
  have hbd0 : St.zero.Bd B := by simp only [St.Bd, St.zero]; omega
  have h := inputLength_loop (Ad K₀) orc x rN 0 .scan .incN .lgI rfl rfl hq B (by omega)
    St.zero.toV hbd0.toV (by simp [St.zero])
  regs at h
  refine (of_areach (P := P) (M := M) ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ h (by simp)).trans ?_
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { St.zero with N := x.length } := by simp only [St.Bd, St.zero]; omega
  refine step_of rfl hbd1 ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ ?_
  simp only [astep]; regs
  have hbd2 : St.Bd B { St.zero with N := x.length, Lg := 1 } := by
    simp only [St.Bd, St.zero]; omega
  have hhv : hv x.length ≤ x.length := by
    unfold hv; split_ifs with h0
    · omega
    · have := Nat.log_lt_self 2 h0; omega
  exact reach_cf (lg_run x.length _ M rfl (by simpa [St.zero] using hbd2)
    (by simp [St.zero]; omega)) (by ext <;> simp [St.zero, lgv]) rfl

/-! ## The width computation -/

/-- **The multiplication chain**: from the `i`-th copy of `X` into `w`, with `w = i · X`, the
machine reaches `wkC` with `w = K₀ · X`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `K₀ - i`, each step a copy site. -/
theorem mw_run (q : Ph3) : ∀ (j i : ℕ) (hi : i < K₀) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool), K₀ - i = j →
    S.w = i * S.X → S.Z = 0 → S.Bd B → K₀ * S.X ≤ B →
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.cp (.mw q ⟨i, hi⟩) 0) S M 0)
      (cf (.wkC q) { S with w := K₀ * S.X } M 0) := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro i hi; omega
  | succ j ih =>
    intro i hi S M hj hw hZ hbd hb
    have hle : (i + 1) * S.X ≤ K₀ * S.X := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    have hwX : S.w + S.X ≤ B := by rw [hw, ← Nat.succ_mul]; exact hle.trans hb
    have h := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.mw q ⟨i, hi⟩) S M 0
      ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩ hbd hZ (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; exact hwX)
    simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h
    regs at h
    have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with w := S.w + S.X } := by
      simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    by_cases hlt : i + 1 < K₀
    · rw [dif_pos hlt] at h
      refine h.trans (reach_cf (ih (i + 1) hlt _ M (by omega) (by simp only; rw [hw]; ring) hZ
        hbd1 (by simpa using hb)) (by ext <;> simp) rfl)
    · rw [dif_neg hlt] at h
      have hK : K₀ = i + 1 := by omega
      exact reach_cf h (by ext <;> simp [hw, hK]; ring) rfl

/-- The register file after a width computation of phase `q` at radius `r`. -/
def wkSt (q : Ph3) (S : St) (r : ℕ) : St :=
  { S with
    w := K₀ * (r + S.Lg + 1)
    K := 2 ^ (K₀ * (r + S.Lg + 1))
    Bs := (if q = .snd then 1 else 2) * 2 ^ (K₀ * (r + S.Lg + 1)) }

/-- **The width computation**: from its first copy, with `X`, `w`, `K`, `Bs`, `C`, `Z`
clear, the machine computes `w = K₀ (r + Lg + 1)` for the phase's radius `r`, `K = 2 ^ w` and
the base `Bs` (`K` for the second search, else `2K`), and reaches the phase's exit.

**Proof sketch.** Copies (`cp_run`) and the multiplication chain (`mw_run`) compute `w`, the
shift site (`sh_run`) computes `K`, copies compute `Bs`. -/
theorem wk_run (q : Ph3) (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (hX : S.X = 0) (hw : S.w = 0) (hK : S.K = 0)
    (hBs : S.Bs = 0) (hC : S.C = 0) (hZ : S.Z = 0) (hK0 : 0 < K₀) (hbd : S.Bd B)
    (hB : 3 * 2 ^ (K₀ * (S.toV (rad q) + S.Lg + 1)) ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.cp (.radX q) 0) S M 0)
      (cf (wkExit q) (wkSt (K₀ := K₀) q S (S.toV (rad q))) M 0) := by
  set r := S.toV (rad q) with hr
  set w := K₀ * (r + S.Lg + 1) with hwd
  have hw2 : w < 2 ^ w := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have hX1 : r + S.Lg + 1 ≤ w := by
    calc r + S.Lg + 1 = 1 * (r + S.Lg + 1) := (one_mul _).symm
      _ ≤ w := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hK0
  have hp : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 0 ∧ (0 : ℤ) ≤ P := ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
  -- `X := r`
  have h1 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.radX q) S M 0 hp hbd hZ
    (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; rw [← hr]; regs; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h1
  rw [← hr] at h1
  regs [hX, zero_add] at h1
  -- `X := r + Lg`
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with X := r } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h2 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.lgX q)
    { S with X := r } M 0 hp
    hbd1 hZ (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h2
  regs at h2
  refine (h1.trans h2).trans ?_
  -- `X := r + Lg + 1`
  have hbd2 : St.Bd B { S with X := r + S.Lg } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  refine step_of rfl hbd2 hp ?_
  simp only [astep, dif_pos hK0]; regs
  -- `w := K₀ · X`
  have hbd3 : St.Bd B { S with X := r + S.Lg + 1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h3 := mw_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) q K₀ 0 hK0
    { S with X := r + S.Lg + 1 }
    M (by omega) (by simp [hw]) hZ hbd3 (by simp only; omega)
  refine h3.trans ?_
  -- `X := 0`, `K := 1`
  have hbd4 : St.Bd B { S with X := r + S.Lg + 1, w := w } := by
    simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  refine step_of rfl hbd4 hp ?_
  simp only [astep]; regs
  refine cont (st' := { S with w := w }) (by ext <;> simp [hX, hwd]) ?_
  have hbd5 : St.Bd B { S with w := w } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  refine step_of rfl hbd5 hp ?_
  simp only [astep]; regs
  refine cont (st' := { S with w := w, K := 1 }) (by ext <;> simp [hK]) ?_
  -- `C := w`
  have hbd6 : St.Bd B { S with w := w, K := 1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h4 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.wC q)
    { S with w := w, K := 1 } M 0 hp hbd6 hZ (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h4
  regs at h4
  refine (reach_cf h4 (st' := { S with w := w, K := 1, C := w }) (by ext <;> simp [hC])
    rfl).trans ?_
  -- `K := 2 ^ w`
  have hbd7 : St.Bd B { S with w := w, K := 1, C := w } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h5 := sh_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) q
    { S with w := w, K := 1, C := w } M 0 hp hbd7 hZ (by simp only; omega)
  refine (reach_cf h5 (st' := { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w }) (by ext <;> simp [hC])
    rfl).trans ?_
  -- `Bs := K` (and once more)
  have hbd8 : St.Bd B { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  have h6 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.KB1 q)
    { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w } M 0 hp hbd8 hZ (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; omega)
  simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h6
  regs at h6
  refine (reach_cf h6 (st' := { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w, Bs := 2 ^ w })
    (by ext <;> simp [hBs]) rfl).trans ?_
  by_cases hq : q = .snd
  · rw [if_pos hq]
    exact reach_cf (MReach.refl _) (by ext <;> simp [wkSt, hq, hwd, hr]) rfl
  · rw [if_neg hq]
    have hbd9 : St.Bd B { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w, Bs := 2 ^ w } := by
      simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
    have h7 := cp_run (orc := orc) (x := x) (B := B) (P := P) (K₀ := K₀) (.KB2 q)
      { S with w := w, K := 2 ^ w, Bs := 2 ^ w } M 0 hp hbd9 hZ
      (by simp only [cpDst, cpSrc]; regs; omega)
    simp only [cpDst, cpSrc, cpExit] at h7
    regs at h7
    exact reach_cf h7 (by ext <;> simp [wkSt, hq, hwd, hr]; ring) rfl

/-! ## The clear chains -/

/-- **The clear chain after the first search**: `U`, `V`, `w`, `K`, `Bs` are cleared. -/
theorem d1_run (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (hbd : S.Bd B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.d1 0) S M 0)
      (cf (.mv 0) { S with U := 0, V := 0, w := 0, K := 0, Bs := 0 } M 0) := by
  have hp : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 0 ∧ (0 : ℤ) ≤ P := ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
  refine clr_step (r := rU) (l' := .d1 1) rfl hbd hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rV) (l' := .d1 2) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rw) (l' := .d1 3) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rK) (l' := .d1 4) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rBs) (l' := .mv 0) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  exact MReach.refl _

/-- **The clear chain before the final scan**: `U`, `V`, `w`, `K`, `Bs` are cleared. -/
theorem fz_run (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (hbd : S.Bd B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.fz 0) S M 0)
      (cf (.cp (.radX .fin) 0) { S with U := 0, V := 0, w := 0, K := 0, Bs := 0 } M 0) := by
  have hp : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 0 ∧ (0 : ℤ) ≤ P := ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
  refine clr_step (r := rU) (l' := .fz 1) rfl hbd hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rV) (l' := .fz 2) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rw) (l' := .fz 3) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rK) (l' := .fz 4) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rBs) (l' := .cp (.radX .fin) 0) rfl
    (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  exact MReach.refl _

/-- **The chain to the next iteration**: `s` is incremented and `U`, `V`, `w`, `K`, `Bs`, `c`,
`c1`, `s1` are cleared. -/
theorem nz_run (S : St) (M : ℤ → Bool) (hbd : S.Bd B) (hs : S.s + 1 ≤ B) :
    MReach (A K₀) orc x (G x B P) (cf (.nz 0) S M 0)
      (cf (.cp (.radX .fst) 0)
        { S with s := S.s + 1, U := 0, V := 0, w := 0, K := 0, Bs := 0, c := 0, c1 := 0,
                 s1 := 0 } M 0) := by
  have hp : (0 : ℤ) ≤ 0 ∧ (0 : ℤ) ≤ P := ⟨le_rfl, Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
  refine inc_step (r := rs) (l' := .nz 1) rfl hbd hp ?_; regs
  have hbd1 : St.Bd B { S with s := S.s + 1 } := by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd ⊢; omega
  refine clr_step (r := rU) (l' := .nz 2) rfl hbd1 hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rV) (l' := .nz 3) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rw) (l' := .nz 4) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rK) (l' := .nz 5) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rBs) (l' := .nz 6) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_
  regs
  refine clr_step (r := rc) (l' := .nz 7) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  refine clr_step (r := rc1) (l' := .nz 8) rfl (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_
  regs
  refine clr_step (r := rs1) (l' := .cp (.radX .fst) 0) rfl
    (by simp only [St.Bd] at hbd1 ⊢; omega) hp ?_; regs
  exact MReach.refl _

end ExpBFS

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-
