Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMRun

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Abstract register machines reaching live configurations

`Complexity.LogProg.arm_run` follows an abstract register machine until it halts. Here the
compiled program follows it to a *live* configuration instead: if the abstract machine goes
from `(l, v)` to `(l', v')` in `N` steps, with the preconditions and register widths of
`arm_run` along the way, the compiled program goes from the representation of `(l, v)` to
that of `(l', v')` (`Complexity.LogProg.arm_reach`), through configurations satisfying the run
invariant `Complexity.LogProg.Inv`. Composed with `Complexity.LogProg.compile_correct_from`,
this splices compiled runs at arbitrary step boundaries, as needed between the choices of a
nondeterministic machine (`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARMRun`).

This is infrastructure for the register-machine descriptions of space-bounded algorithms of
[AB09, §4.1], not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* none (run theorems for `Complexity.LogProg.ARM`).

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.astep_cases` — one abstract step either moves to a live label, keeping
  the answer slot, or halts with an answer, keeping the registers.
* `Complexity.LogProg.arm_step` — one live abstract step is simulated by the compiled program.
* `Complexity.LogProg.arm_reach` — `N` steps to a live configuration are simulated.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

variable {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- **The shape of one abstract step**: from a live configuration the machine either moves
to a live label with the answer slot unchanged, or halts with an answer and the registers
unchanged. -/
lemma astep_cases (A : ARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (l : Λ)
    (v : Fin m → ℕ) (res : Option Bool) :
    (∃ l' v', astep A oracle x (some l, v, res) = (some l', v', res)) ∨
      ∃ b, astep A oracle x (some l, v, res) = (none, v, some b) := by
  cases hA : A l with
  | ret b => exact Or.inr ⟨b, by simp [astep, hA]⟩
  | valP r l' => by_cases h : ValidPlain x <;> simp [astep, hA, h]
  | valQ r l' => by_cases h : ValidPair x <;> simp [astep, hA, h]
  | _ => simp [astep, hA]

/-- A live abstract step started with an empty answer slot keeps it empty. -/
lemma astep_live_res (A : ARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (l l' : Λ)
    (v v' : Fin m → ℕ) (res : Option Bool)
    (h : astep A oracle x (some l, v, none) = (some l', v', res)) : res = none := by
  rcases astep_cases (x := x) A oracle l v none with ⟨l'', v'', h'⟩ | ⟨b, h'⟩
  · rw [h'] at h; simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at h; exact h.2.2.symm
  · rw [h'] at h; simp at h

/-- A simulated run reaching `c'` gives a run to `c'` through configurations satisfying the
run invariant. -/
lemma inv_of_simTo (A : ARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B W : ℕ) {c c' : Cfg m Bool (Λ × Ph) x}
    (h : SimTo (armProg A l₀) oracle W c c') :
    ∃ T, rrun (armProg A l₀) oracle c T = c' ∧
      ∀ t < T, Inv A l₀ oracle D q0 B W (rrun (armProg A l₀) oracle c t) := by
  obtain ⟨T, e, hm⟩ := h
  exact ⟨T, e, fun t ht => inv_of_mid A l₀ oracle D q0 B W _ (hm t ht)⟩

/-- **One live abstract step is simulated.** If the abstract machine steps from `(l, v)` to the
live configuration `(l', v')`, with the preconditions `Pre` met and values of at most `W`
binary digits (counting one increment), then the compiled program goes from the
representation of `(l, v)` to that of `(l', v')`, through configurations satisfying `Inv`.

**Proof sketch.** Case analysis on the instruction at `l`, as in `arm_run`: each live step is
one of the simulation lemmas `sim_inc`, …, `sim_jeqFst` (whose intermediate configurations
satisfy `Inv` by `inv_of_mid`), or a single call step (`sim_call`), whose precondition
`CallOK` is `Pre` at a call; the halting instructions cannot step to a live configuration. -/
theorem arm_step (A : ARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B W : ℕ) (l l' : Λ) (v v' : Fin m → ℕ)
    (out : List Bool) (hs : astep A oracle x (some l, v, none) = (some l', v', none))
    (hp : Pre A oracle D q0 B x (some l, v, none))
    (hw : ∀ r, ((Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length : ℤ) ≤ W) :
    ∃ T, rrun (armProg A l₀) oracle (aseam x l v out) T = aseam x l' v' out ∧
      ∀ t < T, Inv A l₀ oracle D q0 B W (rrun (armProg A l₀) oracle (aseam x l v out) t) := by
  have hW0 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ W := by omega
  have hlen : ∀ r, ((Nat.bits (v r)).length : ℤ) ≤ W := by
    intro r
    have := hw r
    have hle : (Nat.bits (v r)).length ≤ (Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length :=
      length_bits_mono (by omega)
    omega
  have go := fun {c' : Cfg m Bool (Λ × Ph) x} (h : SimTo (armProg A l₀) oracle W
    (aseam x l v out) c') => inv_of_simTo A l₀ oracle D q0 B W h
  cases hA : A l with
  | inc r l'' =>
    simp only [astep, hA, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
    exact go (sim_inc A l₀ oracle l l'' r hA v out W (hw r))
  | dec r l'' =>
    simp only [astep, hA, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
    exact go (sim_dec A l₀ oracle l l'' r hA v out W (hlen r))
  | clr r l'' =>
    simp only [astep, hA, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
    exact go (sim_clr A l₀ oracle l l'' r hA v out W (hlen r))
  | half r l'' =>
    simp only [astep, hA, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
    exact go (sim_half A l₀ oracle l l'' r hA v out W (hlen r))
  | jz r l₁ l₀' =>
    simp only [astep, hA, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
    exact go (sim_jz A l₀ oracle l l₁ l₀' r hA v out W hW0)
  | jodd r l₁ l₀' =>
    simp only [astep, hA, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
    exact go (sim_jodd A l₀ oracle l l₁ l₀' r hA v out W hW0)
  | jeq r s' l₁ l₀' =>
    have hrs : r ≠ s' := by simpa [Pre, hA] using hp
    simp only [astep, hA, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
    exact go (sim_jeq A l₀ oracle l l₁ l₀' r s' hrs hA v out W (hlen r))
  | jeqIn r l₁ l₀' =>
    have hx : ValidPlain x := by simpa [Pre, hA] using hp
    simp only [astep, hA, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
    exact go (sim_jeqIn A l₀ oracle l l₁ l₀' r hA v out W (hlen r) hx)
  | jeqFst r l₁ l₀' =>
    have hx : ValidPair x := by simpa [Pre, hA] using hp
    simp only [astep, hA, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
    exact go (sim_jeqFst A l₀ oracle l l₁ l₀' r hA v out W (hlen r) hx)
  | jeqSnd r l₁ l₀' =>
    have hx : ValidPair x := by simpa [Pre, hA] using hp
    simp only [astep, hA, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
    exact go (sim_jeqSnd A l₀ oracle l l₁ l₀' r hA v out W (hlen r) hx)
  | ret b' => simp [astep, hA] at hs
  | valP r l'' =>
    by_cases hv : ValidPlain x
    · simp only [astep, hA, hv, if_true, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
      exact go ((sim_valP A l₀ oracle l l'' r hA v out W hW0).1 hv)
    · simp [astep, hA, hv] at hs
  | valQ r l'' =>
    by_cases hv : ValidPair x
    · simp only [astep, hA, hv, if_true, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
      exact go ((sim_valQ A l₀ oracle l l'' r hA v out W hW0).1 hv)
    · simp [astep, hA, hv] at hs
  | call j md args l₁ l₀' =>
    have hpc : args.Nodup ∧ CleanRun D (q0 j)
        (vword (callSegs ⟨j, md, args, l₁, l₀'⟩ x (fun r => Nat.bits (v r))))
        (oracle j (vword (callSegs ⟨j, md, args, l₁, l₀'⟩ x (fun r => Nat.bits (v r))))) B := by
      simpa [Pre, hA] using hp
    simp only [astep, hA, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := hs
    refine ⟨1, sim_call (x := x) A l₀ oracle l l₁ l₀' j md args hA v out, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
    rw [rrun_zero]
    refine ⟨fun r => by simp [aseam], fun l' cs hl hcs => ?_⟩
    simp only [aseam, Option.some.injEq] at hl
    subst hl
    rw [armProg_call, hA] at hcs
    simp only [insCall, Option.some.injEq] at hcs
    subst hcs
    have hwd : regWords (aseam x l v out) = fun r => Nat.bits (v r) := by
      funext r; simp [regWords, aseam, tapeWord_bufferTape]
    refine ⟨hpc.1, rfl, fun r _ => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hwd]; exact ⟨rfl, rfl, le_rfl, hlen r⟩
    · rw [hwd]; exact hpc.2

/-- **The reach theorem for abstract register machines.** If, from `(l, v)`, the abstract
machine is at the live configuration `(l', v')` after `N` steps, every configuration before
having the preconditions `Pre` and values of at most `W` binary digits (counting one
increment), then the compiled program goes from the representation of `(l, v)` having
written `out` to that of `(l', v')` having written `out`, through configurations satisfying
the run invariant `Inv`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `N`. A live configuration is reached only through live
configurations (halting is absorbing, `arun_halted`), with the answer slot empty
(`astep_live_res`); the first step is `arm_step`, and the runs are concatenated
(`rrun_add`). -/
theorem arm_reach (A : ARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B W : ℕ) (l' : Λ) (v' : Fin m → ℕ)
    (out : List Bool) :
    ∀ (N : ℕ) (l : Λ) (v : Fin m → ℕ),
      arun A oracle x (some l, v, none) N = (some l', v', none) →
      (∀ t < N, Pre A oracle D q0 B x (arun A oracle x (some l, v, none) t) ∧
        ∀ r, ((Nat.bits ((arun A oracle x (some l, v, none) t).2.1 r + 1)).length : ℤ) ≤ W) →
      ∃ T, rrun (armProg A l₀) oracle (aseam x l v out) T = aseam x l' v' out ∧
        ∀ t < T, Inv A l₀ oracle D q0 B W (rrun (armProg A l₀) oracle (aseam x l v out) t) := by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro l v h _
    simp only [arun, Function.iterate_zero, id, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, -⟩ := h
    exact ⟨0, rfl, fun t ht => by omega⟩
  | succ N ih =>
    intro l v h hpre
    obtain ⟨hp0, hw0⟩ := hpre 0 (by omega)
    simp only [arun, Function.iterate_zero, id] at hp0 hw0
    rw [arun_succ] at h
    rcases astep_cases (x := x) A oracle l v none with ⟨l₁, v₁, hs⟩ | ⟨b, hs⟩
    · obtain ⟨T₁, e1, m1⟩ := arm_step A l₀ oracle D q0 B W l l₁ v v₁ out hs hp0 hw0
      rw [hs] at h
      obtain ⟨T₂, e2, m2⟩ := ih l₁ v₁ h (fun t ht => by
        have := hpre (t + 1) (by omega); rwa [arun_succ, hs] at this)
      refine ⟨T₁ + T₂, by rw [rrun_add, e1, e2], fun t ht => ?_⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T₁ with h' | h'
      · exact m1 t h'
      · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = T₁ + t' := ⟨t - T₁, by omega⟩
        rw [rrun_add, e1]; exact m2 t' (by omega)
    · rw [hs, arun_halted] at h
      simp at h

end Complexity.LogProg
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Machines/ARMWidth.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMProof
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.SpaceClasses

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Abstract register machines with wide registers

`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides` turns a correct abstract register machine whose registers
hold `O(log |x|)` binary digits, calling logspace deciders, into a logspace decider. The run
and space theorem behind it (`Complexity.LogProg.arm_space`) allows any register width `W`;
only the wrapper fixes `W = O(log n)`. This file gives the wrappers for wider registers: a
general one (`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_space`, into `SPACE S`), and the polynomial-width
and `S`-width forms consumed by polynomial-space and Savitch-type arguments.

This is infrastructure — the register-machine description of space-bounded algorithms of
[AB09, §4.1] extended to `S(n) ≥ log n` registers — not itself a result of the book.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_space` — the general wrapper: registers of `W(|x|)` binary
  digits, deciders using space `s_j`, both `O(S(|x|))` on the relevant lengths, give `SPACE S`.
* `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_SPACE` — registers of `O(S(|x|))` binary digits with
  logspace deciders, for `S ≥ logSpace`, give `SPACE S`.
* `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace` — registers of polynomially many binary digits with
  `PSPACE` deciders give `PSPACE`; `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace_of_logspace` and
  `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace_val` are its logspace-decider and value-bound forms.
* `Complexity.LOGSPACE_subset_PSPACE` — `L ⊆ PSPACE`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1, Definitions 4.1 and 4.5.)
-/

namespace Complexity

/-- The logarithmic bound is at most linear: `logSpace n ≤ n + 1`. -/
lemma logSpace_le_succ (n : ℕ) : logSpace n ≤ n + 1 := by
  have := Nat.log_le_self 2 n
  simp only [logSpace]; omega

/-- **`L ⊆ PSPACE`** [AB09, §4.1.2, the chain `L ⊆ … ⊆ PSPACE` of p. 92 (its first and
last members)]: a logspace decider uses at most `c · (n + 1)` cells.

**Proof sketch.** `logSpace n ≤ n + 1 = n ^ 1 + 1`, so `SPACE (logSpace) ⊆ SPACE (n ^ 1 + 1)`
(`Complexity.SPACE.mono`), which lies in `PSPACE` at degree one. -/
theorem LOGSPACE_subset_PSPACE : LOGSPACE ⊆ PSPACE :=
  (SPACE.mono fun n => by simpa using logSpace_le_succ n).trans (space_poly_subset_PSPACE 1)

/-- `SPACE ((n + 1)^k) ⊆ PSPACE`: the shifted polynomial bound gives polynomial space.

**Proof sketch.** `(n + 1)^k ≤ 2^k (n^k + 1)` (`Complexity.succ_pow_le`), so
`Complexity.SPACE.mono_const` and `Complexity.space_poly_subset_PSPACE` at degree `k`. -/
theorem SPACE_succ_pow_subset_PSPACE (k : ℕ) : SPACE (fun n => (n + 1) ^ k) ⊆ PSPACE :=
  (SPACE.mono_const (a := 2 ^ k) fun n => succ_pow_le n k).trans
    (space_poly_subset_PSPACE k)

/-- A number at most `A · 2^s` (with `s ≥ 1`) has `logSpace` at most `(A + 1) s`. -/
lemma logSpace_le_of_le_mul_two_pow {v A s : ℕ} (h : v ≤ A * 2 ^ s) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    logSpace v ≤ (A + 1) * s := by
  have hA : A < 2 ^ A := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have hlt : v < 2 ^ (A + s) := by
    rw [pow_add]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hA (Nat.two_pow_pos s))
  have hle : A + s ≤ (A + 1) * s := by
    have := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right A (show 0 < s by omega)
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]; omega
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos v with rfl | hv
  · simp only [logSpace, Nat.log_zero_right]; omega
  · have := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow (by omega) hlt
    simp only [logSpace]; omega

end Complexity

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

variable {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type}

/-- **Abstract register machines with registers of `W(|x|)` binary digits decide languages in
`SPACE S`** (general width): if, on every input `x`, the abstract machine `A`, calling
deciders for the languages `As j` that run in space `s j`, answers `x ∈ L` through
configurations meeting the syntactic preconditions with every register value of at most
`W |x|` binary digits (counting one increment), and both the register width and the
deciders' space on every virtual input a call can form (of length at most
`2|x| + 2 + m (2 W |x| + 2)`, `Complexity.LogProg.length_callSegs_le`) are at most
`C · S |x|`, with `S ≥ 1`, then `L ∈ SPACE S`. Infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1]; at
`S = W = O(logSpace)` it is `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides`.

**Proof sketch.** As for `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides`: collect the deciders in a clean
bank (`Complexity.LogProg.bank_cleanRun`); the virtual inputs are short
(`Complexity.LogProg.length_callSegs_le`), so the deciders' head ranges are at most
`B = C · S |x| + 1`; `Complexity.LogProg.arm_space` then gives a machine answering `x ∈ L`
within `m (W + 2) + k_D (2B + 1) ≤ (m C + 2m + k_D (2C + 3)) · S |x|` cells. -/
theorem arm_decides_space {L : Language Bool} [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] (A : ARM m d Λ)
    (l₀ : Λ) (As : Fin d → Language Bool) (s : Fin d → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hAs : ∀ j, ∃ M : FinTM Bool, M.DecidesInSpace (As j) (s j))
    (S W : ℕ → ℕ) (C : ℕ) (hS : ∀ n, 1 ≤ S n) (hW : ∀ n, W n ≤ C * S n)
    (hs : ∀ j n v, v ≤ 2 * n + 2 + m * (2 * W n + 2) → s j v ≤ C * S n)
    (hcorr : ∀ x, AHalt A (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) x
      (fun a => PreS A x a ∧ ∀ r, (Nat.bits (a.2.1 r + 1)).length ≤ W x.length)
      (some l₀, fun _ => 0, none) (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x)) :
    L ∈ SPACE S := by
  classical
  let Ms : Fin d → FinTM Bool := fun j => Classical.choose (hAs j)
  have hMs : ∀ j, (Ms j).DecidesInSpace (As j) (s j) := fun j => Classical.choose_spec (hAs j)
  set kD := bankK Ms + bankK Ms with hkD
  set oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool :=
    fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V with horacle
  refine ⟨m * C + 2 * m + kD * (2 * C + 3),
    compileFinTM (armProg A l₀) (l₀, .start) (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms), fun x => ?_⟩
  set n := x.length with hn
  have hS1 := hS n
  set B := C * S n + 1 with hB
  obtain ⟨N, h1, h2, hm⟩ := hcorr x
  -- the preconditions of `arm_space`: syntactic ones, clean decider runs within `B`
  have hpre : ∀ t < N, Pre A oracle (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms) B x
      (arun A oracle x (some l₀, fun _ => 0, none) t) ∧
      ∀ r, ((Nat.bits ((arun A oracle x (some l₀, fun _ => 0, none) t).2.1 r + 1)).length : ℤ)
        ≤ ((W n : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨hps, hbd⟩ := hm t ht
    refine ⟨?_, fun r => by exact_mod_cast hbd r⟩
    generalize hat : arun A oracle x (some l₀, fun _ => 0, none) t = a at hps hbd
    rcases a with ⟨_ | l, v, res⟩
    · trivial
    · simp only [Pre]
      cases hA : A l with
      | jeq r s' l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | jeqIn r l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | jeqFst r l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | jeqSnd r l₁ l₀' => simpa [PreS, hA] using hps
      | inc => trivial
      | dec => trivial
      | clr => trivial
      | half => trivial
      | jz => trivial
      | jodd => trivial
      | ret => trivial
      | valP => trivial
      | valQ => trivial
      | call j md args l₁ l₀' =>
      simp only [PreS, hA] at hps
      refine ⟨hps, ?_⟩
      refine cleanRun_mono (bank_cleanRun Ms As s hMs j _) ?_
      have hVl := length_callSegs_le (x := x) ⟨j, md, args, l₁, l₀'⟩ (W n)
        (fun r => Nat.bits (v r))
        (fun r => by
          show (Nat.bits (v r)).length ≤ W n
          have h0 : (Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length ≤ W n := hbd r
          have hle : (Nat.bits (v r)).length ≤ (Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length :=
            length_bits_mono (by omega)
          omega) hps
      have := hs j n _ hVl
      simp only [hB]
      exact max_le (by omega) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hsp⟩ := arm_space A l₀ oracle (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms) B (W n) N
    (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x) h1 h2 hpre
  refine ⟨T, hT, hsp.trans ?_⟩
  -- the arithmetic: `m (W + 2) + k_D (2B + 1) ≤ (m C + 2m + k_D (2C + 3)) S`
  show _ ≤ (m * C + 2 * m + kD * (2 * C + 3)) * S n
  have f0 : m * W n ≤ m * (C * S n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m (hW n)
  have e1 : m * (W n + 2) = m * W n + 2 * m := by ring
  have e2 : kD * (2 * B + 1) = 2 * kD * C * S n + 3 * kD := by simp only [hB]; ring
  have e3 : (m * C + 2 * m + kD * (2 * C + 3)) * S n =
      m * (C * S n) + 2 * m * S n + 2 * kD * C * S n + 3 * kD * S n := by ring
  rw [e1, e2, e3]
  have f1 : 2 * m ≤ 2 * m * S n := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
  have f2 : 3 * kD ≤ 3 * kD * S n := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
  omega

/-- **Abstract register machines with `O(S)`-digit registers and logspace subroutines decide
languages in `SPACE S`**: for `S ≥ logSpace`, if on every input `x` the abstract machine `A`,
calling deciders for languages in `L`, answers `x ∈ L` through configurations meeting the
syntactic preconditions with every register value of at most `K · S |x|` binary digits
(counting one increment), then `L ∈ SPACE S`. Infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1]
(`S(n) ≥ log n`, the book's standing convention, p. 79); no monotonicity or constructibility
of `S` is needed.

**Proof sketch.** `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_space` with `W = K · S`. A virtual input
has length `v ≤ 2|x| + 2 + m (2 K S + 2) ≤ A · 2^S` (as `|x| < 2^{logSpace |x|} ≤ 2^S` and
`S < 2^S`), so a logspace decider uses `c · logSpace v ≤ c (A + 1) · S` cells
(`Complexity.logSpace_le_of_le_mul_two_pow`). -/
theorem arm_decides_SPACE {L : Language Bool} [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] (A : ARM m d Λ)
    (l₀ : Λ) (As : Fin d → Language Bool) (hAs : ∀ j, As j ∈ LOGSPACE) (S : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hS : ∀ n, logSpace n ≤ S n) (K : ℕ)
    (hcorr : ∀ x, AHalt A (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) x
      (fun a => PreS A x a ∧ ∀ r, (Nat.bits (a.2.1 r + 1)).length ≤ K * S x.length)
      (some l₀, fun _ => 0, none) (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x)) :
    L ∈ SPACE S := by
  classical
  have hc : ∀ j, ∃ (c : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool), M.DecidesInSpace (As j) fun n => c * logSpace n :=
    fun j => hAs j
  let c : Fin d → ℕ := fun j => Classical.choose (hc j)
  have hc' : ∀ j, ∃ M : FinTM Bool, M.DecidesInSpace (As j) fun n => c j * logSpace n :=
    fun j => Classical.choose_spec (hc j)
  set cs := ∑ j, c j with hcs
  have hcj : ∀ j, c j ≤ cs := fun j =>
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := c) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  set A₀ := 2 + 2 * m + 2 * m * K with hA₀
  have hS1 : ∀ n, 1 ≤ S n := fun n => le_trans (by simp [logSpace]) (hS n)
  refine arm_decides_space A l₀ As (fun j n => c j * logSpace n) hc' S (fun n => K * S n)
    (K + cs * (A₀ + 1)) hS1 (fun n => Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
    (fun j n v hv => ?_) hcorr
  -- a virtual input has length at most `A₀ · 2^S`
  set P := 2 ^ S n with hP
  have hnP : n + 1 ≤ P :=
    (succ_le_two_pow_log n).trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (hS n))
  have hSP : S n ≤ P := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le
  have hvP : v ≤ A₀ * P := by
    have g1 : m * K * S n ≤ m * K * P := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hSP
    have g2 : m ≤ m * P := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
    have e1 : m * (2 * (K * S n) + 2) = 2 * (m * K * S n) + 2 * m := by ring
    have e2 : A₀ * P = 2 * P + 2 * (m * P) + 2 * (m * K * P) := by simp only [hA₀]; ring
    rw [e1] at hv; rw [e2]; omega
  have hlog := logSpace_le_of_le_mul_two_pow hvP (hS1 n)
  calc c j * logSpace v ≤ cs * ((A₀ + 1) * S n) := Nat.mul_le_mul (hcj j) hlog
    _ = cs * (A₀ + 1) * S n := by ring
    _ ≤ (K + cs * (A₀ + 1)) * S n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

/-- **Abstract register machines with polynomially wide registers decide languages in
`PSPACE`**: if, on every input `x`, the abstract machine `A`, calling deciders for languages
in `PSPACE`, answers `x ∈ L` through configurations meeting the syntactic preconditions with
every register value of at most `C₀ (|x| + 1)^{c₀}` binary digits (counting one increment),
then `L ∈ PSPACE`. Infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1, Definition 4.5].

**Proof sketch.** Each decider `j` runs in space `c_j (n^{e_j} + 1)`. A virtual input has
length `v ≤ A (|x| + 1)^{c₀ + 1}`, so decider `j` uses at most
`c_j (A^{e_j} + 1) (|x| + 1)^{(c₀ + 1) e_j}` cells. With `E = (c₀ + 1)(Σ e_j + 1)`,
`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_space` at `S = (n + 1)^E` gives `L ∈ SPACE ((n + 1)^E)`,
inside `PSPACE` (`Complexity.SPACE_succ_pow_subset_PSPACE`). -/
theorem arm_decides_pspace {L : Language Bool} [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] (A : ARM m d Λ)
    (l₀ : Λ) (As : Fin d → Language Bool) (hAs : ∀ j, As j ∈ PSPACE) (C₀ c₀ : ℕ)
    (hcorr : ∀ x, AHalt A (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) x
      (fun a => PreS A x a ∧
        ∀ r, (Nat.bits (a.2.1 r + 1)).length ≤ C₀ * (x.length + 1) ^ c₀)
      (some l₀, fun _ => 0, none) (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x)) :
    L ∈ PSPACE := by
  classical
  have hc : ∀ j, ∃ (e c : ℕ) (M : FinTM Bool),
      M.DecidesInSpace (As j) fun n => c * (n ^ e + 1) := fun j => by
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hAs j)
    exact ⟨e, he⟩
  let e : Fin d → ℕ := fun j => Classical.choose (hc j)
  let c : Fin d → ℕ := fun j => Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (hc j))
  have hc' : ∀ j, ∃ M : FinTM Bool, M.DecidesInSpace (As j) fun n => c j * (n ^ e j + 1) :=
    fun j => Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (hc j))
  set A₀ := 2 + 2 * m + 2 * m * C₀ with hA₀
  set es := ∑ j, e j with hes
  set E := (c₀ + 1) * (es + 1) with hE
  set C := C₀ + ∑ j, c j * (A₀ ^ e j + 1) with hC
  have hej : ∀ j, e j ≤ es := fun j =>
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := e) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hcj : ∀ j, c j * (A₀ ^ e j + 1) ≤ C := fun j =>
    (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => c j * (A₀ ^ e j + 1)) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
      (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  have hc₀E : c₀ + 1 ≤ E := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
  have hpowE : ∀ n k, k ≤ E → (n + 1) ^ k ≤ (n + 1) ^ E := fun n k hk =>
    Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hk
  refine SPACE_succ_pow_subset_PSPACE E (arm_decides_space A l₀ As
    (fun j n => c j * (n ^ e j + 1)) hc' (fun n => (n + 1) ^ E) (fun n => C₀ * (n + 1) ^ c₀) C
    (fun n => Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega))
    (fun n => Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (hpowE n c₀ (by omega)))
    (fun j n v hv => ?_) hcorr)
  -- a virtual input has length at most `A₀ (n + 1)^{c₀ + 1}`
  set P := (n + 1) ^ (c₀ + 1) with hP
  have hP1 : n + 1 ≤ P := by
    simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (show 0 < n + 1 by omega) (show 1 ≤ c₀ + 1 by omega)
  have hPc : (n + 1) ^ c₀ ≤ P := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  have hvP : v ≤ A₀ * P := by
    have g1 : m * C₀ * (n + 1) ^ c₀ ≤ m * C₀ * P := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hPc
    have g2 : m ≤ m * P := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
    have e1 : m * (2 * (C₀ * (n + 1) ^ c₀) + 2) = 2 * (m * C₀ * (n + 1) ^ c₀) + 2 * m := by
      ring
    have e2 : A₀ * P = 2 * P + 2 * (m * P) + 2 * (m * C₀ * P) := by simp only [hA₀]; ring
    rw [e1] at hv; rw [e2]; omega
  -- decider `j` uses at most `c_j (A₀^{e_j} + 1) (n + 1)^E` cells
  have hpow : v ^ e j + 1 ≤ (A₀ ^ e j + 1) * (n + 1) ^ E := by
    have h1 : v ^ e j ≤ A₀ ^ e j * (n + 1) ^ E := by
      calc v ^ e j ≤ (A₀ * P) ^ e j := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hvP _
        _ = A₀ ^ e j * (n + 1) ^ ((c₀ + 1) * e j) := by rw [mul_pow, hP, ← pow_mul]
        _ ≤ A₀ ^ e j * (n + 1) ^ E := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (hpowE n _
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ((hej j).trans (Nat.le_succ _))))
    have h2 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ E := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]; omega
  calc c j * (v ^ e j + 1) ≤ c j * ((A₀ ^ e j + 1) * (n + 1) ^ E) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hpow
    _ = c j * (A₀ ^ e j + 1) * (n + 1) ^ E := by ring
    _ ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ E := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hcj j)

/-- **Polynomially wide registers with logspace subroutines give `PSPACE`**: the form of
`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace` with deciders in `L`. Infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1].

**Proof sketch.** `L ⊆ PSPACE` (`Complexity.LOGSPACE_subset_PSPACE`). -/
theorem arm_decides_pspace_of_logspace {L : Language Bool} [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ]
    (A : ARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (As : Fin d → Language Bool) (hAs : ∀ j, As j ∈ LOGSPACE)
    (C₀ c₀ : ℕ)
    (hcorr : ∀ x, AHalt A (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) x
      (fun a => PreS A x a ∧
        ∀ r, (Nat.bits (a.2.1 r + 1)).length ≤ C₀ * (x.length + 1) ^ c₀)
      (some l₀, fun _ => 0, none) (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x)) :
    L ∈ PSPACE :=
  arm_decides_pspace A l₀ As (fun j => LOGSPACE_subset_PSPACE (hAs j)) C₀ c₀ hcorr

/-- **Exponentially large register values give `PSPACE`**: the form of
`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace` with register values at most
`2^{C₀ (|x| + 1)^{c₀}}`. Infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1].

**Proof sketch.** A value `v ≤ 2^N` has `v + 1 < 2^{N + 2}`, so `|bits (v + 1)| ≤ N + 2
≤ (C₀ + 2)(|x| + 1)^{c₀}` (`Complexity.LogProg.length_bits_le`). -/
theorem arm_decides_pspace_val {L : Language Bool} [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ]
    (A : ARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (As : Fin d → Language Bool) (hAs : ∀ j, As j ∈ PSPACE)
    (C₀ c₀ : ℕ)
    (hcorr : ∀ x, AHalt A (fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (As j : Set (List Bool)) V) x
      (fun a => PreS A x a ∧ ∀ r, a.2.1 r ≤ 2 ^ (C₀ * (x.length + 1) ^ c₀))
      (some l₀, fun _ => 0, none) (MultiTapeTM.indicator (L : Set (List Bool)) x)) :
    L ∈ PSPACE := by
  refine arm_decides_pspace A l₀ As hAs (C₀ + 2) c₀ fun x =>
    (hcorr x).mono fun a ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, fun r => ?_⟩
  set N := C₀ * (x.length + 1) ^ c₀ with hN
  have hlt : a.2.1 r + 1 < 2 ^ (N + 2) := by
    have := h2 r
    have e : 2 ^ (N + 2) = 4 * 2 ^ N := by rw [pow_add]; ring
    have := Nat.two_pow_pos N
    omega
  have h3 := length_bits_le hlt
  have h4 : 2 ≤ 2 * (x.length + 1) ^ c₀ :=
    Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega))
  have e : (C₀ + 2) * (x.length + 1) ^ c₀ = N + 2 * (x.length + 1) ^ c₀ := by
    simp only [hN]; ring
  omega

end Complexity.LogProg
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/Machines/ARMWidthExample.lean =====

```
/-
Copyright (c) 2026 TCSlib contributors. All rights reserved.
Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMWidth
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.InputAccess

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Exhaustive search with a polynomially wide register

A non-vacuity check for `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace_val`, on an algorithm that
genuinely needs registers of more than logarithmically many binary digits: for a language
`P ∈ PSPACE`, the language `Complexity.LogProg.WidthExample.searchLang P` of inputs `x` having
a witness `u < 2^|x|` with `⟨x, bits u⟩ ∈ P` is in `PSPACE`. The abstract register machine
`Complexity.LogProg.WidthExample.searchA` measures `n = |x|` (asking the logspace decider of
`Complexity.inputLenLang`), computes `2^n` by `n` doublings, and then runs a counter `u`
through `0, 1, …, 2^n - 1`, asking the decider of `P` on `⟨x, bits u⟩`. The counter and the
bound `2^n` have `n + 1` binary digits — far beyond the `O(log n)` of
`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides`.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.WidthExample.searchLang` — exhaustive search over `|x|`-bit witnesses.
* `Complexity.LogProg.WidthExample.searchA` — the search machine.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.WidthExample.searchLang_mem_PSPACE` — `searchLang P ∈ PSPACE` for
  `P ∈ PSPACE`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1; compare the exhaustive-search argument of
  Example 4.6, `NP ⊆ PSPACE`.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

namespace WidthExample

open Turing

/-- **Exhaustive search over `|x|`-bit witnesses**: the inputs `x` with some `u < 2^|x|` such
that `⟨x, bits u⟩ ∈ P`. -/
def searchLang (P : Language Bool) : Language Bool :=
  {x | ∃ u < 2 ^ x.length, pairEncode x (Nat.bits u) ∈ P}

/-- The labels of the search machine. -/
inductive Lb where
  | init | scan | incI | dbl | decI | d1 | d1a | d1b | d1c | d2 | d2a | d2b
  | enum | chk | nxt | acc | rej
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- **The search machine**, on registers `i = 0`, `p = 1`, `t = 2`, `u = 3`: set `p = 1`;
count `i = |x|` (asking `i < |x|` of decider `0`); while `i ≠ 0`, decrement `i` and double `p`
(move `p` into `t` twice over, then back); finally, for `u = 0, 1, …` until `u = p = 2^|x|`,
accept if decider `1` accepts `⟨x, bits u⟩`; reject at the end. -/
def searchA : ARM 4 2 Lb
  | .init => .inc 1 .scan
  | .scan => .call 0 .whole [0] .incI .dbl
  | .incI => .inc 0 .scan
  | .dbl => .jz 0 .enum .decI
  | .decI => .dec 0 .d1
  | .d1 => .jz 1 .d2 .d1a
  | .d1a => .dec 1 .d1b
  | .d1b => .inc 2 .d1c
  | .d1c => .inc 2 .d1
  | .d2 => .jz 2 .dbl .d2a
  | .d2a => .dec 2 .d2b
  | .d2b => .inc 1 .d2
  | .enum => .jeq 3 1 .rej .chk
  | .chk => .call 1 .whole [3] .acc .nxt
  | .nxt => .inc 3 .enum
  | .acc => .ret true
  | .rej => .ret false

/-- The deciders: `0` is `Complexity.inputLenLang` (`i < |x|`), `1` is `P`. -/
def decs (P : Language Bool) : Fin 2 → Language Bool := ![inputLenLang, P]

/-- The oracle: membership in the deciders' languages. -/
noncomputable def orc (P : Language Bool) : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool :=
  fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (decs P j : Set (List Bool)) V

/-- The register file `(i, p, t, u)`. -/
def rf (i p t u : ℕ) : Fin 4 → ℕ := ![i, p, t, u]

/-- Updating register `0` (`i`) of the register file. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_upd0 (i p t u a : ℕ) : Function.update (rf i p t u) 0 a = rf a p t u := by
  funext k
  match k with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ | ⟨1, _⟩ | ⟨2, _⟩ | ⟨3, _⟩ => rfl
  | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega
/-- Updating register `1` (`p`) of the register file. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_upd1 (i p t u a : ℕ) : Function.update (rf i p t u) 1 a = rf i a t u := by
  funext k
  match k with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ | ⟨1, _⟩ | ⟨2, _⟩ | ⟨3, _⟩ => rfl
  | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega
/-- Updating register `2` (`t`) of the register file. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_upd2 (i p t u a : ℕ) : Function.update (rf i p t u) 2 a = rf i p a u := by
  funext k
  match k with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ | ⟨1, _⟩ | ⟨2, _⟩ | ⟨3, _⟩ => rfl
  | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega
/-- Updating register `3` (`u`) of the register file. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_upd3 (i p t u a : ℕ) : Function.update (rf i p t u) 3 a = rf i p t a := by
  funext k
  match k with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ | ⟨1, _⟩ | ⟨2, _⟩ | ⟨3, _⟩ => rfl
  | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega
/-- Register `0` of the register file is `i`. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_0 (i p t u : ℕ) : rf i p t u 0 = i := rfl
/-- Register `1` of the register file is `p`. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_1 (i p t u : ℕ) : rf i p t u 1 = p := rfl
/-- Register `2` of the register file is `t`. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_2 (i p t u : ℕ) : rf i p t u 2 = t := rfl
/-- Register `3` of the register file is `u`. -/
@[simp] lemma rf_3 (i p t u : ℕ) : rf i p t u 3 = u := rfl

/-- The guard of the runs: the syntactic preconditions, and every register at most `B`. -/
def G (x : List Bool) (B : ℕ) : AConf 4 Lb → Prop :=
  fun a => PreS searchA x a ∧ ∀ s, a.2.1 s ≤ B

/-- Every configuration of the search machine with registers at most `B` meets the guard. -/
lemma guard_rf (x : List Bool) (B : ℕ) (l : Lb) {i p t u : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ B) (hp : p ≤ B) (ht : t ≤ B)
    (hu : u ≤ B) : G x B (some l, rf i p t u, none) := by
  refine ⟨by cases l <;> simp [PreS, searchA], fun s => ?_⟩
  match s with
  | ⟨0, _⟩ => exact hi
  | ⟨1, _⟩ => exact hp
  | ⟨2, _⟩ => exact ht
  | ⟨3, _⟩ => exact hu
  | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega

variable (P : Language Bool) (x : List Bool) (B : ℕ)

/-- **The first half of a doubling**: from `d1` with `p = a`, `t = b`, the machine moves `p`
into `t` twice over, reaching `d2` with `p = 0`, `t = b + 2a`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `a`: each round decrements `p` and increments `t` twice. -/
lemma d1_loop (i u : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ B) (hu : u ≤ B) : ∀ a b, b + 2 * a ≤ B →
    AReach searchA (orc P) x (G x B) (some .d1, rf i a b u, none)
      (some .d2, rf i 0 (b + 2 * a) u, none) := by
  intro a
  induction a with
  | zero =>
    intro b hb
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simpa [astep, searchA] using AReach.refl _
  | succ a ih =>
    intro b hb
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep, searchA, rf_1, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep, searchA, rf_1, rf_upd1, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep, searchA, rf_2, rf_upd2]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep, searchA, rf_2, rf_upd2]
    have e : b + 2 * (a + 1) = b + 1 + 1 + 2 * a := by ring
    rw [e]
    exact ih (b + 1 + 1) (by omega)

/-- **The second half of a doubling**: from `d2` with `p`, `t = b`, the machine moves `t`
back into `p`, reaching `dbl` with `p + b` and `t = 0`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `b`: each round decrements `t` and increments `p`. -/
lemma d2_loop (i u : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ B) (hu : u ≤ B) : ∀ b p, p + b ≤ B →
    AReach searchA (orc P) x (G x B) (some .d2, rf i p b u, none)
      (some .dbl, rf i (p + b) 0 u, none) := by
  intro b
  induction b with
  | zero =>
    intro p hb
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simpa [astep, searchA] using AReach.refl _
  | succ b ih =>
    intro p hb
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep, searchA, rf_2, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep, searchA, rf_2, rf_upd2, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ hi (by omega) (by omega) hu) ?_
    simp only [astep, searchA, rf_1, rf_upd1]
    have e : p + (b + 1) = p + 1 + b := by ring
    rw [e]
    exact ih (p + 1) (by omega)

/-- **The doubling loop**: from `dbl` with `i = k`, `p = 2^a` and `a + k = n`, `2^n ≤ B`, the
machine reaches `enum` with `i = 0`, `p = 2^n`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `k`: each round decrements `i` and doubles `p` (`d1_loop`,
`d2_loop`), all registers staying at most `2^n`. -/
lemma dbl_loop (n : ℕ) (hB : 2 ^ n ≤ B) : ∀ k a, a + k = n →
    AReach searchA (orc P) x (G x B) (some .dbl, rf k (2 ^ a) 0 0, none)
      (some .enum, rf 0 (2 ^ n) 0 0, none) := by
  have hn : n ≤ B := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le.trans hB
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro a ha
    obtain rfl : a = n := by omega
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simpa [astep, searchA] using AReach.refl _
  | succ k ih =>
    intro a ha
    have h2 : 2 ^ (a + 1) ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    have e2 : 2 ^ (a + 1) = 2 * 2 ^ a := by ring
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep, searchA, rf_0, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
    refine AReach.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep, searchA, rf_0, rf_upd0, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    refine (d1_loop P x B k 0 (by omega) (by omega) (2 ^ a) 0 (by omega)).trans ?_
    refine (d2_loop P x B k 0 (by omega) (by omega) (0 + 2 * 2 ^ a) 0 (by omega)).trans ?_
    have e : 0 + (0 + 2 * 2 ^ a) = 2 ^ (a + 1) := by omega
    rw [e]
    exact ih (a + 1) (by omega)

/-- **The search loop**: from `enum` with `p = 2^n` and counter `u ≤ 2^n`, `2^n ≤ B`, the
machine answers whether some `w` with `u ≤ w < 2^n` has `⟨x, bits w⟩ ∈ P`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on `2^n - u`. At `u = 2^n` the machine rejects, and no such `w`
exists. Below, it accepts if `⟨x, bits u⟩ ∈ P`, and otherwise moves to `u + 1`. -/
lemma enum_loop (n : ℕ) (hB : 2 ^ n ≤ B) : ∀ k u, u + k = 2 ^ n → ∀ b : Bool,
    (b = true ↔ ∃ w, u ≤ w ∧ w < 2 ^ n ∧ pairEncode x (Nat.bits w) ∈ P) →
    AHalt searchA (orc P) x (G x B) (some .enum, rf 0 (2 ^ n) 0 u, none) b := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro u hu b hb
    obtain rfl : u = 2 ^ n := by omega
    refine AHalt.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) hB) ?_
    simp only [astep, searchA, rf_1, rf_3, ↓reduceIte]
    obtain rfl : b = false := by
      cases b
      · rfl
      · obtain ⟨w, h1, h2, -⟩ := hb.mp rfl; omega
    exact AHalt.ret rfl (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) hB)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro u hu b hb
    have hu' : u < 2 ^ n := by omega
    refine AHalt.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    simp only [astep, searchA, rf_1, rf_3, hu'.ne, ↓reduceIte]
    refine AHalt.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
    have ho : orc P 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits u)) = true ↔ pairEncode x (Nat.bits u) ∈ P := by
      simp [orc, decs, indicator_eq_decide]
    simp only [astep, searchA, vword_whole₁, rf_3]
    by_cases hq : pairEncode x (Nat.bits u) ∈ P
    · rw [if_pos (ho.mpr hq)]
      obtain rfl : b = true := hb.mpr ⟨u, le_rfl, hu', hq⟩
      exact AHalt.ret rfl (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) (by omega))
    · have hf : orc P 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits u)) = false := by
        simpa using mt ho.mp hq
      rw [hf]
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      refine AHalt.step (guard_rf x B _ (by omega) hB (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
      simp only [astep, searchA, rf_3, rf_upd3]
      refine ih (u + 1) (by omega) b (hb.trans ⟨fun ⟨w, h1, h2, h3⟩ => ⟨w, ?_, h2, h3⟩,
        fun ⟨w, h1, h2, h3⟩ => ⟨w, by omega, h2, h3⟩⟩)
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u w with h | h
      · omega
      · obtain rfl : w = u := by omega
        exact absurd h3 hq

/-- **Exhaustive search over `|x|`-bit witnesses preserves `PSPACE`**: if `P ∈ PSPACE` then
the language of inputs `x` with some `u < 2^|x|` such that `⟨x, bits u⟩ ∈ P` is in
`PSPACE`. [AB09, §4.1; the exhaustive-search argument of Example 4.6] — here an example of
`Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace_val`, whose registers hold values up to `2^|x|`.

**Proof sketch.** `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace_val` with the deciders of
`Complexity.inputLenLang` (in `L ⊆ PSPACE`) and `P`, and value bound `2^{|x| + 1}`. The
machine sets `p = 1`, counts `i = |x|` (`Complexity.LogProg.inputLength_loop`), doubles `p`
`|x|` times (`dbl_loop`), and searches `u = 0, …, 2^|x| - 1` (`enum_loop`); every register
stays at most `2^|x|`. -/
theorem searchLang_mem_PSPACE (hP : P ∈ PSPACE) : searchLang P ∈ PSPACE := by
  refine arm_decides_pspace_val searchA .init (decs P) (fun j => ?_) 1 1 fun x => ?_
  · match j with
    | 0 => exact LOGSPACE_subset_PSPACE inputLenLang_mem
    | 1 => exact hP
  set n := x.length with hn
  set B := 2 ^ (1 * (x.length + 1) ^ 1) with hB'
  have hB : 2 ^ n ≤ B := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by rw [pow_one, one_mul]; omega)
  have hnB : n ≤ B := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le.trans hB
  have h1B : 1 ≤ B := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  -- `init`: set `p = 1`
  have e0 : (fun _ : Fin 4 => 0) = rf 0 0 0 0 := by
    funext k
    match k with
    | ⟨0, _⟩ | ⟨1, _⟩ | ⟨2, _⟩ | ⟨3, _⟩ => rfl
    | ⟨_ + 4, h⟩ => omega
  rw [e0]
  refine AHalt.step (G := G x B) (guard_rf x B (i := 0) (p := 0) (t := 0) (u := 0) .init
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)) ?_
  simp only [astep, searchA, rf_1, rf_upd1, zero_add]
  -- count `i = |x|`
  have hq : ∀ k ≤ x.length, orc P 0 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits k)) = decide (k < x.length) := by
    intro k _
    simp only [orc, decs, Matrix.cons_val_zero, inputLenLang, indicator_indexLang_pairEncode]
    exact decide_eq_decide.mpr Iff.rfl
  have hcount := inputLength_loop searchA (orc P) x 0 0 .scan .incI .dbl rfl rfl hq B
    (by omega) (rf 0 1 0 0) (fun s => (guard_rf x B .init (by omega) h1B (by omega) (by omega)).2 s)
    (by simp)
  simp only [rf_upd0] at hcount
  refine hcount.halt ?_
  -- double `p` `|x|` times, then search
  have hd := dbl_loop P x B n hB n 0 (by omega)
  rw [pow_zero] at hd
  refine hd.halt (enum_loop P x B n hB (2 ^ n) 0 (by omega) _ ?_)
  simp [indicator_eq_decide, searchLang, hn]

end WidthExample

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMLoops
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMReach

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Abstract register machines with a monotone memory tape

A *memory register machine* (`Complexity.LogProg.MARM`) is an abstract register machine
(`Complexity.LogProg.ARM`) with one more device: a tape of bits (the *memory*), initially all
`0`, with a head, and four more instructions: branch on the bit under the head (`mread`), set
it to `1` (`mset`), and move the head (`mleft`, `mright`). Bits are never reset, so the
memory only grows. This is what an exponential-time algorithm needs beyond the counters of
a space-bounded one: a table indexed by register values (a visited set, [AB09, §4.1.1,
proof of Theorem 4.2]), addressed by walking the head. The compiled machine is in
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.MARMCompile`, its time bound in
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.MARMTime`.

Runs of a memory register machine between memory instructions are runs of its
*deterministic part* (`Complexity.LogProg.MARM.detPart`, answering a fixed bit at the memory
labels), so the counting loops of `TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.ARMLoops` and
`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Logspace.InputAccess` transfer
(`Complexity.LogProg.MReach.of_areach`).

The machine model is infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1.1], not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.MIns`, `Complexity.LogProg.MARM` — instructions and machines.
* `Complexity.LogProg.MARM.detPart` — the register instructions, `ret β` at memory labels.
* `Complexity.LogProg.mstep`, `Complexity.LogProg.mrun` — the semantics.
* `Complexity.LogProg.MReach`, `Complexity.LogProg.MHalt` — runs through a guard.

## Main results

* the run algebra `mrun_add`, `MReach.trans`, `MReach.halt`, `MReach.step`, `MHalt.step`,
  `MHalt.ret`;
* `Complexity.LogProg.MReach.of_areach` — a run of the deterministic part to a live
  configuration is a run of the memory machine, the memory untouched.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1, Theorem 4.2.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

variable {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- The instructions of a memory register machine: a register instruction, or a memory
instruction. -/
inductive MIns (m d : ℕ) (Λ : Type) where
  /-- a register instruction of `Complexity.LogProg.Ins` -/
  | det (i : Ins m d Λ)
  /-- go to `l₁` if the memory bit under the head is `1`, else to `l₀` -/
  | mread (l₁ l₀ : Λ)
  /-- set the memory bit under the head to `1` -/
  | mset (l : Λ)
  /-- move the memory head one cell left -/
  | mleft (l : Λ)
  /-- move the memory head one cell right -/
  | mright (l : Λ)

/-- A memory register machine: an instruction at every label. -/
abbrev MARM (m d : ℕ) (Λ : Type) := Λ → MIns m d Λ

/-- Whether an instruction is a memory instruction. -/
def MIns.isMem {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} : MIns m d Λ → Bool
  | .det _ => false
  | _ => true

/-- The deterministic part of a memory register machine, answering `β` at the memory labels.
The compiled memory machine agrees with the compiled `A.detPart β` away from those labels. -/
def MARM.detPart (A : MARM m d Λ) (β : Bool) : ARM m d Λ := fun l =>
  match A l with
  | .det i => i
  | _ => .ret β

/-- At a register label the deterministic part is the instruction. -/
lemma MARM.detPart_det {A : MARM m d Λ} {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i)
    (β : Bool) : A.detPart β l = i := by
  simp [MARM.detPart, hA]

/-- At a memory label the deterministic part answers `β`. -/
lemma MARM.detPart_mem {A : MARM m d Λ} {l : Λ} (hA : (A l).isMem = true) (β : Bool) :
    A.detPart β l = .ret β := by
  unfold MARM.detPart
  cases h : A l with
  | det i => rw [h] at hA; simp [MIns.isMem] at hA
  | _ => rfl

/-- The memory: the bits (`true` = `1`) and the head position. -/
abbrev Mem := (ℤ → Bool) × ℤ

/-- A configuration of a memory register machine: an abstract configuration and the memory. -/
abbrev MConf (m : ℕ) (Λ : Type) := AConf m Λ × Mem

open Classical in
/-- **One step of a memory register machine** on input `x`, deciders answering `oracle`: a
register instruction acts as in `astep` on the abstract configuration, a memory instruction on
the memory; halted configurations are fixed. -/
noncomputable def mstep (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (x : List Bool) : MConf m Λ → MConf m Λ
  | ((none, v, res), μ) => ((none, v, res), μ)
  | ((some l, v, res), (M, p)) =>
    match A l with
    | .det i => (astep (fun _ => i) oracle x (some l, v, res), (M, p))
    | .mread l₁ l₀ => ((some (if M p then l₁ else l₀), v, res), (M, p))
    | .mset l' => ((some l', v, res), (Function.update M p true, p))
    | .mleft l' => ((some l', v, res), (M, p - 1))
    | .mright l' => ((some l', v, res), (M, p + 1))

/-- The run of a memory register machine. -/
noncomputable def mrun (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (c : MConf m Λ) (n : ℕ) : MConf m Λ :=
  (mstep A oracle x)^[n] c

/-- A run of a memory register machine from `a` to `a'` through configurations satisfying
`G`. -/
def MReach (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (G : MConf m Λ → Prop) (a a' : MConf m Λ) : Prop :=
  ∃ T, mrun A oracle x a T = a' ∧ ∀ t < T, G (mrun A oracle x a t)

/-- A run of a memory register machine from `a` answering `b`, through configurations
satisfying `G`. -/
def MHalt (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (G : MConf m Λ → Prop) (a : MConf m Λ) (b : Bool) : Prop :=
  ∃ T, (mrun A oracle x a T).1.1 = none ∧ (mrun A oracle x a T).1.2.2 = some b ∧
    ∀ t < T, G (mrun A oracle x a t)

section Semantics

variable {A : MARM m d Λ} {oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool}

/-- At a register label a step is the step of the deterministic part, the memory untouched. -/
lemma mstep_det {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i) (β : Bool) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (res : Option Bool) (μ : Mem) :
    mstep A oracle x ((some l, v, res), μ) =
      (astep (A.detPart β) oracle x (some l, v, res), μ) := by
  obtain ⟨M, p⟩ := μ
  simp only [mstep, hA, astep, MARM.detPart_det hA β]

/-- Running `n + 1` steps is one step followed by `n` steps. -/
lemma mrun_succ (c : MConf m Λ) (n : ℕ) :
    mrun A oracle x c (n + 1) = mrun A oracle x (mstep A oracle x c) n := by
  simp [mrun, Function.iterate_succ_apply]

/-- Running `s + t` steps is running `s` steps, then `t` steps. -/
lemma mrun_add (c : MConf m Λ) (s t : ℕ) :
    mrun A oracle x c (s + t) = mrun A oracle x (mrun A oracle x c s) t := by
  simp only [mrun]; rw [Nat.add_comm, Function.iterate_add_apply]

/-- A halted configuration stays put. -/
lemma mrun_halted (v : Fin m → ℕ) (res : Option Bool) (μ : Mem) (n : ℕ) :
    mrun A oracle x ((none, v, res), μ) n = ((none, v, res), μ) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [mrun_succ]; exact ih

end Semantics

section Combinators

variable {A : MARM m d Λ} {oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool} {G : MConf m Λ → Prop}

/-- Every configuration reaches itself. -/
lemma MReach.refl (a : MConf m Λ) : MReach A oracle x G a a := ⟨0, rfl, fun t h => by omega⟩

/-- Runs compose. -/
lemma MReach.trans {a b c : MConf m Λ} (h₁ : MReach A oracle x G a b)
    (h₂ : MReach A oracle x G b c) : MReach A oracle x G a c := by
  obtain ⟨T₁, e1, m1⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨T₂, e2, m2⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨T₁ + T₂, by rw [mrun_add, e1, e2], fun t ht => ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T₁ with h | h
  · exact m1 t h
  · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = T₁ + t' := ⟨t - T₁, by omega⟩
    rw [mrun_add, e1]; exact m2 t' (by omega)

/-- A run followed by a halting run is a halting run with the same answer. -/
lemma MReach.halt {a b : MConf m Λ} {r : Bool} (h₁ : MReach A oracle x G a b)
    (h₂ : MHalt A oracle x G b r) : MHalt A oracle x G a r := by
  obtain ⟨T₁, e1, m1⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨T₂, f1, f2, m2⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨T₁ + T₂, by rw [mrun_add, e1]; exact f1, by rw [mrun_add, e1]; exact f2,
    fun t ht => ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T₁ with h | h
  · exact m1 t h
  · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = T₁ + t' := ⟨t - T₁, by omega⟩
    rw [mrun_add, e1]; exact m2 t' (by omega)

/-- A configuration satisfying the guard reaches its successor in one step. -/
lemma MReach.single {a : MConf m Λ} (hG : G a) :
    MReach A oracle x G a (mstep A oracle x a) := ⟨1, rfl, fun t ht => by
  obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
  exact hG⟩

/-- A step followed by a run. -/
lemma MReach.step {a c : MConf m Λ} (hG : G a) (h : MReach A oracle x G (mstep A oracle x a) c) :
    MReach A oracle x G a c := (MReach.single hG).trans h

/-- A step followed by a halting run. -/
lemma MHalt.step {a : MConf m Λ} {r : Bool} (hG : G a)
    (h : MHalt A oracle x G (mstep A oracle x a) r) : MHalt A oracle x G a r :=
  (MReach.single hG).halt h

/-- Answering in one step. -/
lemma MHalt.ret {l : Λ} {v : Fin m → ℕ} {r : Bool} {μ : Mem} (hA : A l = .det (.ret r))
    (hG : G ((some l, v, none), μ)) : MHalt A oracle x G ((some l, v, none), μ) r :=
  ⟨1, by obtain ⟨M, p⟩ := μ; simp [mrun, mstep, astep, hA],
    by obtain ⟨M, p⟩ := μ; simp [mrun, mstep, astep, hA], fun t ht => by
    obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
    exact hG⟩

/-- Rewriting the end configuration of a run along an equation. -/
lemma MReach.of_eq {a b b' : MConf m Λ} (h : MReach A oracle x G a b) (e : b = b') :
    MReach A oracle x G a b' := e ▸ h

/-- A run through a guard is a run through any weaker guard. -/
lemma MReach.mono {G' : MConf m Λ → Prop} {a b : MConf m Λ} (h : MReach A oracle x G a b)
    (hG : ∀ c, G c → G' c) : MReach A oracle x G' a b := by
  obtain ⟨T, e, hm⟩ := h; exact ⟨T, e, fun t ht => hG _ (hm t ht)⟩

/-- A halting run through a guard is a halting run through any weaker guard. -/
lemma MHalt.mono {G' : MConf m Λ → Prop} {a : MConf m Λ} {r : Bool}
    (h : MHalt A oracle x G a r) (hG : ∀ c, G c → G' c) : MHalt A oracle x G' a r := by
  obtain ⟨T, e1, e2, hm⟩ := h; exact ⟨T, e1, e2, fun t ht => hG _ (hm t ht)⟩

end Combinators

section Transfer

variable {A : MARM m d Λ} {oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool}

/-- A run of the deterministic part from `a` that is live at time `T` is, up to time `T`, a
run of the memory machine with the memory untouched.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the time. A live run never visits a memory label before its
end: there the deterministic part answers and halts for good (`arun_halted`). At register
labels the two steps agree (`mstep_det`); halted configurations are fixed by both. -/
lemma mrun_eq_arun (β : Bool) (a : AConf m Λ) (μ : Mem) (T : ℕ)
    (hlive : (arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a T).1 ≠ none) :
    ∀ t ≤ T, mrun A oracle x (a, μ) t = (arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a t, μ) := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => intro _; rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    intro ht
    have e := ih (by omega)
    rw [mrun_add, e]
    show mstep A oracle x _ = _
    rw [show arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a (t + 1) =
      astep (A.detPart β) oracle x (arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a t) by
        simp [arun, Function.iterate_succ_apply']]
    generalize hc : arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a t = c
    obtain ⟨_ | l, v, res⟩ := c
    · rfl
    · cases hA : A l with
      | det i => exact mstep_det hA β v res μ
      | _ =>
        exfalso
        have hret : A.detPart β l = .ret β := MARM.detPart_mem (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem]) β
        have h1 : arun (A.detPart β) oracle x a (t + 1) = (none, v, some β) := by
          simp [arun, Function.iterate_succ_apply'] at hc ⊢
          rw [hc]; simp [astep, hret]
        apply hlive
        rw [show T = (t + 1) + (T - (t + 1)) by omega, arun_add, h1, arun_halted]

/-- **Runs of the deterministic part transfer.** A run of `A.detPart β` through `G` from `a`
to a live configuration `a'` is a run of the memory machine from `(a, μ)` to `(a', μ)` through
configurations whose abstract part satisfies `G` and whose memory is `μ`.

**Proof sketch.** `mrun_eq_arun` up to the end of the run. -/
lemma MReach.of_areach {β : Bool} {G : AConf m Λ → Prop} {a a' : AConf m Λ} (μ : Mem)
    (h : AReach (A.detPart β) oracle x G a a') (hlive : a'.1 ≠ none) :
    MReach A oracle x (fun c => G c.1 ∧ c.2 = μ) (a, μ) (a', μ) := by
  obtain ⟨T, e, hm⟩ := h
  have key := mrun_eq_arun (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := x) β a μ T (by rw [e]; exact hlive)
  refine ⟨T, by rw [key T le_rfl, e], fun t ht => ?_⟩
  rw [key t ht.le]
  exact ⟨hm t ht, rfl⟩

end Transfer

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-

Authors: Hydroxyi

import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.MARM
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARMCompile

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Compiling memory register machines

The compiled machine of a memory register machine `A` (`Complexity.LogProg.mcompileTM`) has
the work tapes of the compiled deterministic part `A.detPart false` (registers and decider
block) and one more tape, the memory. Away from the start states of memory instructions it
makes the step of the compiled deterministic part, leaving the memory tape alone
(`Complexity.LogProg.liftAct`); at those start states it makes one step on the memory tape.
The memory tape holds `1` as the symbol `true` and `0` as a blank, so the only symbol ever
written on it is `true`.

As for nondeterministic machines (`TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.NARMCompile`),
no instruction-level simulation is redone: at a memory start state the compiled deterministic
part halts at once, so its runs that end live (or with the other answer) avoid those states,
and the compiled memory machine follows them (`Complexity.LogProg.mrunFrom_eq`).

This is infrastructure for [AB09, §4.1.1], not itself a result of the book.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.liftAct`, `Complexity.LogProg.memCfg` — an extra, idle tape.
* `Complexity.LogProg.mcompileTM`, `Complexity.LogProg.mcompileFinTM` — the compiled machine.
* `Complexity.LogProg.mseam` — the compiled configuration of a memory machine configuration.
* `Complexity.LogProg.MBox` — head ranges of registers, deciders and memory.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.mdet_live`, `Complexity.LogProg.mdet_halt` — the register steps.
* `Complexity.LogProg.mmem_step` — a memory step is one compiled step.
* `Complexity.LogProg.mcompileTM_init` — the initial configuration.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1.1.)
-/

namespace Complexity.LogProg

open Turing

/-! ## An extra tape -/

section Lift

variable {K : ℕ} {St : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- The memory tape of memory bits: `true` at the `1`s, blank at the `0`s. -/
def memTape (M : ℤ → Bool) : ℤ → Option Bool := fun z => if M z then some true else none

/-- An action with one more work tape, left alone. -/
def liftAct (a : Action K Bool St) : Action (K + 1) Bool St :=
  ⟨a.inputTape, Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Option (Option Bool) × SignType) a.workTapes (none, 0),
    a.output, a.state⟩

/-- A configuration with one more work tape holding `M`, its head at `p`. -/
def memCfg (c : Cfg K Bool St x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ) : Cfg (K + 1) Bool St x :=
  ⟨c.state, c.inputPos, Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℤ → Option Bool) c.workTapes M,
    Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℤ) c.workTapePos p, c.output⟩

/-- The old tapes read as before. -/
@[simp] lemma memCfg_symbols_castSucc (c : Cfg K Bool St x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ)
    (i : Fin K) : (memCfg c M p).workTapeSymbols i.castSucc = c.workTapeSymbols i := by
  simp [memCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]

/-- The extra tape reads its cell under the head. -/
@[simp] lemma memCfg_symbols_last (c : Cfg K Bool St x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ) :
    (memCfg c M p).workTapeSymbols (Fin.last K) = M p := by
  simp [memCfg, Cfg.workTapeSymbols]

/-- A lifted action acts on the old tapes and leaves the extra tape alone. -/
lemma liftAct_apply (a : Action K Bool St) (c : Cfg K Bool St x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ) :
    (liftAct a).apply (memCfg c M p) = memCfg (a.apply c) M p := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext i z
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [Action.apply, liftAct, memCfg]
    · simp only [Action.apply, liftAct, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
  · funext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [Action.apply, liftAct, memCfg]
    · simp [Action.apply, liftAct, memCfg]

end Lift

/-! ## The compiled machine -/

section Construction

variable {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type}

/-- The memory instruction whose fragment starts at a compiled state (`none` elsewhere). -/
def mop (A : MARM m d Λ) : CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m → Option (MIns m d Λ)
  | .prog (l, ph) => if ph = .start ∧ (A l).isMem = true then some (A l) else none
  | _ => none

/-- A compiled state with a memory instruction is the start state of its fragment. -/
lemma mop_spec {A : MARM m d Λ} {q : CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m} {i : MIns m d Λ}
    (h : mop A q = some i) : ∃ l, q = .prog (l, .start) ∧ A l = i ∧ i.isMem = true := by
  match q, h with
  | .prog (l, ph), h =>
    simp only [mop] at h
    split_ifs at h with hph
    · obtain ⟨rfl, hm⟩ := hph
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst h
      exact ⟨l, rfl, rfl, hm⟩

/-- The one-step action of a memory instruction, reading the memory symbol `r`. -/
def memAct {K : ℕ} (i : MIns m d Λ) (r : Option Bool) : Action (K + 1) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) :=
  match i with
  | .det _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩
  | .mread l₁ l₀ =>
    ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, some (.prog ((if r = some true then l₁ else l₀), .start))⟩
  | .mset l =>
    ⟨0, Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (fun _ => (none, 0))
      (some (some true), 0), none, some (.prog (l, .start))⟩
  | .mleft l =>
    ⟨0, Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (fun _ => (none, 0)) (none, -1),
      none, some (.prog (l, .start))⟩
  | .mright l =>
    ⟨0, Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Option (Option Bool) × SignType) (fun _ => (none, 0)) (none, 1),
      none, some (.prog (l, .start))⟩

/-- **The compiled memory machine** of a memory register machine `A` with start label `l₀`,
calling the deciders `D` from the start states `q0 j`: at the start state of a memory
instruction one step on the memory tape (the last work tape), everywhere else the step of the
compiled deterministic part with the memory tape idle. -/
def mcompileTM (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) :
    MultiTapeTM (m + kD + 1) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) where
  q₀ := .prog (l₀, .start)
  tr q a w :=
    match mop A q with
    | some i => memAct i (w (Fin.last _))
    | none => liftAct (ctr (armProg (A.detPart false) l₀) D q0 q a (fun i => w i.castSucc))

/-- The compiled memory machine as a bundled finite machine. -/
def mcompileFinTM [Fintype Λ] [DecidableEq Λ] [Fintype SD] [DecidableEq SD]
    (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) : FinTM Bool where
  k := m + kD + 1
  State := CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m
  tm := mcompileTM A l₀ D q0

/-- The compiled deterministic part answering `β` at the memory labels. -/
abbrev detM (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (β : Bool) : MultiTapeTM (m + kD) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) :=
  compileTM (armProg (A.detPart β) l₀) (l₀, .start) D q0

/-- The call nodes of the compiled deterministic parts do not depend on the answer at the
memory labels. -/
lemma armProg_mdetPart_call (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (β β' : Bool) :
    (armProg (A.detPart β) l₀).call = (armProg (A.detPart β') l₀).call := by
  funext q
  obtain ⟨l, ph⟩ := q
  show insCall (A.detPart β l) ph = insCall (A.detPart β' l) ph
  cases hA : A l with
  | det i => rw [MARM.detPart_det hA, MARM.detPart_det hA]
  | _ =>
    rw [MARM.detPart_mem (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem]), MARM.detPart_mem (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem])]
    rfl

/-- Away from the memory start states, the compiled deterministic parts agree. -/
lemma detM_tr (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    {q : CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m} (hq : mop A q = none) (β : Bool) :
    (detM A l₀ D q0 β).tr q = (detM A l₀ D q0 false).tr q := by
  funext a w
  simp only [detM, compileTM]
  rw [ctr_congr D q0 q (armProg_mdetPart_call A l₀ β false) ?_]
  rintro ⟨l, ph⟩ rfl
  funext a' w'
  show insTr (A.detPart β l) l ph a' w' = insTr (A.detPart false l) l ph a' w'
  cases hA : A l with
  | det i => rw [MARM.detPart_det hA, MARM.detPart_det hA]
  | _ =>
    have hph : ph ≠ .start := by
      rintro rfl; simp [mop, hA, MIns.isMem] at hq
    rw [MARM.detPart_mem (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem]), MARM.detPart_mem (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem])]
    cases ph <;> first | exact absurd rfl hph | rfl

/-- **Away from the memory start states, the compiled memory machine makes the step of the
compiled deterministic part** (for either answer `β`), its memory tape idle. -/
lemma mcompileTM_step (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (β : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) x)
    (hc : ∀ q, c.state = some q → mop A q = none) (M : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ) :
    (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).step (memCfg c M p) = memCfg ((detM A l₀ D q0 β).step c) M p := by
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  cases hs : c.state with
  | none => simp [memCfg, hs]
  | some q =>
    have hq := hc q hs
    have hst : (memCfg c M p).state = some q := by simp [memCfg, hs]
    rw [hst]
    simp only
    rw [detM_tr A l₀ D q0 hq β]
    have hsym : (fun i => (memCfg c M p).workTapeSymbols i.castSucc) = c.workTapeSymbols := by
      funext i; simp
    have hin : (memCfg c M p).inputSymbol = c.inputSymbol := rfl
    simp only [mcompileTM, hq, hsym, hin]
    exact liftAct_apply _ c M p

/-- **The compiled memory machine follows the compiled deterministic part** along its runs
that avoid the memory start states, its memory tape idle.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the time, by `mcompileTM_step`. -/
lemma mrunFrom_eq (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (β : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool)
    (p : ℤ) (T : ℕ)
    (hX : ∀ t < T, ∀ q, ((detM A l₀ D q0 β).runFrom c t).state = some q → mop A q = none) :
    ∀ t ≤ T, (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (memCfg c M p) t =
      memCfg ((detM A l₀ D q0 β).runFrom c t) M p := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => intro _; rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    intro ht
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', ih (by omega)]
    exact mcompileTM_step A l₀ D q0 β _ (hX t (by omega)) M p

/-- **At a memory start state the compiled deterministic part halts at once, writing `β`.** -/
lemma detM_step_mem (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (β : Bool) {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg (m + kD) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) x)
    (q : CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) (hc : c.state = some q) (hq : mop A q ≠ none) :
    ((detM A l₀ D q0 β).step c).state = none ∧
      ((detM A l₀ D q0 β).step c).output = c.output ++ [β] := by
  obtain ⟨i, hq'⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp hq
  obtain ⟨l, rfl, hA, hm⟩ := mop_spec hq'
  have hret : A.detPart β l = .ret β := MARM.detPart_mem (by rw [hA]; exact hm) β
  have hcall : (armProg (A.detPart β) l₀).call (l, .start) = none := by
    show insCall (A.detPart β l) .start = none
    rw [hret]; rfl
  have htr : ∀ a w, (armProg (A.detPart β) l₀).tm.tr (l, .start) a w = retAct β := by
    intro a w
    show insTr (A.detPart β l) l .start a w = retAct β
    rw [hret]; rfl
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  rw [hc]
  simp only [detM, compileTM, ctr, hcall, htr, retAct, Action.apply]
  exact ⟨rfl, by simp⟩

/-- The deterministic parts have the same preconditions. -/
lemma pre_mdetPart (A : MARM m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B : ℕ) {x : List Bool} (β β' : Bool)
    (a : AConf m Λ) :
    Pre (A.detPart β) oracle D q0 B x a ↔ Pre (A.detPart β') oracle D q0 B x a := by
  rcases a with ⟨_ | l, v, res⟩
  · exact Iff.rfl
  · cases hA : A l with
    | det i => simp only [Pre, MARM.detPart_det hA]
    | _ =>
      simp only [Pre, MARM.detPart_mem (A := A) (l := l) (by simp [hA, MIns.isMem])]

/-- At a register label the deterministic parts make the same step. -/
lemma astep_mdetPart {A : MARM m d Λ} {l : Λ} {i : Ins m d Λ} (hA : A l = .det i)
    (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) {x : List Bool} (β β' : Bool) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (res : Option Bool) :
    astep (A.detPart β) oracle x (some l, v, res) =
      astep (A.detPart β') oracle x (some l, v, res) := by
  simp only [astep, MARM.detPart_det hA]

/-- The compiled configuration of a memory machine configuration: the compiled program
configuration of the registers, and the memory tape. -/
def mseam (x : List Bool) (l : Λ) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool) :
    Cfg (m + kD + 1) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) x :=
  memCfg (seam (kD := kD) (SD := SD) (aseam x l v out)) (memTape M) p

/-- The initial configuration of the compiled memory machine is the compiled configuration of
the start label, all registers `0`, the memory blank with its head at `0`. -/
lemma mcompileTM_init (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD)
    (x : List Bool) :
    (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).initCfg x = mseam x l₀ (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => false) 0 [] := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext i z
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [mseam, memCfg, memTape]
    · simp only [mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun k => ?_) j <;>
        simp [seam, aseam, Nat.zero_bits]
  · funext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [mseam, memCfg]
    · simp only [mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
      refine Fin.addCases (fun r => ?_) (fun k => ?_) j <;> simp [seam, aseam]

end Construction

/-! ## Simulating the steps -/

section Steps

variable {m d kD : ℕ} {Λ SD : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- A compiled memory configuration with register heads in `[-1, W]`, decider heads in
`[-B, B]` and the memory head in `[-P, P]`. -/
def MBox {St : Type} (W B P : ℕ) (C : Cfg (m + kD + 1) Bool St x) : Prop :=
  (∀ r : Fin m, (-1 : ℤ) ≤ C.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r).castSucc ∧
    C.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r).castSucc ≤ W) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin kD, |C.workTapePos (Fin.natAdd m i).castSucc| ≤ B) ∧
  |C.workTapePos (Fin.last _)| ≤ P

/-- The compiled configuration of a memory machine configuration is in the box. -/
lemma mbox_mseam (W B P : ℕ) (l : Λ) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (hp : |p| ≤ P) :
    MBox (kD := kD) (St := CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m) W B P (mseam x l v M p out) :=
  ⟨fun r => by simp only [mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; simp [seam, aseam],
    fun i => by simp only [mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; simp [seam],
    by simpa [mseam, memCfg] using hp⟩

/-- A lifted configuration is in the box when the original one has its register and decider
heads in range and the memory head is in range. -/
lemma mbox_memCfg {St : Type} (W B P : ℕ) (c : Cfg (m + kD) Bool St x) (M : ℤ → Option Bool)
    (p : ℤ) (h1 : ∀ r : Fin m, (-1 : ℤ) ≤ c.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r) ∧
      c.workTapePos (Fin.castAdd kD r) ≤ W)
    (h2 : ∀ i : Fin kD, |c.workTapePos (Fin.natAdd m i)| ≤ B) (hp : |p| ≤ P) :
    MBox W B P (memCfg c M p) :=
  ⟨fun r => by simp only [memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact h1 r,
    fun i => by simp only [memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact h2 i,
    by simpa [memCfg] using hp⟩

/-- **A live register step.** If, at a register label, the deterministic part steps from
`(l, v)` to the live `(l', v')`, with the preconditions and register widths of `arm_step`,
then the compiled memory machine goes from the compiled configuration of `(l, v)` to that of
`(l', v')`, the memory unchanged, in the box.

**Proof sketch.** `arm_step` and `compile_correct_from` give a run of the compiled
deterministic part reaching the seam of `(l', v')`, in range. It ends live, so it avoids the
memory start states (`avoid_of_live`, `detM_step_mem`), and the compiled memory machine
follows it (`mrunFrom_eq`). -/
theorem mdet_live (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B W P : ℕ) (l l' : Λ) (v v' : Fin m → ℕ)
    (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool)
    (hs : astep (A.detPart false) oracle x (some l, v, none) = (some l', v', none))
    (hp : Pre (A.detPart false) oracle D q0 B x (some l, v, none))
    (hw : ∀ r, ((Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length : ℤ) ≤ W) (hP : |p| ≤ P) :
    ∃ S, (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) S = mseam x l' v' M p out ∧
      ∀ t ≤ S, MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) t) := by
  obtain ⟨T, e, hinv⟩ := arm_step (A.detPart false) l₀ oracle D q0 B W l l' v v' out hs hp hw
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hb⟩ := compile_correct_from (armProg (A.detPart false) l₀) (l₀, .start) D q0
    oracle (fun _ => -1) (fun _ => (W : ℤ)) B (aseam x l v out) T
    (fun t ht r => by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T with h | h
      · exact (hinv t h).1 r
      · obtain rfl : t = T := by omega
        rw [e]; simp [aseam])
    (fun t ht => (hinv t ht).2)
  have hX := avoid_of_live (detM A l₀ D q0 false) (fun q => mop A q ≠ none)
    (fun c q hc hq => (detM_step_mem A l₀ D q0 false c q hc hq).1)
    (seam (aseam x l v out)) S (by rw [hS, e]; simp [seam, aseam])
  have hag := mrunFrom_eq A l₀ D q0 false (seam (aseam x l v out)) (memTape M) p S
    (fun t ht q hq => not_not.mp (hX t ht q hq))
  refine ⟨S, ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  · rw [mseam, hag S le_rfl, hS, e]; rfl
  · rw [mseam, hag t ht]
    exact mbox_memCfg W B P _ _ p (hb t ht).1 (hb t ht).2 hP

/-- **A halting register step.** If, at a register label, the deterministic part halts from
`(l, v)` with answer `b₀`, with the preconditions and register widths of `arm_run`, then the
compiled memory machine halts from the compiled configuration of `(l, v)` with output
`out ++ [b₀]`, in the box.

**Proof sketch.** As `mdet_live`, with `arm_run` (one step) for the deterministic part
answering `!b₀` at the memory labels: its run ends with answer `b₀ ≠ !b₀`, so it avoids the
memory start states (`avoid_of_halt`). -/
theorem mdet_halt (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) (B W P : ℕ) (l : Λ) {i : Ins m d Λ}
    (hA : A l = .det i) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool) (b₀ : Bool)
    (hs : astep (A.detPart false) oracle x (some l, v, none) = (none, v, some b₀))
    (hp : Pre (A.detPart false) oracle D q0 B x (some l, v, none))
    (hw : ∀ r, ((Nat.bits (v r + 1)).length : ℤ) ≤ W) (hP : |p| ≤ P) :
    ∃ S, ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) S).state = none ∧
      ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) S).output = out ++ [b₀] ∧
      ∀ t ≤ S, MBox W B P ((mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).runFrom (mseam x l v M p out) t) := by
  have hs' : astep (A.detPart (!b₀)) oracle x (some l, v, none) = (none, v, some b₀) := by
    rw [astep_mdetPart hA oracle (!b₀) false]; exact hs
  obtain ⟨T, e1, e2, e3, hinv⟩ := arm_run (x := x) (A.detPart (!b₀)) l₀ oracle D q0 B W 1 l v out
    b₀ (by simp [arun, hs']) (by simp [arun, hs'])
    (fun t ht => by
      obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      exact ⟨(pre_mdetPart A oracle D q0 B false (!b₀) _).1 hp, hw⟩)
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hb⟩ := compile_correct_from (armProg (A.detPart (!b₀)) l₀) (l₀, .start) D q0
    oracle (fun _ => -1) (fun _ => (W : ℤ)) B (aseam x l v out) T
    (fun t ht r => by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T with h | h
      · exact (hinv t h).1 r
      · obtain rfl : t = T := by omega
        exact e3 r)
    (fun t ht => (hinv t ht).2)
  have hX := avoid_of_halt (detM A l₀ D q0 (!b₀)) (fun q => mop A q ≠ none) (!b₀)
    (fun c q hc hq => detM_step_mem A l₀ D q0 (!b₀) c q hc hq)
    (seam (aseam x l v out)) S b₀ (by rw [hS]; exact e2) (by cases b₀ <;> simp)
  have hag := mrunFrom_eq A l₀ D q0 (!b₀) (seam (aseam x l v out)) (memTape M) p S
    (fun t ht q hq => not_not.mp (hX t ht q hq))
  refine ⟨S, ?_, ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  · rw [mseam, hag S le_rfl, hS]
    exact seam_state_none (kD := kD) (SD := SD) _ e1
  · rw [mseam, hag S le_rfl, hS]
    exact e2
  · rw [mseam, hag t ht]
    exact mbox_memCfg W B P _ _ p (hb t ht).1 (hb t ht).2 hP

/-- **A memory step is one compiled step**: at a memory label, the compiled memory machine
goes in one step from the compiled configuration of a configuration to that of its successor.

**Proof sketch.** At the start state of a memory instruction the compiled transition is
`memAct`: it reads the memory cell under the head, moves only the memory head or writes `true`
under it, and goes to the target label. Compare the components of the two configurations
(`Fin.lastCases` on the tapes: the old tapes are untouched). -/
lemma mmem_step (A : MARM m d Λ) (l₀ : Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool)
    (D : MultiTapeTM kD Bool SD) (q0 : Fin d → SD) {l : Λ} (hA : (A l).isMem = true)
    (v : Fin m → ℕ) (M : ℤ → Bool) (p : ℤ) (out : List Bool) :
    ∃ l' M' p', mstep A oracle x ((some l, v, none), (M, p)) = ((some l', v, none), (M', p')) ∧
      (mcompileTM A l₀ D q0).step (mseam x l v M p out) = mseam x l' v M' p' out := by
  have hst : (mseam (kD := kD) (SD := SD) x l v M p out).state = some (.prog (l, .start)) := rfl
  have hmop : mop (SD := SD) A (.prog (l, .start)) = some (A l) := by simp [mop, hA]
  have hlast : (mseam (kD := kD) (SD := SD) x l v M p out).workTapeSymbols (Fin.last _) =
      memTape M p := by simp [mseam]
  have key : ∀ (l' : Λ) (M' : ℤ → Bool) (p' : ℤ)
      (a : Action (m + kD + 1) Bool (CSt (Λ × Ph) SD m)),
      a.inputTape = 0 → a.output = none → a.state = some (.prog (l', .start)) →
      (∀ j : Fin (m + kD), a.workTapes j.castSucc = (none, 0)) →
      ((a.workTapes (Fin.last _)).1 = none ∧ M' = M ∨
        (a.workTapes (Fin.last _)).1 = some (some true) ∧ M' = Function.update M p true) →
      p + ((a.workTapes (Fin.last _)).2 : ℤ) = p' →
      a.apply (mseam x l v M p out) = mseam x l' v M' p' out := by
    intro l' M' p' a h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
    refine Cfg.ext ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · simp [Action.apply, h3, mseam, memCfg, seam, aseam]
    · simp [Action.apply, h1, mseam, memCfg, seam, aseam]
    · funext i z
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simp only [Action.apply, mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_last]
        rcases h5 with ⟨hw, rfl⟩ | ⟨hw, rfl⟩
        · simp only [hw]
        · simp only [hw]
          by_cases hz : z = p
          · subst hz; simp [memTape]
          · simp [memTape, Function.update_of_ne hz]
      · simp only [Action.apply, h4 j, mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; rfl
    · funext i
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simp only [Action.apply, mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_last]
        exact h6
      · simp only [Action.apply, h4 j, mseam, memCfg, Fin.snoc_castSucc]; simp; rfl
    · simp [Action.apply, h2, mseam, memCfg, seam, aseam]
  unfold MultiTapeTM.step
  rw [hst]
  simp only [mcompileTM, hmop, hlast]
  cases hA' : A l with
  | det i => rw [hA'] at hA; simp [MIns.isMem] at hA
  | mread l₁ l₀' =>
    refine ⟨if M p then l₁ else l₀', M, p, by simp [mstep, hA'], key _ M p _ rfl rfl ?_
      (fun j => rfl) (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) (by simp [memAct])⟩
    by_cases hM : M p <;> simp [memAct, memTape, hM]
  | mset l' =>
    refine ⟨l', Function.update M p true, p, by simp [mstep, hA'], key _ _ p _ rfl rfl rfl
      (fun j => by simp [memAct]) (Or.inr ⟨by simp [memAct], rfl⟩) (by simp [memAct])⟩
  | mleft l' =>
    refine ⟨l', M, p - 1, by simp [mstep, hA'], key _ M _ _ rfl rfl rfl
      (fun j => by simp [memAct]) (Or.inl ⟨by simp [memAct], rfl⟩) (by simp [memAct]; ring)⟩
  | mright l' =>
    refine ⟨l', M, p + 1, by simp [mstep, hA'], key _ M _ _ rfl rfl rfl
      (fun j => by simp [memAct]) (Or.inl ⟨by simp [memAct], rfl⟩) (by simp [memAct])⟩

end Steps

end Complexity.LogProg
```

```
/-
