Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Basic
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassP.TimeConstructible
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.InputLength
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.VirtualInput
import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.Build.Seam
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Bin

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Space-constructible functions

[AB09, §4.1, p. 79]: `S : ℕ → ℕ` is space-constructible when some machine
computes `S(|x|)` from `x` within `O(S(|x|))` space, and the book's standing
convention is `S(n) > log n`. The definition mirrors
`Complexity.TimeConstructible` — output in binary (`Nat.bits`), constant slack
`c · S n`, which implements the book's own asymptotic space convention
([AB09, p. 79]: "computes `S(|x|)` in `O(S(|x|))` space"); whether an
exact-space variant is also satisfiable is a separate question this campaign
does not pose (the chapter-1 exact-**time** refutation does not transfer: a
space deadline forces no premature halt — round-1 audit, finding 3) — and
carries the book's
convention as the conjunct `∀ n, logSpace n ≤ S n`, so that downstream
statements (the space hierarchy, Savitch) can draw on it without restating it;
results needing only weaker hypotheses must say so (seeded to the P4.1 audit).

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.SpaceConstructible` — the binary-output, constant-slack,
  above-log form. [AB09, §4.1, p. 79]

## Main results (proved)

* `Complexity.spaceConstructible_logSpace` — `log` is space-constructible.
* `Complexity.spaceConstructible_linear` — `n + 1` is space-constructible.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1, p. 79.)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Turing

/-- A function `S` is **space-constructible** when it dominates the logarithm
(`Complexity.logSpace`, the book's standing `S(n) > log n` convention carried as
data) and some machine computes the binary representation of `S (|x|)` from `x`
within `c · S (|x|)` visited work-tape cells. Mirrors
`Complexity.TimeConstructible` (binary output via `Nat.bits`, constant slack).
[AB09, §4.1, p. 79] -/
def SpaceConstructible (S : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ n, logSpace n ≤ S n) ∧
  ∃ c : ℕ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ M : FinTM Bool,
    M.ComputesInSpace (fun x => (S x.length).bits) fun n => c * S n

/-- Positive binary words have exactly the normalized logarithmic width. -/
private lemma b3a_bits_length {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n.bits.length = logSpace n := by
  have lower := Nat.lt_size.mpr (Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hn)
  have upper := LogProg.length_bits_le_log n
  rw [← Nat.size_eq_bits_len] at lower
  unfold logSpace
  omega

/-- The counter word with its first cell overwritten by `true`. -/
private def b3a_word (n : ℕ) : List Bool := true :: n.bits.tail

/-- The overwrite handles zero while preserving every positive counter width. -/
private lemma b3a_word_length (n : ℕ) : (b3a_word n).length = logSpace n := by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    simp [b3a_word, logSpace, Nat.bits]
  · simp only [b3a_word, List.length_cons, List.length_tail, b3a_bits_length hn]
    unfold logSpace
    omega

/-- Restricting a buffer to its occupied nonnegative interval does not change it. -/
private lemma b3a_buffer_restrict (w : List Bool) (z : ℤ) :
    (if 0 ≤ z ∧ z < (w.length : ℤ) then FinTM.bufferTape w z else none) =
      FinTM.bufferTape w z := by
  by_cases hzero : 0 ≤ z
  · by_cases hlast : z < (w.length : ℤ)
    · simp [hzero, hlast]
    · have out : w.length ≤ z.toNat := by omega
      simp [hzero, hlast, FinTM.bufferTape]
  · simp [hzero, FinTM.bufferTape]

/-- Setting the first buffered cell yields `true :: tail`, including an empty buffer. -/
private lemma b3a_buffer_overwrite (w : List Bool) (z : ℤ) :
    (if z = 0 then some true else FinTM.bufferTape w z) =
      FinTM.bufferTape (true :: w.tail) z := by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · subst z
    simp [FinTM.bufferTape]
  · by_cases hp : 0 ≤ z
    · have ht : z.toNat ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp only [if_neg hz, FinTM.bufferTape, if_pos hp, List.getElem?_cons,
        if_neg ht, List.getElem?_tail]
      congr 1
      omega
    · simp [hz, FinTM.bufferTape, hp]

/-- A live phase seam: its word is on tape zero and all heads are at the origin. -/
private def b3a_cfg {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] {S : Type} (s : S)
    (x w : List Bool) : Cfg k Bool S x :=
  { Cfg.init s x with
    workTapes := fun j => if j = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape w else fun _ => none }

/-- Map only the control field of a canonical phase seam. -/
private lemma b3a_cfg_map {k : ℕ} [NeZero k] {S T : Type} (f : S → T)
    (s : S) (x w : List Bool) :
    (b3a_cfg (k := k) s x w).mapState f = b3a_cfg (f s) x w := rfl

/-- Relocate a single-buffer seam along a selection preserving tape zero.
**Proof sketch.** Selected tapes use the public configuration projections;
other tapes use the frame theorem at time zero. All unused cells and heads are blank. -/
private lemma b3a_embed_cfg {m k : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero k] {S : Type}
    (R : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k) (hzero : ι 0 = 0)
    (s : S) (x w : List Bool) :
    embedEmitCfg ι (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] (b3a_cfg s x w) =
      b3a_cfg (k := k) s x w := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext j
    by_cases chosen : j ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := chosen
      rw [embedEmitCfg_selected_tape]
      have hz : ι i = 0 ↔ i = 0 := by rw [← hzero, ι.injective.eq_iff]
      simp only [b3a_cfg, hz]
    · have frame := (embedEmitTM_frame ι R (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
        [] (b3a_cfg s x w) 0).1 j chosen
      have hj : j ≠ 0 := fun eq => chosen ⟨0, hzero.trans eq.symm⟩
      simpa [b3a_cfg, hj] using frame.1
  · funext j
    by_cases chosen : j ∈ Set.range ι
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := chosen
      rw [embedEmitCfg_selected_pos]
      rfl
    · exact (embedEmitTM_frame ι R (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0)
        [] (b3a_cfg s x w) 0).1 j chosen |>.2
  · rfl

/-- A coarse constant-factor space bound for tape relocation.
**Proof sketch.** Every selected tape is bounded by the source's total space;
each unused tape contributes one cell. Sum this common bound over the host bank. -/
private lemma b3a_embed_space {m k : ℕ} {S : Type} {x : List Bool}
    (R : MultiTapeTM m Bool S) (ι : Fin m ↪ Fin k)
    (d : Cfg m Bool S x) (t : ℕ) :
    (embedEmitTM ι R).spaceUsed
        (embedEmitCfg ι (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] d) t ≤
      k * (R.spaceUsed d t + 1) := by
  unfold MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin k, (R.spaceUsed d t + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      by_cases chosen : j ∈ Set.range ι
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := chosen
        rw [(embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead ι R (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) [] d t i).2]
        exact (R.spaceUsedByTape_le_spaceUsed d t i).trans (Nat.le_succ _)
      · rw [(embedEmitTM_visitedByTapeHead_frame ι R (fun _ _ => none)
          (fun _ => 0) [] d t j chosen).2]
        omega
    _ = _ := by simp [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsed]

/-- The additive space ledger for an arbitrary live-exit seam.
**Proof sketch.** Apply the public visited-set inclusion on each tape, bound
the cardinality of its union by the sum, and sum over the bank. -/
private lemma b3a_seam_space {k : ℕ} {S T : Type} [DecidableEq S] {x : List Bool}
    (R : MultiTapeTM k Bool S) (exit : S) (Q : MultiTapeTM k Bool T) (entry : T)
    {d e : Cfg k Bool S x} {a b : ℕ} (run : R.runFrom d a = e)
    (live : e.state = some exit) (cut : ∀ u < a, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) :
    (seamCompTM R exit Q entry).spaceUsed (d.mapState Sum.inl) (a + 1 + b) ≤
      R.spaceUsed d a + Q.spaceUsed (e.mapState fun _ => entry) b := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin k, (R.spaceUsedByTape d a i +
        Q.spaceUsedByTape (e.mapState fun _ => entry) b i) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      calc
        _ ≤ (R.visitedByTapeHead d a i ∪
            Q.visitedByTapeHead (e.mapState fun _ => entry) b i).card := by
          apply Finset.card_le_card
          exact seamCompTM_visitedByTapeHead_ofCfg R exit Q entry run live cut i
        _ ≤ _ := Finset.card_union_le _ _
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_add_distrib

/-- The public native counter, specialized to blank origin tapes with a cardinality ledger.
**Proof sketch.** Instantiate R8.5c at its entry, identify the globally blank frame
with the buffer layout, and enclose each head's visited set in the promised interval.
The first-exit clause is retained for the subsequent dispatch. -/
private theorem b3a_counter :
    ∃ (K : ℕ) (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S)
      (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool S) (entry exit : S) (B : ℕ),
      ∀ x : List Bool, ∃ t,
        R.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) t = b3a_cfg exit x x.length.bits ∧
        (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
        R.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg entry x []) t ≤ B * (x.length.bits.length + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨K, S, fs, ds, R, entry, exit, C, contract⟩ := exists_inputLengthTM
  letI := fs
  letI := ds
  refine ⟨K, S, fs, ds, R, entry, exit, (K + 1) * (2 * C + 1), ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨t, _, cut, heads, finished⟩ := contract (b3a_cfg entry x []) rfl rfl
    (by intros; simp [b3a_cfg]) (by intros; simp [b3a_cfg])
  refine ⟨t, ?_, cut, ?_⟩
  · rw [finished]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext j z
      by_cases hj : j = 0
      · simp [b3a_cfg, hj, b3a_buffer_restrict]
      · simp [b3a_cfg, hj]
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · have perTape (j : Fin (K + 1)) : R.spaceUsedByTape (b3a_cfg entry x []) t j ≤
        2 * (C * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) + 1 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (Finset.Icc (-((C * (x.length.bits.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ))
            ((C * (x.length.bits.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)).card := by
          apply Finset.card_le_card
          intro z hz
          obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
          have bound := heads u (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hu)) j
          simpa [b3a_cfg, Finset.mem_Icc, abs_le] using bound
        _ = _ := by rw [Int.card_Icc]; omega
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin (K + 1), (2 * (C * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) + 1) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => perTape j
      _ = (K + 1) * (2 * (C * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) + 1) := by simp
      _ ≤ (K + 1) * ((2 * C + 1) * (x.length.bits.length + 1)) := by
        apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
        ring_nf; omega
      _ = _ := by ring

/-- The public constant writer overwrites cell zero and returns to its origin.
**Proof sketch.** Use R8.4 with `[true]`. Its four-step trace supplies the exact
exit cut and two-cell head interval; the buffer update is the tail identity above. -/
private theorem b3a_overwrite (x w : List Bool) :
    (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]).runFrom (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) 4 =
        b3a_cfg .done x (true :: w.tail) ∧
      (∀ u < 4, ((writeConstTM 1 0 [true]).runFrom
        (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) u).state ≠ some .done) ∧
      (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]).spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) 4 ≤ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨run, cut, heads⟩ := writeConstTM_run_ofCfg (0 : Fin 1) [true]
    (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x w) rfl
  norm_num only [List.length_singleton] at run
  refine ⟨?_, cut, ?_⟩
  · rw [run]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext j z
      have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp only [b3a_cfg, Cfg.init, hj, if_pos, List.length_singleton,
        zero_add, sub_zero]
      simp only [true_and, show (0 ≤ z ∧ z < 1) ↔ z = 0 by omega]
      by_cases hz : z = 0
      · simp [hz, FinTM.bufferTape]
      · simpa [hz] using b3a_buffer_overwrite w z
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · change ∑ j : Fin 1, _ ≤ 2
    rw [Fintype.sum_subsingleton _ (0 : Fin 1)]
    calc
      _ ≤ (Finset.Icc (0 : ℤ) 1).card := by
        apply Finset.card_le_card
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
        simpa [b3a_cfg] using heads 0 u (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hu))
      _ = 2 := by decide

/-- The emitting phase shares tape zero and places its bank after the native counter bank. -/
private def b3a_virtualSelect (K m : ℕ) : Fin (1 + m) ↪ Fin (K + 1 + m) where
  toFun i := ⟨if i.val = 0 then 0 else K + i.val, by split_ifs <;> omega⟩
  inj' := by
    intro i j eq
    apply Fin.ext
    have vals := congrArg Fin.val eq
    dsimp at vals
    split_ifs at vals <;> omega

/-- The initial virtual-input layout is the single-buffer phase seam.
**Proof sketch.** Split the host tapes into its buffer and source bank. The source
starts at input position one, with blank work tapes and all heads at zero. -/
private lemma b3a_virtual_cfg (L : FinTM Bool) (x y : List Bool) :
    vhostCfg (L.tm.initCfg y) true (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) [] =
      b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y := by
  apply Cfg.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext j z
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i
      have zero : Fin.castAdd L.k (0 : Fin 1) = 0 := rfl
      change FinTM.bufferTape y z =
        (if Fin.castAdd L.k (0 : Fin 1) = 0 then FinTM.bufferTape y else fun _ => none) z
      rw [if_pos zero]
    · have nonzero : Fin.natAdd 1 i ≠ (0 : Fin (1 + L.k)) := by
        intro eq
        have vals := congrArg Fin.val eq
        simp only [Fin.coe_natAdd, Fin.val_zero] at vals
        omega
      simp only [vhostCfg, Fin.addCases_right, b3a_cfg, if_neg nonzero,
        MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
  · funext j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simp [vhostCfg, b3a_cfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
    · simp [vhostCfg, b3a_cfg, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
  · rfl

/-- Assemble the three public phases with an explicit boundary-inclusive space allowance.
**Proof sketch.** Count on a native bank, overwrite its first cell, then host the
length counter on that word. Both seams dispatch at their first exits. The public
relocation and seam ledgers bound total space by a fixed multiple of the normalized
logarithm plus one; the final virtual-input halt emits the full binary answer. -/
private theorem b3a_log_machine :
    ∃ (A : ℕ), 0 < A ∧ ∃ M : FinTM Bool,
      M.ComputesInSpace (fun x => (logSpace x.length).bits)
        (fun n => A * (logSpace n + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨K, S, fs, ds, R, entry, exit, B, counter⟩ := b3a_counter
  letI := fs
  letI := ds
  obtain ⟨L, b, computes, space⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed
  let k := K + 1 + L.k
  let ic : Fin (K + 1) ↪ Fin k := Fin.castAddEmb L.k
  let iw : Fin 1 ↪ Fin k := Fin.castLEEmb (by dsimp [k]; omega)
  let iv := b3a_virtualSelect K L.k
  have ic0 : ic 0 = 0 := rfl
  have iw0 : iw 0 = 0 := rfl
  have iv0 : iv 0 = 0 := by apply Fin.ext; simp [iv, b3a_virtualSelect]
  let C := embedEmitTM ic R
  let W := embedEmitTM iw (writeConstTM 1 0 [true])
  let E := embedEmitTM iv (vhostEmitTM L.tm)
  let CW := seamCompTM C exit W (.wr 0)
  let H := seamCompTM CW (Sum.inr .done) E (L.tm.q₀, true)
  let M : FinTM Bool :=
    { k := k
      State := (S ⊕ WritePhase 1) ⊕ (L.State × Bool)
      tm := {H with q₀ := Sum.inl (Sum.inl entry)} }
  refine ⟨k * (B + b + 8) + 1, by omega, M, ?_⟩
  intro x
  let y := b3a_word x.length
  obtain ⟨t, counted, countCut, countSpace⟩ := counter x
  obtain ⟨written, writeCut, writeSpace⟩ := b3a_overwrite x x.length.bits
  -- Count and overwrite share the buffer; their first-exit cuts justify both dispatches.
  have countRun : C.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) t =
      b3a_cfg exit x x.length.bits := by
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0 entry x [], embedEmitTM_runFrom, counted,
      b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0]
  have countFirst : ∀ u < t, (C.runFrom (b3a_cfg entry x []) u).state ≠ some exit := by
    intro u hu
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0 entry x [], embedEmitTM_runFrom]
    exact countCut u hu
  have writeRun : W.runFrom (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4 =
      b3a_cfg .done x y := by
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0 (.wr 0) x x.length.bits,
      embedEmitTM_runFrom, written, b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0]
    rfl
  have writeFirst : ∀ u < 4,
      (W.runFrom (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) u).state ≠ some .done := by
    intro u hu
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0 (.wr 0) x x.length.bits,
      embedEmitTM_runFrom]
    exact writeCut u hu
  have cwRun : CW.runFrom (b3a_cfg (Sum.inl entry) x []) (t + 1 + 4) =
      b3a_cfg (Sum.inr .done) x y := by
    simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using seamCompTM_run_ofCfg C exit W (.wr 0)
      countRun rfl countFirst (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using writeRun)
  have cwFirst : ∀ u < t + 1 + 4,
      (CW.runFrom (b3a_cfg (Sum.inl entry) x []) u).state ≠ some (Sum.inr .done) := by
    simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using seamCompTM_firstReturn_ofCfg C exit W (.wr 0) .done
      countRun rfl countFirst (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using writeRun) rfl
      (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using writeFirst)
  -- The last phase forwards the hosted counter's full output, including its halting step.
  let u := b * (y.length + 1)
  have tag : FinTM.VirtualTag (L.tm.initCfg y).inputPos true := by
    simp [FinTM.VirtualTag, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, Cfg.init]
  obtain ⟨tagEnd, _, hosted⟩ := vhostEmitTM_runFrom L.tm (L.tm.initCfg y) true tag
    (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) [] u
  have emitted : E.runFrom (b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y) u =
      embedEmitCfg iv (fun _ _ => none) (fun _ => 0) []
        (vhostCfg (L.tm.runFrom (L.tm.initCfg y) u) tagEnd (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) []) := by
    rw [← b3a_embed_cfg (vhostEmitTM L.tm) iv iv0 (L.tm.q₀, true) x y,
      ← b3a_virtual_cfg, embedEmitTM_runFrom, hosted]
  have fullRun := seamCompTM_run_ofCfg CW (Sum.inr .done) E (L.tm.q₀, true)
    cwRun rfl cwFirst (by simpa only [b3a_cfg_map] using emitted)
  have start : M.tm.initCfg x = b3a_cfg (Sum.inl (Sum.inl entry)) x [] := by
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp [M, MultiTapeTM.initCfg, b3a_cfg, Cfg.init]
  refine ⟨(t + 1 + 4) + 1 + u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (FinTM.computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    rw [start]
    change (H.runFrom _ _).state = none ∧ (H.runFrom _ _).output = _
    rw [show b3a_cfg (Sum.inl (Sum.inl entry)) x [] =
      (b3a_cfg (Sum.inl entry) x []).mapState Sum.inl from rfl, fullRun]
    obtain ⟨halted, output⟩ := (FinTM.computesInTime_iff L y _ u).mp (computes y)
    simp only [Cfg.mapState, embedEmitCfg, vhostCfg, List.nil_append,
      halted, output, Option.map_none, y, b3a_word_length, and_self]
  · rw [start]
    change H.spaceUsed _ _ ≤ _
    -- Add the three boundary-inclusive ledgers before absorbing the constant slack.
    have firstLedger := b3a_seam_space C exit W (.wr 0) (b := 4)
      countRun rfl countFirst
    have lastLedger := b3a_seam_space CW (Sum.inr .done) E (L.tm.q₀, true) (b := u)
      cwRun rfl cwFirst
    simp only [b3a_cfg_map] at firstLedger lastLedger
    have cSpace := b3a_embed_space R ic (b3a_cfg entry x []) t
    rw [b3a_embed_cfg R ic ic0] at cSpace
    have wSpace := b3a_embed_space (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw
      (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4
    rw [b3a_embed_cfg (writeConstTM 1 0 [true]) iw iw0] at wSpace
    have eSpace := b3a_embed_space (vhostEmitTM L.tm) iv
      (vhostCfg (L.tm.initCfg y) true (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) []) u
    rw [b3a_virtual_cfg, b3a_embed_cfg (vhostEmitTM L.tm) iv iv0] at eSpace
    have eSource := vhostEmitTM_spaceUsed_le L.tm (L.tm.initCfg y) true tag
      (1 : Fin (x.length + 2)) [] u
    rw [b3a_virtual_cfg] at eSource
    have sizeBound : Nat.size y.length ≤ y.length := by
      rw [← Nat.size_eq_bits_len]
      exact length_bits_le_self _
    have width := LogProg.length_bits_le_log x.length
    have yLength : y.length = logSpace x.length := b3a_word_length _
    have nativeBound : C.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg entry x []) t ≤
        k * (B * (logSpace x.length + 1) + 1) := by
      apply cSpace.trans
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      apply Nat.add_le_add_right
      exact countSpace.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left B (Nat.add_le_add_right width 1))
    have writerBound : W.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4 ≤ k * 3 := by
      exact wSpace.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))
    have emitterBound : E.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y) u ≤
        k * (b * (logSpace x.length + 1) + logSpace x.length + 3) := by
      apply eSpace.trans
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      have ls := space y u
      have bound := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left b (Nat.add_le_add_right sizeBound 1))
      rw [yLength] at bound eSource ls
      omega
    calc
      _ ≤ C.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg entry x []) t +
          W.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (.wr 0) x x.length.bits) 4 +
          E.spaceUsed (b3a_cfg (L.tm.q₀, true) x y) u :=
        lastLedger.trans (Nat.add_le_add_right firstLedger _)
      _ ≤ k * (B * (logSpace x.length + 1) + 1) + k * 3 +
          k * (b * (logSpace x.length + 1) + logSpace x.length + 3) := by
        exact Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add nativeBound writerBound) emitterBound
      _ ≤ (k * (B + b + 8) + 1) * (logSpace x.length + 1) := by
        ring_nf; omega

/-- **The logarithm is space-constructible.** [AB09, p. 79: "all functions of
interest, including `log n`, …, are space-constructible"]

**Proof sketch.** Fill obligations: a machine that (i) counts the input length
in binary on a work tape by one left-to-right input scan with a binary
increment at each step (the `Turing.counterTM`/`incrementTM` idiom — P11 of
`machine-library-design.md` §4, space-annotated per §12 R3) — the counter word
has `|Nat.bits n| = logSpace n` cells **for `n > 0` only** (`Nat.bits 0 = []`
has length `0 ≠ logSpace 0 = 1`; round-1 audit, finding 1), so (ii) the empty
input is special-cased to emit `(logSpace 0).bits = [true]` directly, and
otherwise the machine computes the counter word's bit-length by a second count
and emits its bits. Space: the counters and markers fit in
`A·(logSpace n + 1) ≤ 2A·logSpace n` visited cells (boundary cells included
before absorbing, since `logSpace n ≥ 1`); the dominance conjunct is `le_refl`
at `S = logSpace`.

**Fill appendix.** The empty-input special case is realized uniformly: after
R8.5c counts the native input, the constant writer sets the first buffered cell
to `true`. The resulting word has length `logSpace n`, including at zero. A
Z1-hosted Catalog length counter emits its binary length and genuinely halts.
Both live exits are intercepted at their first visits. The space ledger includes
the native head intervals, the overwrite boundary, the virtual-input boundary
cells and the fresh bank, giving `A * (logSpace n + 1)` before absorption. -/
theorem spaceConstructible_logSpace : SpaceConstructible logSpace := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, M, hM⟩ := b3a_log_machine
  refine ⟨fun _ => le_rfl, 2 * A, by omega, M, ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hs⟩ := hM x
  refine ⟨t, ht, hs.trans ?_⟩
  have hlog : logSpace x.length + 1 ≤ 2 * logSpace x.length := by
    unfold logSpace
    omega
  calc
    A * (logSpace x.length + 1) ≤ A * (2 * logSpace x.length) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hlog
    _ = (2 * A) * logSpace x.length := by ring

/-- **Linear space is constructible**: `n ↦ n + 1` is space-constructible (the
`+ 1` prevents the inherited zero-bound collapse at `n = 0` — the P0
convention, `SpaceComplexity/ZeroSpace.lean` — and satisfies the dominance
conjunct; zero-space classes are nonempty, so this is about collapse, not
vacuity).

**Proof sketch.** The input-scan counter of
`Complexity.spaceConstructible_logSpace`, **initialized at `1`** so that after
`n` consumed symbols it holds `n + 1` (an uncorrected length counter holds `n`
and emits the wrong word — round-1 audit, finding 2); emit its bits. Space:
the counter's binary width plus fixed administrative cells fit in
`A·(n + 2) ≤ 2A·(n + 1)` visited cells; dominance is `logSpace n ≤ n + 1`
(`1 ≤ 1` at `n = 0`; a small arithmetic lemma otherwise).

**Fill appendix.** The counter initialized at `1` is realized by the Catalog
length counter on `true :: x`, using the proved prepend and buffered-composition
rows. Its linear running time bounds all visited work-tape cells, including
the counter width and boundary cells. -/
theorem spaceConstructible_linear : SpaceConstructible fun n => n + 1 := by
  refine ⟨fun n => Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.log_le_self 2 n), ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨P, a, hp, _⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_prepend_spaceUsed [true]
  obtain ⟨L, b, hl, _⟩ := FinTM.computesFunInTime_lengthBits_spaceUsed
  let M := FinTM.bufferedCompTM P L
  refine ⟨M.k * (a + 2 * b + 4) + 1, by omega, M, ?_⟩
  intro x
  let t := a * (x.length + 1) + (x.length + 1) + 2 + b * (x.length + 2)
  refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [M, t] using FinTM.bufferedCompTM_computesInTime P L (hp x) (hl ([true] ++ x))
  · have ht : t + 1 ≤ (a + 2 * b + 4) * (x.length + 1) := by
      dsimp [t]
      ring_nf; omega
    calc
      M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ M.k * (t + 1) :=
        M.tm.spaceUsed_le_mul_succ _ _
      _ ≤ M.k * ((a + 2 * b + 4) * (x.length + 1)) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ ht
      _ ≤ (M.k * (a + 2 * b + 4) + 1) * (x.length + 1) := by
        rw [← Nat.mul_assoc]
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_succ _)

end Complexity
```

## ===== TCSlib/Complexity/SpaceComplexity/ImplicitPoly.lean =====

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Hydroxyi
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Lib
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.Bank
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.ConfigCount

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Implicitly logspace computable functions are computable in logspace and in polynomial time

[AB09, Def 4.16 and p. 112]: an implicitly logspace computable function can be computed by a
machine with a write-once output tape in logarithmic space — for `i = 0, 1, 2, …` ask the
length language whether `i` is a position of `f(x)` and, if so, ask the bit language for
`f(x)ᵢ` and write it — and logspace computations run in polynomial time, so the function is
polynomial-time computable.

The enumeration is a register-tape program (`Complexity.LogProg.RProg`) with one register,
the binary counter `i`, calling the two deciders on the virtual input `⟨x, i⟩`; it is
compiled with `Complexity.LogProg.compile_space` against the decider bank
`Complexity.LogProg.bankTM`.

## Main results

* `Complexity.ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable.computesInSpace` — some machine computes `f` in
  space `O(log n)`. [AB09, Def 4.16; Exercise 4.8, one direction]
* `Complexity.ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable.polyTimeComputable` — `f` is polynomial-time
  computable. [AB09, p. 112: "logspace computations run in polynomial time"]

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.3, Definition 4.16; §6.2.1, p. 112.)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Turing LogProg

/-- Membership of a pair in an index language. -/
lemma pairEncode_mem_indexLang (p : List Bool → ℕ → Prop) (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    pairEncode x (Nat.bits i) ∈ indexLang p ↔ p x i := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x', i', h, hp⟩
    have := pairEncode_injective (a₁ := (x, Nat.bits i)) (a₂ := (x', Nat.bits i')) h
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at this
    obtain ⟨rfl, hb⟩ := this
    rw [bits_injective hb]; exact hp
  · intro h; exact ⟨x, i, rfl, h⟩

namespace ImplicitEnum

/-- The states of the enumeration program. -/
inductive St where
  | ask | bit | emitT | emitF | incC | incB | done
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- The ordinary transitions: emit a bit, increment the counter, halt. -/
def tm : MultiTapeTM 1 Bool St where
  q₀ := .ask
  tr
    | .emitT, _, _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), some true, some .incC⟩
    | .emitF, _, _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), some false, some .incC⟩
    | .incC, _, w => incCAct 0 .incC .incB (w 0)
    | .incB, _, w => incBAct 0 .incB .ask (w 0)
    | _, _, _ => ⟨0, fun _ => (none, 0), none, none⟩

/-- **The enumeration program**: at `ask`, ask decider `0` (the length language) about
`⟨x, i⟩`; at `bit`, ask decider `1` (the bit language); emit the answer; increment `i`. -/
def prog : RProg 1 2 St where
  tm := tm
  call
    | .ask => some ⟨0, .whole, [0], .bit, .done⟩
    | .bit => some ⟨1, .whole, [0], .emitT, .emitF⟩
    | _ => none

/-- The program configuration at the start of round `i`, having written `out`. -/
def cfg (x out : List Bool) (s : St) (i : ℕ) : Cfg 1 Bool St x :=
  ⟨some s, 1, fun _ => FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i), fun _ => 0, out⟩

/-- The virtual input of both calls in round `i` is `⟨x, i⟩`. -/
lemma vword_call (x out : List Bool) (s : St) (i : ℕ) (dec : Fin 2) (yes no : St) :
    vword (callSegs ⟨dec, .whole, [0], yes, no⟩ x (regWords (cfg x out s i))) =
      pairEncode x (Nat.bits i) := by
  simp [callSegs, argSegs, regWords, cfg, tapeWord_bufferTape, vword, Mode.seg0, render,
    pairEncode_eq_dbl]

/-- The enumerator configuration `cfg x out s i` is in state `s`. -/
@[simp] lemma cfg_state (x out : List Bool) (s : St) (i : ℕ) : (cfg x out s i).state = some s :=
  rfl

/-- The call at `ask`. -/
lemma rstep_ask (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool) (x out : List Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    rstep prog o (cfg x out .ask i) =
      cfg x out (if o 0 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) then .bit else .done) i := by
  have h := vword_call x out .ask i 0 .bit .done
  have hc : prog.call .ask = some ⟨0, .whole, [0], .bit, .done⟩ := rfl
  simp only [rstep, cfg_state, hc]
  rw [h]; rfl

/-- The call at `bit`. -/
lemma rstep_bit (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool) (x out : List Bool) (i : ℕ) :
    rstep prog o (cfg x out .bit i) =
      cfg x out (if o 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) then .emitT else .emitF) i := by
  have h := vword_call x out .bit i 1 .emitT .emitF
  have hc : prog.call .bit = some ⟨1, .whole, [0], .emitT, .emitF⟩ := rfl
  simp only [rstep, cfg_state, hc]
  rw [h]; rfl

section Run

variable (f : List Bool → List Bool) (o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool)
  (ho0 : ∀ x i, o 0 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) = decide (i < (f x).length))
  (ho1 : ∀ x i, o 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) = (f x).getD i false)

/-- The configurations met along the run: a call configuration of some round, or an ordinary
configuration with the counter head in `[-1, W]`. -/
def Shape (x : List Bool) (F W : ℕ) (c : Cfg 1 Bool St x) : Prop :=
  (∃ out s i, i ≤ F ∧ (s = .ask ∨ s = .bit) ∧ c = cfg x out s i) ∨
  ((∀ l, c.state = some l → prog.call l = none) ∧ -1 ≤ c.workTapePos 0 ∧
    c.workTapePos 0 ≤ W)

/-- Writing the binary word of `n` on the counter of an enumerator configuration gives the
enumerator configuration with counter `n`. -/
lemma regCfg_cfg (x out : List Bool) (s s' : St) (i : ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    regCfg (cfg x out s i) s' 0 (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits n)) 0 = cfg x out s' n := by
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · funext r; rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero r]; simp [regCfg, cfg]
  · funext r; rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero r]; simp [regCfg, cfg]

include ho0 ho1 in
/-- **One round**: from round `i < |f x|` with `f(x)₀ … f(x)ᵢ₋₁` written, the program
writes `f(x)ᵢ` and reaches round `i + 1`.

**Proof sketch.** The round asks the bit decider (a call on `⟨x, bits i⟩`), emits the answer
`f(x)ᵢ` (`rstep_bit`), then increments the counter `i` with the increment fragment (`inc_run`).
Every intermediate configuration has the counter in binary of length at most `W` and output a
prefix of `f x`, which is `Shape`. -/
lemma round (x : List Bool) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < (f x).length) (F W : ℕ) (hF : (f x).length ≤ F)
    (hW : (Nat.bits (i + 1)).length ≤ W) :
    ∃ T, rrun prog o (cfg x ((f x).take i) .ask i) T = cfg x ((f x).take (i + 1)) .ask (i + 1) ∧
      ∀ t < T, Shape x F W (rrun prog o (cfg x ((f x).take i) .ask i) t) := by
  set b := (f x)[i] with hb
  have h1 : rrun prog o (cfg x ((f x).take i) .ask i) 1 = cfg x ((f x).take i) .bit i := by
    rw [rrun_one, rstep_ask, ho0]
    simp [hi]
  have h2 : rrun prog o (cfg x ((f x).take i) .bit i) 1 =
      cfg x ((f x).take i) (if b then .emitT else .emitF) i := by
    rw [rrun_one, rstep_bit, ho1]
    simp [hb, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]
  have h3 : rrun prog o (cfg x ((f x).take i) (if b then .emitT else .emitF) i) 1 =
      cfg x ((f x).take (i + 1)) .incC i := by
    rw [rrun_one, rstep_noncall prog o _ (if b then .emitT else .emitF) rfl (by cases b <;> rfl)]
    unfold MultiTapeTM.step
    simp only [cfg]
    have ht : (f x).take (i + 1) = (f x).take i ++ [b] := by
      rw [hb, List.take_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]; rfl
    rw [ht]
    cases b <;> (refine Cfg.ext rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_) <;> simp [prog, tm, Action.apply]
  obtain ⟨T₄, h4, hm4⟩ := inc_run prog o 0 .incC .incB .ask (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    rfl rfl (cfg x ((f x).take (i + 1)) .incC i) i
  rw [regCfg_cfg, regCfg_cfg] at h4
  refine ⟨1 + (1 + (1 + T₄)), ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  · rw [rrun_add, h1, rrun_add, h2, rrun_add, h3, h4]
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
    · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      exact Or.inl ⟨_, .ask, i, by omega, Or.inl rfl, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = 1 + t' := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [rrun_add, h1]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
    · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      exact Or.inl ⟨_, .bit, i, by omega, Or.inr rfl, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = 1 + t' := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [rrun_add, h2]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t 1 with h | h
    · obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
      refine Or.inr ⟨fun l hl => ?_, by simp [rrun_zero, cfg], by simp [rrun_zero, cfg]⟩
      simp only [rrun_zero, cfg, Option.some.injEq] at hl
      subst hl; cases b <;> rfl
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = 1 + t' := ⟨t - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [rrun_add, h3]
    obtain ⟨s', f', q, hq, hs', hq1, hq2⟩ := hm4 t (by omega)
    rw [regCfg_cfg] at hq
    rw [hq]
    refine Or.inr ⟨fun l hl => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [regCfg, Option.some.injEq] at hl
      subst hl; rcases hs' with rfl | rfl <;> rfl
    · simpa [regCfg] using hq1
    · simp only [regCfg, Function.update_self]; omega

include ho0 ho1 in
/-- All rounds: from the start the program reaches round `i ≤ |f x|`. -/
lemma rounds (x : List Bool) (F W : ℕ) (hF : (f x).length ≤ F)
    (hW : ∀ i < (f x).length, (Nat.bits (i + 1)).length ≤ W) :
    ∀ i ≤ (f x).length, ∃ T, rrun prog o (cfg x [] .ask 0) T = cfg x ((f x).take i) .ask i ∧
      ∀ t < T, Shape x F W (rrun prog o (cfg x [] .ask 0) t) := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro _; exact ⟨0, by simp [rrun_zero], fun t ht => absurd ht (by omega)⟩
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi
    obtain ⟨T₁, h1, hm1⟩ := ih (by omega)
    obtain ⟨T₂, h2, hm2⟩ := round f o ho0 ho1 x i (by omega) F W hF (hW i (by omega))
    refine ⟨T₁ + T₂, by rw [rrun_add, h1, h2], fun t ht => ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T₁ with h | h
    · exact hm1 t h
    · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = T₁ + t' := ⟨t - T₁, by omega⟩
      rw [rrun_add, h1]; exact hm2 t' (by omega)

include ho0 ho1 in
/-- **The whole run**: the program halts with output `f x`, every configuration before the
halt having the shape `Shape`.

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the number of rounds: `round` takes round `i` to round `i + 1`
for `i < |f x|`; at `i = |f x|` the length decider answers no and the program halts with output
`f x` and counter head home. The shape invariant is collected round by round. -/
lemma run (x : List Bool) (F W : ℕ) (hF : (f x).length ≤ F)
    (hW : ∀ i < (f x).length, (Nat.bits (i + 1)).length ≤ W) :
    ∃ N, (rrun prog o (Cfg.init .ask x) N).state = none ∧
      (rrun prog o (Cfg.init .ask x) N).output = f x ∧
      (rrun prog o (Cfg.init .ask x) N).workTapePos 0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ t < N, Shape x F W (rrun prog o (Cfg.init .ask x) t) := by
  have hinit : (Cfg.init .ask x : Cfg 1 Bool St x) = cfg x [] .ask 0 := by
    refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ rfl rfl
    funext r z; simp [cfg, Nat.zero_bits]
  rw [hinit]
  obtain ⟨T, h1, hm1⟩ := rounds f o ho0 ho1 x F W hF hW (f x).length le_rfl
  rw [List.take_length] at h1
  have h2 : rrun prog o (cfg x (f x) .ask (f x).length) 1 = cfg x (f x) .done (f x).length := by
    rw [rrun_one, rstep_ask, ho0]; simp
  have h3 : (rrun prog o (cfg x (f x) .done (f x).length) 1).state = none ∧
      (rrun prog o (cfg x (f x) .done (f x).length) 1).output = f x ∧
      (rrun prog o (cfg x (f x) .done (f x).length) 1).workTapePos 0 = 0 := by
    rw [rrun_one, rstep_noncall prog o _ .done rfl rfl]
    simp [MultiTapeTM.step, cfg, prog, tm, Action.apply]
  refine ⟨T + (1 + 1), ?_, ?_, ?_, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  · rw [rrun_add, h1, rrun_add, h2]; exact h3.1
  · rw [rrun_add, h1, rrun_add, h2]; exact h3.2.1
  · rw [rrun_add, h1, rrun_add, h2]; exact h3.2.2
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t T with h | h
    · exact hm1 t h
    · obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ : ∃ t', t = T + t' := ⟨t - T, by omega⟩
      rw [rrun_add, h1]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t' 1 with h' | h'
      · obtain rfl : t' = 0 := by omega
        exact Or.inl ⟨_, .ask, _, hF, Or.inl rfl, rfl⟩
      · obtain rfl : t' = 1 := by omega
        rw [h2]
        refine Or.inr ⟨fun l hl => ?_, by simp [cfg], by simp [cfg]⟩
        simp only [cfg_state, Option.some.injEq] at hl
        subst hl; rfl

end Run

end ImplicitEnum

/-- **Implicitly logspace computable functions are computable in logspace** [AB09, Def 4.16;
one direction of Exercise 4.8]: some machine computes `f` visiting `O(log n)` work cells.

**Proof sketch.** The enumeration program `ImplicitEnum.prog` keeps `i` in binary on one
register and, for `i = 0, 1, …`, asks the length language and the bit language about `⟨x, i⟩`
and writes the answer (`ImplicitEnum.run`). `i ≤ |f(x)| ≤ C (n+1)^e`, so the counter has
`O(log n)` bits, and the deciders run on inputs of length `2n + 2 + O(log n)`, in space
`O(log n)`. `compile_space` turns the program into a machine computing `f` within the
register range plus `kD (2B + 1)` cells, which `log_poly_bound` shows to be `O(log n)`. -/
theorem ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable.computesInSpace {f : List Bool → List Bool}
    (hf : ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable f) :
    ∃ (M : FinTM Bool) (c : ℕ), M.ComputesInSpace f fun n => c * logSpace n := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨C, e, hlen⟩, ⟨c1, M1, hM1⟩, ⟨c0, M0, hM0⟩⟩ := hf
  let Ms : Fin 2 → FinTM Bool := fun j => if j = 0 then M0 else M1
  let A : Fin 2 → Language Bool := fun j => if j = 0 then
    indexLang (fun x i => i < (f x).length) else indexLang (fun x i => (f x).getD i false = true)
  let s : Fin 2 → ℕ → ℕ := fun j n => if j = 0 then c0 * logSpace n else c1 * logSpace n
  have hMs : ∀ j, (Ms j).DecidesInSpace (A j) (s j) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj; simpa [Ms, A, s] using hM0
    · have hj1 : j = 1 := Fin.ext (by
        have := j.isLt; have : j.val ≠ 0 := fun h => hj (Fin.ext h); simp; omega)
      subst hj1; simpa [Ms, A, s] using hM1
  let o : Fin 2 → List Bool → Bool := fun j V => MultiTapeTM.indicator (A j : Set (List Bool)) V
  have ho0 : ∀ x i, o 0 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) = decide (i < (f x).length) := by
    intro x i
    have := pairEncode_mem_indexLang (fun x i => i < (f x).length) x i
    by_cases h : i < (f x).length <;>
      simp_all [o, A, MultiTapeTM.indicator]
  have ho1 : ∀ x i, o 1 (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)) = (f x).getD i false := by
    intro x i
    have := pairEncode_mem_indexLang (fun x i => (f x).getD i false = true) x i
    cases h : (f x).getD i false <;> simp_all [o, A, MultiTapeTM.indicator]
  obtain ⟨K1, hK1⟩ := LogProg.log_poly_bound C e 1
  obtain ⟨K2, hK2⟩ := LogProg.log_poly_bound (C + 2) (e + 1) 2
  set kD := bankK Ms + bankK Ms with hkD
  refine ⟨compileFinTM ImplicitEnum.prog .ask (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms),
    K1 + 2 + kD * (2 * ((c0 + c1) * K2 + 1) + 1), fun x => ?_⟩
  set n := x.length with hn
  set F := C * (n + 1) ^ e with hFdef
  set W := Nat.log 2 (F + 1) + 1 with hWdef
  set B := (c0 + c1) * logSpace (2 * n + 2 + W) + 1 with hBdef
  have hF : (f x).length ≤ F := hlen x
  have hbitsW : ∀ i ≤ F + 1, (Nat.bits i).length ≤ W := fun i hi =>
    (LogProg.length_bits_le_log i).trans (by have := Nat.log_mono_right (b := 2) hi; omega)
  obtain ⟨N, hN1, hN2, hN3, hNs⟩ := ImplicitEnum.run f o ho0 ho1 x F W hF
    (fun i hi => hbitsW (i + 1) (by omega))
  have hbox : ∀ t ≤ N, ∀ r : Fin 1, (-1 : ℤ) ≤ (rrun ImplicitEnum.prog o (Cfg.init .ask x) t).workTapePos r ∧
      (rrun ImplicitEnum.prog o (Cfg.init .ask x) t).workTapePos r ≤ (W : ℤ) := by
    intro t ht r
    rw [Fin.fin_one_eq_zero r]
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge t N with h | h
    · rcases hNs t h with ⟨out, s', i, -, -, hc⟩ | ⟨-, h1, h2⟩
      · rw [hc]; simp [ImplicitEnum.cfg]
      · exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · obtain rfl : t = N := by omega
      rw [hN3]; simp
  have hcalls : ∀ t < N, CallOK ImplicitEnum.prog (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms) o (fun _ => -1)
      (fun _ => (W : ℤ)) B (rrun ImplicitEnum.prog o (Cfg.init .ask x) t) := by
    intro t ht l cs hl hcs
    rcases hNs t ht with ⟨out, s', i, hi, hs', hc⟩ | ⟨hnc, -, -⟩
    · rw [hc] at hl ⊢
      simp only [ImplicitEnum.cfg_state, Option.some.injEq] at hl
      subst hl
      have hreg : regWords (ImplicitEnum.cfg x out s' i) = fun _ => Nat.bits i := by
        funext r; simp [regWords, ImplicitEnum.cfg, tapeWord_bufferTape]
      have hV : vword (callSegs cs x (regWords (ImplicitEnum.cfg x out s' i))) =
          pairEncode x (Nat.bits i) := by
        rcases hs' with rfl | rfl <;> simp only [ImplicitEnum.prog, Option.some.injEq] at hcs <;>
          (subst hcs; exact ImplicitEnum.vword_call _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
      have hargs : cs.args = [0] := by
        rcases hs' with rfl | rfl <;> simp only [ImplicitEnum.prog, Option.some.injEq] at hcs <;>
          (subst hcs; rfl)
      refine ⟨by rw [hargs]; simp, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro r hr
        rw [hargs] at hr
        simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hr
        subst hr
        rw [hreg]
        refine ⟨rfl, rfl, le_rfl, ?_⟩
        beta_reduce
        exact_mod_cast hbitsW i (by omega)
      · rw [hV]
        refine (bank_cleanRun Ms A s hMs cs.dec _).mono ?_
        have hlenV : (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)).length ≤ 2 * n + 2 + W := by
          have := hbitsW i (by omega)
          simp [pairEncode, hn]; omega
        have hsj : s cs.dec (pairEncode x (Nat.bits i)).length ≤
            (c0 + c1) * logSpace (2 * n + 2 + W) := by
          have hm := logSpace_mono hlenV
          simp only [s]
          split_ifs
          · exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c0 hm).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega))
          · exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left c1 hm).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega))
        simp only [hBdef]
        omega
    · exact absurd hcs (by rw [hnc l hl]; simp)
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTs⟩ := compile_space ImplicitEnum.prog .ask (bankTM Ms) (bankStart Ms) o
    (fun _ => -1) (fun _ => (W : ℤ)) B N (f x) hN1 hN2 hbox hcalls
  refine ⟨T, hT, hTs.trans ?_⟩
  -- the arithmetic
  simp only [Finset.univ_unique, Fin.default_eq_zero, Finset.sum_singleton]
  have hW2 : (((W : ℤ) - -1 + 1).toNat) = W + 2 := by omega
  rw [hW2]
  set L := logSpace n with hL
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ L := by simp [hL, logSpace]
  have hWL : W + 2 ≤ (K1 + 2) * L := by
    have := hK1 n
    simp only [hWdef, hFdef]
    have : (K1 + 2) * L = K1 * L + 2 * L := by ring
    simp only [logSpace] at hL
    rw [hL] at *
    omega
  have hlogW : logSpace (2 * n + 2 + W) ≤ K2 * L := by
    have hWle : W ≤ F + 2 := by
      have := Nat.log_le_self 2 (F + 1); omega
    have hle : 2 * n + 2 + W ≤ (C + 2) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) + 2 := by
      have h1 : n + 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) := by
        calc n + 1 = (n + 1) ^ 1 := by ring
          _ ≤ (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
      have h2 : (n + 1) ^ e ≤ (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
      have h3 : F ≤ C * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left C h2
      have : (C + 2) * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) = C * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) + 2 * (n + 1) ^ (e + 1) := by
        ring
      omega
    have := hK2 n
    have hm := logSpace_mono hle
    simp only [logSpace] at hm this ⊢
    simp only [hL, logSpace]
    omega
  have hBL : 2 * B + 1 ≤ (2 * ((c0 + c1) * K2 + 1) + 1) * L := by
    have h1 : (c0 + c1) * logSpace (2 * n + 2 + W) ≤ (c0 + c1) * (K2 * L) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hlogW
    have e1 : (2 * ((c0 + c1) * K2 + 1) + 1) * L = 2 * ((c0 + c1) * (K2 * L)) + 3 * L := by ring
    rw [e1]
    simp only [hBdef]
    omega
  calc W + 2 + kD * (2 * B + 1) ≤ (K1 + 2) * L + kD * ((2 * ((c0 + c1) * K2 + 1) + 1) * L) :=
        Nat.add_le_add hWL (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hBL)
    _ = (K1 + 2 + kD * (2 * ((c0 + c1) * K2 + 1) + 1)) * L := by ring

/-- **Implicitly logspace computable functions are polynomial-time computable**
[AB09, p. 112: "logspace computations run in polynomial time"].

**Proof sketch.** `ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable.computesInSpace` gives a machine computing
`f` in logarithmic space; by configuration counting
(`Complexity.polyTimeComputable_of_computesInSpace`) it runs in polynomial time. -/
theorem ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable.polyTimeComputable {f : List Bool → List Bool}
    (hf : ImplicitlyLogspaceComputable f) : PolyTimeComputable f := by
  obtain ⟨M, c, hM⟩ := hf.computesInSpace
  exact polyTimeComputable_of_computesInSpace hM

end Complexity
```

```
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: Seyoon Ragavan
-/
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.Machines.DblLang

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# Random access to a general input in logarithmic space

A logspace machine reads its input at a position held in binary on a work tape [AB09, §4.1:
"a pointer into the input"]. The received `LogProg` layer has no such access for a general
(non-unary) input: the input instructions of `Complexity.LogProg.ARM` presuppose inputs
`⟨1ⁿ, w⟩` or `⟨1ⁿ, ⟨u, w⟩⟩`, and a call's virtual input is the whole input or its leading run
of `1`s followed by register words (P0 reception audit, `audits/ch34-p0-findings.md`). This
file supplies the missing piece twice, at the two levels later logspace programs use:

* **as a program fragment**: `Complexity.LogProg.readIn_run` reads bit `i` of the input,
  `i` held in binary on a register, into the control state (a counter register stepped up to
  `i` in lockstep with the input head, the received equality, increment, rewind and clear
  fragments), and restores everything else;
* **as a language pair**: `Complexity.implicitlyLogspaceComputable_id` — the bit and length
  languages of the identity, `Complexity.inputBitLang` and `Complexity.inputLenLang`, are in
  `L` — so an abstract register machine reads its own input at a register-held position by a
  `whole`-mode call with that register as its one argument (`Complexity.LogProg.vword_whole₁`,
  `Complexity.indicator_indexLang_pairEncode`).

Phase P4.4b of `AroraBarakChapters3-4Plan.md` (the B7 statement mini-phase, recorded in
`audits/ch4-p44-resolutions-addendum.md`). The fragment is campaign-owned and lives here,
not in `Machines/`, by decision D3; it is built only from received fragments.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.LogProg.RdPh`, `Complexity.LogProg.readTr` — the phases and the transition
  table of the input-read fragment.
* `Complexity.inputBitLang`, `Complexity.inputLenLang` — `{⟨u, i⟩ | uᵢ = 1}` and
  `{⟨u, i⟩ | i < |u|}`.

## Main results

* `Complexity.LogProg.vword_whole₁` — a `whole` call with one argument presents `⟨u, V r⟩`.
* `Complexity.indicator_indexLang_pairEncode` — the answer of an `indexLang` decider on a
  genuine pair.
* `Complexity.pairEncode_ne_nil` — no pair is empty (so `[]` lies in no `indexLang`).
* `Complexity.pairEncode_getD` — a shared bit-address formula for doubled fields,
  separators, and suffixes of paired inputs.
* `Complexity.LogProg.alignedPair_loop` — a bounded ARM pair scan at any positive stride.
* `Complexity.LogProg.register_update_le` — the shared register-bound update rule.
* `Complexity.LogProg.registerCopy_loop` — copy by bounded counting, preserving the source.
* `Complexity.LogProg.registerScale_loop` — consume a source into a scaled destination.
* `Complexity.LogProg.canonicalTail_loop` — canonical-tail and width validation before decoding.
* `Complexity.LogProg.boundedDecode_loop` — reverse binary decoding after the width check.
* `Complexity.LogProg.indexedSeek_loop` — bounded positioning within a strided segment.
* `Complexity.LogProg.inputLength_loop` — a bounded ARM loop counting a general input
  through its length-query oracle.
* `Complexity.LogProg.readIn_run` — the input-read fragment (proved; phase-P4.4b
  statement).
* `Complexity.implicitlyLogspaceComputable_id` — input random access in `L` (proved;
  phase-P4.4b statement), with `Complexity.inputBitLang_mem`, `Complexity.inputLenLang_mem`.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.1; §4.3, Definition 4.16.)
-/

namespace Complexity

open Turing

/-- No pair encoding is the empty word: `pairEncode x y` contains the separator. -/
theorem pairEncode_ne_nil (x y : List Bool) : pairEncode x y ≠ [] := by
  intro h
  have := congrArg List.length h
  simp [length_pairEncode] at this

/-- **The answer of an index-language decider on a genuine pair**: the indicator of
`indexLang p` at `⟨u, bits v⟩` is the decision of `p u v`. -/
theorem indicator_indexLang_pairEncode (p : List Bool → ℕ → Prop) (u : List Bool) (v : ℕ) :
    MultiTapeTM.indicator (indexLang p : Set (List Bool)) (pairEncode u (Nat.bits v)) =
      @decide (p u v) (Classical.dec _) := by
  rw [LogProg.indicator_eq_decide]
  exact decide_eq_decide.mpr (pairEncode_mem_indexLang p u v)

namespace LogProg

/-- **A `whole`-mode call with one argument** presents the pair of the whole input and the
argument register's word: its virtual input is `⟨u, V r⟩`. -/
theorem vword_whole₁ {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} (u : List Bool) (j : Fin d) (r : Fin m) (l₁ l₀ : Λ)
    (V : Fin m → List Bool) :
    vword (callSegs ⟨j, .whole, [r], l₁, l₀⟩ u V) = pairEncode u (V r) := by
  simp [callSegs, Mode.seg0, argSegs, vword, render, pairEncode_eq_dbl]

/-! ## The input-read fragment -/

/-- The phases of the input-read fragment: the equality test of the counter with the index
(`eC`, `eBy`, `eBn`), the read (`yes`) or advance (`no`) step, the counter increment (`iC`,
`iB`), and, carrying the symbol read, the input rewind (`rw₁`, `rw₂`) and the counter clear
(`cR`, `cE`). -/
inductive RdPh where
  | eC | eBy | eBn
  | yes | no
  | iC | iB
  | rw₁ (a : Option Bool) | rw₂ (a : Option Bool)
  | cR (a : Option Bool) | cE (a : Option Bool)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

variable {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} {x : List Bool}

/-- **The transition table of the input-read fragment** on index register `r` and counter
register `s`, its phases embedded by `st` and its exits by `ex`. With the input head on
position `k + 1` (input symbol `k`) and the counter holding `bits k`: compare the counter with
the index (`eq_run`); if equal, take the symbol under the head; if not, stop at the right
blank, or else step the input head right and increment the counter (`inc_run`). Then rewind
the input head to position `1` (`rewind_x`) and clear the counter (`clr_run`), exiting into
`ex a` with the symbol `a` taken. -/
def readTr (r s : Fin m) (st : RdPh → Λ) (ex : Option Bool → Λ) :
    RdPh → Option Bool → (Fin m → Option Bool) → Action m Bool Λ
  | .eC, _, w => eqCAct s r (st .eC) (st .eBy) (st .eBn) (w s) (w r)
  | .eBy, _, w => eqBAct s r (st .eBy) (st .yes) (w s)
  | .eBn, _, w => eqBAct s r (st .eBn) (st .no) (w s)
  | .yes, a, _ => goAct (st (.rw₁ a))
  | .no, a, _ =>
    match a with
    | none => goAct (st (.rw₁ none))
    | some _ => xAct s 1 0 (st .iC)
  | .iC, _, w => incCAct s (st .iC) (st .iB) (w s)
  | .iB, _, w => incBAct s (st .iB) (st .eC) (w s)
  | .rw₁ a, _, _ => xAct s (-1) 0 (st (.rw₂ a))
  | .rw₂ a, b, _ => rw2Act s (st (.rw₂ a)) (st (.cR a)) b
  | .cR a, _, w => toEndAct s (st (.cR a)) (st (.cE a)) (w s)
  | .cE a, _, w => clrEAct s (st (.cE a)) (ex a) (w s)

/-- A proof-only instance of the frozen read table, with disjoint phase and exit labels.
Exits halt, which lets the received fragments' non-call trace clauses recover phase
membership before the final exit. The eventual transport does not require `st` injective. -/
private def readModel (r s : Fin m) : RProg m 0 (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) :=
  ⟨⟨.inl .eC, fun l a w => match l with
    | .inl ph => readTr r s Sum.inl Sum.inr ph a w
    | .inr _ => junkAct⟩, fun _ => none⟩

/-- A read-fragment boundary with its input position and canonical counter explicit. -/
private def readAt (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (s : Fin m)
    (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (k : ℕ) :
    Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x :=
  ⟨some l, ip, Function.update c.workTapes s (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits k)),
    Function.update c.workTapePos s 0, c.output⟩

/-- The frame and head-range assertion, before restricting the control label to a phase. -/
private def readFrame (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (d : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) : Prop :=
  ∃ l ip f p q, d = ⟨some l, ip, Function.update c.workTapes s f,
      Function.update (Function.update c.workTapePos s p) r q, c.output⟩ ∧
    -1 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ (Nat.bits (x.length + 1)).length ∧
    -1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (Nat.bits (x.length + 1)).length

/-- A counter-only fragment view satisfies the frame. -/
private theorem readFrame_reg (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (l l' : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (k : ℕ) (f : ℤ → Option Bool) (p : ℤ)
    (hp : -1 ≤ p) (hp' : p ≤ (Nat.bits (x.length + 1)).length) :
    readFrame c r s (regCfg (readAt c s l ip k) l' s f p) := by
  refine ⟨l', ip, f, p, 0, ?_, hp, hp', by omega, by omega⟩
  refine Cfg.ext rfl rfl ?_ ?_ rfl
  · simp [regCfg, readAt]
  · simp [regCfg, readAt, Function.update_of_ne hrs, hrp]

/-- A boundary configuration is framed with both active heads at the origin. -/
private theorem readFrame_at (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (k : ℕ) : readFrame c r s (readAt c s l ip k) := by
  have he : regCfg (readAt c s l ip k) l s (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits k)) 0 =
      readAt c s l ip k := by simp [regCfg, readAt]
  rw [← he]
  exact readFrame_reg c r s hrs hrp l l ip k _ 0 (by omega) (by omega)

/-- The comparison fragment is framed, with its common head position bounded by the
counter word rather than by the possibly much longer index word.

**Proof sketch.** Apply the received equality fragment with the counter as its first
register. Its trace moves the two heads together, so the counter length bounds both;
rewrite its configuration view into the frame and use monotonicity of binary length. -/
private theorem read_eq (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (i k : ℕ) (hr : c.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i))
    (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (hk : k ≤ x.length)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
    ∃ T, rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ip k) T =
        readAt c s (.inl (if k = i then .yes else .no)) ip k ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s
        (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ip k) n) := by
  obtain ⟨T, he, hm⟩ := eq_run (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) s r (Ne.symm hrs)
    (.inl .eC) (.inl .eBy) (.inl .eBn) (.inl .yes) (.inl .no)
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl rfl rfl
    (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ip k) k i (by simp [readAt])
    (by simp [readAt, hrs, hr])
  have view (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) :
      eqCfg (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ip k) l s r 0 = readAt c s l ip k := by
    simp [eqCfg, readAt, Function.update_of_ne hrs, hrp]
  rw [view, view] at he
  refine ⟨T, ?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  · simpa only [apply_ite Sum.inl] using he
  · rw [view] at hm
    obtain ⟨l, p, he', _, hlo, hhi⟩ := hm n hn
    refine ⟨l, ip, FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits k), p, p, ?_, hlo, ?_, hlo, ?_⟩
    · rw [he']; simp [eqCfg, readAt]
    all_goals
      have hw := length_bits_mono (show k ≤ x.length + 1 by omega)
      omega

/-- One ordinary model step applies the frozen table. -/
private theorem read_one (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (ph : RdPh) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (k : ℕ) :
    rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl ph) ip k) 1 =
      (readTr r s Sum.inl Sum.inr ph (inSym x ip.val)
        (readAt c s (.inl ph) ip k).workTapeSymbols).apply (readAt c s (.inl ph) ip k) := by
  rw [rrun_one, rstep_noncall (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) _ (.inl ph) rfl rfl]
  simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, readModel, readAt, inputSymbol_eq, inSym]

/-- Rewind and clear restore the boundary input head and the empty counter.

**Proof sketch.** Invoke `rewind_x` at the current input position, then `clr_run` on the
counter. Both leave the index tape and all unrelated tapes unchanged. -/
private theorem read_cleanup (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ x.length)
    (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (a : Option Bool) :
    ∃ T, rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl (.rw₁ a)) ip k) T =
        readAt c s (.inr a) 1 0 ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s
        (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl (.rw₁ a)) ip k) n) := by
  obtain ⟨A, heA, hmA⟩ := rewind_x (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
    (readAt c s (.inl (.rw₁ a)) ip k) s 0 (.inl (.rw₁ a)) (.inl (.rw₂ a)) (.inl (.cR a))
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl rfl ip
  have xv (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) (jp : Fin (x.length + 2)) :
      xCfg (readAt c s (.inl (.rw₁ a)) ip k) l jp s 0 = readAt c s l jp k := by
    simp [xCfg, readAt]
  rw [xv, xv] at heA
  have hone : (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (x.length + 2)) = 1 := by
    apply Fin.ext; simp
  rw [hone] at heA
  obtain ⟨B, heB, hmB⟩ := clr_run (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) s
    (.inl (.cR a)) (.inl (.cE a)) (.inr a)
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl rfl (readAt c s (.inl (.cR a)) 1 k) k
  have rv (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) (j : ℕ) :
      regCfg (readAt c s (.inl (.cR a)) 1 k) l s (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits j)) 0 =
      readAt c s l 1 j := by simp [regCfg, readAt]
  rw [rv, rv] at heB
  refine ⟨A + B, by rw [rrun_add, heA, heB], fun n hn => ?_⟩
  by_cases hnA : n < A
  · rw [xv] at hmA
    obtain ⟨l, jp, he, _⟩ := hmA n hnA
    rw [he, xv]
    exact readFrame_at c r s hrs hrp l jp k
  · have hn' : n = A + (n - A) := by omega
    rw [hn', rrun_add, heA]
    rw [rv] at hmB
    obtain ⟨l, f, p, he, _, hlo, hhi⟩ := hmB (n - A) (by omega)
    rw [he]
    exact readFrame_reg c r s hrs hrp _ l 1 k f p hlo
      (hhi.trans (by exact_mod_cast length_bits_mono (show k ≤ x.length + 1 by omega)))

/-- Advance one counter/input position when both the requested index and the input end
are still ahead.

**Proof sketch.** The received equality fragment answers no. One table step advances the
input head, and the received increment fragment advances the counter. -/
private theorem read_advance (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (i k : ℕ) (hr : c.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i))
    (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (hk : k < min i x.length) :
    ∃ T, rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
        (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ k) T =
        readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨k + 2, by omega⟩ (k + 1) ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
        (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ k) n) := by
  obtain ⟨A, heA, hmA⟩ := read_eq c r s hrs i k hr hrp (by omega) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩
  rw [if_neg (show k ≠ i by omega)] at heA
  have he1 : rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
      (readAt c s (.inl .no) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ k) 1 =
      readAt c s (.inl .iC) ⟨k + 2, by omega⟩ k := by
    rw [read_one, inSym_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem (show k < x.length by omega)]
    simp only [readTr]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ (by simp [Action.apply, xAct, readAt])
    · apply Fin.ext
      simpa only [Action.apply, xAct, readAt] using
        (moveInputPos_pos_val (x := x) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ (by dsimp; omega))
    · funext j z; simp [Action.apply, xAct, readAt]
    · funext j; simp [Action.apply, xAct, readAt]
  obtain ⟨B, heB, hmB⟩ := inc_run (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) s
    (.inl .iC) (.inl .iB) (.inl .eC) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl rfl
    (readAt c s (.inl .iC) ⟨k + 2, by omega⟩ k) k
  have rv (l : RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) (j : ℕ) :
      regCfg (readAt c s (.inl .iC) ⟨k + 2, by omega⟩ k) l s (FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits j)) 0 =
      readAt c s l ⟨k + 2, by omega⟩ j := by simp [regCfg, readAt]
  rw [rv, rv] at heB
  refine ⟨A + (1 + B), by rw [rrun_add, heA, rrun_add, he1, heB], fun n hn => ?_⟩
  by_cases hnA : n < A
  · exact hmA n hnA
  · have hn' : n = A + (n - A) := by omega
    rw [hn', rrun_add, heA]
    by_cases heq : n - A = 0
    · rw [heq, rrun_zero]
      exact readFrame_at c r s hrs hrp _ _ _
    · have hn'' : n - A = 1 + (n - A - 1) := by omega
      rw [hn'', rrun_add, he1]
      rw [rv] at hmB
      obtain ⟨l, f, p, he, _, hlo, hhi⟩ := hmB (n - A - 1) (by omega)
      rw [he]
      exact readFrame_reg c r s hrs hrp _ l _ k f p hlo
        (hhi.trans (by exact_mod_cast length_bits_mono (show k + 1 ≤ x.length + 1 by omega)))

/-- At the smaller of the desired index and input length, read the answer and clean up.

**Proof sketch.** Equality selects the requested cell when the index is reached; otherwise
this is the right blank and the requested answer is also `none`. Rewind and clear complete
the routine. -/
private theorem read_finish (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (i : ℕ) (hr : c.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i))
    (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) :
    ∃ T, rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
        (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨min i x.length + 1, by omega⟩ (min i x.length)) T =
        readAt c s (.inr x[i]?) 1 0 ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
        (readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨min i x.length + 1, by omega⟩ (min i x.length)) n) := by
  let k := min i x.length
  let ip : Fin (x.length + 2) := ⟨k + 1, by dsimp [k]; omega⟩
  obtain ⟨A, heA, hmA⟩ := read_eq c r s hrs i k hr hrp (by dsimp [k]; omega) ip
  have he1 : rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0)
      (readAt c s (.inl (if k = i then .yes else .no)) ip k) 1 =
      readAt c s (.inl (.rw₁ x[i]?)) ip k := by
    by_cases hki : k = i
    · rw [if_pos hki, read_one]
      have hin : inSym x ip.val = x[i]? := by dsimp [ip]; rw [inSym_succ, hki]
      rw [hin]
      simp [readTr, goAct, Action.apply, readAt]
    · have hklen : k = x.length := by dsimp [k] at *; omega
      have hi : x.length ≤ i := by dsimp [k] at *; omega
      rw [if_neg hki, read_one]
      have hin : inSym x ip.val = none := by dsimp [ip]; rw [inSym_succ, hklen]; simp
      rw [hin, List.getElem?_eq_none hi]
      simp [readTr, goAct, Action.apply, readAt]
  obtain ⟨B, heB, hmB⟩ := read_cleanup c r s hrs hrp k (by dsimp [k]; omega) ip x[i]?
  refine ⟨A + (1 + B), by rw [rrun_add, heA, rrun_add, he1, heB], fun n hn => ?_⟩
  by_cases hnA : n < A
  · exact hmA n hnA
  · have hn' : n = A + (n - A) := by omega
    rw [hn', rrun_add, heA]
    by_cases heq : n - A = 0
    · rw [heq, rrun_zero]
      exact readFrame_at c r s hrs hrp _ _ _
    · have hn'' : n - A = 1 + (n - A - 1) := by omega
      rw [hn'', rrun_add, he1]
      exact hmB (n - A - 1) (by omega)

/-- The proof-only model executes the whole routine with the original frame.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the counter up to `min i |x|`, concatenate each bounded advance,
then append `read_finish`. All sub-runs come from the received fragments. -/
private theorem read_model_run (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (r s : Fin m)
    (hrs : r ≠ s) (i : ℕ) (hr : c.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i))
    (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) :
    ∃ T, rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) 1 0) T =
        readAt c s (.inr x[i]?) 1 0 ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s
        (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) 1 0) n) := by
  have rounds : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ min i x.length), ∃ T,
      rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) 1 0) T =
        readAt c s (.inl .eC) ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ k ∧
      ∀ n < T, readFrame c r s
        (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) (readAt c s (.inl .eC) 1 0) n) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro hk; exact ⟨0, rfl, fun n hn => by omega⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      obtain ⟨A, heA, hmA⟩ := ih (by omega)
      obtain ⟨B, heB, hmB⟩ := read_advance c r s hrs i k hr hrp (by omega)
      refine ⟨A + B, by rw [rrun_add, heA, heB], fun n hn => ?_⟩
      by_cases hnA : n < A
      · exact hmA n hnA
      · have hn' : n = A + (n - A) := by omega
        rw [hn', rrun_add, heA]
        exact hmB (n - A) (by omega)
  obtain ⟨A, heA, hmA⟩ := rounds (min i x.length) le_rfl
  obtain ⟨B, heB, hmB⟩ := read_finish c r s hrs i hr hrp
  refine ⟨A + B, by rw [rrun_add, heA, heB], fun n hn => ?_⟩
  by_cases hnA : n < A
  · exact hmA n hnA
  · have hn' : n = A + (n - A) := by omega
    rw [hn', rrun_add, heA]
    exact hmB (n - A) (by omega)

/-- The proof-only model has no calls, so its register run is its ordinary machine run. -/
private theorem read_run_eq (r s : Fin m) (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x) (n : ℕ) :
    rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) c n = (readModel r s).tm.runFrom c n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [rrun_succ, ih, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
    cases hs : ((readModel r s).tm.runFrom c n).state <;>
      simp [rstep, MultiTapeTM.step, hs, readModel]

/-- Every state strictly before an exit in the proof-only model is a fragment phase.

**Proof sketch.** The final exit is live. Earlier configurations are live because halts are
absorbing. An earlier exit would halt on its next step, contradicting that liveness. -/
private theorem read_model_phase (r s : Fin m) (c : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x)
    (T : ℕ) (a : Option Bool)
    (hT : (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) c T).state = some (.inr a)) :
    ∀ n < T, ∃ ph, (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) c n).state = some (.inl ph) := by
  simp only [read_run_eq] at hT ⊢
  have hl := (readModel r s).tm.runFrom_state_ne_none_of_le c T
    (by rw [hT]; simp)
  intro n hn
  cases he : ((readModel r s).tm.runFrom c n).state with
  | none => exact (hl n (by omega) he).elim
  | some l =>
    cases l with
    | inl ph => exact ⟨ph, rfl⟩
    | inr b =>
      exfalso
      apply hl (n + 1) (by omega)
      rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step']
      simp [MultiTapeTM.step, he, readModel, junkAct, Action.apply]

/-- The frozen table commutes with replacing its phase and exit labels. -/
private theorem read_action_map (r s : Fin m) (st : RdPh → Λ) (ex : Option Bool → Λ)
    (ph : RdPh) (a : Option Bool) (w : Fin m → Option Bool) :
    (readTr r s Sum.inl Sum.inr ph a w).mapState (Sum.elim st ex) = readTr r s st ex ph a w := by
  cases ph <;>
    simp [readTr, eqCAct, eqBAct, incCAct, incBAct, rw2Act, toEndAct, clrEAct,
      regAct, mv2Act, xAct, goAct, Action.mapState, apply_ite] <;>
    repeat' first | split | rfl

section Read

variable (P : RProg m d Λ) (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (r s : Fin m) (hrs : r ≠ s)
  (st : RdPh → Λ) (ex : Option Bool → Λ)
  (htr : ∀ ph a w, P.tm.tr (st ph) a w = readTr r s st ex ph a w)
  (hc : ∀ ph, P.call (st ph) = none)

include hrs htr hc in
/-- **The input-read fragment** (phase P4.4b; proved): from phase `eC`, with
`bits i` on the index register `r`, an empty counter register `s`, both heads on cell `0` and
the input head on position `1`, the program reaches the exit `ex x[i]?` — symbol `i` of the
input, `none` when `i ≥ |x|` — in the same configuration otherwise (registers, heads, input
position and output restored). Throughout, only registers `s` and `r` change (the tape of `s`,
the heads of both), both heads stay in `[-1, |bits (|x| + 1)|]`, and every state is an
ordinary fragment state: the fragment's space is these two ranges, independently of `i`.
A hand-built fragment: no received layer reads a general input at a register-held position
(the `Parse` fragments assume unary-first inputs).

**Proof sketch.** Induction on the counter value `k ≤ min i |x|`, the input head on position
`k + 1`. `eq_run` (with `r₁ := s`, so both heads stay within `|bits k|`) compares `bits k`
with `bits i`. If `k = i`, phase `yes` takes `inSym x (i + 1) = x[i]?`. Otherwise phase `no`
reads `inSym x (k + 1)`: at the right blank (`k = |x| < i`) the symbol taken is
`none = x[i]?`; on a letter (`k < |x|`) the head steps right and `inc_run` turns `bits k` into
`bits (k + 1)`, `k + 1 ≤ |x|`. Then `rewind_x` returns the input head to position `1`, and
`clr_run` empties the counter (its head within `|bits k|`). -/
theorem readIn_run (c : Cfg m Bool Λ x) (i : ℕ)
    (hr : c.workTapes r = FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits i)) (hs : c.workTapes s = FinTM.bufferTape [])
    (hrp : c.workTapePos r = 0) (hsp : c.workTapePos s = 0) (hip : c.inputPos.val = 1) :
    ∃ T, rrun P oracle { c with state := some (st .eC) } T = { c with state := some (ex x[i]?) } ∧
      ∀ t < T, ∃ (ph : RdPh) (ip : Fin (x.length + 2)) (f : ℤ → Option Bool) (q q' : ℤ),
        rrun P oracle { c with state := some (st .eC) } t =
          ⟨some (st ph), ip, Function.update c.workTapes s f,
            Function.update (Function.update c.workTapePos s q) r q', c.output⟩ ∧
        -1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (Nat.bits (x.length + 1)).length ∧
        -1 ≤ q' ∧ q' ≤ (Nat.bits (x.length + 1)).length := by
  let c₀ : Cfg m Bool (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) x :=
    ⟨some (.inl .eC), c.inputPos, c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, c.output⟩
  let d₀ := readAt c₀ s (.inl .eC) 1 0
  let rename : (RdPh ⊕ Option Bool) → Λ := Sum.elim st ex
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hmid⟩ := read_model_run c₀ r s hrs i hr hrp
  have hphase := read_model_phase r s d₀ T x[i]? (by rw [hT]; rfl)
  have hm : ∀ n ≤ T, rrun P oracle (d₀.mapState rename) n =
      (rrun (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) d₀ n).mapState rename := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro _; rfl
    | succ n ih =>
      intro hn
      obtain ⟨ph, hph⟩ := hphase n (by omega)
      rw [rrun_succ, ih (by omega), rrun_succ]
      rw [rstep_noncall P oracle _ (st ph) (by simp [Cfg.mapState, hph, rename]) (hc ph),
        rstep_noncall (readModel r s) (fun j => j.elim0) _ (.inl ph) hph rfl]
      simp only [MultiTapeTM.step, Cfg.mapState, hph, Option.map_some, rename, Sum.elim_inl]
      rw [htr]
      rw [← read_action_map]
      rfl
  have hstart : d₀.mapState rename = {c with state := some (st .eC)} := by
    refine Cfg.ext rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ rfl
    · apply Fin.ext; simpa [d₀, c₀, readAt, Cfg.mapState] using hip.symm
    · simp [d₀, c₀, readAt, Cfg.mapState, Nat.zero_bits, ← hs, Function.update_eq_self]
    · simp [d₀, c₀, readAt, Cfg.mapState, ← hsp, Function.update_eq_self]
  rw [← hstart]
  refine ⟨T, ?_, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  · rw [hm T le_rfl, hT]
    refine Cfg.ext rfl ?_ ?_ ?_ rfl
    · apply Fin.ext; simpa [readAt, Cfg.mapState] using hip.symm
    · simp [readAt, c₀, Cfg.mapState, Nat.zero_bits, ← hs, Function.update_eq_self]
    · simp [readAt, c₀, Cfg.mapState, ← hsp, Function.update_eq_self]
  · obtain ⟨ph, hph⟩ := hphase n hn
    obtain ⟨l, ip, f, p, q, he, hlo, hhi, hlo', hhi'⟩ := hmid n hn
    have hl : l = Sum.inl ph := by rw [he] at hph; exact Option.some.inj hph
    subst l
    refine ⟨ph, ip, f, p, q, ?_, hlo, hhi, hlo', hhi'⟩
    rw [hm n (by omega), he]
    rfl

end Read

end LogProg

/-! ## Input access as a language pair -/

/-- The bit language of the identity: `{⟨u, bits i⟩ | uᵢ = 1}` (`0`-based; `false` beyond the
end). -/
def inputBitLang : Language Bool := indexLang fun u i => u.getD i false = true

/-- The length language of the identity: `{⟨u, bits i⟩ | i < |u|}`. -/
def inputLenLang : Language Bool := indexLang fun u i => i < u.length

/-- Reading a paired word by position selects a doubled first-field bit, a separator bit,
or a suffix bit. The default is `false` beyond the complete word. This common address rule
serves the nested layouts of index dropping, query reshaping, and multiplication.

**Proof sketch.** Within the first field, write the address as twice its quotient by two
plus its parity and cite `getElem?_dbl`. Outside that field, the append lookup rule exposes
the separator or the suffix. -/
theorem pairEncode_getD (u v : List Bool) (j : ℕ) :
    (pairEncode u v).getD j false =
      if j < 2 * u.length then u.getD (j / 2) false
      else if j = 2 * u.length then false
      else if j = 2 * u.length + 1 then true
      else v.getD (j - 2 * u.length - 2) false := by
  by_cases hj : j < 2 * u.length
  · rw [if_pos hj, pairEncode_eq_dbl, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.append_assoc, List.getElem?_append_left (by simpa using hj)]
    have hc : j / 2 < u.length := by omega
    have hread : (dbl u)[j]? = some u[j / 2] := by
      rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one j with h | h
      · have he : 2 * (j / 2) + (false : Bool).toNat = j := by simp; omega
        simpa only [he] using getElem?_dbl u (j / 2) hc false
      · have he : 2 * (j / 2) + (true : Bool).toNat = j := by simp; omega
        simpa only [he] using getElem?_dbl u (j / 2) hc true
    rw [hread]
    simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, hc]
  · rw [if_neg hj, pairEncode_eq_dbl, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.append_assoc, List.getElem?_append_right (by simp; omega)]
    simp only [length_dbl]
    by_cases he : j = 2 * u.length
    · subst j; simp
    · rw [if_neg he]
      by_cases he' : j = 2 * u.length + 1
      · subst j; simp
      · rw [if_neg he', show j - 2 * u.length = (j - 2 * u.length - 2) + 1 + 1 by omega]
        rfl

namespace LogProg

open Classical

/-- A length-query/increment loop counts the host input, with all registers bounded by
the chosen bound. The oracle law is needed only up to the first failing query, at the
input length. This shared ARM fragment is used by the query validators.

**Proof sketch.** Induct on the input length minus the current counter. Below the end,
the length call succeeds and increment reduces the remaining count. At the end, the call
fails and exits. The counter never exceeds the input length; all other registers stay
unchanged. Both instructions meet the received ARM syntactic preconditions. -/
theorem inputLength_loop {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} (A : ARM m d Λ)
    (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool) (r : Fin m) (j : Fin d)
    (scan inc done : Λ)
    (hscan : A scan = .call j .whole [r] inc done)
    (hinc : A inc = .inc r scan)
    (hquery : ∀ n ≤ x.length, oracle j (pairEncode x (Nat.bits n)) = decide (n < x.length))
    (B : ℕ) (hB : x.length ≤ B) (v : Fin m → ℕ)
    (hv : ∀ s, v s ≤ B) (hr : v r ≤ x.length) :
    AReach A oracle x (fun a => PreS A x a ∧ ∀ s, a.2.1 s ≤ B)
      (some scan, v, none) (some done, Function.update v r x.length, none) := by
  generalize hN : x.length - v r = N
  induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing v with
  | h N ih =>
    have hs : astep A oracle x (some scan, v, none) =
        (some (if v r < x.length then inc else done), v, none) := by
      simp only [astep, hscan, vword_whole₁, hquery (v r) hr, decide_eq_true_eq]
    have hg : PreS A x (some scan, v, none) ∧ ∀ s, v s ≤ B :=
      ⟨by simp [PreS, hscan], hv⟩
    by_cases hlt : v r < x.length
    · let v' := Function.update v r (v r + 1)
      have hv' : ∀ s, v' s ≤ B := by
        intro s
        by_cases he : s = r
        · subst s; dsimp [v']; rw [Function.update_self]; omega
        · simpa [v', Function.update_of_ne he] using hv s
      have hr' : v' r ≤ x.length := by simp [v']; omega
      have hremain : x.length - v' r < N := by simp [v']; omega
      have hc := ih (x.length - v' r) hremain v' hv' hr' rfl
      have hi : astep A oracle x (some inc, v, none) = (some scan, v', none) := by
        simp [astep, hinc, v']
      apply AReach.step hg
      rw [hs, if_pos hlt]
      apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hinc], hv⟩
      rw [hi]
      simpa only [v', Function.update_idem] using hc
    · have he : v r = x.length := by omega
      have hp := AReach.single (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := x)
        (G := fun a => PreS A x a ∧ ∀ s, a.2.1 s ≤ B) (a := (some scan, v, none)) hg
      have hs' : astep A oracle x (some scan, v, none) = (some done, v, none) := by
        rw [hs, if_neg hlt]
      have hvdone : Function.update v r x.length = v := by
        rw [← he, Function.update_eq_self]
      rw [hvdone]
      simpa only [hs'] using hp

/-- A bounded straight sequence of register increments. The labels may belong to any
larger ARM; no new reachability relation is needed. -/
private lemma arm_increments {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} (A : ARM m d Λ)
    (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool) (r : Fin m)
    (labels : ℕ → Λ) (k B : ℕ)
    (hcode : ∀ i < k, A (labels i) = .inc r (labels (i + 1)))
    (v : Fin m → ℕ) (hv : ∀ s, v s ≤ B) (hk : v r + k ≤ B) :
    AReach A oracle x (fun a => PreS A x a ∧ ∀ s, a.2.1 s ≤ B)
      (some (labels 0), v, none)
      (some (labels k), Function.update v r (v r + k), none) := by
  induction k generalizing labels v with
  | zero => simpa only [Nat.add_zero, Function.update_eq_self] using
      (AReach.refl (A := A) (oracle := oracle) (x := x)
        (G := fun a => PreS A x a ∧ ∀ s, a.2.1 s ≤ B) (some (labels 0), v, none))
  | succ k ih =>
    have hc := hcode 0 (by omega)
    apply AReach.step ⟨by simp [PreS, hc], hv⟩
    simp only [astep, hc]
    have hv' : ∀ s, Function.update v r (v r + 1) s ≤ B := by
      intro s
      by_cases hs : s = r
      · subst s; simp; omega
      · simpa [Function.update_of_ne hs] using hv s
    have hp := ih (fun i => labels (i + 1))
      (fun i hi => hcode (i + 1) (by omega)) (Function.update v r (v r + 1)) hv'
      (by simp; omega)
    simpa only [Function.update_self, Function.update_idem, Nat.add_assoc,
      Nat.add_comm 1 k] using hp

/-- An aligned pair scan using the input-bit oracle, at any positive stride. It rejects
exactly failed pair decodes and otherwise leaves the pointer just beyond the separator.
The scan imposes no canonicality condition on either field. Four increment chains move
past a first `false`, a first `true`, an equal pair, or the separator respectively.

**Proof sketch.** Induct by two input letters. An empty word fails the first end test;
a singleton fails the second. Equal letters advance and recur, `01` exits at the payload,
and `10` rejects. Each advance is `arm_increments`; all pointer values stay below the
supplied end address. This is the shared aligned-scan argument for nested query layouts. -/
theorem alignedPair_loop {m d : ℕ} {Λ : Type} (A : ARM m d Λ)
    (oracle : Fin d → List Bool → Bool) (x : List Bool)
    (r limit : Fin m) (j : Fin d) (scan first : Λ) (test read : Bool → Λ)
    (fail done : Λ) (advance : Fin 4 → ℕ → Λ) (stride B : ℕ)
    (hstride : 0 < stride) (hrlimit : r ≠ limit)
    (hscan : A scan = .jeq r limit fail first)
    (hfirst : A first = .call j .whole [r] (advance 1 0) (advance 0 0))
    (htest : ∀ b, A (test b) = .jeq r limit fail (read b))
    (hread : ∀ b, A (read b) = .call j .whole [r]
      (if b then advance 2 0 else advance 3 0) (if b then fail else advance 2 0))
    (hadvance : ∀ k i, i < stride → A (advance k i) = .inc r (advance k (i + 1)))
    (hend : advance 0 stride = test false ∧ advance 1 stride = test true ∧
      advance 2 stride = scan ∧ advance 3 stride = done)
    (w : List Bool) (v : Fin m → ℕ) (hv : ∀ s, v s ≤ B)
    (hlimit : v limit = v r + stride * w.length)
    (horacle : ∀ i < w.length,
      oracle j (pairEncode x (Nat.bits (v r + stride * i))) = w.getD i false) :
    match pairDecode w with
